struct ShadowBenchmarkSample
{
    uint64_t Count = 0, Vertices = 0, Draws = 0, MaxVertices = 0;
    double Gpu = 0, Cpu = 0, ShadowGpu = 0, FrameMs = 0;
    vector<RenderProfiler::PassTiming> PassTotals;
    uint64_t GpuSamples = 0;
};
array<ShadowBenchmarkSample, 3> g_ShadowBenchmark{};
uint64_t g_ShadowBenchmarkSerial = 0;

bool PlayRenderTestEnabled()
{
    char value[8]{};
    GetEnvironmentVariableA("DX12_PLAY_RENDER_TEST", value, sizeof(value));
    return atoi(value) != 0;
}

bool ShadowBenchmarkEnabled()
{
    char value[8]{};
    GetEnvironmentVariableA("DX12_PLAY_RENDER_BENCH", value, sizeof(value));
    return atoi(value) != 0;
}

void RecordShadowBenchmark()
{
    const auto& snapshot = RenderProfiler::GetLatest();
    if (!snapshot.PipelineStatisticsValid || snapshot.Serial == g_ShadowBenchmarkSerial) return;
    g_ShadowBenchmarkSerial = snapshot.Serial;
    const uint64_t serial = snapshot.Serial;
    const int phase = serial >= 27 && serial <= 75 ? 1 :
        (serial >= 107 && serial <= 155 ? 2 : (serial >= 8 && serial <= 18 ? 0 : -1));
    if (phase < 0) return;
    auto& sample = g_ShadowBenchmark[phase];
    ++sample.Count;
    sample.Vertices += snapshot.Pipeline.IAVertices;
    sample.MaxVertices = max(sample.MaxVertices, snapshot.Pipeline.IAVertices);
    sample.Draws += snapshot.Calls.DrawCalls;
    sample.Gpu += snapshot.GpuRenderMs;
    sample.Cpu += snapshot.CpuRenderMs;
    sample.FrameMs += World::GetFrameTimeMs();
    if (snapshot.GpuTimingValid)
    {
        ++sample.GpuSamples;
        for (const auto& pass : snapshot.Passes)
        {
            if (pass.Name == "Shadow")
            {
                sample.ShadowGpu += pass.GpuMs;
            }
            auto total = find_if(sample.PassTotals.begin(), sample.PassTotals.end(),
                [&](const auto& entry) { return entry.Name == pass.Name; });
            if (total == sample.PassTotals.end())
            {
                sample.PassTotals.push_back({pass.Name});
                total = prev(sample.PassTotals.end());
            }
            total->CpuMs += pass.CpuMs;
            total->GpuMs += pass.GpuMs;
            total->DrawCalls += pass.DrawCalls;
        }
    }
}
void Check(bool passed, const char* name);

bool SunLightingTestEnabled()
{
    char value[8]{};
    return GetEnvironmentVariableA("DX12_SUN_LIGHTING_TEST", value, sizeof(value)) && atoi(value) != 0;
}
EntityID g_TestSun = g_kINVALID_ENTITY;
array<double, 5> g_SunRadiance{};
array<array<double, 3>, 5> g_SunColors{};
void BeforeSunLightingFrame(uint64_t frame)
{
    g_FrameCount = frame + 1;
    const uint64_t phase = frame <= 10 ? frame : (frame <= 20 ? frame - 10 : 10);
    if (frame == 11)
    {
        auto& transform = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<TransformComponent>(g_TestSun);
        transform.Position = {0, 1.568f, -10}; // 8.9 degree sun elevation, matching the reported morning.
        transform.IsDirty = true;
        ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<LightComponent>(g_TestSun).Color = {1, 0.35f, 0.08f, 1};
    }
    if (frame == 0)
    {
        vector<EntityID> removed;
        for (EntityID id : World::GetView<TransformComponent>())
        {
            if (ComponentManager::HasComponent<MeshComponent>(id) &&
                ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<MeshComponent>(id).IsEnvironment)
            {
                Entity(id).SetName("Renamed Environment Regression Sky");
                continue; // Environment identity must not depend on its editable name.
            }
            if (!ComponentManager::HasComponent<CameraComponent>(id)) removed.push_back(id);
        }
        for (auto id : removed) World::DestroyEntity(Entity(id));
        Entity environment = World::CreateEntity().Add<NameComponent>().Add<MeshComponent>()
            .Add<StaticModelComponent>().Add<TransformComponent>().Add<MaterialComponent>();
        environment.SetName("Renamed Environment Regression Sky");
        environment.Get<MeshComponent>().IsEnvironment = true;
        environment.Get<TransformComponent>().Scale = {50, 50, 50};
        environment.Get<TransformComponent>().IsDirty = true;
        environment.Get<StaticModelComponent>().ModelId = ModelManager::LoadStaticModel("asset/model/sky/sky.obj");
        environment.Get<MaterialComponent>().ShaderClassMode = MaterialMode::Manual;
        environment.Get<MaterialComponent>().ShaderClass = ShaderClass::Unlit;
        g_TestSun = Sun::Create({0, 8, -8}, {0, 0, 0});
        Entity cube = World::CreateEntity().Add<NameComponent>().Add<MeshComponent>()
            .Add<TransformComponent>().Add<MaterialComponent>();
        cube.SetName("Sun Lighting Regression Cube");
        auto& material = cube.Get<MaterialComponent>();
        material.ShaderClassMode = MaterialMode::Manual;
        material.ShaderClass = ShaderClass::PBR;
        material.Metallic = 0;
        material.Roughness = 0.8f;
        VertexResource resource;
        resource.entityid = cube.GetID();
        resource.objectType = ObjectType::CUBE;
        resource.color = Color::WHITE;
        PrimitiveGeometry::CreateObjectVertex(resource);
        auto id = Camera::GetCameraEntity();
        auto& transform = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<TransformComponent>(id);
        transform.Position = {0, 3, -8};
        transform.IsDirty = true;
        auto& camera = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<CameraComponent>(id);
        camera.Target = {0, 0, 0};
        camera.AllowUserControl = false;
        camera.LockOnTarget = g_kINVALID_ENTITY;
    }
    RenderConfiguration::SetHdr(true);
    RenderConfiguration::SetResolutionScale(1.0f);
    DayNightCycle::GetSettings().Running = false;
    DayNightCycle::GetSettings().TimeDriven = false;
    DayNightCycle::GetSettings().AutomaticLighting = false;
    RenderConfiguration::SetRenderMode(RenderMode::DEFERRED);
    RendererSettings::SetMeshShadersEnabled(false);
    RendererSettings::SetComputeGBufferEnabled(false);
    RendererSettings::SetSsaoEnabled(false);
    RendererSettings::SetSsgiEnabled(false);
    RendererSettings::SetUpscaleMode(UpscaleMode::Bilateral);
    auto& rays = Raytracing::GetSettings();
    rays.Enabled = true;
    rays.Reflections = true;
    rays.Denoise = false;
    rays.Shadows = true;
    rays.RenderMode = phase >= 7 && phase <= 8 ? Raytracing::Mode::Full : Raytracing::Mode::ReflectionsOnly;
    RendererSettings::SetShadowMapMethod(phase >= 5 && phase <= 6 ?
        ShadowMapMethod::VirtualShadowMap : ShadowMapMethod::ShadowMap);
    auto& sun = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<LightComponent>(g_TestSun);
    sun.IsActive = phase < 9;
    sun.CastShadow = phase >= 3;
    sun.AffectsVolumetrics = false;
}
void AfterSunLightingFrame(uint64_t frame)
{
    if (frame < 2 || frame > 20 || frame % 2) return;
    const uint64_t phase = frame <= 10 ? frame : frame - 10;
    Check(phase == 8 ? Raytracing::UsesRaytracedShadows() : !Raytracing::UsesRaytracedShadows(),
        "sun regression uses the requested raster or raytraced shadow path");
    if (phase == 4 || phase == 6)
        for (EntityID id : World::GetView<MeshComponent>())
            if (ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<MeshComponent>(id).IsEnvironment)
                Check(!LightingResources::ShouldDrawEntityInCurrentShadowPass(id),
                    "environment mesh is excluded from shadow culling and bounds");
    RenderCapture::TextureData image, materials;
    bool read = RenderCapture::ReadTexture(RenderTargets::GetSceneResource(), image) &&
        RenderCapture::ReadTexture(RenderTargets::GetGBufferResource(GBufferType::MATERIAL), materials);
    const bool compatible = read && image.Format == DXGI_FORMAT_R16G16B16A16_FLOAT &&
        materials.Format == DXGI_FORMAT_R16G16B16A16_FLOAT &&
        image.Width == materials.Width && image.Height == materials.Height;
    Check(compatible, "read sun regression HDR and PBR mask");
    if (!compatible) return;
    double sum = 0;
    array<double, 3> channels{};
    uint32_t pixels = 0;
    for (uint32_t y = 0; y < image.Height; ++y)
    {
        auto* color = reinterpret_cast<const uint16_t*>(image.Bytes.data() + y * image.RowPitch);
        auto* mask = reinterpret_cast<const uint16_t*>(materials.Bytes.data() + y * materials.RowPitch);
        for (uint32_t x = 0; x < image.Width; ++x)
            if (abs(RenderCapture::HalfToFloat(mask[x * 4 + 3]) - 11.f) < 0.1f)
            {
                sum += 0.2126 * RenderCapture::HalfToFloat(color[x * 4]) +
                    0.7152 * RenderCapture::HalfToFloat(color[x * 4 + 1]) +
                    0.0722 * RenderCapture::HalfToFloat(color[x * 4 + 2]);
                for (uint32_t c = 0; c < 3; ++c) channels[c] += RenderCapture::HalfToFloat(color[x * 4 + c]);
                ++pixels;
            }
    }
    Check(pixels > 100, "sun regression includes visible PBR pixels");
    g_SunRadiance[phase / 2 - 1] = pixels ? sum / pixels : 0;
    WriteGraphicsLog("Sun lighting regression frame=%llu radiance=%.6f pixels=%u\n", frame,
        g_SunRadiance[phase / 2 - 1], pixels);
    for (uint32_t c = 0; c < 3; ++c) g_SunColors[phase / 2 - 1][c] = pixels ? channels[c] / pixels : 0;
    if (phase == 10)
    {
        double direct = g_SunRadiance[0] - g_SunRadiance[4];
        Check(direct > 0.05, "virtual sun lights unshadowed PBR surface");
        Check(g_SunRadiance[1] - g_SunRadiance[4] > direct * 0.5,
            "reflection-only ShadowMap preserves sun on unoccluded PBR surface");
        Check(g_SunRadiance[2] - g_SunRadiance[4] > direct * 0.5,
            "reflection-only Virtual ShadowMap preserves sun on unoccluded PBR surface");
        Check(g_SunRadiance[3] - g_SunRadiance[4] > direct * 0.5,
            "full raytracing preserves sun on unoccluded PBR surface");
        if (frame == 20)
            for (uint32_t path = 1; path <= 3; ++path)
            {
                double red = g_SunColors[path][0] - g_SunColors[4][0];
                double green = g_SunColors[path][1] - g_SunColors[4][1];
                double blue = g_SunColors[path][2] - g_SunColors[4][2];
                WriteGraphicsLog("Sun morning direct path=%u RGB=%.6f,%.6f,%.6f\n", path, red, green, blue);
                Check(red > green * 1.4 && green > blue * 1.3,
                    "morning sun color reaches PBR in raster and raytraced shadow paths");
            }
    }
}

void ValidateReflectionDenoising(const RenderCapture::TextureData& filtered)
{
    if (!NrdDenoiser::IsCompiled()) return;
    RenderCapture::TextureData noisy;
    const bool read = RenderCapture::ReadTexture(RayReflections::GetNoisyResource(), noisy);
    Check(read && noisy.Width == filtered.Width && noisy.Height == filtered.Height,
        "read matching raw NRD reflection input");
    if (!read || noisy.Width != filtered.Width || noisy.Height != filtered.Height) return;

    // NRD's input Y channel is 0.25 R + 0.5 G + 0.25 B. Compare the same luminance
    // in the composed RGB output. Neighbor differences measure high-frequency variation;
    // skip background and hit/miss boundaries so silhouettes do not dominate this fixture.
    double rawVariation = 0, filteredVariation = 0;
    UINT pairs = 0;
    for (UINT y = 0; y < filtered.Height; ++y)
    {
        const auto* raw = reinterpret_cast<const uint16_t*>(noisy.Bytes.data() + y * noisy.RowPitch);
        const auto* output = reinterpret_cast<const uint16_t*>(filtered.Bytes.data() + y * filtered.RowPitch);
        for (UINT x = 1; x < filtered.Width; ++x)
        {
            const UINT current = x * 4, previous = current - 4;
            const float distance = RenderCapture::HalfToFloat(output[current + 3]);
            const float previousDistance = RenderCapture::HalfToFloat(output[previous + 3]);
            if (abs(distance) < 0.01f || abs(previousDistance) < 0.01f) continue;
            const auto luminance = [&](UINT index)
            {
                return 0.25f * RenderCapture::HalfToFloat(output[index]) +
                    0.5f * RenderCapture::HalfToFloat(output[index + 1]) +
                    0.25f * RenderCapture::HalfToFloat(output[index + 2]);
            };
            rawVariation += abs(RenderCapture::HalfToFloat(raw[current]) - RenderCapture::HalfToFloat(raw[previous]));
            filteredVariation += abs(luminance(current) - luminance(previous));
            ++pairs;
        }
    }
    WriteGraphicsLog("Validation NRD reflection: neighbor pairs=%u rawVariation=%.6f filteredVariation=%.6f\n",
        pairs, rawVariation / max(pairs, 1u), filteredVariation / max(pairs, 1u));
    Check(pairs > 100 && rawVariation > 0 && filteredVariation < rawVariation,
        "NRD reduces reflection high-frequency variation in the test scene");
}

void ValidateVertexDeformation()
{
    VertexDeformationView view;
    const bool resolved = VertexDeformation::TryResolveMesh(g_Mover, view);
    Check(resolved && VertexDeformation::GetDispatchCount() > 0, "GPU procedural vertex dispatch");
    if (!resolved) return;
    const auto& mesh = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<MeshComponent>(g_Mover);
    const auto& motion = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<ProceduralMotionComponent>(g_Mover);
    vector<uint8_t> current, previous;
    const bool read = RenderCapture::ReadBuffer(view.CurrentResource,
        D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_VERTEX_AND_CONSTANT_BUFFER, view.CurrentView.SizeInBytes, current) &&
        RenderCapture::ReadBuffer(view.PreviousResource,
            D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_VERTEX_AND_CONSTANT_BUFFER, view.PreviousView.SizeInBytes, previous);
    Check(read, "read current and previous GPU vertices");
    if (!read) return;
    void* mapped = nullptr;
    const CD3DX12_RANGE noRead(0, 0);
    if (FAILED(mesh.VertexBuffer->Map(0, &noRead, &mapped)))
    {
        Check(false, "map immutable procedural base vertices");
        return;
    }
    Procedural::VertexMotionSettings settings;
    settings.Method = motion.Method;
    settings.Amplitude = { motion.Amplitude.x, motion.Amplitude.y, motion.Amplitude.z };
    settings.Speed = motion.Speed;
    settings.SpatialFrequency = motion.SpatialFrequency;
    settings.Seed = motion.Seed;
    bool positions = true, normals = true, attributes = true, moved = false;
    const auto close = [](float a, float b, float tolerance) { return isfinite(a) && abs(a - b) < tolerance; };
    for (UINT index = 0; index < mesh.VertexCount; ++index)
    {
        const auto& base = static_cast<const Vertex*>(mapped)[index];
        const auto& now = reinterpret_cast<const Vertex*>(current.data())[index];
        const auto& old = reinterpret_cast<const Vertex*>(previous.data())[index];
        const Procedural::Vector3 basePosition{ base.Pos.x, base.Pos.y, base.Pos.z };
        const auto expected = Procedural::DeformPosition(basePosition, settings, motion.Time);
        const auto expectedPrevious = Procedural::DeformPosition(basePosition, settings, g_PreviousVertexTime);
        const auto normal = Procedural::DeformNormal(basePosition,
            { base.Normal.x, base.Normal.y, base.Normal.z }, settings, motion.Time);
        positions &= close(now.Pos.x, expected.X, 0.002f) && close(now.Pos.y, expected.Y, 0.002f) &&
            close(now.Pos.z, expected.Z, 0.002f) && close(old.Pos.x, expectedPrevious.X, 0.002f) &&
            close(old.Pos.y, expectedPrevious.Y, 0.002f) && close(old.Pos.z, expectedPrevious.Z, 0.002f);
        normals &= close(now.Normal.x, normal.X, 0.02f) && close(now.Normal.y, normal.Y, 0.02f) && close(now.Normal.z, normal.Z, 0.02f);
        attributes &= memcmp(&now.Tex, &base.Tex, sizeof(base.Tex)) == 0 &&
            memcmp(&now.Color, &base.Color, sizeof(base.Color)) == 0;
        moved |= abs(now.Pos.y - base.Pos.y) > 0.001f;
    }
    const CD3DX12_RANGE noWrite(0, 0);
    mesh.VertexBuffer->Unmap(0, &noWrite);
    Check(positions && moved, "GPU positions and motion history agree with CPU reference");
    Check(normals && attributes, "GPU deformed normals and unchanged UV/color");
}

void Check(bool passed, const char* name)
{
    if (!passed)
    {
        ++g_Failures;
    }
    const char* result = "FAIL";
    if (passed)
    {
        result = "PASS";
    }
    WriteGraphicsLog("Validation: %s %s\n", result, name);
}

void CreateTestScene()
{
    // Check the real startup scene, including registration from separate .cpp files.
    const char* startupNames[] = {
        "Cube", "polygon3d", "XBot", "field", "Moca", "Karen",
        "Kacchatta_Hone", "Alicia"
    };
    for (const char* name : startupNames)
    {
        unsigned int count = 0;
        for (EntityID id : World::GetView<NameComponent>())
        {
            if (ComponentManager::GetComponent<NameComponent>(id).Name == name)
            {
                ++count;
            }
        }
        const string checkName = string("auto-registered startup entity created once: ") + name;
        Check(count == 1, checkName.c_str());
    }

    bool startupSky = false;
    for (EntityID id : World::GetView<MeshComponent>())
        startupSky |= ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<MeshComponent>(id).IsEnvironment;
    Check(!startupSky, "physical atmosphere startup does not create a legacy Sky object");

    RendererSettings::SetMeshShadersEnabled(true);
    D3D12_FEATURE_DATA_D3D12_OPTIONS7 meshOptions{};
    if (SUCCEEDED(GraphicsDevice::GetDevice()->CheckFeatureSupport(D3D12_FEATURE_D3D12_OPTIONS7, &meshOptions, sizeof(meshOptions))) &&
        meshOptions.MeshShaderTier != D3D12_MESH_SHADER_TIER_NOT_SUPPORTED)
        Check(MeshShaderPipeline::IsAvailable(), "mesh shader pipelines initialize on supported hardware");
    const auto suns = World::GetView<SunComponent>();
    if (suns.begin() == suns.end())
    {
        Check(Sun::CreateDefault() != g_kINVALID_ENTITY, "create simulation Sun");
    }
    for (EntityID sun : World::GetView<SunComponent>())
    {
        Check(!ComponentManager::HasComponent<MeshComponent>(sun) &&
            !ComponentManager::HasComponent<MaterialComponent>(sun), "virtual Sun has no rendered mesh or material");
    }
    Procedural::TerrainSettings terrain;
    terrain.Resolution = 24;
    g_Terrain = ProceduralScene::GenerateTerrain(terrain);
    Check(g_Terrain != g_kINVALID_ENTITY, "generate terrain");
    Entity mover = World::CreateEntity().Add<NameComponent>().Add<MeshComponent>()
        .Add<TransformComponent>().Add<MaterialComponent>().Add<ProceduralMotionComponent>();
    mover.SetName("Procedural Validation Cube");
    g_Mover = mover.GetID();
    auto& transform = mover.Get<TransformComponent>();
    transform.Position = { 0.0f, 4.0f, 0.0f };
    mover.Get<MaterialComponent>().ShaderClassMode = MaterialMode::Manual;
    mover.Get<MaterialComponent>().ShaderClass = ShaderClass::PBR;
    mover.Get<ProceduralMotionComponent>().Origin = transform.Position;
    mover.Get<ProceduralMotionComponent>().Amplitude = { 1.0f, 0.75f, 1.0f };
    VertexResource resource;
    resource.entityid = mover.GetID();
    resource.objectType = ObjectType::CUBE;
    resource.color = Color::WHITE;
    PrimitiveGeometry::CreateObjectVertex(resource);
    Check(ProceduralScene::SavePreset("bin/validation/terrain.proc", terrain), "save terrain preset");
    Procedural::TerrainSettings restored;
    Check(ProceduralScene::LoadPreset("bin/validation/terrain.proc", restored) &&
        Procedural::BuildHeightMap(restored) == Procedural::BuildHeightMap(terrain), "load reproducible terrain preset");
    const auto before = restored;
    ofstream invalid("bin/validation/invalid.proc");
    invalid << "PROCEDURAL_TERRAIN 1\n99 0 nan 100 0 0 0\n-1 0 0 0\n";
    invalid.close();
    Check(!ProceduralScene::LoadPreset("bin/validation/invalid.proc", restored) &&
        restored.Noise.Seed == before.Noise.Seed, "reject invalid preset without mutation");
    ostringstream configuration;
    SimulationConfiguration::Save(configuration);
    istringstream records(configuration.str());
    string line;
    while (getline(records, line))
    {
        const size_t delimiter = line.find('=');
        Check(SimulationConfiguration::TryLoad(line.substr(0, delimiter), line.substr(delimiter + 1)), "simulation configuration roundtrip");
    }
    for (auto mode : { Raytracing::Mode::ReflectionsOnly, Raytracing::Mode::Full })
    {
        Raytracing::GetSettings().RenderMode = mode;
        ostringstream saved;
        SimulationConfiguration::Save(saved);
        Raytracing::GetSettings().RenderMode = mode == Raytracing::Mode::Full ?
            Raytracing::Mode::ReflectionsOnly : Raytracing::Mode::Full;
        istringstream reload(saved.str());
        while (getline(reload, line))
        {
            const size_t delimiter = line.find('=');
            SimulationConfiguration::TryLoad(line.substr(0, delimiter), line.substr(delimiter + 1));
        }
        Check(Raytracing::GetSettings().RenderMode == mode, "raytracing mode survives save/load");
    }
}

void ValidateRayTexture()
{
    RenderCapture::TextureData data;
    if (!Raytracing::IsActive())
    {
        return;
    }
    Check(RenderCapture::ReadTexture(Raytracing::GetResultResource(), data), "read raytracing texture");
    UINT shadowed = 0;
    UINT occluded = 0;
    bool finite = true;
    for (UINT row = 0; row < data.Height; ++row)
    {
        const auto* values = reinterpret_cast<const uint16_t*>(data.Bytes.data() + static_cast<size_t>(row) * data.RowPitch);
        for (UINT column = 0; column < data.Width; ++column)
        {
            const float shadow = RenderCapture::HalfToFloat(values[column * 2]);
            const float ambient = RenderCapture::HalfToFloat(values[column * 2 + 1]);
            finite &= isfinite(shadow) && isfinite(ambient) && shadow >= 0.0f && shadow <= 1.0f && ambient >= 0.0f && ambient <= 1.0f;
            shadowed += shadow < 0.99f;
            occluded += ambient < 0.99f;
        }
    }
    Check(finite, "finite bounded ray visibility");
    Check(shadowed > 0 && occluded > 0, "rays intersect scene geometry");
    WriteGraphicsLog("Validation: ray hits shadow=%u ao=%u instances=%u\n", shadowed, occluded, Raytracing::GetInstanceCount());
}

void ValidateSkyBrightness(bool night)
{
    RenderCapture::TextureData texture;
    if (!RenderCapture::ReadTexture(RenderTargets::GetEditorSceneResource(), texture))
    {
        Check(false, "read atmospheric sky");
        return;
    }
    double total = 0;
    UINT samples = 0;
    for (UINT row = texture.Height / 32; row < texture.Height / 6; row += 4)
    {
        for (UINT column = 0; column < texture.Width; column += 4)
        {
            const BYTE* pixel = texture.Bytes.data() + static_cast<size_t>(row) * texture.RowPitch;
            float red, green, blue;
            if (texture.Format == DXGI_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM)
            {
                pixel += column * 4;
                red = pixel[0] / 255.0f;
                green = pixel[1] / 255.0f;
                blue = pixel[2] / 255.0f;
            }
            else
            {
                const auto* color = reinterpret_cast<const uint16_t*>(pixel) + column * 4;
                red = RenderCapture::HalfToFloat(color[0]);
                green = RenderCapture::HalfToFloat(color[1]);
                blue = RenderCapture::HalfToFloat(color[2]);
            }
            total += red * 0.2126f + green * 0.7152f + blue * 0.0722f;
            ++samples;
        }
    }
    const float luminance = samples ? static_cast<float>(total / samples) : 0.0f;
    Check(isfinite(luminance) && luminance > 0, "finite visible atmospheric sky");
    if (night)
    {
        Check(g_NoonSkyLuminance > luminance * 1.5f, "night sky is darker than noon");
    }
    else
    {
        g_NoonSkyLuminance = luminance;
    }
    WriteGraphicsLog("Validation: %s sky luminance %.4f\n", night ? "night" : "noon", luminance);
}
}

bool RenderingValidation::IsEnabled()
{
    char value[8]{};
    return GetEnvironmentVariableA("DX12_FEATURE_SMOKE_TEST", value, sizeof(value)) > 0 && atoi(value) != 0;
}

void RenderingValidation::BeforeFrame(uint64_t frame)
{
    if (VirtualGeometryProduction::ValidationEnabled())
    {
        VirtualGeometryProduction::BeforeFrame(frame);
        return;
    }
    if (PlayRenderTestEnabled())
    {
        if (ShadowBenchmarkEnabled())
        {
            if (frame == 1)
            {
                World::SetVSyncEnabled(false);
                World::SetFixedFrameRateEnabled(false);
                Check(Raytracing::GetSettings().RenderMode == Raytracing::Mode::ReflectionsOnly &&
                    RendererSettings::GetShadowMapMethod() == ShadowMapMethod::VirtualShadowMap,
                    "VSM benchmark keeps reflections-only raytracing throughout");
            }
            if (frame == 20)
            {
                SetEnvironmentVariableA("DX12_SHADOW_REFERENCE_DRAW", "1");
                ProjectManager::Play();
            }
            if (frame == 80)
            {
                ProjectManager::Stop();
                SetEnvironmentVariableA("DX12_SHADOW_REFERENCE_DRAW", "0");
            }
            if (frame == 100) ProjectManager::Play();
            if (frame == 160) ProjectManager::Stop();
            return;
        }
        if (frame == 20) ProjectManager::Play();
        if (frame == 46)
        {
            ProjectManager::TogglePause();
            g_PlayCacheEnabled = RendererSettings::GetCacheVirtualShadowPages();
            RendererSettings::SetCacheVirtualShadowPages(false);
            SetEnvironmentVariableA("DX12_SHADOW_REFERENCE_DRAW", "1");
        }
        if (frame == 49) SetEnvironmentVariableA("DX12_SHADOW_REFERENCE_DRAW", nullptr);
        if (frame == 52) RendererSettings::SetCacheVirtualShadowPages(true);
        if (frame >= 52 && frame <= 60)
        {
            // Dirty moving-caster keys without changing the paused pose. This
            // exercises stationary-depth reuse against the same reference image.
            for (auto entity : World::GetView<AnimationModelComponent>())
                ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<AnimationModelComponent>(entity).CurrentTime += 0.0001f;
        }
        if (frame == 65)
        {
            ProjectManager::Stop();
            RendererSettings::SetCacheVirtualShadowPages(g_PlayCacheEnabled);
        }
        return;
    }
    if (ThumbnailValidation::Enabled()) { ThumbnailValidation::BeforeFrame(frame); return; }
    if (MaterialValidation::Enabled())
    {
        MaterialValidation::BeforeFrame(frame);
        return;
    }
    if (CloudValidation::Enabled())
    {
        ImGuiManager::m_HdrEnabled = true;
        ImGuiManager::m_ToneMapEnabled = true;
        if (frame == 0) BeforeSunLightingFrame(0);
        CloudValidation::BeforeFrame(frame);
        return;
    }
    if (SunLightingTestEnabled())
    {
        ImGuiManager::m_HdrEnabled = true;
        ImGuiManager::m_ToneMapEnabled = false;
        BeforeSunLightingFrame(frame);
        return;
    }
    if (VirtualGeometryStreamingValidation::Enabled()) { VirtualGeometryStreamingValidation::BeforeFrame(frame); return; }
    if (VirtualGeometryValidation::Enabled()) { VirtualGeometryValidation::BeforeFrame(frame); return; }
    if (MeshletValidation::Enabled()) { MeshletValidation::BeforeFrame(frame); return; }
    if (GPUVisibilityValidation::Enabled()) { GPUVisibilityValidation::BeforeFrame(frame); return; }
    if (GPUDrivenValidation::Enabled()) { GPUDrivenValidation::BeforeFrame(frame); return; }
    if (!IsEnabled())
    {
        return;
    }
    if (frame == 0)
    {
        char startup[8]{};
        if (GetEnvironmentVariableA("DX12_VALIDATION_DLSS_STARTUP", startup, sizeof(startup)) > 0 && atoi(startup) != 0)
        {
            RendererSettings::SetUpscaleMode(UpscaleMode::Dlss);
        }
        filesystem::create_directories("bin/validation");
        CreateTestScene();
    }
    g_FrameCount = frame + 1;
    const float hours[] = { 6.0f, 12.0f, 18.0f, 0.0f };
    DayNightCycle::GetSettings().Running = false;
    DayNightCycle::GetSettings().DayOfYear = 81;
    DayNightCycle::SetTime(hours[(frame / 8) % 4]);
    Raytracing::GetSettings().Enabled = frame < 32 || frame >= 36;
    Raytracing::GetSettings().Reflections = (frame < 24 || frame >= 28) && frame != 18;
    Raytracing::GetSettings().Shadows = true;
    Raytracing::GetSettings().RenderMode = (frame == 12 || frame == 13) ?
        Raytracing::Mode::ReflectionsOnly : Raytracing::Mode::Full;
    if (frame == 12) RendererSettings::SetShadowMapMethod(ShadowMapMethod::ShadowMap);
    if (frame == 13) RendererSettings::SetShadowMapMethod(ShadowMapMethod::VirtualShadowMap);
    if (frame == 8)
    {
        ProjectManager::Play();
    }
    if (frame == 16)
    {
        g_PausedTime = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<ProceduralMotionComponent>(g_Mover).Time;
        ProjectManager::TogglePause();
    }
    if (frame == 18)
    {
        ProjectManager::TogglePause();
    }
    if (frame == 20)
    {
        ProjectManager::Stop();
    }
    if (frame == 24)
    {
        const auto before = ImGuiManager::CaptureEntity(g_Terrain);
        g_OriginalTerrainHash = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<MeshComponent>(g_Terrain).GeometryHash;
        auto settings = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<ProceduralTerrainComponent>(g_Terrain).Settings;
        settings.Noise.Method = Procedural::NoiseMethod::DomainWarp;
        settings.Noise.Seed = 123;
        Check(ProceduralScene::GenerateTerrain(settings, g_Terrain) == g_Terrain, "regenerate existing terrain");
        ImGuiManager::PushUndoSnapshot(before);
    }
    if (frame == 21)
    {
        RendererSettings::SetComputeGBufferEnabled(false);
        auto& motion = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<ProceduralMotionComponent>(g_Mover);
        motion.Target = Procedural::MotionTarget::MeshVertices;
        motion.PreviewInEditor = true;
        motion.Speed = 0.4f;
        motion.Time = 0.6;
        VertexDeformation::ResetHistory(g_Mover);
    }
    if (frame >= 22 && frame <= 38)
        g_PreviousVertexTime = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<ProceduralMotionComponent>(g_Mover).Time;
    if (frame == 39)
        ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<ProceduralMotionComponent>(g_Mover).Enabled = false;
    if (frame == 30)
    {
        auto terrain = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<ProceduralTerrainComponent>(g_Terrain).Settings;
        terrain.Resolution = 256;
        Check(ProceduralScene::GenerateTerrain(terrain, g_Terrain) == g_Terrain, "generate large terrain for mesh shader validation");
        RendererSettings::SetComputeGBufferEnabled(true);
    }
    if (frame == 25)
    {
        ImGuiManager::Undo();
        Check(ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<ProceduralTerrainComponent>(g_Terrain).Settings.Noise.Method ==
            Procedural::NoiseMethod::Fractal &&
            ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<MeshComponent>(g_Terrain).GeometryHash == g_OriginalTerrainHash,
            "Undo restores terrain geometry and settings");
        ImGuiManager::Redo();
        Check(ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<ProceduralTerrainComponent>(g_Terrain).Settings.Noise.Method ==
            Procedural::NoiseMethod::DomainWarp, "Redo restores regenerated terrain");
    }
    if (frame == 28)
    {
        RenderConfiguration::Resize(960, 640);
    }
    if (frame == 40)
    {
        GraphicsDevice::WaitForGpuIdle();
        vector<EntityID> removed;
        for (EntityID entity : World::GetView<MeshComponent>())
        {
            if (!ComponentManager::HasComponent<SunComponent>(entity) && !ComponentManager::HasComponent<CameraComponent>(entity))
            {
                removed.push_back(entity);
            }
        }
        for (EntityID entity : removed)
        {
            World::DestroyEntity(Entity(entity));
        }
    }
    if (frame == 44)
    {
        Procedural::TerrainSettings terrain;
        terrain.Resolution = 16;
        g_Terrain = ProceduralScene::GenerateTerrain(terrain);
        Check(g_Terrain != g_kINVALID_ENTITY, "restore geometry after empty scene");
    }
    if (frame == 48 || frame == 68)
    {
        RendererSettings::SetUpscaleMode(UpscaleMode::Dlss);
        RenderConfiguration::SetResolutionScale(0.5f);
    }
    if (frame == 56)
    {
        RenderConfiguration::Resize(1280, 720);
    }
    if (frame == 64)
    {
        RendererSettings::SetUpscaleMode(UpscaleMode::Bilateral);
    }
    if (frame == 68) RenderConfiguration::SetResolutionScale(1.0f / 1.5f);
    if (frame == 70) RenderConfiguration::SetResolutionScale(1.0f / 1.7f);
    if (frame == 72) RenderConfiguration::SetResolutionScale(1.0f / 3.0f);
    if (frame == 74) RenderConfiguration::SetResolutionScale(1.0f / 1.3f);
    if (frame == 82) RenderConfiguration::SetResolutionScale(0.25f);
    if (frame == 76)
    {
        ImGuiManager::m_HdrEnabled = true;
        ImGuiManager::m_ToneMapEnabled = false;
        RenderConfiguration::SetHdr(true);
    }
    if (frame == 79)
    {
        ImGuiManager::m_ToneMapEnabled = true;
    }
    GpuSceneValidation::BeforeFrame(frame);
}

void RenderingValidation::AfterFrame(uint64_t frame)
{
    VirtualGeometryProduction::RecordBenchmark();
    if (VirtualGeometryProduction::ValidationEnabled())
    {
        VirtualGeometryProduction::AfterFrame(frame);
        return;
    }
    if (PlayRenderTestEnabled())
    {
        if (ShadowBenchmarkEnabled()) { RecordShadowBenchmark(); return; }
        if (frame == 18 || frame == 45 || frame == 70)
        {
            const auto& snapshot = RenderProfiler::GetLatest();
            WriteGraphicsLog("Play render frame %llu: draws=%llu indexed=%llu dispatch=%llu indirect=%llu IA=%llu VS=%llu GPU=%.3f\n",
                frame, snapshot.Calls.DrawCalls, snapshot.Calls.IndexedDrawCalls,
                snapshot.Calls.DispatchCalls, snapshot.Calls.ExecuteIndirectCalls,
                snapshot.Pipeline.IAVertices, snapshot.Pipeline.VSInvocations, snapshot.GpuRenderMs);
            for (const auto& pass : snapshot.Passes)
                WriteGraphicsLog("Play render pass %s: draws=%llu\n", pass.Name.c_str(), pass.DrawCalls);
            if (frame == 45)
            {
                Check(!Raytracing::UsesRaytracedShadows() && RendererSettings::GetShadowMapMethod() == ShadowMapMethod::VirtualShadowMap,
                    "performance test keeps reflections-only raytracing and VSM shadows");
                Check(snapshot.Calls.DrawCalls < 64, "play avoids per-mesh per-page shadow draws");
                Check(snapshot.PipelineStatisticsValid && LightingResources::UseStaticShadowCache(0),
                    "VSM pipeline statistics and stationary-depth reuse are active");
            }
        }
        if (frame >= 57 && frame <= 61)
        {
            for (const auto& pass : RenderProfiler::GetLatest().Passes)
                if (pass.Name == "Stationary Shadow Update")
                    Check(pass.DrawCalls == 0, "moving-caster edits reuse stationary shadow depth");
        }
        if (frame == 48 || frame == 51 || frame == 61)
        {
            for (UINT layer = 0; layer < g_PlayShadowReference.size(); ++layer)
            {
                if (frame == 48)
                {
                    Check(RenderCapture::ReadTextureSlice(LightingResources::GetShadowMapResource(),
                        g_PlayShadowReference[layer], layer), "capture reference shadow layer");
                    continue;
                }
                RenderCapture::TextureData optimized;
                Check(RenderCapture::ReadTextureSlice(LightingResources::GetShadowMapResource(), optimized, layer),
                    "capture optimized shadow layer");
                const auto& reference = g_PlayShadowReference[layer];
                uint64_t changed = 0, populated = 0;
                float maximumError = 0;
                if (reference.Bytes.size() != optimized.Bytes.size() || reference.Bytes.empty())
                {
                    Check(false, "shadow comparison has equal nonempty dimensions");
                    continue;
                }
                for (UINT y = 0; y < reference.Height; ++y)
                    for (UINT x = 0; x < reference.Width; ++x)
                    {
                        float a, b;
                        memcpy(&a, reference.Bytes.data() + y * reference.RowPitch + x * sizeof(float), sizeof(float));
                        memcpy(&b, optimized.Bytes.data() + y * optimized.RowPitch + x * sizeof(float), sizeof(float));
                        populated += a < 1.0f;
                        const float error = abs(a - b);
                        maximumError = max(maximumError, error);
                        changed += error > 0.00001f;
                    }
                WriteGraphicsLog("Play shadow comparison frame=%llu layer=%u populated=%llu changed=%llu maxError=%.8f\n",
                    frame, layer, populated, changed, maximumError);
                Check(changed == 0, "merged and reference shadow depths match within 1e-5");
            }
        }
        return;
    }
    if (ThumbnailValidation::Enabled()) { ThumbnailValidation::AfterFrame(frame); return; }
    if (MaterialValidation::Enabled())
    {
        MaterialValidation::AfterFrame(frame);
        return;
    }
    if (CloudValidation::Enabled()) { CloudValidation::AfterFrame(frame); return; }
    if (SunLightingTestEnabled()) { AfterSunLightingFrame(frame); return; }
    if (VirtualGeometryStreamingValidation::Enabled()) { VirtualGeometryStreamingValidation::AfterFrame(frame); return; }
    if (VirtualGeometryValidation::Enabled()) { VirtualGeometryValidation::AfterFrame(frame); return; }
    if (MeshletValidation::Enabled()) { MeshletValidation::AfterFrame(frame); return; }
    if (GPUVisibilityValidation::Enabled()) { GPUVisibilityValidation::AfterFrame(frame); return; }
    if (GPUDrivenValidation::Enabled()) { GPUDrivenValidation::AfterFrame(frame); return; }
    GpuSceneValidation::AfterFrame(frame);
    if (!IsEnabled())
    {
        return;
    }
    if (frame == 15)
    {
        Check(ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<ProceduralMotionComponent>(g_Mover).Time > 0.0, "Play advances motion");
        ValidateRayTexture();
        if (Raytracing::IsAvailable())
        {
            Check(Raytracing::AreReflectionsActive(), "scene raytracing reflection dispatch");
            if (NrdDenoiser::IsCompiled())
            {
                Check(RayReflections::GetDenoiserDispatchCount() > 0, "actual NVIDIA NRD REBLUR_SPECULAR dispatch sequence");
                Check(Raytracing::GetAmbientDenoiserDispatchCount() > 0, "actual NVIDIA NRD REBLUR_DIFFUSE_OCCLUSION dispatch sequence");
            }
            RenderCapture::TextureData reflection;
            const bool read = RenderCapture::ReadTexture(RayReflections::GetResultResource(), reflection);
            Check(read, "read scene reflection radiance");
            if (read)
            {
                UINT hits = 0, offscreenHits = 0, bright = 0;
                bool finite = true;
                for (UINT y = 0; y < reflection.Height; ++y)
                {
                    const auto* pixels = reinterpret_cast<const uint16_t*>(reflection.Bytes.data() + y * reflection.RowPitch);
                    for (UINT x = 0; x < reflection.Width; ++x)
                    {
                        const float distance = RenderCapture::HalfToFloat(pixels[x * 4 + 3]);
                        hits += abs(distance) > 0.01f;
                        offscreenHits += distance < -0.01f;
                        for (UINT c = 0; c < 3; ++c)
                        {
                            const float value = RenderCapture::HalfToFloat(pixels[x * 4 + c]);
                            finite &= isfinite(value) && value >= 0;
                            bright += value > 0.005f;
                        }
                    }
                }
                Check(finite && hits > 0 && bright > 0, "finite reflected radiance with actual scene intersections");
                Check(offscreenHits > 0, "reflection rays intersect geometry outside the camera image");
                WriteGraphicsLog("Validation reflection: hits=%u offscreenHits=%u brightChannels=%u extent=%ux%u\n", hits, offscreenHits, bright, reflection.Width, reflection.Height);
                ValidateReflectionDenoising(reflection);
            }
        }
        if (Raytracing::IsAvailable() && NrdDenoiser::IsCompiled())
            Check(Raytracing::GetDenoiserDispatchCount() > 0, "actual NVIDIA NRD SIGMA dispatch sequence");
        ValidateSkyBrightness(false);
    }
    if (frame == 31) ValidateSkyBrightness(true);
    if ((frame == 12 || frame == 13) && Raytracing::IsAvailable())
    {
        Check(Raytracing::AreReflectionsActive(), "reflection-only mode remains active");
        Check(!Raytracing::UsesRaytracedShadows() && !Raytracing::UsesRaytracedAmbientOcclusion(),
            "reflection-only mode uses raster shadows and disables ray AO");
        if (frame == 13 && NrdDenoiser::IsCompiled()) Check(!RayReflections::DidRestartHistory(), "reflection-only mode accumulates temporal history");
        Check(LightingResources::GetShadowLightCount() > 0, "reflection-only mode has raster shadow passes");
        RenderCapture::TextureData shadowDepth;
        bool hasRasterShadow = RenderCapture::ReadTexture(RenderTargets::GetShadowDepthResource(), shadowDepth);
        UINT writtenDepth = 0;
        if (hasRasterShadow)
        {
            for (UINT y = 0; y < shadowDepth.Height; ++y)
            {
                const auto* values = reinterpret_cast<const float*>(shadowDepth.Bytes.data() + y * shadowDepth.RowPitch);
                for (UINT x = 0; x < shadowDepth.Width; ++x)
                    writtenDepth += isfinite(values[x]) && values[x] > 0.0f && values[x] < 1.0f;
            }
        }
        Check(hasRasterShadow && writtenDepth > 0, frame == 12 ?
            "reflection-only ShadowMap writes geometry depth" : "reflection-only Virtual ShadowMap writes geometry depth");
        RenderCapture::TextureData visibility;
        bool unshadowed = RenderCapture::ReadTexture(Raytracing::GetResultResource(), visibility);
        if (unshadowed)
        {
            for (UINT y = 0; y < visibility.Height; ++y)
            {
                const auto* pixels = reinterpret_cast<const uint16_t*>(visibility.Bytes.data() + y * visibility.RowPitch);
                for (UINT x = 0; x < visibility.Width; ++x)
                    unshadowed &= RenderCapture::HalfToFloat(pixels[x * 2]) >= 0.999f;
            }
        }
        Check(unshadowed, "disabled ray shadows produce unshadowed visibility");
    }
    if (frame == 19 && Raytracing::IsAvailable() && NrdDenoiser::IsCompiled())
        Check(RayReflections::DidRestartHistory(), "reflection re-enable restarts stale temporal history");
    if (frame == 25 && Raytracing::IsAvailable())
        Check(!Raytracing::AreReflectionsActive() && Raytracing::IsActive(), "reflection switch leaves raytracing shadows active");
    if (frame == 23 || frame == 29 || frame == 37) ValidateVertexDeformation();
    if ((frame == 23 || frame == 31) && MeshShaderPipeline::IsSupported())
    {
        const auto& stats = MeshShaderPipeline::GetStatistics();
        Check(stats.Draws > 0 && stats.Meshlets > 0 && stats.MaxGroupsPerPage <= 65535,
            frame == 23 ? "mesh shader renders procedural vertices into MRT GBuffer" :
                "mesh shader renders large procedural terrain into visibility GBuffer");
        WriteGraphicsLog("Validation mesh shaders: draws=%u meshlets=%u pages=%u maximumGroups=%u\n",
            stats.Draws, stats.Meshlets, stats.Pages, stats.MaxGroupsPerPage);
        if (frame == 31) Check(stats.Pages > stats.Draws, "GPU executes multiple mesh pages with a nonzero meshlet base");
    }
    if (frame == 39)
    {
        VertexDeformationView view;
        Check(!VertexDeformation::TryResolveMesh(g_Mover, view), "disabled vertex motion restores base geometry");
    }
    if (frame == 17)
    {
        Check(ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<ProceduralMotionComponent>(g_Mover).Time == g_PausedTime, "Pause freezes motion");
    }
    if (frame == 19)
    {
        Check(ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<ProceduralMotionComponent>(g_Mover).Time > g_PausedTime, "resume advances motion");
    }
    if (frame == 20)
    {
        const auto& motion = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<ProceduralMotionComponent>(g_Mover);
        const auto& transform = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<TransformComponent>(g_Mover);
        Check(motion.Time == 0.0 && transform.Position.y == motion.Origin.y, "Stop restores motion origin and time");
    }
    if (frame == 29)
    {
        Check(GraphicsDevice::GetWidth() == 960 && GraphicsDevice::GetHeight() == 640, "resize render targets");
    }
    if (frame == 33)
    {
        Check(!Raytracing::IsActive(), "DXR off uses raster fallback");
    }
    if (frame == 37 && Raytracing::IsAvailable())
    {
        Check(Raytracing::IsActive(), "DXR on rebuilds active frame");
    }
    if (frame == 41)
    {
        Check(!Raytracing::IsActive() && Raytracing::GetInstanceCount() == 0, "empty acceleration structure fallback");
    }
    if (frame == 47 && Raytracing::IsAvailable())
    {
        Check(Raytracing::IsActive(), "DXR resumes after geometry recreation");
    }
    if (frame == 5 || frame == 53 || frame == 61 || frame == 69 || frame == 71 || frame == 73 ||
        frame == 75 || frame == 78 || frame == 81 || frame == 83)
    {
        if (frame == 5 && RendererSettings::GetUpscaleMode() != UpscaleMode::Dlss) return;
        if (DlssUpscaler::IsAvailable())
        {
            Check(DlssUpscaler::IsActive(), "DLSS evaluates after resize/toggle/format change");
        }
        else
        {
            char disabled[8]{};
            const bool forcedDisabled = GetEnvironmentVariableA("DX12_DISABLE_DLSS", disabled, sizeof(disabled)) > 0 && atoi(disabled) != 0;
            Check(!DlssUpscaler::IsActive(), "unsupported DLSS uses raster upscale fallback");
            // A capability-positive device must not silently lose DLSS during evaluation.
            Check(forcedDisabled || string(DlssUpscaler::GetStatus()).find("failed") == string::npos, "DLSS availability does not hide evaluation failure");
        }
        const auto& timing = RenderProfiler::GetLatest();
        for (const auto& pass : timing.Passes)
        {
            if (pass.Name == "DXR Shadows / AO" || pass.Name == "DLSS Super Resolution")
            {
                WriteGraphicsLog("Validation timing: %s GPU %.3f ms CPU %.3f ms\n", pass.Name.c_str(), pass.GpuMs, pass.CpuMs);
            }
        }
    }
    if (frame == 65)
    {
        Check(!DlssUpscaler::IsActive(), "DLSS off uses Bilateral");
    }
    if (frame == 55)
    {
        Check(RenderCapture::SaveScenePng(L"bin/validation/dlss.png"), "capture DLSS output");
    }
    if (frame < 32 && (frame % 8) == 7)
    {
        const wchar_t* paths[] = { L"bin/validation/morning.png", L"bin/validation/noon.png", L"bin/validation/evening.png", L"bin/validation/night.png" };
        Check(RenderCapture::SaveScenePng(paths[frame / 8]), "capture day period");
    }
}

bool RenderingValidation::Finish()
{
    if (VirtualGeometryProduction::ValidationEnabled())
    {
        return VirtualGeometryProduction::Finish();
    }
    if (PlayRenderTestEnabled())
    {
        if (ShadowBenchmarkEnabled())
        {
            const char* names[] = {"edit", "reference-play", "optimized-play"};
            for (size_t i = 0; i < g_ShadowBenchmark.size(); ++i)
            {
                const auto& sample = g_ShadowBenchmark[i];
                Check(sample.Count >= (i == 0 ? 8u : 40u), "collect enough VSM benchmark samples");
                if (sample.Count)
                    WriteGraphicsLog("VSM benchmark %s: samples=%llu IA=%.0f maxIA=%llu draws=%.1f GPU=%.3f CPU=%.3f shadowGPU=%.3f frameMs=%.3f FPS=%.1f\n",
                        names[i], sample.Count, double(sample.Vertices) / sample.Count, sample.MaxVertices,
                        double(sample.Draws) / sample.Count, sample.Gpu / sample.Count, sample.Cpu / sample.Count,
                        sample.ShadowGpu / sample.Count, sample.FrameMs / sample.Count,
                        sample.FrameMs > 0 ? 1000.0 * sample.Count / sample.FrameMs : 0);
                Check(sample.GpuSamples == sample.Count, "benchmark has valid GPU timestamps for every sample");
                for (const auto& pass : sample.PassTotals)
                {
                    WriteGraphicsLog("Render benchmark %s pass [%s]: samples=%llu GPU=%.4f CPU=%.4f draws=%.2f\n",
                        names[i], pass.Name.c_str(), sample.GpuSamples,
                        pass.GpuMs / sample.GpuSamples, pass.CpuMs / sample.GpuSamples,
                        double(pass.DrawCalls) / sample.GpuSamples);
                }
            }
            const auto& reference = g_ShadowBenchmark[1];
            const auto& optimized = g_ShadowBenchmark[2];
            Check(reference.Count && optimized.Count &&
                double(optimized.Vertices) / optimized.Count < double(reference.Vertices) / reference.Count * 0.75,
                "VSM live play reduces average IA vertex work by at least 25 percent");
        }
        g_Failures += RenderCapture::ReportGraphicsErrors();
        WriteGraphicsLog("Play render failures = %u\n", g_Failures);
        return g_Failures == 0;
    }
    if (ThumbnailValidation::Enabled()) return ThumbnailValidation::Finish();
    if (MaterialValidation::Enabled())
    {
        return MaterialValidation::Finish();
    }
    if (CloudValidation::Enabled()) return CloudValidation::Finish();
    if (VirtualGeometryStreamingValidation::Enabled()) return VirtualGeometryStreamingValidation::Finish();
    if (VirtualGeometryValidation::Enabled()) return VirtualGeometryValidation::Finish();
    if (MeshletValidation::Enabled()) return MeshletValidation::Finish();
    if (GPUVisibilityValidation::Enabled()) return GPUVisibilityValidation::Finish();
    if (GPUDrivenValidation::Enabled()) return GPUDrivenValidation::Finish();
    if (!IsEnabled())
    {
        return true;
    }
    GraphicsDevice::WaitForGpuIdle();
    Check(g_FrameCount >= 84, "complete feature smoke sequence");
    g_Failures += GpuSceneValidation::Failures();
    g_Failures += RenderCapture::ReportGraphicsErrors();
    WriteGraphicsLog("Validation: feature smoke failures = %u\n", g_Failures);
    return g_Failures == 0;
}

#pragma once
#include <cstdint>

class RenderingValidation
{
public:
    static bool IsEnabled();
    static void BeforeFrame(uint64_t frame);
    static void AfterFrame(uint64_t frame);
    static bool Finish();
};

===== FILE: core\thumbnailvalidation.cpp =====
#include "pch.h"
#include "thumbnailvalidation.h"
#include "assetthumbnailmanager.h"
#include "materialmanager.h"
#include "rendercapture.h"
#include "graphicslog.h"
#include "graphicsdevice.h"
#include "world.h"
#include "imguimanager.h"
#include "renderprofiler.h"
#include "texturemanager.h"
#include <DirectXTex.h>
#include <fstream>

namespace
{
std::filesystem::path root;
std::vector<std::filesystem::path> files;
std::vector<AssetHandle> handles;
MaterialAssetData material;
AssetHandle surface = 0, texture = 0, mesh = 0, broken = 0;
uint64_t materialRevision = 0;
uint64_t colorHash = 0;
uint64_t cacheHits = 0;
unsigned int stage = 0, failures = 0;
bool complete = false;
size_t entityCount = 0;
UINT renderedBuffer = 0;
XMFLOAT2 surfaceCell{};
bool surfaceSelected = false;
UINT inputStep = 0, visibleCells = 0, maximumVisibleCells = 0;
ComPtr<ID3D12Resource> existingTexture;

void Check(bool condition, const char* name)
{
    WriteGraphicsLog("Thumbnail validation: %s %s\n", condition ? "PASS" : "FAIL", name);
    if (!condition) ++failures;
}

bool MakeImage(const std::filesystem::path& path, UINT width, UINT height, uint32_t color)
{
    DirectX::ScratchImage image;
    if (FAILED(image.Initialize2D(DXGI_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM, width, height, 1, 1))) return false;
    const auto* pixels = image.GetImage(0, 0, 0);
    for (UINT row = 0; row < height; ++row)
    {
        auto* line = reinterpret_cast<uint32_t*>(pixels->pixels + row * pixels->rowPitch);
        for (UINT column = 0; column < width; ++column) line[column] = color;
    }
    if (path.extension() == ".dds") return SUCCEEDED(DirectX::SaveToDDSFile(*pixels, DirectX::DDS_FLAGS_NONE, path.c_str()));
    if (path.extension() == ".tga") return SUCCEEDED(DirectX::SaveToTGAFile(*pixels, path.c_str()));
    return SUCCEEDED(DirectX::SaveToWICFile(*pixels, DirectX::WIC_FLAGS_NONE,
        DirectX::GetWICCodec(path.extension() == ".jpg" ? DirectX::WIC_CODEC_JPEG : DirectX::WIC_CODEC_PNG), path.c_str()));
}

AssetHandle Register(const std::filesystem::path& path)
{
    std::string error;
    const auto handle = MaterialManager::Registry().Register(path, AssetRegistry::Classify(path), error);
    Check(handle != 0, "fixture GUID registration");
    handles.push_back(handle);
    files.push_back(path);
    files.emplace_back(path.wstring() + L".meta");
    return handle;
}

uint64_t HashImage(const ThumbnailHandle& thumbnail)
{
    RenderCapture::TextureData pixels;
    if (!thumbnail.Image || !RenderCapture::ReadTexture(thumbnail.Image->Resource.Get(), pixels)) return 0;
    uint64_t hash = 1469598103934665603ull;
    for (auto byte : pixels.Bytes) hash = (hash ^ byte) * 1099511628211ull;
    return hash;
}

void CaptureBrowser()
{
    RenderCapture::TextureData pixels;
    auto* resource = GraphicsDevice::GetBackBuffer(renderedBuffer);
    if (!resource || !RenderCapture::ReadTextureMip(resource, pixels, 0, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PRESENT)) return;
    DirectX::ScratchImage image;
    if (FAILED(image.Initialize2D(pixels.Format, pixels.Width, pixels.Height, 1, 1))) return;
    const auto* destination = image.GetImage(0, 0, 0);
    for (UINT row = 0; row < pixels.Height; ++row)
        memcpy(destination->pixels + row * destination->rowPitch, pixels.Bytes.data() + row * pixels.RowPitch, destination->rowPitch);
    Check(SUCCEEDED(DirectX::SaveToWICFile(*destination, DirectX::WIC_FLAGS_NONE,
        DirectX::GetWICCodec(DirectX::WIC_CODEC_PNG), L"build/thumbnail-tests/browser.png")), "capture browser grid");
}
}

bool ThumbnailValidation::Enabled()
{
    char value[8]{};
    return GetEnvironmentVariableA("DX12_THUMBNAIL_TEST", value, sizeof(value)) > 0 && atoi(value) != 0;
}

void ThumbnailValidation::BeforeFrame(uint64_t frame)
{
    renderedBuffer = GraphicsDevice::GetFrameIndex();
    if (frame != 0) return;
    root = std::filesystem::path("asset") / ("__thumbnail_validation_" + std::to_string(GetCurrentProcessId()));
    std::filesystem::create_directories(root);
    std::filesystem::create_directories("build/thumbnail-tests");
    entityCount = Registry::GetEntities().size();
    for (const auto& name : {"Wide.png", "Square.jpg", "Square.dds", "Tall.tga"})
    {
        const auto path = root / name;
        Check(MakeImage(path, name == std::string("Tall.tga") ? 64 : 192,
            name == std::string("Tall.tga") ? 192 : name == std::string("Wide.png") ? 108 : 192, 0xff3030e0), "write image fixture");
        const auto handle = Register(path);
        if (name == std::string("Wide.png")) texture = handle;
    }
    material.Textures[0] = texture;
    // Fixture setup may synchronously preload; thumbnail Request/Generate must reuse this resource.
    existingTexture = TextureManager::GetTextureResource(TextureManager::LoadTexture(root / "Wide.png"));
    material.Roughness = 0.25f;
    material.Metallic = 0.5f;
    std::string error;
    Check(MaterialSerializer::Save(root / "Surface.material", material, error), "write material fixture");
    surface = Register(root / "Surface.material");
    std::ofstream model(root / "Offset.obj");
    model << "mtllib Shared.mtl\nv 99 -1 0\nv 101 -1 0\nv 100 1 0\nv 100 0 2\nusemtl Red\nf 1 3 2\nf 1 2 4\nusemtl Blue\nf 2 3 4\nf 3 1 4\n";
    model.close();
    std::ofstream(root / "Shared.mtl") << "newmtl Red\nKd 0.9 0.1 0.1\nnewmtl Blue\nKd 0.1 0.1 0.9\n";
    files.push_back(root / "Shared.mtl");
    mesh = Register(root / "Offset.obj");
    std::ofstream(root / "Broken.png") << "invalid image";
    broken = Register(root / "Broken.png");
    RenderProfiler::SetWindowVisible(false);
    ImGuiManager::SetAssetBrowserDirectory(root, true);
    // The fixture also exercises row clipping and large-directory enumeration.
    for (UINT index = 0; index < 1000; ++index)
    {
        const auto path = root / ("Unused_" + std::to_string(index) + ".txt");
        std::ofstream(path) << "unsupported fallback";
        files.push_back(path);
    }
}

void ThumbnailValidation::AfterFrame(uint64_t frame)
{
    if (complete) return;
    const auto thumbnail = AssetThumbnailManager::Request(surface, ThumbnailPriority::Selected);
    if (stage == 0)
    {
        bool ready = true;
        for (auto handle : handles)
        {
            const auto item = AssetThumbnailManager::Request(handle);
            if (handle == broken) ready = ready && item.State == ThumbnailState::Failed;
            else ready = ready && item.State == ThumbnailState::Ready;
        }
        if (!ready) return;
        Check(HashImage(thumbnail) != 0, "material sphere renders");
        const auto wide = AssetThumbnailManager::Request(texture);
        Check(wide.Image->Width * 9 == wide.Image->Height * 16, "wide texture keeps aspect ratio");
        Check(wide.Image->Resource == existingTexture && !wide.Image->Descriptor, "loaded texture resource and SRV reused");
        const auto meshThumbnail = AssetThumbnailManager::Request(mesh);
        Check(HashImage(meshThumbnail) != 0, "offset mesh renders with camera fit");
        RenderCapture::SaveTexturePng(thumbnail.Image->Resource.Get(), L"build/thumbnail-tests/material.png");
        RenderCapture::SaveTexturePng(meshThumbnail.Image->Resource.Get(), L"build/thumbnail-tests/mesh.png");
        CaptureBrowser();
        colorHash = HashImage(thumbnail);
        materialRevision = thumbnail.Revision;
        material.BaseColor = {0.2f, 0.9f, 0.3f, 1.0f};
        std::string error;
        Check(MaterialSerializer::Save(root / "Surface.material", material, error), "save changed material");
        AssetThumbnailManager::MarkDirty(surface);
        ++stage;
    }
    else if (stage == 1 && thumbnail.State == ThumbnailState::Ready && thumbnail.Revision != materialRevision)
    {
        Check(HashImage(thumbnail) != colorHash, "material edit updates thumbnail");
        colorHash = HashImage(thumbnail);
        materialRevision = thumbnail.Revision;
        Check(MakeImage(root / "Wide.png", 192, 108, 0xff30e030), "replace source texture");
        AssetThumbnailManager::MarkDirty(texture);
        ++stage;
    }
    else if (stage == 2 && thumbnail.State == ThumbnailState::Ready && thumbnail.Revision != materialRevision &&
        AssetThumbnailManager::Request(texture).State == ThumbnailState::Ready)
    {
        Check(HashImage(thumbnail) != colorHash, "texture dependency updates material");
        const auto before = AssetThumbnailManager::Request(texture);
        std::string error;
        Check(MaterialManager::Registry().Move(texture, root / "Renamed.png", error), "rename/move keeps GUID");
        files.push_back(root / "Renamed.png");
        files.emplace_back((root / "Renamed.png").wstring() + L".meta");
        Check(AssetThumbnailManager::Request(texture).Image == before.Image, "rename preserves thumbnail identity");
        cacheHits = AssetThumbnailManager::CacheHits();
        ++stage;
    }
    else if (stage == 3)
    {
        uint64_t savedKey = 0;
        std::ifstream manifest(ThumbnailRenderer::CachePath(surface).string() + ".key");
        if (!(manifest >> savedKey) || savedKey != AssetThumbnailManager::LastCacheKey(surface)) return;
        AssetThumbnailManager::Remove(surface);
        AssetThumbnailManager::Request(surface);
        ++stage;
    }
    else if (stage == 4 && thumbnail.State == ThumbnailState::Ready)
    {
        Check(AssetThumbnailManager::CacheHits() > cacheHits, "disk cache reused after eviction");
        Check(Registry::GetEntities().size() == entityCount, "preview adds no world entities");
        Check(AssetThumbnailManager::MemoryBytes() <= AssetThumbnailManager::Settings().MemoryBudget, "memory remains inside budget");
        const auto model = AssetThumbnailManager::Request(mesh);
        if (model.State != ThumbnailState::Ready) return;
        colorHash = HashImage(model);
        materialRevision = model.Revision;
        std::ofstream(root / "Shared.mtl") << "newmtl Red\nKd 0.1 0.9 0.1\nnewmtl Blue\nKd 0.9 0.8 0.1\n";
        ++stage;
    }
    else if (stage == 5)
    {
        const auto model = AssetThumbnailManager::Request(mesh);
        if (model.State != ThumbnailState::Ready || model.Revision == materialRevision) return;
        Check(HashImage(model) != colorHash, "actual external MTL change invalidates mesh");
        ++stage;
    }
    else if (stage == 6 && inputStep >= 2 && surfaceSelected)
    {
        Check(true, "thumbnail cell selects material");
        inputStep = 0;
        ++stage;
    }
    else if (stage == 7 && inputStep >= 16)
    {
        Check(maximumVisibleCells > 0 && maximumVisibleCells < 64, "1000 asset scroll clips offscreen UI");
        AssetThumbnailManager::Settings().Size = 64;
        ++stage;
    }
    else if (stage == 8 && thumbnail.State == ThumbnailState::Ready && thumbnail.Image->Width == 64)
    {
        Check(true, "thumbnail size setting regenerates preview");
        AssetThumbnailManager::Settings().Size = 128;
        ++stage;
    }
    else if (stage == 9 && thumbnail.State == ThumbnailState::Ready && thumbnail.Image->Width == 128)
    {
#ifdef _DEBUG
        Check(RenderCapture::ReportGraphicsErrors() == 0, "DX12 debug layer has no errors");
#else
        WriteGraphicsLog("Thumbnail validation: Release debug layer disabled; debug-layer checks run in Debug\n");
#endif
        complete = true;
    }
    if (frame == 299 && !complete) Check(false, "thumbnail sequence completes");
}

void ThumbnailValidation::BeforeEditorFrame()
{
    if (!Enabled()) return;
    visibleCells = 0;
    if (stage == 6 && inputStep < 2)
    {
        auto& input = ImGui::GetIO();
        input.AddMousePosEvent(surfaceCell.x, surfaceCell.y);
        input.AddMouseButtonEvent(ImGuiMouseButton_Left, inputStep == 0);
        ++inputStep;
    }
    else if (stage == 7 && inputStep < 16)
    {
        auto& input = ImGui::GetIO();
        input.AddMousePosEvent(surfaceCell.x, surfaceCell.y);
        input.AddMouseWheelEvent(0, inputStep < 8 ? -8.0f : 8.0f);
        ++inputStep;
    }
}

void ThumbnailValidation::CaptureAssetCell(const char* fileName, float x, float y, bool selected)
{
    if (!Enabled()) return;
    maximumVisibleCells = std::max(maximumVisibleCells, ++visibleCells);
    if (std::string(fileName) == "Surface.material")
    {
        surfaceCell = {x + 48, y + 48};
        surfaceSelected = selected;
    }
}

bool ThumbnailValidation::Finish()
{
    Check(complete, "all thumbnail stages completed");
    WriteGraphicsLog("Thumbnail validation failures = %u\n", failures);
    for (auto handle : handles) AssetThumbnailManager::Remove(handle);
    existingTexture.Reset();
    std::error_code error;
    for (const auto& file : files) std::filesystem::remove(file, error);
    if (!root.empty()) std::filesystem::remove(root, error);
    MaterialManager::Refresh();
    return complete && failures == 0;
}

===== FILE: core\vector.h =====
#pragma once
#include <cmath>

class Vector3
{
public:
	float x, y, z;

	Vector3() = default;
	Vector3(const Vector3& a) :x(a.x), y(a.y), z(a.z) {};

	Vector3(float nx, float ny, float nz) :x(nx), y(ny), z(nz) {};

	Vector3& operator = (const Vector3& a)
	{
		x = a.x;
		y = a.y;
		z = a.z;
		return *this;
	}

	Vector3& operator = (float a) 
	{
		x = a;
		y = a;
		z = a;
		return *this;
	}

	Vector3& operator = (XMFLOAT3 a) 
	{
		x = a.x;
		y = a.y;
		z = a.z;
		return *this;
	}

	operator DirectX::XMFLOAT3() const
	{
		return DirectX::XMFLOAT3(x, y, z);
	}

	bool operator ==(const Vector3& a)const {
		return x == a.x && y == a.y && z == a.z;
	}

	bool operator != (const Vector3& a)const {
		return x != a.x || y != a.y || z != a.z;
	}

	Vector3 operator - () const { return Vector3(-x, -y, -z); }

	Vector3 operator +(const Vector3& a) const {
		return Vector3(x + a.x, y + a.y, z + a.z);
	}

	Vector3 operator +(const float& a)const {
		return Vector3(x + a, y + a, z + a);
	}

	Vector3 operator -(const Vector3& a)const {
		return Vector3(x - a.x, y - a.y, z - a.z);
	}

	Vector3 operator *(float a)const {
		return Vector3(x * a, y * a, z * a);
	}

	Vector3 operator /(float a)const
	{
		float OneOverA = 1.f / a;
		return Vector3(x * OneOverA, y * OneOverA, z * OneOverA);
	}

	Vector3 operator /(Vector3& a)const {
		return Vector3(x / a.x, y / a.y, z / a.z);
	}

	Vector3 operator +=(const Vector3& a)
	{
		x += a.x; y += a.y; z += a.z;
		return *this;
	}

	Vector3 operator +=(float a)
	{
		x += a; y += a; z += a;
		return *this;
	}

	Vector3 operator -=(const Vector3& a)
	{
		x -= a.x; y -= a.y; z -= a.z;
		return *this;
	}

	Vector3 operator *=(const Vector3& a)
	{
		x *= a.x; y *= a.y; z *= a.z;
		return *this;
	}

	Vector3 operator *= (const float& a) {
		return Vector3(x *= a, y *= a, z *= a);
	}

	Vector3 operator /=(const Vector3& a)
	{
		x /= a.x; y /= a.y; z /= a.z;
		return *this;
	}

	void Normalize()
	{
		float magsq = x * x + y * y + z * z;
		if (magsq > 0.f)
		{
			float oneOverMag = 1.f / sqrtf(magsq);
			x *= oneOverMag;
			y *= oneOverMag;
			z *= oneOverMag;
		}
	}

	float Length()const
	{
		return sqrtf(x * x + y * y + z * z); 
	}

	float operator *(const Vector3& a) {
		return x * a.x + y * a.y + z * a.z;
	}

	Vector3 Lerp(const Vector3& a, const Vector3& b, float t)
	{
		return a * (1.0f - t) + b * t;
	}

	static float dot(const Vector3& a, const Vector3& b)
	{
		return a.x * b.x + a.y * b.y + a.z * b.z;
	}

	static Vector3 cross(const Vector3& a, const Vector3& b)
	{
		Vector3 ret{};
		ret.x = a.y * b.z - a.z * b.y;
		ret.y = a.z * b.x - a.x * b.z;
		ret.z = a.x * b.y - a.y * b.x;
		return ret;
	}

	static float Distance(const Vector3& a, const Vector3& b)
	{
		float dx = a.x - b.x;
		float dy = a.y - b.y;
		float dz = a.z - b.z;
		return sqrtf(dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz);
	}

	static float DistanceSquared(const Vector3& a, const Vector3& b)
	{
		float dx = a.x - b.x;
		float dy = a.y - b.y;
		float dz = a.z - b.z;
		return dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz;
	}

	static const Vector3 Up() { return Vector3(0.f, 1.f, 0.f); }
	static const Vector3 Down() { return Vector3(0.f, -1.f, 0.f); }
	static const Vector3 Left() { return Vector3(-1.f, 0.f, 0.f); }
	static const Vector3 Right() { return Vector3(1.f, 0.f, 0.f); }
	static const Vector3 Forward() { return Vector3(0.f, 0.f, 1.f); }
	static const Vector3 Backward() { return Vector3(0.f, 0.f, -1.f); }
	static const Vector3 One() { return Vector3(1.f, 1.f, 1.f); }
	static const Vector3 Zero() { return Vector3(0.f, 0.f, 0.f); }
};

#include "pch.h"
#include "world.h"

float World::m_DeltaTime = 0.0f;
float World::m_RawDeltaTime = 0.0f;
float World::m_SmoothedDeltaTime = 0.0f;
float World::m_FrameRate = 0.0f;
float World::m_FrameTimeMs = 0.0f;
double World::m_FrameStatsAccumulator = 0.0;
int World::m_FrameStatsCount = 0;
long long World::m_LastTime = 0;
long long World::m_Frequency = 0;
bool World::m_VSyncEnabled = false;
bool World::m_FixedFrameRateEnabled = true;
int World::m_TargetFrameRate = 144;
unordered_map<string, EntityID> World::m_NameMap;
unordered_map<EntityID, string> World::m_IdToNameMap;

void World::RegisterName(EntityID entity, const string& name)
{
    if (entity >= g_kMAX_ENTITIES || name.empty())
    {
        return;
    }

    auto oldIt = m_IdToNameMap.find(entity);
    if (oldIt != m_IdToNameMap.end())
    {
        m_NameMap.erase(oldIt->second);
    }

    auto sameNameIt = m_NameMap.find(name);
    if (sameNameIt != m_NameMap.end())
    {
        m_IdToNameMap.erase(sameNameIt->second);
    }

    m_NameMap[name] = entity;
    m_IdToNameMap[entity] = name;
}

Entity World::GetEntityByName(const string& name)
{
    auto it = m_NameMap.find(name);
    if (it != m_NameMap.end())
    {
        return Entity(it->second);
    }
    return Entity(g_kINVALID_ENTITY);
}

void World::UnregisterName(EntityID entity)
{
    auto it = m_IdToNameMap.find(entity);
    if (it == m_IdToNameMap.end())
    {
        return;
    }

    m_NameMap.erase(it->second);
    m_IdToNameMap.erase(it);
}

void World::Update()
{
    constexpr float kMaxDeltaTime = 0.1f;
    constexpr float kSmoothingResetDelta = 1.0f / 20.0f;
    constexpr float kFastFrameDelta = 1.0f / 120.0f;

    if (m_Frequency == 0)
    {
        LARGE_INTEGER li;
        QueryPerformanceFrequency(&li);
        m_Frequency = li.QuadPart;
        QueryPerformanceCounter(&li);
        m_LastTime = li.QuadPart;
        m_DeltaTime = 1.0f / 60.0f;
        m_RawDeltaTime = m_DeltaTime;
        m_SmoothedDeltaTime = m_DeltaTime;
        m_FrameTimeMs = m_DeltaTime * 1000.0f;
        return;
    }

    LARGE_INTEGER li;
    QueryPerformanceCounter(&li);
    long long currentTime = li.QuadPart;
    m_RawDeltaTime = static_cast<float>(currentTime - m_LastTime) / m_Frequency;
    m_LastTime = currentTime;

    if (m_RawDeltaTime > kMaxDeltaTime)
    {
        m_RawDeltaTime = kMaxDeltaTime;
    }
    else if (m_RawDeltaTime < 0.0f)
    {
        m_RawDeltaTime = 0.0f;
    }

    if (m_SmoothedDeltaTime <= 0.0f || m_RawDeltaTime >= kSmoothingResetDelta)
    {
        m_SmoothedDeltaTime = m_RawDeltaTime;
    }
    else
    {
        float smoothRate;
        if ((m_RawDeltaTime <= kFastFrameDelta))
        {
            smoothRate = 0.18f;
        }
        else
        {
            smoothRate = 0.32f;
        }
        m_SmoothedDeltaTime += (m_RawDeltaTime - m_SmoothedDeltaTime) * smoothRate;
    }

    m_DeltaTime = m_SmoothedDeltaTime;
    m_FrameTimeMs = m_RawDeltaTime * 1000.0f;
    m_FrameStatsAccumulator += m_RawDeltaTime;
    m_FrameStatsCount++;
    if (m_FrameStatsAccumulator >= 0.5)
    {
        if (m_FrameStatsAccumulator > 0.0)
        {
            m_FrameRate = static_cast<float>(m_FrameStatsCount / m_FrameStatsAccumulator);
        }
        else
        {
            m_FrameRate = 0.0f;
        }
        m_FrameStatsAccumulator = 0.0;
        m_FrameStatsCount = 0;
    }
}

void World::WaitForFrameLimit()
{
    if (!m_FixedFrameRateEnabled || m_TargetFrameRate <= 0 || m_Frequency == 0)
    {
        return;
    }

    const double targetSeconds = 1.0 / static_cast<double>(m_TargetFrameRate);
    LARGE_INTEGER li;
    QueryPerformanceCounter(&li);

    const long long targetTicks = static_cast<long long>(targetSeconds * static_cast<double>(m_Frequency));
    const long long targetTime = m_LastTime + targetTicks;
    while (li.QuadPart < targetTime)
    {
        const double remainingSeconds = static_cast<double>(targetTime - li.QuadPart) / static_cast<double>(m_Frequency);
        if (remainingSeconds > 0.002)
        {
            Sleep(static_cast<DWORD>((remainingSeconds * 1000.0) - 1.0));
        }
        else
        {
            Sleep(0);
        }
        QueryPerformanceCounter(&li);
    }
}

    return m_DeltaTime;

inline Entity& Entity::SetName(const string& name)
{
	if (!Has<NameComponent>())
	{

#include "pch.h"
#include "componentmanager.h"

bool ComponentManager::HasComponent(EntityID EntityID, ComponentType type)
{
	return Registry::HasComponent(EntityID, type);
}

void ComponentManager::Init()
{
}

void ComponentManager::Uninit()
{
}

void ComponentManager::ClearEntity(EntityID entity)
{
	if (entity >= g_kMAX_ENTITIES)
	{
		return;
	}

	for (ComponentTypeID type = 0; type < ComponentTypeRegistry::GetRegisteredCount(); ++type)
	{
		if (Registry::HasComponent(entity, ComponentType(type)))
		{
			ComponentTypeRegistry::ClearComponent(entity, ComponentType(type));
		}
	}
}

void ComponentManager::ReportMissingComponentError(EntityID entity, const char* componentName)
{
	wchar_t buf[1024];
	wstring entityName = L"Unregistered ";

	if (entity < g_kMAX_ENTITIES && HasComponent(entity, ComponentType::NAME))
	{
		string n = ComponentStorage<NameComponent>::Get(entity).Name;
		int len = MultiByteToWideChar(CP_UTF8, 0, n.c_str(), -1, NULL, 0);
		if (len > 0)
		{
			vector<wchar_t> w(len);
			MultiByteToWideChar(CP_UTF8, 0, n.c_str(), -1, w.data(), len);
			entityName = w.data();
		}
	}

	wchar_t wCompName[256];
	MultiByteToWideChar(CP_UTF8, 0, componentName, -1, wCompName, 256);

	swprintf_s(buf, L"Error: EntityID [%d] (Name: %s) does not have component [%s].\nPlease check whether the target entity has this component.",
		entity, entityName.c_str(), wCompName);

	MessageBoxW(nullptr, buf, L"ECS Component Missing Error", MB_OK | MB_ICONERROR);
}

#pragma once

template<typename T>
struct ComponentStorage
{
	static constexpr uint32_t kInvalidIndex = numeric_limits<uint32_t>::max();

	static vector<T>& DenseData()
	{
		static vector<T> data;
		return data;
	}

	static vector<EntityID>& DenseEntities()
	{
		static vector<EntityID> entities;
		return entities;
	}

	static array<uint32_t, g_kMAX_ENTITIES>& SparseIndices()
	{
		static array<uint32_t, g_kMAX_ENTITIES> indices = []
			{
				array<uint32_t, g_kMAX_ENTITIES> value{};
				value.fill(kInvalidIndex);
				return value;
			}();
		return indices;
	}

	static void CreateEntity(EntityID entity)
	{
		if (entity >= g_kMAX_ENTITIES || SparseIndices()[entity] != kInvalidIndex)
		{
			return;
		}

		auto& data = DenseData();
		auto& entities = DenseEntities();
		entities.push_back(entity);
		try
		{
			data.emplace_back();
		}
		catch (...)
		{
			entities.pop_back();
			throw;
		}
		SparseIndices()[entity] = static_cast<uint32_t>(data.size() - 1);
	}

	static bool Contains(EntityID entity)
	{
		return entity < g_kMAX_ENTITIES && SparseIndices()[entity] != kInvalidIndex;
	}

	static T& Get(EntityID entity)
	{
		return DenseData()[SparseIndices()[entity]];
	}

	static void ClearEntity(EntityID entity)
	{
		if (!Contains(entity))
		{
			return;
		}

		auto& data = DenseData();
		auto& entities = DenseEntities();
		auto& sparse = SparseIndices();
		const uint32_t index = sparse[entity];
		const uint32_t lastIndex = static_cast<uint32_t>(data.size() - 1);
		if (index != lastIndex)
		{
			data[index] = move(data[lastIndex]);
			const EntityID movedEntity = entities[lastIndex];
			entities[index] = movedEntity;
			sparse[movedEntity] = index;
		}
		data.pop_back();
		entities.pop_back();
		sparse[entity] = kInvalidIndex;
	}

	static void Reset()
	{
		DenseData().clear();
		DenseEntities().clear();
		SparseIndices().fill(kInvalidIndex);
	}
};

template<typename T>
inline ComponentType ComponentTypeRegistry::GetType()
{
	type_index key(typeid(T));
	auto& typeIds = TypeIds();
	auto it = typeIds.find(key);
	if (it != typeIds.end())
	{
		return ComponentType(it->second);
	}

	auto& nextTypeId = NextTypeId();
	assert(nextTypeId < g_kMAX_COMPONENTS && "Component type limit reached");
	ComponentTypeID id = nextTypeId++;
	typeIds.emplace(key, id);
	ComponentTypeRegistry::CreateCallbacks().push_back(&ComponentStorage<T>::CreateEntity);
	ClearCallbacks().push_back(&ComponentStorage<T>::ClearEntity);
	ComponentTypeRegistry::ResetCallbacks().push_back(&ComponentStorage<T>::Reset);
	return ComponentType(id);
}

template<typename T>
struct ComponentTypeTraits
{
	static ComponentType value()
	{
		return ComponentTypeRegistry::GetType<T>();
	}
};

class ComponentManager
{
private:
	friend class Registry;

public:
	static void Init();
	static void Uninit();
	static void ClearEntity(EntityID entity);

	template<typename T>
	static T& GetComponent(EntityID entity)
	{
		if (entity >= g_kMAX_ENTITIES)
		{
			ReportMissingComponentError(entity, "Invalid Entity");
			assert(false && "GetComponent called on invalid entity id");
			abort();
		}

		if (!Registry::HasComponent(entity, ComponentTypeTraits<T>::value()))
		{
			ReportMissingComponentError(entity, typeid(T).name());
			assert(false && "GetComponent called for a missing component");
			abort();
		}

        if constexpr (is_same_v<T, MeshComponent> || is_same_v<T, StaticModelComponent> ||
            is_same_v<T, AnimationModelComponent> || is_same_v<T, MaterialComponent> ||
            is_same_v<T, SpriteComponent> || is_same_v<T, AABBComponent> ||
            is_same_v<T, LODComponent> || is_same_v<T, InstancingComponent> ||
            is_same_v<T, ShaderComponent> || is_same_v<T, NameComponent> ||
            is_same_v<T, ProceduralMotionComponent>)
        {
            GpuSceneChanges::Notify(entity);
        }
		return ComponentStorage<T>::Get(entity);
	}

	template<typename T>
	static T& GetComponentUnchecked(EntityID entity)
	{
		assert(entity < g_kMAX_ENTITIES && Registry::IsAlive(entity));
		assert(ComponentStorage<T>::Contains(entity));
		return ComponentStorage<T>::Get(entity);
	}

	template<typename T>
	static const vector<T>& GetDenseComponents() { return ComponentStorage<T>::DenseData(); }

	template<typename T>
	static const vector<EntityID>& GetDenseEntities() { return ComponentStorage<T>::DenseEntities(); }


	template<typename T, typename Function>
	static void ForEachComponent(Function&& function)
	{
		auto& data = ComponentStorage<T>::DenseData();
		const auto& entities = ComponentStorage<T>::DenseEntities();
		const size_t count = data.size();
		for (size_t i = 0; i < count; ++i)
		{
			function(entities[i], data[i]);
		}
	}


	template<typename Primary, typename... Required, typename Function>
	static void ForEach(Function&& function)
	{
		auto& primaryData = ComponentStorage<Primary>::DenseData();
		const auto& entities = ComponentStorage<Primary>::DenseEntities();
		const size_t count = primaryData.size();
		for (size_t i = 0; i < count; ++i)
		{
			const EntityID entity = entities[i];
			if ((ComponentStorage<Required>::Contains(entity) && ...))
			{
				function(entity, primaryData[i], ComponentStorage<Required>::Get(entity)...);
			}
		}
	}

	static void ReportMissingComponentError(EntityID entity, const char* componentName);

	template<typename T>
	static bool HasComponent(EntityID entity)
	{
		return Registry::HasComponent(entity, ComponentTypeTraits<T>::value());
	}

	static bool HasComponent(EntityID entity, ComponentType type);

	template<typename... ComponentTypes>
	static void AddComponent(EntityID entity, ComponentTypes... types)
	{
		Registry::AddComponent(entity, types...);
	}

	template<typename... ComponentTypes>
	static void RemoveComponent(EntityID entity, ComponentTypes... types)
	{
		Registry::RemoveComponent(entity, types...);
	}
};
