void Check(bool condition, const char* message)
{
    WriteGraphicsLog("Cloud validation: %s %s\n", condition ? "PASS" : "FAIL", message);
    if (!condition) ++g_Failures;
}
uint64_t NoiseHash()
{
    RenderCapture::TextureData noise;
    if (!RenderCapture::ReadTexture(CloudRenderer::GetBaseNoiseResource(), noise)) return 0;
    uint64_t hash = 1469598103934665603ull;
    const UINT depth = CloudRenderer::GetBaseNoiseResource()->GetDesc().DepthOrArraySize;
    const UINT bytesPerVoxel = noise.Format == DXGI_FORMAT_R8_UNORM ? 1 : 2;
    for (UINT z = 0; z < depth; ++z)
        for (UINT y = 0; y < noise.Height; ++y)
            for (UINT x = 0; x < noise.Width * bytesPerVoxel; ++x)
            {
                hash ^= noise.Bytes[(z * noise.Height + y) * noise.RowPitch + x];
                hash *= 1099511628211ull;
            }
    return hash;
}
void ValidateSceneOcclusion(const RenderCapture::TextureData& cloud)
{
    RenderCapture::TextureData depth, material;
    const bool read = RenderCapture::ReadTexture(RenderTargets::GetGBufferResource(GBufferType::DEPTH), depth) &&
        RenderCapture::ReadTexture(RenderTargets::GetGBufferResource(GBufferType::MATERIAL), material);
    Check(read && depth.Format == DXGI_FORMAT_R32_FLOAT, "read scene depth for occlusion oracle");
    if (!read) return;
    XMMATRIX view, projection;
    const auto camera = Camera::GetCameraEntity();
    Camera::GetCameraMatrices(camera, view, projection);
    const XMMATRIX inverse = XMMatrixInverse(nullptr, view * projection);
    const auto position = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<TransformComponent>(camera).Position;
    const auto& settings = CloudRenderer::GetSettings();
    UINT tested = 0;
    bool occluded = true;
    for (UINT y = 0; y < cloud.Height; ++y)
    {
        const UINT fullY = min(depth.Height - 1, static_cast<UINT>((y + 0.5f) / cloud.Height * depth.Height));
        const auto* depthRow = reinterpret_cast<const float*>(depth.Bytes.data() + fullY * depth.RowPitch);
        const auto* materialRow = reinterpret_cast<const uint16_t*>(material.Bytes.data() + fullY * material.RowPitch);
        const auto* cloudRow = reinterpret_cast<const uint16_t*>(cloud.Bytes.data() + y * cloud.RowPitch);
        for (UINT x = 0; x < cloud.Width; ++x)
        {
            const UINT fullX = min(depth.Width - 1, static_cast<UINT>((x + 0.5f) / cloud.Width * depth.Width));
            if (RenderCapture::HalfToFloat(materialRow[fullX * 4 + 3]) < -0.5f || depthRow[fullX] >= 0.999999f) continue;
            const float uvX = (x + 0.5f) / cloud.Width;
            const float uvY = (y + 0.5f) / cloud.Height;
            XMFLOAT3 world;
            XMStoreFloat3(&world, XMVector3TransformCoord(XMVectorSet(uvX * 2 - 1, 1 - uvY * 2, depthRow[fullX], 1), inverse));
            // The camera is below the cloud slab: geometry below its bottom cannot contain cloud.
            if (position.y < settings.BottomHeight && world.y < settings.BottomHeight - 0.01f)
            {
                // Raster interpolation and CPU UV division can choose adjacent full-res
                // texels at exact integer boundaries. Test interior footprints here;
                // the final HDR comparison below includes every silhouette pixel.
                bool interior = fullX > 0 && fullY > 0 && fullX + 1 < depth.Width && fullY + 1 < depth.Height;
                for (int row = -1; row <= 1 && interior; ++row)
                    for (int column = -1; column <= 1 && interior; ++column)
                    {
                        const UINT nearX = fullX + column;
                        const UINT nearY = fullY + row;
                        const auto* nearDepth = reinterpret_cast<const float*>(depth.Bytes.data() + nearY * depth.RowPitch);
                        const auto* nearMaterial = reinterpret_cast<const uint16_t*>(material.Bytes.data() + nearY * material.RowPitch);
                        const float ndcX = (nearX + 0.5f) / depth.Width * 2 - 1;
                        const float ndcY = 1 - (nearY + 0.5f) / depth.Height * 2;
                        const float nearWorldY = XMVectorGetY(XMVector3TransformCoord(XMVectorSet(ndcX, ndcY, nearDepth[nearX], 1), inverse));
                        interior &= RenderCapture::HalfToFloat(nearMaterial[nearX * 4 + 3]) >= -0.5f && nearWorldY < settings.BottomHeight - 0.1f;
                    }
                if (!interior) continue;
                ++tested;
                occluded &= RenderCapture::HalfToFloat(cloudRow[x * 4 + 3]) == 1;
                for (UINT channel = 0; channel < 3; ++channel)
                    occluded &= RenderCapture::HalfToFloat(cloudRow[x * 4 + channel]) == 0;
            }
        }
    }
    WriteGraphicsLog("Cloud occlusion: checked foreground pixels=%u\n", tested);
    Check(tested > 100 && occluded, "foreground geometry clips cloud ray before layer entry");
    Check(RenderCapture::ReadTexture(RenderTargets::GetSceneResource(), g_CloudHdr), "read final HDR composite");
    g_ForegroundMask.assign(static_cast<size_t>(depth.Width) * depth.Height, 0);
    for (UINT y = 0; y < depth.Height; ++y)
    {
        const auto* depths = reinterpret_cast<const float*>(depth.Bytes.data() + y * depth.RowPitch);
        const auto* materials = reinterpret_cast<const uint16_t*>(material.Bytes.data() + y * material.RowPitch);
        for (UINT x = 0; x < depth.Width; ++x)
        {
            if (RenderCapture::HalfToFloat(materials[x * 4 + 3]) < -0.5f || depths[x] >= 0.999999f) continue;
            const float uvX = (x + 0.5f) / depth.Width;
            const float uvY = (y + 0.5f) / depth.Height;
            const float worldY = XMVectorGetY(XMVector3TransformCoord(XMVectorSet(uvX * 2 - 1, 1 - uvY * 2, depths[x], 1), inverse));
            g_ForegroundMask[y * depth.Width + x] = worldY < settings.BottomHeight - 0.01f;
        }
    }
}
void ValidateCompositeForeground()
{
    RenderCapture::TextureData clearHdr;
    const bool read = RenderCapture::ReadTexture(RenderTargets::GetSceneResource(), clearHdr);
    const bool compatible = read && clearHdr.Width == g_CloudHdr.Width && clearHdr.Height == g_CloudHdr.Height &&
        clearHdr.Format == DXGI_FORMAT_R16G16B16A16_FLOAT && g_CloudHdr.Format == clearHdr.Format &&
        g_ForegroundMask.size() == static_cast<size_t>(clearHdr.Width) * clearHdr.Height &&
        !clearHdr.Bytes.empty() && !g_CloudHdr.Bytes.empty();
    Check(compatible, "read HDR reference without cloud shadows");
    if (!compatible) return;
    UINT tested = 0;
    bool attenuated = true;
    UINT shadowed = 0;
    for (UINT y = 0; y < clearHdr.Height; ++y)
    {
        const auto* actual = reinterpret_cast<const uint16_t*>(g_CloudHdr.Bytes.data() + y * g_CloudHdr.RowPitch);
        const auto* reference = reinterpret_cast<const uint16_t*>(clearHdr.Bytes.data() + y * clearHdr.RowPitch);
        for (UINT x = 0; x < clearHdr.Width; ++x)
            if (g_ForegroundMask[y * clearHdr.Width + x])
            {
                ++tested;
                for (UINT channel = 0; channel < 3; ++channel)
                {
                    const float lit = RenderCapture::HalfToFloat(reference[x * 4 + channel]);
                    const float shaded = RenderCapture::HalfToFloat(actual[x * 4 + channel]);
                    attenuated &= shaded <= lit + 0.002f;
                    if (lit - shaded > 0.005f) ++shadowed;
                }
            }
    }
    Check(tested > 100 && attenuated, "cloud shadow only attenuates foreground illumination");
    Check(shadowed > 100, "clouds cast measurable shadows on foreground receivers");
}
}
bool CloudValidation::Enabled()
{
    char value[8]{};
    return GetEnvironmentVariableA("DX12_CLOUD_TEST", value, sizeof(value)) && atoi(value) != 0;
}
void CloudValidation::BeforeFrame(uint64_t frame)
{
    g_LastFrame = static_cast<UINT>(frame);
    g_RecordedFrameIndex = GraphicsDevice::GetFrameIndex();
    if (frame == 52) RenderConfiguration::Resize(1920, 1080);
    if (frame == 64) RenderConfiguration::Resize(1200, 600);
    if (frame == 84) RenderConfiguration::Resize(1920, 1080);
    // Resize may select a new swap-chain index.
    g_RecordedFrameIndex = GraphicsDevice::GetFrameIndex();
    RenderConfiguration::SetHdr(true);
    RenderConfiguration::SetRenderMode(RenderMode::DEFERRED);
    RenderConfiguration::SetResolutionScale(frame >= 76 && frame < 80 ? 0.67f : 1.0f);
    Raytracing::GetSettings().Enabled = false;
    RendererState::m_AntiAliasingMode = AntiAliasingMode::NONE;
    auto& settings = CloudRenderer::GetSettings();
    settings = CloudSettings{};
    settings.Enabled = true;
    settings.WindSpeed = 0;
    settings.Coverage = 0.55f;
    if (frame == 0)
    {
        for (auto id : World::GetView<MeshComponent>())
        {
            if (ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<MeshComponent>(id).IsEnvironment) continue;
            auto& tower = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<TransformComponent>(id);
            tower.Position = { 0, 18, 30 };
            tower.Scale = { 6, 35, 6 };
            tower.IsDirty = true;
        }
    }
    const auto camera = Camera::GetCameraEntity();
    auto& transform = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<TransformComponent>(camera);
    auto& view = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<CameraComponent>(camera);
    transform.Position = { 0, 3, -8 };
    view.Target = { 0, 12, 40 };
    view.AllowUserControl = false;
    transform.IsDirty = true;
    // The selected solar light drives daylight; a shared virtual moon lights night.
    for (auto id : World::GetView<LightComponent>())
    {
        auto& light = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<LightComponent>(id);
        light.IsActive = true;
        light.Intensity = frame >= 44 && frame < 48 ? 0.0f : frame >= 48 && frame < 52 ? 100.0f : 3.0f;
        light.Color = { 1, 0.9f, 0.75f, 1 };
        auto& sun = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<TransformComponent>(id);
        sun.Position = frame >= 48 && frame < 52 ? XMFLOAT3{ 0, 1, -8 } : XMFLOAT3{ 0, 8, -8 };
        sun.IsDirty = true;
    }
    const UINT scenario = static_cast<UINT>(frame / 4);
    switch (scenario)
    {
    case 1: settings.Coverage = 0; break;
    case 2: settings.Density = 0; break;
    case 3: transform.Position.y = 30; view.Target.y = 31; break;
    case 4: transform.Position.y = 60; view.Target.y = 0; break;
    case 5: view.Target.y = transform.Position.y; break;
    case 6: transform.Position.y = 30; view.Target.y = 30; break;
    case 7: view.Target = { 0.001f, 50, -8 }; break;
    case 8: view.Target = { 0.001f, -50, -8 }; break;
    case 9: settings.TopHeight = settings.BottomHeight + 0.01f; break;
    case 10: settings.TopHeight = 400; settings.Density = 10; settings.Coverage = 1; break;
    case 13: settings.ApplyQuality(CloudQuality::Low); break;
    case 14: settings.ApplyQuality(CloudQuality::Medium); break;
    case 15: settings.ApplyQuality(CloudQuality::High); break;
    case 16: settings.ResolutionScale = 1; break;
    case 17: settings.Seed = 1338; break;
    case 20: settings.WindSpeed = 1000; break;
    default: break;
    }
    if (frame == 72) CloudRenderer::GenerateNoise(1337);
    if (frame >= 84 && frame < 144) settings.ApplyQuality(CloudQuality::Low);
    if (frame >= 204 && frame < 264) settings.ApplyQuality(CloudQuality::High);
    if (frame >= 264 && frame < 292) settings.Debug = static_cast<CloudDebug>(1 + (frame - 264) / 4);
    if (frame >= 292)
    {
        settings.Debug = CloudDebug::Normal;
        settings.CastShadows = frame < 296;
        if (frame == 300)
        {
            Light::CreateDesc desc;
            desc.Name = "Cloud unrelated directional regression";
            desc.Direction = { 0, 1, 0 };
            desc.Color = { 1, 0, 1, 1 };
            desc.Intensity = 100;
            desc.Priority = 100;
            g_UnrelatedDirectional = Light::Create(desc);
        }
        if (Registry::IsAlive(g_UnrelatedDirectional))
        {
            auto& unrelated = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<LightComponent>(g_UnrelatedDirectional);
            unrelated.Intensity = 100;
            unrelated.Color = { 1, 0, 1, 1 };
        }
        if (frame >= 304)
            for (auto id : World::GetView<SunComponent, LightComponent>())
                ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<LightComponent>(id).IsActive = false;
    }
    if (frame >= 316)
    {
        // Keep these views deterministic and independent of the celestial-lighting cases.
        DayNightCycle::GetSettings().AutomaticLighting = false;
        DayNightCycle::GetSettings().TimeDriven = false;
        for (auto id : World::GetView<SunComponent, LightComponent>())
        {
            ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<LightComponent>(id).IsActive = true;
        }
        if (Registry::IsAlive(g_UnrelatedDirectional))
        {
            ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<LightComponent>(g_UnrelatedDirectional).IsActive = false;
        }
        settings.LayerCount = 2;
        settings.BottomHeight = 10;
        settings.TopHeight = 30;
        settings.Coverage = 1;
        settings.Density = 0.6f;
        settings.DetailStrength = 0;
        settings.JitterStrength = 0;
        auto& upper = settings.Layer(1);
        upper.BottomHeight = 40;
        upper.TopHeight = 50;
        upper.Coverage = 1;
        upper.Density = 0.4f;
        upper.DetailStrength = 0;
        view.Target = { 0.001f, 100, -8 };
        const UINT layerScenario = static_cast<UINT>((frame - 316) / 4);
        if (layerScenario == 0)
        {
            upper.LayerEnabled = false;
        }
        else if (layerScenario == 1)
        {
            settings.LayerEnabled = false;
        }
        else if (layerScenario == 3)
        {
            settings.LayerEnabled = false;
            upper.LayerEnabled = false;
        }
        else if (layerScenario == 4)
        {
            transform.Position.y = 35;
            view.Target = { 0, 35, 40 };
        }
        else if (layerScenario == 5)
        {
            transform.Position.y = 60;
            view.Target = { 0.001f, 0, -8 };
            // Reverse height order to exercise sorting for downward rays.
            std::swap(settings.Layer(0), settings.Layer(1));
        }
        else if (layerScenario == 6)
        {
            upper.TopHeight = upper.BottomHeight + 0.01f;
            upper.Density = 10;
            settings.LayerEnabled = false;
        }
        else if (layerScenario == 7)
        {
            settings.LayerCount = 4;
            settings.Layer(2) = upper;
            settings.Layer(2).BottomHeight = 20;
            settings.Layer(2).TopHeight = 45;
            settings.Layer(3) = upper;
            settings.Layer(3).BottomHeight = 70;
            settings.Layer(3).TopHeight = 80;
        }
        else if (layerScenario >= 8)
        {
            settings.LayerEnabled = false;
            upper.Density = 4;
            settings.Extinction = 0.3f;
            settings.CastShadows = layerScenario == 8;
            view.Target = { 0, 12, 40 };
        }
    }
    if (frame == 0) Check(CloudRenderer::IsAvailable(), "cloud pipelines initialize");
    if (frame >= 308 && frame < 316)
    {
        auto& cycle = DayNightCycle::GetSettings();
        cycle.Running = false;
        cycle.AutomaticLighting = true;
        for (auto id : World::GetView<SunComponent, LightComponent>())
            ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<LightComponent>(id).IsActive = true;
        if (Registry::IsAlive(g_UnrelatedDirectional))
            ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<LightComponent>(g_UnrelatedDirectional).IsActive = false;
        DayNightCycle::SetTime(frame < 312 ? 17.15f : 0.0f);
        const auto direction = DayNightCycle::GetSunDirection();
        const float sign = frame < 312 ? 1.0f : -1.0f;
        view.Target = { transform.Position.x + direction.x * sign * 100,
            transform.Position.y + (max)(direction.y * sign, 0.15f) * 100,
            transform.Position.z + direction.z * sign * 100 };
    }
    g_Configurations.push_back({ static_cast<UINT>(ceilf(GraphicsDevice::GetWidth() * settings.ResolutionScale)),
        static_cast<UINT>(ceilf(GraphicsDevice::GetHeight() * settings.ResolutionScale)), settings.ViewSteps, settings.LightSteps });
}
void CloudValidation::AfterFrame(uint64_t frame)
{
    if (auto* rendered = CloudRenderer::GetCloudResource(g_RecordedFrameIndex))
    {
        const auto desc = rendered->GetDesc();
        g_Configurations.back().Width = static_cast<UINT>(desc.Width);
        g_Configurations.back().Height = desc.Height;
    }
    const auto& timing = RenderProfiler::GetLatest();
    if (timing.Serial && timing.Serial != g_LastTimingSerial && timing.Serial <= g_Configurations.size())
    {
        g_LastTimingSerial = timing.Serial;
        const auto& config = g_Configurations[timing.Serial - 1];
        for (const auto& pass : timing.Passes)
            if (pass.Name == "Cloud Total" || pass.Name == "Cloud Raymarch" || pass.Name == "Cloud Composite")
            {
                g_SawGpuTiming |= pass.GpuMs > 0;
                WriteGraphicsLog("Cloud profiling: serial=%llu %s %.3f ms resolution=%ux%u steps=%d/%d\n",
                    timing.Serial, pass.Name.c_str(), pass.GpuMs, config.Width, config.Height, config.ViewSteps, config.LightSteps);
                if (timing.Serial >= 85 && timing.Serial <= 264 && config.Width == 960 && config.Height == 540 && pass.Name == "Cloud Total" && pass.GpuMs > 0)
                {
                    const uint64_t benchmarkFrame = timing.Serial - 85;
                    const UINT quality = static_cast<UINT>(benchmarkFrame / 60);
                    if (benchmarkFrame % 60 >= 10) g_BenchmarkMs[quality].push_back(pass.GpuMs);
                }
            }
    }
    if (frame >= 84 && frame < 264) return;
    if (frame % 4 != 3) return;
    RenderCapture::TextureData cloud;
    const bool read = RenderCapture::ReadTexture(CloudRenderer::GetCloudResource(g_RecordedFrameIndex), cloud);
    Check(read && cloud.Format == DXGI_FORMAT_R16G16B16A16_FLOAT, "read scattering/transmittance buffer");
    if (!read) return;
    const auto& settings = CloudRenderer::GetSettings();
    Check(cloud.Width == max(1u, static_cast<UINT>(ceilf(GraphicsDevice::GetSceneWidth() * settings.ResolutionScale))) &&
        cloud.Height == max(1u, static_cast<UINT>(ceilf(GraphicsDevice::GetSceneHeight() * settings.ResolutionScale))),
        "cloud extent follows scene resize and resolution scale");
    bool valid = true;
    double opacity = 0;
    double radiance = 0;
    for (UINT y = 0; y < cloud.Height; ++y)
    {
        const auto* pixels = reinterpret_cast<const uint16_t*>(cloud.Bytes.data() + y * cloud.RowPitch);
        for (UINT x = 0; x < cloud.Width; ++x)
        {
            for (UINT channel = 0; channel < 4; ++channel)
            {
                const float value = RenderCapture::HalfToFloat(pixels[x * 4 + channel]);
                valid &= isfinite(value) && value >= 0;
                if (channel == 3) { valid &= value <= 1; opacity += 1 - value; }
                else radiance += value;
            }
        }
    }
    Check(valid, "finite nonnegative scattering and transmittance in [0,1]");
    if (frame >= 316)
    {
        const UINT layerScenario = static_cast<UINT>((frame - 316) / 4);
        if (layerScenario == 0)
        {
            g_LowerLayerOpacity = opacity;
            Check(opacity > 1, "lower layer remains visible with upper layer disabled");
        }
        else if (layerScenario == 1)
        {
            g_UpperLayerOpacity = opacity;
            Check(opacity > 1, "upper layer renders independently with lower layer disabled");
        }
        else if (layerScenario == 2)
        {
            g_TwoLayerOpacity = opacity;
            Check(opacity > g_LowerLayerOpacity && opacity > g_UpperLayerOpacity,
                "two separated layers both contribute optical depth");
        }
        else if (layerScenario == 3)
        {
            Check(opacity == 0 && radiance == 0, "all disabled layers transmit scene exactly");
        }
        else if (layerScenario == 4)
        {
            bool clearGap = true;
            for (UINT y = cloud.Height / 2 - 1; y <= cloud.Height / 2; ++y)
            {
                const auto* pixels = reinterpret_cast<const uint16_t*>(cloud.Bytes.data() + y * cloud.RowPitch);
                for (UINT x = 0; x < cloud.Width; ++x)
                {
                    clearGap &= RenderCapture::HalfToFloat(pixels[x * 4 + 3]) == 1;
                }
            }
            Check(clearGap, "horizontal rays in gap between layers stay clear");
        }
        else if (layerScenario == 5)
        {
            Check(opacity > 1, "unsorted layers render from above");
        }
        else if (layerScenario == 6)
        {
            Check(opacity > 0, "isolated extremely thin upper layer is sampled");
        }
        else if (layerScenario == 7)
        {
            Check(opacity > g_TwoLayerOpacity, "four layers including overlaps contribute density");
        }
        if (layerScenario >= 8)
        {
            RenderCapture::TextureData scene;
            RenderCapture::TextureData material;
            const bool read = RenderCapture::ReadTexture(RenderTargets::GetSceneResource(), scene) &&
                RenderCapture::ReadTexture(RenderTargets::GetGBufferResource(GBufferType::MATERIAL), material);
            const bool compatible = read && scene.Format == DXGI_FORMAT_R16G16B16A16_FLOAT &&
                material.Format == DXGI_FORMAT_R16G16B16A16_FLOAT &&
                scene.Width == material.Width && scene.Height == material.Height;
            Check(compatible, "read HDR surface receivers for upper-layer shadow comparison");
            double receiverRadiance = 0;
            if (compatible)
            {
                for (UINT y = 0; y < scene.Height; ++y)
                {
                    const auto* pixels = reinterpret_cast<const uint16_t*>(scene.Bytes.data() + y * scene.RowPitch);
                    const auto* materials = reinterpret_cast<const uint16_t*>(material.Bytes.data() + y * material.RowPitch);
                    for (UINT x = 0; x < scene.Width; ++x)
                    {
                        if (RenderCapture::HalfToFloat(materials[x * 4 + 3]) < -0.5f)
                        {
                            continue;
                        }
                        for (UINT channel = 0; channel < 3; ++channel)
                        {
                            receiverRadiance += RenderCapture::HalfToFloat(pixels[x * 4 + channel]);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            if (layerScenario == 8)
            {
                g_ShadowedReceiverRadiance = receiverRadiance;
                g_ShadowedCloudOpacity = opacity;
            }
            else
            {
                Check(receiverRadiance > g_ShadowedReceiverRadiance + 0.01,
                    "upper layer alone casts shadows on surface receivers");
                Check(opacity == g_ShadowedCloudOpacity,
                    "upper-layer shadow toggle preserves cloud optical depth");
            }
        }
        if (layerScenario == 2 || layerScenario == 5 || layerScenario == 7)
        {
            wchar_t path[128]{};
            swprintf_s(path, L"bin/validation/cloud-layers-%u.png", layerScenario);
            Check(RenderCapture::SaveScenePng(path), "capture layered clouds");
        }
        return;
    }
    if (frame >= 308)
    {
        Check(opacity > 1 && radiance > 0, "celestial lighting produces visible cloud scattering");
        if (frame == 311 || frame == 315)
        {
            const wchar_t* path = frame == 311 ? L"bin/validation/cloud-sunset.png" : L"bin/validation/cloud-moon.png";
            Check(RenderCapture::SaveScenePng(path), "capture sunset or moonlit clouds");
        }
        if (frame == 315)
            Check(DayNightCycle::GetSunDirection().y < 0, "moonlit clouds render with sun below horizon");
        return;
    }
    if (frame >= 292)
    {
        if (frame == 295)
        {
            g_ConnectedSunCloud = cloud;
            g_ConnectedSunRadiance = radiance;
            ValidateSceneOcclusion(cloud);
        }
        if (frame == 299 || frame == 303)
        {
            bool identical = cloud.Width == g_ConnectedSunCloud.Width && cloud.Height == g_ConnectedSunCloud.Height;
            if (identical)
                for (UINT y = 0; y < cloud.Height; ++y)
                    identical &= memcmp(cloud.Bytes.data() + y * cloud.RowPitch,
                        g_ConnectedSunCloud.Bytes.data() + y * g_ConnectedSunCloud.RowPitch, cloud.Width * 8) == 0;
            Check(identical, frame == 299 ? "shadow toggle preserves cloud scattering" :
                "bright unrelated directional light does not replace the virtual sun");
            if (frame == 299) ValidateCompositeForeground();
        }
        if (frame == 307)
            Check(radiance < g_ConnectedSunRadiance, "inactive sun removes direct cloud scattering despite unrelated light");
        return;
    }
    if (frame >= 264)
    {
        Check(settings.Debug != CloudDebug::Normal, "runtime diagnostic view renders without shader recompile");
        return;
    }
    const UINT scenario = static_cast<UINT>(frame / 4);
    if (scenario == 0)
    {
        Check(opacity > 1 && radiance > 0, "volume is visible and lit");
        g_InitialOpacity = opacity;
        g_InitialRadiance = radiance;
        ValidateSceneOcclusion(cloud);
        g_NoiseHash = NoiseHash();
        Check(g_NoiseHash != 0, "GPU base noise readback");
    }
    if (scenario == 1 || scenario == 2 || scenario == 8)
        Check(opacity == 0 && radiance == 0, "clear/zero-density/nonintersecting rays transmit scene exactly");
    if (scenario == 1) ValidateCompositeForeground();
    if (scenario == 11) Check(radiance < g_InitialRadiance, "zero sun intensity reduces cloud scattering");
    if (scenario == 5)
    {
        bool horizontalClear = true;
        for (UINT y = cloud.Height / 2 - 1; y <= cloud.Height / 2; ++y)
        {
            const auto* pixels = reinterpret_cast<const uint16_t*>(cloud.Bytes.data() + y * cloud.RowPitch);
            for (UINT x = 0; x < cloud.Width; ++x)
                horizontalClear &= RenderCapture::HalfToFloat(pixels[x * 4 + 3]) == 1;
        }
        Check(horizontalClear, "horizontal rays below layer remain clear");
    }
    if (scenario == 17) Check(NoiseHash() != g_NoiseHash, "different seed changes GPU noise");
    if (scenario == 18)
    {
        Check(NoiseHash() == g_NoiseHash, "same seed regenerates identical GPU noise");
        Check(abs(opacity - g_InitialOpacity) < 0.01, "returning camera and seed restores world-space cloud");
        Check(CloudRenderer::GetNoiseGenerationCount() == 3, "noise generated only at startup and seed changes");
    }
    if (scenario == 0 || scenario == 3 || scenario == 4 || scenario == 6 || scenario == 20)
    {
        wchar_t path[128]{};
        swprintf_s(path, L"bin/validation/cloud-%02u.png", scenario);
        Check(RenderCapture::SaveScenePng(path), "capture cloud scenario");
    }
}
bool CloudValidation::Finish()
{
    Check(g_LastFrame >= 355, "complete cloud validation including four-layer clouds");
    Check(g_SawGpuTiming, "cloud GPU timestamps available");
    const char* qualityNames[] = { "Low", "Medium", "High" };
    array<double, 3> medians{};
    for (UINT quality = 0; quality < 3; ++quality)
    {
        auto& samples = g_BenchmarkMs[quality];
        Check(samples.size() >= 30, "warmed 1920x1080 GPU samples for quality preset");
        if (samples.empty()) continue;
        sort(samples.begin(), samples.end());
        medians[quality] = samples[samples.size() / 2];
        WriteGraphicsLog("Cloud benchmark: 1920x1080 %s samples=%zu median=%.3f ms p95=%.3f ms\n",
            qualityNames[quality], samples.size(), medians[quality],
            samples[static_cast<size_t>((samples.size() - 1) * 0.95)]);
    }
    Check(medians[0] < medians[1] && medians[1] < medians[2], "quality presets change measured GPU load");
    g_Failures += RenderCapture::ReportGraphicsErrors();
    ComPtr<ID3D12InfoQueue> info;
    if (SUCCEEDED(GraphicsDevice::GetDevice()->QueryInterface(IID_PPV_ARGS(&info))))
    {
        UINT warnings = 0;
        UINT legacyWarnings = 0;
        UINT trackingLimitations = 0;
        for (UINT64 index = 0; index < info->GetNumStoredMessagesAllowedByRetrievalFilter(); ++index)
        {
            SIZE_T bytes = 0;
            info->GetMessage(index, nullptr, &bytes);
            vector<BYTE> storage(bytes);
            auto* message = reinterpret_cast<D3D12_MESSAGE*>(storage.data());
            if (SUCCEEDED(info->GetMessage(index, message, &bytes)) && message->Severity == D3D12_MESSAGE_SEVERITY_WARNING)
            {
                // Reproduced with clouds disabled in the existing Sun Lighting test.
                // Report separately: existing indirect VB/IB/root updates limit GBV.
                if (message->ID == D3D12_MESSAGE_ID_GPU_BASED_VALIDATION_RESOURCE_STATE_IMPRECISE)
                {
                    ++trackingLimitations;
                    continue;
                }
                // Existing readback helpers use COPY_DEST on readback buffers, and
                // legacy scene passes clear with values different from optimized clears.
                // Cloud passes neither create those buffers nor issue clears.
                if (message->ID == D3D12_MESSAGE_ID_CREATERESOURCE_STATE_IGNORED ||
                    message->ID == D3D12_MESSAGE_ID_CLEARRENDERTARGETVIEW_MISMATCHINGCLEARVALUE)
                {
                    ++legacyWarnings;
                    continue;
                }
                ++warnings;
                WriteGraphicsLog("Cloud validation D3D12 warning id=%u: %s\n", static_cast<UINT>(message->ID), message->pDescription);
            }
        }
        WriteGraphicsLog("Cloud validation: existing readback/scene-clear warnings = %u\n", legacyWarnings);
        WriteGraphicsLog("Cloud validation: existing GBV tracking limitations = %u\n", trackingLimitations);
        Check(warnings == 0, "no additional D3D12 resource/descriptor/barrier warnings");
    }
    WriteGraphicsLog("Validation: cloud failures = %u\n", g_Failures);
    return g_Failures == 0;
}

constexpr UINT kFrameCount = RendererState::g_kFRAME_COUNT;
constexpr UINT kDescriptorStart = RendererState::g_kHIZ_MIP_SRV_START_INDEX +
    2 * RendererState::g_kHIZ_MAX_MIPS + 2 * kFrameCount + 1;
constexpr UINT kDescriptorsPerFrame = 3;
static_assert(kDescriptorStart + kDescriptorsPerFrame * kFrameCount <= RendererState::g_kENGINE_DESCRIPTOR_END,
    "DLSS descriptors exceed the reserved engine heap");

ID3D12Device* g_Device = nullptr;
ID3D12DescriptorHeap* g_Heap = nullptr;
UINT g_Increment = 0;

bool g_Active = false;

bool g_ResetHistory = true;
bool g_LoggedEvaluation = false;
UINT g_JitterFrame = 0;

#ifdef RENDERINGPROJECT_USE_DLSS
NVSDK_NGX_Parameter* g_Parameters = nullptr;
NVSDK_NGX_Handle* g_Feature = nullptr;
bool g_Initialized = false;
UINT g_InputWidth = 0;
UINT g_InputHeight = 0;
UINT g_OutputWidth = 0;
UINT g_OutputHeight = 0;
bool g_FeatureHdr = false;
ComPtr<ID3D12RootSignature> g_Root;
ComPtr<ID3D12PipelineState> g_PreparePipeline;
ComPtr<ID3D12PipelineState> g_CopyPipeline;

{
    ComPtr<ID3D12Resource> Color;
    ComPtr<ID3D12Resource> Motion;
    ComPtr<ID3D12Resource> Output;
};
array<FrameResources, kFrameCount> g_Frames;

D3D12_CPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE CpuHandle(UINT index)
{
    return CD3DX12_CPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE(g_Heap->GetCPUDescriptorHandleForHeapStart(), index, g_Increment);
}

D3D12_GPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE GpuHandle(UINT index)
{
    return CD3DX12_GPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE(g_Heap->GetGPUDescriptorHandleForHeapStart(), index, g_Increment);

bool CreateHelperPipelines()
{
    CD3DX12_DESCRIPTOR_RANGE ranges[4];
    CD3DX12_ROOT_PARAMETER parameters[4];
    for (UINT index = 0; index < 4; ++index)
    {
        const auto type = index < 2 ? D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_RANGE_TYPE_SRV : D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_RANGE_TYPE_UAV;
        ranges[index].Init(type, 1, index % 2);
        parameters[index].InitAsDescriptorTable(1, &ranges[index]);
    }
    const CD3DX12_ROOT_SIGNATURE_DESC description(4, parameters);
    ComPtr<ID3DBlob> serialized;
    if (FAILED(D3D12SerializeRootSignature(&description, D3D_ROOT_SIGNATURE_VERSION_1, &serialized, nullptr)) ||
        FAILED(g_Device->CreateRootSignature(0, serialized->GetBufferPointer(), serialized->GetBufferSize(), IID_PPV_ARGS(&g_Root))))
    {
        return false;
    }
    auto createPipeline = [](const wchar_t* path, ComPtr<ID3D12PipelineState>& pipeline)
    {
        ComPtr<ID3DBlob> shader;
        if (FAILED(D3DReadFileToBlob(path, &shader)))
        {
            return false;
        }
        D3D12_COMPUTE_PIPELINE_STATE_DESC description{};
        description.pRootSignature = g_Root.Get();
        description.CS = { shader->GetBufferPointer(), shader->GetBufferSize() };
        return SUCCEEDED(g_Device->CreateComputePipelineState(&description, IID_PPV_ARGS(&pipeline)));
    };
    return createPipeline(L"shader/hlsl/build/DlssPrepareCS.cso", g_PreparePipeline) &&
        createPipeline(L"shader/hlsl/build/DlssCopyCS.cso", g_CopyPipeline);
}

bool CreateTexture(UINT width, UINT height, DXGI_FORMAT format, const wchar_t* name, ComPtr<ID3D12Resource>& texture)
{
    const auto heap = CD3DX12_HEAP_PROPERTIES(D3D12_HEAP_TYPE_DEFAULT);
    const auto description = CD3DX12_RESOURCE_DESC::Tex2D(format, width, height, 1, 1, 1, 0,
        D3D12_RESOURCE_FLAG_ALLOW_UNORDERED_ACCESS);
    if (FAILED(g_Device->CreateCommittedResource(&heap, D3D12_HEAP_FLAG_NONE, &description,
        D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_NON_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE, nullptr, IID_PPV_ARGS(&texture))))
    {
        return false;
    }
    texture->SetName(name);
    return true;
}

bool EnsureFeature(ID3D12GraphicsCommandList* commands, UINT width, UINT height, UINT outputWidth, UINT outputHeight)
{
    const bool hdrInput = ImGuiManager::IsHdrEnabled() && !ImGuiManager::IsToneMapEnabled();
    if (g_Feature && g_InputWidth == width && g_InputHeight == height &&
        g_OutputWidth == outputWidth && g_OutputHeight == outputHeight && g_FeatureHdr == hdrInput)
    {
        return true;
    }
    if (!GraphicsDevice::WaitForGpuIdle())
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (g_Feature)
    {
        NVSDK_NGX_D3D12_ReleaseFeature(g_Feature);
        g_Feature = nullptr;
    }
    g_Frames = {};
    for (UINT index = 0; index < kFrameCount; ++index)
    {
        auto& frame = g_Frames[index];
        if (!CreateTexture(width, height, DXGI_FORMAT_R16G16B16A16_FLOAT, L"DLSS Input Color", frame.Color) ||
            !CreateTexture(width, height, DXGI_FORMAT_R16G16_FLOAT, L"DLSS Motion Vectors", frame.Motion) ||
            !CreateTexture(outputWidth, outputHeight, DXGI_FORMAT_R16G16B16A16_FLOAT, L"DLSS Output", frame.Output))
        {
            return false;
        }
        const UINT first = kDescriptorStart + index * kDescriptorsPerFrame;
        D3D12_UNORDERED_ACCESS_VIEW_DESC view{};
        view.ViewDimension = D3D12_UAV_DIMENSION_TEXTURE2D;
        view.Format = DXGI_FORMAT_R16G16_FLOAT;
        g_Device->CreateUnorderedAccessView(frame.Motion.Get(), nullptr, &view, CpuHandle(first));
        view.Format = DXGI_FORMAT_R16G16B16A16_FLOAT;
        g_Device->CreateUnorderedAccessView(frame.Color.Get(), nullptr, &view, CpuHandle(first + 1));
        D3D12_SHADER_RESOURCE_VIEW_DESC outputView{};
        outputView.Format = DXGI_FORMAT_R16G16B16A16_FLOAT;
        outputView.ViewDimension = D3D12_SRV_DIMENSION_TEXTURE2D;
        outputView.Shader4ComponentMapping = D3D12_DEFAULT_SHADER_4_COMPONENT_MAPPING;
        outputView.Texture2D.MipLevels = 1;
        g_Device->CreateShaderResourceView(frame.Output.Get(), &outputView, CpuHandle(first + 2));
    }
    NVSDK_NGX_DLSS_Create_Params parameters{};
    parameters.Feature.InWidth = width;
    parameters.Feature.InHeight = height;
    parameters.Feature.InTargetWidth = outputWidth;
    parameters.Feature.InTargetHeight = outputHeight;
    const float scale = static_cast<float>(width) / outputWidth;
    parameters.Feature.InPerfQualityValue = NVSDK_NGX_PerfQuality_Value_MaxQuality;
    if (scale <= 0.38f)
    {
        parameters.Feature.InPerfQualityValue = NVSDK_NGX_PerfQuality_Value_UltraPerformance;
    }
    else if (scale <= 0.52f)
    {
        parameters.Feature.InPerfQualityValue = NVSDK_NGX_PerfQuality_Value_MaxPerf;
    }
    else if (scale < 0.64f)
    {
        parameters.Feature.InPerfQualityValue = NVSDK_NGX_PerfQuality_Value_Balanced;
    }
    parameters.InFeatureCreateFlags = NVSDK_NGX_DLSS_Feature_Flags_MVLowRes | NVSDK_NGX_DLSS_Feature_Flags_MVJittered;
    if (hdrInput)
    {
        parameters.InFeatureCreateFlags |= NVSDK_NGX_DLSS_Feature_Flags_IsHDR | NVSDK_NGX_DLSS_Feature_Flags_AutoExposure;
    }
    const auto result = NGX_D3D12_CREATE_DLSS_EXT(commands, 1, 1, &g_Feature, g_Parameters, &parameters);
    if (NVSDK_NGX_FAILED(result))
    {
        WriteGraphicsLog("DLSS: feature creation failed 0x%08x\n", static_cast<unsigned>(result));
        g_Status = "DLSS feature creation failed; using Bilateral";
        return false;
    }
    g_InputWidth = width;
    g_InputHeight = height;
    g_OutputWidth = outputWidth;
    g_OutputHeight = outputHeight;
    g_FeatureHdr = hdrInput;
    g_ResetHistory = true;
    WriteGraphicsLog("DLSS: feature %ux%u -> %ux%u mode=%d HDR=%d\n", width, height, outputWidth, outputHeight,
        static_cast<int>(parameters.Feature.InPerfQualityValue), static_cast<int>(hdrInput));
    return true;
}

void Transition(ID3D12GraphicsCommandList* commands, ID3D12Resource* texture, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATES before, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATES after)
{
    const auto barrier = CD3DX12_RESOURCE_BARRIER::Transition(texture, before, after);
    commands->ResourceBarrier(1, &barrier);
}
#endif

float Halton(UINT index, UINT base)
{
    float result = 0.0f;
    float weight = 1.0f;
    while (index != 0)
    {
        weight /= base;
        result += (index % base) * weight;
        index /= base;
    }
    return result;
}
}

void DlssUpscaler::Initialize(ID3D12Device* device, ID3D12DescriptorHeap* heap, UINT increment)
{
    Shutdown();
    g_Device = device;
    g_Heap = heap;
    g_Increment = increment;
#ifdef RENDERINGPROJECT_USE_DLSS
    char disabled[8]{};
    if (GetEnvironmentVariableA("DX12_DISABLE_DLSS", disabled, sizeof(disabled)) > 0 && atoi(disabled) != 0)
    {
        g_Status = "DLSS disabled for compatibility validation";
        return;
    }
    if (!device || !heap || increment == 0 || !CreateHelperPipelines())
    {
        g_Status = "DLSS helper pipeline is unavailable";
        return;
    }
    wchar_t executable[MAX_PATH]{};
    GetModuleFileNameW(nullptr, executable, MAX_PATH);
    const auto directory = filesystem::path(executable).parent_path().wstring();
    const wchar_t* paths[] = { directory.c_str() };
    NVSDK_NGX_FeatureCommonInfo info{};
    info.PathListInfo.Path = paths;
    info.PathListInfo.Length = 1;
    const auto logs = filesystem::absolute("bin/ngx").wstring();
    error_code error;
    filesystem::create_directories(logs, error);
    const auto result = NVSDK_NGX_D3D12_Init_with_ProjectID("ddaac575-3a1b-4406-94ce-e13d43222fe2",
        NVSDK_NGX_ENGINE_TYPE_CUSTOM, "1.0", logs.c_str(), device, &info);
    if (NVSDK_NGX_FAILED(result))
    {
        WriteGraphicsLog("DLSS: NGX initialization unavailable 0x%08x\n", static_cast<unsigned>(result));
        g_Status = "NGX unavailable on this GPU/driver; using Bilateral";
        return;
    }
    g_Initialized = true;
    int available = 0;
    int needsDriver = 0;
    if (NVSDK_NGX_SUCCEED(NVSDK_NGX_D3D12_GetCapabilityParameters(&g_Parameters)))
    {
        g_Parameters->Get(NVSDK_NGX_Parameter_SuperSampling_Available, &available);
        g_Parameters->Get(NVSDK_NGX_Parameter_SuperSampling_NeedsUpdatedDriver, &needsDriver);
    }
    g_Available = available != 0 && needsDriver == 0;
    g_Status = g_Available ? "DLSS Super Resolution ready" : "DLSS unsupported or driver update required; using Bilateral";
    WriteGraphicsLog("DLSS: %s\n", g_Status.c_str());
#endif
}

void DlssUpscaler::Shutdown()
{
#ifdef RENDERINGPROJECT_USE_DLSS
    if (g_Feature)
    {
        NVSDK_NGX_D3D12_ReleaseFeature(g_Feature);
        g_Feature = nullptr;
    }
    if (g_Parameters)
    {
        NVSDK_NGX_D3D12_DestroyParameters(g_Parameters);
        g_Parameters = nullptr;
    }
    if (g_Initialized)
    {
        NVSDK_NGX_D3D12_Shutdown1(g_Device);
    }
    g_Initialized = false;
    g_Frames = {};
    g_Root.Reset();
    g_PreparePipeline.Reset();
    g_CopyPipeline.Reset();
#endif
    g_Available = false;
    g_Active = false;
    g_Prepared = false;
    g_ResetHistory = true;
    g_LoggedEvaluation = false;
    g_JitterFrame = 0;
    g_Jitter = {};
    g_Camera = g_kINVALID_ENTITY;
    g_Status = "NGX SDK is not installed";
}

bool DlssUpscaler::IsAvailable() { return g_Available; }
bool DlssUpscaler::IsActive() { return g_Active; }
const char* DlssUpscaler::GetStatus() { return g_Status.c_str(); }
XMFLOAT2 DlssUpscaler::GetJitter() { return g_Jitter; }

bool DlssUpscaler::IsScaleSupported(UINT width, UINT height, UINT outputWidth, UINT outputHeight)
{
    return g_Available && width > 0 && height > 0 && width < outputWidth && height < outputHeight &&
        static_cast<uint64_t>(width) * 4 >= outputWidth && static_cast<uint64_t>(height) * 4 >= outputHeight;
}

bool DlssUpscaler::IsRequested()
{
    return RenderConfiguration::GetRenderMode() == RenderMode::DEFERRED &&
        RendererSettings::GetUpscaleMode() == UpscaleMode::Dlss && IsScaleSupported(
            GraphicsDevice::GetSceneWidth(), GraphicsDevice::GetSceneHeight(), GraphicsDevice::GetWidth(), GraphicsDevice::GetHeight());
}

void DlssUpscaler::PrepareFrame(EntityID camera)
{
    g_Active = false;
    const bool requested = IsRequested();
    if (!requested || !g_Prepared || camera != g_Camera)
    {
        g_ResetHistory = true;
        g_JitterFrame = 0;
    }
    g_Jitter = {};
    if (requested)
    {
        const UINT phaseCount = max(8u, static_cast<UINT>(8.0f * GraphicsDevice::GetWidth() /
            GraphicsDevice::GetSceneWidth() * GraphicsDevice::GetHeight() / GraphicsDevice::GetSceneHeight()));
        const UINT index = g_JitterFrame++ % phaseCount + 1;
        g_Jitter = { Halton(index, 2) - 0.5f, Halton(index, 3) - 0.5f };
    }
    g_Prepared = requested;
    g_Camera = camera;
}

bool DlssUpscaler::Execute(ID3D12GraphicsCommandList* commands, UINT frameIndex,
    ID3D12Resource* color, D3D12_GPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE colorSrv, ID3D12Resource* depth,
    ID3D12Resource* velocity, D3D12_GPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE velocitySrv, ID3D12Resource* output,
    D3D12_GPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE outputUav)
{
    g_Active = false;
#ifdef RENDERINGPROJECT_USE_DLSS
    if (!IsRequested() || !g_Prepared || !commands || !color || !depth || !velocity || !output || frameIndex >= kFrameCount)
    {
        return false;
    }
    const auto input = color->GetDesc();
    const auto target = output->GetDesc();
    if (!EnsureFeature(commands, static_cast<UINT>(input.Width), input.Height, static_cast<UINT>(target.Width), target.Height))
    {
        g_Available = false;
        return false;
    }
    auto& frame = g_Frames[frameIndex];
    const UINT first = kDescriptorStart + frameIndex * kDescriptorsPerFrame;
    Transition(commands, frame.Motion.Get(), D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_NON_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS);
    Transition(commands, frame.Color.Get(), D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_NON_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS);
    ID3D12DescriptorHeap* heaps[] = { g_Heap };
    commands->SetDescriptorHeaps(1, heaps);
    commands->SetComputeRootSignature(g_Root.Get());
    commands->SetPipelineState(g_PreparePipeline.Get());
    commands->SetComputeRootDescriptorTable(0, velocitySrv);
    commands->SetComputeRootDescriptorTable(1, colorSrv);
    commands->SetComputeRootDescriptorTable(2, GpuHandle(first));
    commands->SetComputeRootDescriptorTable(3, GpuHandle(first + 1));
    commands->Dispatch((g_InputWidth + 7) / 8, (g_InputHeight + 7) / 8, 1);
    Transition(commands, frame.Motion.Get(), D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_NON_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE);
    Transition(commands, frame.Color.Get(), D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_NON_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE);
    Transition(commands, frame.Output.Get(), D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_NON_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS);
    NVSDK_NGX_D3D12_DLSS_Eval_Params evaluation{};
    evaluation.Feature.pInColor = frame.Color.Get();
    evaluation.Feature.pInOutput = frame.Output.Get();
    evaluation.pInDepth = depth;
    evaluation.pInMotionVectors = frame.Motion.Get();
    evaluation.InJitterOffsetX = g_Jitter.x;
    evaluation.InJitterOffsetY = g_Jitter.y;
    evaluation.InMVScaleX = static_cast<float>(g_InputWidth);
    evaluation.InMVScaleY = static_cast<float>(g_InputHeight);
    evaluation.InRenderSubrectDimensions = { g_InputWidth, g_InputHeight };
    evaluation.InReset = g_ResetHistory;
    const auto result = NGX_D3D12_EVALUATE_DLSS_EXT(commands, g_Feature, g_Parameters, &evaluation);
    Transition(commands, frame.Output.Get(), D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_NON_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE);
    if (NVSDK_NGX_FAILED(result))
    {
        g_Available = false;
        g_Status = "DLSS evaluation failed; using Bilateral";
        WriteGraphicsLog("DLSS: evaluation failed 0x%08x\n", static_cast<unsigned>(result));
        return false;
    }
    // NGX can change descriptor heaps and compute bindings.
    commands->SetDescriptorHeaps(1, heaps);
    commands->SetComputeRootSignature(g_Root.Get());
    commands->SetPipelineState(g_CopyPipeline.Get());
    commands->SetComputeRootDescriptorTable(0, GpuHandle(first + 2));
    commands->SetComputeRootDescriptorTable(2, outputUav);
    commands->Dispatch((g_OutputWidth + 7) / 8, (g_OutputHeight + 7) / 8, 1);
    g_ResetHistory = false;
    g_Active = true;
    if (!g_LoggedEvaluation)
    {
        WriteGraphicsLog("DLSS: first evaluation %ux%u -> %ux%u\n", g_InputWidth, g_InputHeight, g_OutputWidth, g_OutputHeight);
        g_LoggedEvaluation = true;
    }
    return true;
#else
    return false;
#endif
}

===== FILE: rendering\dlssupscaler.h =====
#pragma once

#include "pch.h"
#include "ecs.h"

class DlssUpscaler
{
public:
    static void Initialize(ID3D12Device* device, ID3D12DescriptorHeap* heap, UINT descriptorIncrement);
    static void Shutdown();
    static bool IsAvailable();
    static bool IsActive();
    static const char* GetStatus();
    static bool IsScaleSupported(UINT inputWidth, UINT inputHeight, UINT outputWidth, UINT outputHeight);
    static void PrepareFrame(EntityID camera);
    static bool IsRequested();
    static XMFLOAT2 GetJitter();
    static bool Execute(ID3D12GraphicsCommandList* commands, UINT frameIndex,
        ID3D12Resource* color, D3D12_GPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE colorSrv,
        ID3D12Resource* depth, ID3D12Resource* velocity, D3D12_GPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE velocitySrv,
        ID3D12Resource* output, D3D12_GPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE outputUav);
};

===== FILE: rendering\editordescriptorpool.h =====
#pragma once
#include <cstdint>
#include <optional>
#include <vector>

// Slots are reusable only after the submission that last referenced them completes.
class EditorDescriptorPool
{
public:
    explicit EditorDescriptorPool(uint32_t count) : m_Slots(count) {}
    std::optional<uint32_t> Allocate()
    {
        for (uint32_t index = 0; index < m_Slots.size(); ++index)
        {
            if (m_Slots[index].State != State::Free) continue;
            m_Slots[index].State = State::Used;
            return index;
        }
        return std::nullopt;
    }
    bool Retire(uint32_t index, uint64_t fence)
    {
        if (index >= m_Slots.size() || m_Slots[index].State != State::Used) return false;
        m_Slots[index] = {State::Retired, fence};
        return true;
    }
    void Collect(uint64_t completed)
    {
        for (auto& slot : m_Slots)
        {
            if (slot.State == State::Retired && slot.Fence <= completed) slot = {};
        }
    }
    uint32_t Available() const
    {
        uint32_t count = 0;
        for (const auto& slot : m_Slots) if (slot.State == State::Free) ++count;
        return count;
    }
private:
    enum class State { Free, Used, Retired };
    struct Slot { State State = State::Free; uint64_t Fence = 0; };
    std::vector<Slot> m_Slots;
};

===== FILE: rendering\editordescriptors.cpp =====
#include "pch.h"
#include "editordescriptors.h"
#include "editordescriptorpool.h"
#include "frameconstants.h"
#include "graphicsdevice.h"

namespace { EditorDescriptorPool pool(RendererState::g_kTHUMBNAIL_DESCRIPTOR_COUNT); }

EditorDescriptorLease::~EditorDescriptorLease() { EditorDescriptors::Retire(Index); }

std::shared_ptr<EditorDescriptorLease> EditorDescriptors::Allocate()
{
    const auto slot = pool.Allocate();
    if (!slot) return {};
    auto lease = std::make_shared<EditorDescriptorLease>();
    lease->Index = RendererState::g_kTHUMBNAIL_DESCRIPTOR_START + *slot;
    const auto heap = FrameConstants::GetCbvHeap();
    lease->Cpu = CD3DX12_CPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE(heap->GetCPUDescriptorHandleForHeapStart(),
        lease->Index, FrameConstants::GetCbvIncrementSize());
    lease->Gpu = CD3DX12_GPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE(heap->GetGPUDescriptorHandleForHeapStart(),
        lease->Index, FrameConstants::GetCbvIncrementSize());
    return lease;
}

void EditorDescriptors::Retire(UINT index)
{
    pool.Retire(index - RendererState::g_kTHUMBNAIL_DESCRIPTOR_START, GraphicsDevice::GetPendingSubmissionFence());
}

void EditorDescriptors::Collect() { pool.Collect(GraphicsDevice::GetCompletedFence()); }
UINT EditorDescriptors::Available() { return pool.Available(); }
void EditorDescriptors::Shutdown() { pool = EditorDescriptorPool(RendererState::g_kTHUMBNAIL_DESCRIPTOR_COUNT); }

===== FILE: rendering\frameconstants.cpp =====
#include "pch.h"
#include "frameconstants.h"

D3D12_GPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE FrameConstants::AllocateTransientConstantBuffer(const ConstantBuffer3D& constants)
{
	return AllocateTransientConstantBuffer(&constants, sizeof(constants));
}

D3D12_GPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE FrameConstants::AllocateTransientConstantBuffer(const void* data, size_t bytes)
{
	UINT8* frameCbvDataBegin = GetConstantBufferPtr();
	if (!data || bytes > g_kCB_ALIGNED_SIZE || !frameCbvDataBegin || !m_CbvHeap || m_TransientCbSlot >= g_kTRANSIENT_CB_SLOT_COUNT)
	{
		return {};
	}

	const UINT slot = g_kTRANSIENT_CB_START_INDEX + m_TransientCbSlot++;
	memcpy(frameCbvDataBegin + (slot * g_kCB_ALIGNED_SIZE), data, bytes);
	return GetConstantBufferHandle(slot);
}

===== FILE: rendering\frameconstants.h =====
#pragma once
#include "rendererstate.h"

class FrameConstants : protected RendererState
{
public:
	using RendererState::g_kCB_ALIGNED_SIZE;
	using RendererState::g_kCBV_PER_FRAME_COUNT;
	using RendererState::g_kCBV_COUNT;
	using RendererState::g_kMAX_DYNAMIC_VERTICES;
	using RendererState::g_kMAX_SRVS;
	using RendererState::g_kTEXTURE_SRV_START_INDEX;
	using RendererState::g_kTRANSIENT_CB_SLOT_COUNT;
	using RendererState::g_kTRANSIENT_CB_START_INDEX;
	using RendererState::m_DynamicVertexBuffer;
	using RendererState::m_DynamicVertexBufferView;
	using RendererState::m_pDynamicVertexDataBegin;
	using RendererState::m_DynamicVertexOffset;

	static D3D12_GPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE AllocateTransientConstantBuffer(const ConstantBuffer3D& constants);
	static D3D12_GPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE AllocateTransientConstantBuffer(const void* data, size_t bytes);
	static ID3D12DescriptorHeap* GetCbvHeap() { return m_CbvHeap.Get(); }
	static UINT GetCurrentFrameCbvBaseIndex() { return m_FrameIndex * g_kCBV_PER_FRAME_COUNT; }
	static UINT GetCurrentFrameCbvIndex(UINT slot)
	{
		UINT safeSlot;
		if (slot < g_kCBV_PER_FRAME_COUNT)
		{
			safeSlot = slot;
		}
		else
		{
			safeSlot = g_kCBV_PER_FRAME_COUNT - 1;
		}
		return GetCurrentFrameCbvBaseIndex() + safeSlot;
	}
	static D3D12_GPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE GetConstantBufferHandle(UINT slot)
	{
		if (!m_CbvHeap)
		{
			return {};
		}
		return CD3DX12_GPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE(
			m_CbvHeap->GetGPUDescriptorHandleForHeapStart(),
			GetCurrentFrameCbvIndex(slot),
			m_CbvIncrementSize);
	}
	static UINT8* GetConstantBufferPtr()
	{
		if (!m_pCbvDataBegin)
		{
			return nullptr;
		}
		return m_pCbvDataBegin + GetCurrentFrameCbvBaseIndex() * g_kCB_ALIGNED_SIZE;
	}
	static UINT GetCbvIncrementSize() { return m_CbvIncrementSize; }
};

===== FILE: rendering\framepipeline.cpp =====
#include "pch.h"
#include "transmittanceshadows.h"
#include "framepipeline.h"
#include "systemmanager.h"
#include "rendergraph.h"
#include "graphicsdevice.h"
#include "postprocesssystem.h"
#include "rendertargets.h"
#include "scenepasses.h"
#include "postprocesspass.h"
#include "lightingresources.h"
#include "vertexdeformation.h"
#include "meshshaderpipeline.h"
#include "raytracing.h"
#include "gpuscene/gpuscene.h"
#include "gpudriven/gpudrivenrenderer.h"
#include "gpudriven/gpudrivenvalidation.h"

void FramePipeline::Execute()
{
	ID3D12GraphicsCommandList* commandList = GraphicsDevice::GetCommandList();
    TransmittanceShadows::PrepareFrame();
    ScenePasses::PrepareStaticShadowCache();
	VertexDeformation::PrepareFrame(commandList, GraphicsDevice::GetFrameIndex());
	MeshShaderPipeline::BeginFrame();
	static RenderGraph graph;
	static bool graphReady = false;

	if (!graphReady)
	{
		if (graph.GetPassCount() == 0)
		{
			RenderGraph::ImportedResource shadowDepthResource{};
			shadowDepthResource.Name = "Shadow Depth";
			shadowDepthResource.Resource = RenderTargets::GetShadowDepthResource();
			shadowDepthResource.InitialState = D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE;
			shadowDepthResource.FinalState = D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE;
			shadowDepthResource.HasFinalState = true;
			const auto shadowDepth = graph.ImportResource(shadowDepthResource);

			const auto gpuScene = graph.CreateLogicalResource("GPU Scene");
            graph.AddPass("GPU Scene", [gpuScene](RenderGraph::PassBuilder& builder) { builder.Write(gpuScene); },
                [](ID3D12GraphicsCommandList* list) { RenderProfiler::ScopedEvent profile("GPU Scene", list); GpuScene::Execute(list); });
            const auto geometry = graph.CreateLogicalResource("Geometry Buffers");
			const auto sceneDepth = graph.CreateLogicalResource("Scene Depth");
			const auto velocity = graph.CreateLogicalResource("Velocity");
			const auto sceneColor = graph.CreateLogicalResource("Scene Color");
			const auto editorScene = graph.CreateLogicalResource("Editor Scene");

			graph.AddPass(
				"Shadow",
				[shadowDepth, gpuScene](RenderGraph::PassBuilder& builder)
				{
					builder.Read(gpuScene).Write(shadowDepth, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_DEPTH_WRITE);
				},
				[](ID3D12GraphicsCommandList* passCommandList)
				{
					RenderProfiler::ScopedEvent profile("Shadow", passCommandList);
					// Phase 3 GBV exercises the production GPU Scene/opaque passes.
					// Full-frame CPU fallback and auxiliary passes are tested separately.
					if (GPUDrivenValidation::IsGpuValidationRun()) return;
					if (Raytracing::UsesRaytracedShadows()) return;
					const UINT shadowLightCount = LightingResources::GetShadowLightCount();
					for (UINT shadowIndex = 0; shadowIndex < shadowLightCount; ++shadowIndex)
					{
						if (!LightingResources::ShouldRenderShadowPass(shadowIndex))
						{
							continue;
						}
                        if (LightingResources::UseStaticShadowCache(shadowIndex))
                        {
                            if (LightingResources::ShouldRenderStaticShadowPass(shadowIndex) &&
                                ScenePasses::BeginShadowPass(shadowIndex, false, true))
                            {
                                RenderProfiler::ScopedEvent stationary("Stationary Shadow Update", passCommandList);
                                LightingResources::SetShadowCasterSubset(LightingResources::ShadowCasterSubset::Stationary);
                                SystemManager::DrawSystem(RenderPass::ShadowMap, false);
                                ScenePasses::EndStaticShadowPass();
                            }
                            const bool restored = ScenePasses::RestoreStaticShadowDepth(shadowIndex);
                            if (ScenePasses::BeginShadowPass(shadowIndex, restored))
                            {
                                LightingResources::SetShadowCasterSubset(restored ? LightingResources::ShadowCasterSubset::Moving :
                                    LightingResources::ShadowCasterSubset::All);
                                SystemManager::DrawSystem(RenderPass::ShadowMap, false);
                                ScenePasses::EndShadowPass();
                            }
                            LightingResources::SetShadowCasterSubset(LightingResources::ShadowCasterSubset::All);
                            continue;
                        }
						if (ScenePasses::BeginShadowPass(shadowIndex))
						{
							SystemManager::DrawSystem(RenderPass::ShadowMap, false);
							ScenePasses::EndShadowPass();
						}
					}
					ScenePasses::EndShadowPassBatch();
					if (shadowLightCount > 0)
					{
						LightingResources::SetCurrentShadowPassIndex(0);
						LightingResources::UpdateShadowConstantBuffer();
					}
				});

            const auto transmission = graph.CreateLogicalResource("Transparent Shadow Transmission");
            graph.AddPass("Transparent Shadows",
                [shadowDepth, gpuScene, transmission](RenderGraph::PassBuilder& builder)
                {
                    builder.Read(gpuScene).Read(shadowDepth, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE).Write(transmission);
                },
                [](ID3D12GraphicsCommandList* list)
                {
                    RenderProfiler::ScopedEvent profile("Transparent Shadows", list);
                    if (GPUDrivenValidation::IsGpuValidationRun() || !TransmittanceShadows::HasCasters()) return;
                    for (UINT shadow = 0; shadow < LightingResources::GetShadowLightCount(); ++shadow)
                    {
                        if (!LightingResources::ShouldRenderShadowPass(shadow)) continue;
                        for (UINT peel = 0; peel < RendererState::g_kTRANSMITTANCE_SHADOW_LAYERS; ++peel)
                        {
                            if (!TransmittanceShadows::BeginPass(shadow, peel)) continue;
                            SystemManager::DrawSystem(RenderPass::TransmittanceShadow, false);
                            TransmittanceShadows::EndPass();
                        }
                    }
                    ScenePasses::EndShadowPassBatch();
                    LightingResources::SetCurrentShadowPassIndex(0);
                    LightingResources::UpdateShadowConstantBuffer();
                });

			graph.AddPass(
				"GBuffer / Opaque",
				[shadowDepth, geometry, sceneDepth, gpuScene, transmission](RenderGraph::PassBuilder& builder)
				{
					builder.Read(transmission).Read(gpuScene).Read(shadowDepth, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE)
						.Write(geometry)
						.Write(sceneDepth);
				},
				[](ID3D12GraphicsCommandList* passCommandList)
				{
					RenderProfiler::ScopedEvent profile("GBuffer / Opaque", passCommandList);
					const auto submissionStart = chrono::steady_clock::now();
					ScenePasses::BeginScenePass();
					GPUDrivenRenderer::Draw(passCommandList);
					if (!GPUDrivenValidation::IsGpuValidationRun()) SystemManager::DrawSystem(RenderPass::PrimaryScene, false);
					if (ScenePasses::BuildOcclusionHierarchyAndBeginPhaseTwo())
					{
						SystemManager::DrawSystem(RenderPass::OcclusionPhase2, false);
					}
					GPUDrivenRenderer::DrawSecondPass(passCommandList);
					GPUDrivenRenderer::BuildHiZ(passCommandList);
					ScenePasses::EndScenePass();
					GPUDrivenRenderer::RecordOpaqueSubmission(chrono::duration<double, milli>(chrono::steady_clock::now() - submissionStart).count());
				});

			graph.AddPass(
				"Velocity",
				[sceneDepth, velocity](RenderGraph::PassBuilder& builder)
				{
					builder.Read(sceneDepth).Write(velocity);
				},
				[](ID3D12GraphicsCommandList* passCommandList)
				{
					RenderProfiler::ScopedEvent profile("Velocity", passCommandList);
					if (GPUDrivenValidation::IsGpuValidationRun()) return;
					ScenePasses::RenderVelocityBuffer();
					SystemManager::DrawSystem(RenderPass::Velocity, false);
					GPUDrivenRenderer::DrawVelocity(passCommandList);
					ScenePasses::EndVelocityBuffer();
				});

			graph.AddPass(
				"Deferred Lighting / PostProcess",
				[shadowDepth, geometry, sceneDepth, velocity, sceneColor, editorScene, gpuScene](
					RenderGraph::PassBuilder& builder)
				{
					builder.Read(gpuScene).Read(shadowDepth, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE)
						.Read(geometry)
						.Read(sceneDepth)
						.Read(velocity)
						.Write(sceneColor)
						.Write(editorScene);
				},
				[](ID3D12GraphicsCommandList* passCommandList)
				{
					RenderProfiler::ScopedEvent profile("Deferred Lighting / PostProcess", passCommandList);
					if (GPUDrivenValidation::IsGpuValidationRun()) return;
					PostProcessSystem postProcess;
					postProcess.Draw(RenderPass::PrimaryScene, false);
				});

			graph.AddPass(
				"Transparent / Overlay",
				[sceneColor, editorScene](RenderGraph::PassBuilder& builder)
				{
					builder.Read(sceneColor).ReadWrite(editorScene);
				},
				[](ID3D12GraphicsCommandList* passCommandList)
				{
					RenderProfiler::ScopedEvent profile("Transparent / Overlay", passCommandList);
					if (GPUDrivenValidation::IsGpuValidationRun()) return;
					ScenePasses::BeginEditorSceneOverlayPass();
					SystemManager::DrawSystem(RenderPass::OverlayScene, false);
					ScenePasses::EndEditorSceneOverlayPass();
				});

			graph.AddPass(
				"AntiAliasing",
				[sceneDepth, velocity, editorScene](RenderGraph::PassBuilder& builder)
				{
					builder.Read(sceneDepth).Read(velocity).ReadWrite(editorScene);
				},
				[](ID3D12GraphicsCommandList* passCommandList)
				{
					RenderProfiler::ScopedEvent profile("AntiAliasing", passCommandList);
					if (GPUDrivenValidation::IsGpuValidationRun()) return;
					PostProcessPass::ApplyAntiAliasing();
				});
		}

		graphReady = graph.Compile();
		if (!graphReady)
		{
			Debug::Log("ERROR: Frame RenderGraph compile failed: %s\n", graph.GetLastError().c_str());
			return;
		}
	}

	if (!graph.Execute(commandList))
	{
		Debug::Log("ERROR: Frame RenderGraph execution failed: %s\n", graph.GetLastError().c_str());
	}
}
