===== FILE: rendering\gpuscene\gpuscenebuffer.cpp =====
#include "pch.h"
#include "gpuscenebuffer.h"
#include "rendererstate.h"
static_assert(GpuSceneBuffer::FrameCount == RendererState::g_kFRAME_COUNT);

namespace
{
void ThrowIfFailed(HRESULT result)
{
    if (FAILED(result))
    {
        throw runtime_error("GPU scene buffer allocation/map failed");
    }
}
ComPtr<ID3D12Resource> CreateBuffer(ID3D12Device *device, uint64_t bytes, D3D12_HEAP_TYPE heapType,
                                    D3D12_RESOURCE_STATES state, D3D12_RESOURCE_FLAGS flags)
{
    ComPtr<ID3D12Resource> resource;
    const auto heap = CD3DX12_HEAP_PROPERTIES(heapType);
    const auto description = CD3DX12_RESOURCE_DESC::Buffer(bytes, flags);
    ThrowIfFailed(device->CreateCommittedResource(&heap, D3D12_HEAP_FLAG_NONE, &description, state, nullptr,
                                                  IID_PPV_ARGS(&resource)));
    return resource;
}
} // namespace

void GpuSceneBuffer::BeginFrame(uint32_t frame)
{
    m_Retired.at(frame).clear();
    m_Copies.clear();
}

bool GpuSceneBuffer::Ensure(ID3D12Device *device, uint32_t count, uint32_t stride, uint32_t frame, const wchar_t *name,
                            bool unorderedAccess)
{
    if (m_Resource && count <= m_Capacity)
    {
        return false;
    }
    uint32_t capacity = max(1024u, m_Capacity);
    while (capacity < count)
    {
        if (capacity > UINT32_MAX / 2)
        {
            throw overflow_error("GPU scene capacity overflow");
        }
        capacity *= 2;
    }
    auto resource =
        CreateBuffer(device, uint64_t(capacity) * stride, D3D12_HEAP_TYPE_DEFAULT, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_COPY_DEST,
                     unorderedAccess ? D3D12_RESOURCE_FLAG_ALLOW_UNORDERED_ACCESS : D3D12_RESOURCE_FLAG_NONE);
    resource->SetName(name);
    if (m_Resource)
    {
        m_Retired.at(frame).push_back(m_Resource);
    }
    m_Resource = resource;
    m_Capacity = capacity;
    m_Stride = stride;
    State = D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_COPY_DEST;
    m_NeedsFullUpload = true;
    return true;
}

uint64_t GpuSceneBuffer::Stage(ID3D12Device *device, uint32_t frame, const void *data, uint32_t count,
                               span<const uint32_t> changes)
{
    m_Copies.clear();
    uint64_t bytes = uint64_t(m_NeedsFullUpload ? count : changes.size()) * m_Stride;
    if (!bytes)
    {
        return 0;
    }
    if (m_UploadBytes.at(frame) < bytes)
    {
        if (m_Upload[frame])
        {
            m_Retired[frame].push_back(m_Upload[frame]);
        }
        uint64_t capacity = 65536;
        while (capacity < bytes)
        {
            capacity *= 2;
        }
        m_Upload[frame] = CreateBuffer(device, capacity, D3D12_HEAP_TYPE_UPLOAD, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_GENERIC_READ,
                                       D3D12_RESOURCE_FLAG_NONE);
        m_UploadBytes[frame] = capacity;
    }
    void *mapped = nullptr;
    const D3D12_RANGE noRead{0, 0};
    ThrowIfFailed(m_Upload[frame]->Map(0, &noRead, &mapped));
    const auto *source = static_cast<const uint8_t *>(data);
    auto *destination = static_cast<uint8_t *>(mapped);
    if (m_NeedsFullUpload)
    {
        memcpy(destination, source, static_cast<size_t>(bytes));
        m_Copies.push_back({0, 0, bytes});
    }
    else
    {
        uint64_t offset = 0;
        for (uint32_t id : changes)
        {
            const uint64_t target = uint64_t(id) * m_Stride;
            memcpy(destination + offset, source + target, m_Stride);
            if (!m_Copies.empty() && m_Copies.back().Destination + m_Copies.back().Size == target)
            {
                m_Copies.back().Size += m_Stride;
            }
            else
            {
                m_Copies.push_back({target, offset, m_Stride});
            }
            offset += m_Stride;
        }
    }
    const D3D12_RANGE written{0, static_cast<SIZE_T>(bytes)};
    m_Upload[frame]->Unmap(0, &written);
    m_NeedsFullUpload = false;
    return bytes;
}

void GpuSceneBuffer::Copy(ID3D12GraphicsCommandList *commands, uint32_t frame) const
{
    for (const auto &range : m_Copies)
    {
        commands->CopyBufferRegion(m_Resource.Get(), range.Destination, m_Upload.at(frame).Get(), range.Source,
                                   range.Size);
    }
}

uint64_t GpuSceneBuffer::MemoryBytes() const
{
    uint64_t bytes = uint64_t(m_Capacity) * m_Stride;
    for (uint64_t upload : m_UploadBytes)
    {
        bytes += upload;
    }
    for (const auto &frame : m_Retired)
    {
        for (const auto &resource : frame)
        {
            bytes += resource->GetDesc().Width;
        }
    }
    return bytes;
}

===== FILE: rendering\gpuscene\gpuscenebuffer.h =====
#pragma once
#include <d3d12.h>
#include <wrl.h>
#include <array>
#include <vector>
#include <cstdint>
#include <span>

// Retirement follows GraphicsDevice's existing frame fences. BeginFrame is called
// only after the allocator for that swap-chain frame has become safe to reuse.
class GpuSceneBuffer
{
  public:
    static constexpr uint32_t FrameCount = 3;
    void BeginFrame(uint32_t frame);
    bool Ensure(ID3D12Device *device, uint32_t count, uint32_t stride, uint32_t frame, const wchar_t *name,
                bool unorderedAccess = false);
    uint64_t Stage(ID3D12Device *device, uint32_t frame, const void *data, uint32_t count,
                   span<const uint32_t> changes);
    void Copy(ID3D12GraphicsCommandList *commands, uint32_t frame) const;
    ID3D12Resource *Resource() const { return m_Resource.Get(); }
    uint32_t Capacity() const { return m_Capacity; }
    uint64_t MemoryBytes() const;
    D3D12_RESOURCE_STATES State = D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_COPY_DEST;

  private:
    struct CopyRange
    {
        uint64_t Destination, Source, Size;
    };
    Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID3D12Resource> m_Resource;
    array<Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID3D12Resource>, FrameCount> m_Upload;
    array<vector<Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID3D12Resource>>, FrameCount> m_Retired;
    array<uint64_t, FrameCount> m_UploadBytes{};
    vector<CopyRange> m_Copies;
    uint32_t m_Capacity = 0;
    uint32_t m_Stride = 0;
    bool m_NeedsFullUpload = false;
};

===== FILE: rendering\gpuscene\gpuscenechanges.h =====
#pragma once
#include "gpuscenetypes.h"
#include <unordered_map>
#include <vector>

// ECS mutation notifications. No D3D or component dependencies in this header.
namespace GpuSceneChanges
{
struct PendingChanges
{
    unordered_map<uint32_t, GpuSceneDirtyFlags> Changed;
    vector<uint32_t> Destroyed;
    bool ResetScene = false;
};
inline PendingChanges &Pending()
{
    static PendingChanges changes;
    return changes;
}
inline void Notify(uint32_t entity, GpuSceneDirtyFlags flags = GpuSceneDirtyFlags::All)
{
    if (entity != UINT32_MAX)
    {
        Pending().Changed[entity] = Pending().Changed[entity] | flags;
    }
}
inline void Destroy(uint32_t entity)
{
    Pending().Destroyed.push_back(entity);
    Pending().Changed.erase(entity);
}
inline void Reset()
{
    Pending() = {};
    Pending().ResetScene = true;
}
} // namespace GpuSceneChanges

===== FILE: rendering\gpuscene\gpusceneculling.cpp =====
#include "pch.h"
#include "gpusceneculling.h"
#include "shaderpipelines.h"
#include "componentmanager.h"
#include "camera.h"
#include "renderprofiler.h"
#include "visibility/gpuvisibility.h"

void GpuSceneCulling::Prepare(ID3D12Device *device, uint32_t slots, uint32_t frame)
{
    Visibility.BeginFrame(frame);
    Visibility.Ensure(device, slots, sizeof(uint32_t), frame, L"GPU Scene Visibility", true);
    if (m_Pipeline)
    {
        return;
    }
    CD3DX12_ROOT_PARAMETER parameters[5];
    parameters[0].InitAsShaderResourceView(0);
    parameters[1].InitAsShaderResourceView(1);
    parameters[2].InitAsShaderResourceView(2);
    parameters[3].InitAsUnorderedAccessView(0);
    parameters[4].InitAsConstants(20, 0);
    CD3DX12_ROOT_SIGNATURE_DESC description;
    description.Init(_countof(parameters), parameters);
    ComPtr<ID3DBlob> serialized, errors;
    if (FAILED(D3D12SerializeRootSignature(&description, D3D_ROOT_SIGNATURE_VERSION_1, &serialized, &errors)))
    {
        throw runtime_error("GPU scene culling root signature failed");
    }
    if (FAILED(device->CreateRootSignature(0, serialized->GetBufferPointer(), serialized->GetBufferSize(),
                                           IID_PPV_ARGS(&m_Root))))
    {
        throw runtime_error("GPU scene culling root creation failed");
    }
    ComPtr<ID3DBlob> shader;
    ShaderDescription shaderDescription{};
    shaderDescription.csoPath = "shader/hlsl/build/GpuSceneCullCS.cso";
    shaderDescription.ppBlob = shader.GetAddressOf();
    if (!ShaderPipelines::LoadShaderBlob(shaderDescription))
    {
        throw runtime_error("GPU scene culling shader is missing");
    }
    D3D12_COMPUTE_PIPELINE_STATE_DESC pipeline{};
    pipeline.pRootSignature = m_Root.Get();
    pipeline.CS = {shader->GetBufferPointer(), shader->GetBufferSize()};
    if (FAILED(device->CreateComputePipelineState(&pipeline, IID_PPV_ARGS(&m_Pipeline))))
    {
        throw runtime_error("GPU scene culling pipeline failed");
    }
}

void GpuSceneCulling::ExecuteCulling(ID3D12GraphicsCommandList *commands, ID3D12Resource *instances,
                                     ID3D12Resource *meshes, ID3D12Resource *materials, uint32_t slots,
                                     uint32_t meshCount, uint32_t materialCount)
{
    if (!slots)
    {
        return;
    }
    struct Constants
    {
        XMFLOAT4X4 ViewProjection;
        uint32_t Slots, Meshes, Materials, EnableFrustum;
    } constants{};
    static_assert(sizeof(constants) == 80);
    XMStoreFloat4x4(&constants.ViewProjection, XMMatrixIdentity());
    const EntityID camera = Camera::GetCameraEntity();
    if (camera != g_kINVALID_ENTITY && ComponentManager::HasComponent<CameraComponent>(camera))
    {
        const auto &data = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<CameraComponent>(camera);
        XMStoreFloat4x4(&constants.ViewProjection,
                        XMLoadFloat4x4(&data.ViewMatrix) * XMLoadFloat4x4(&data.ProjectionMatrix));
        if (GPUVisibility::GetSettings().FreezeCamera)
            constants.ViewProjection=GPUVisibility::CullingViewProjection();
        constants.EnableFrustum = GPUVisibility::GetSettings().Frustum ? 1 : 0;
    }
    constants.Slots = slots;
    constants.Meshes = meshCount;
    constants.Materials = materialCount;
    RenderProfiler::ScopedEvent profile("GPU Scene Culling", commands);
    commands->SetComputeRootSignature(m_Root.Get());
    commands->SetPipelineState(m_Pipeline.Get());
    commands->SetComputeRootShaderResourceView(0, instances->GetGPUVirtualAddress());
    commands->SetComputeRootShaderResourceView(1, meshes->GetGPUVirtualAddress());
    commands->SetComputeRootShaderResourceView(2, materials->GetGPUVirtualAddress());
    commands->SetComputeRootUnorderedAccessView(3, Visibility.Resource()->GetGPUVirtualAddress());
    commands->SetComputeRoot32BitConstants(4, 20, &constants, 0);
    commands->Dispatch((slots + 63) / 64, 1, 1);
}

===== FILE: rendering\gpuscene\gpusceneslots.h =====
#pragma once
#include "gpuscenetypes.h"
#include <vector>
#include <cstring>
#include <stdexcept>

// CPU cache bookkeeping is independently testable; no draw calls or GPU synchronization here.
class GpuSceneSlots
{
    vector<GPUInstanceData> m_Data;
    vector<uint64_t> m_Generations;
    vector<GPUInstanceID> m_Free;
    vector<uint8_t> m_Dirty;
    vector<GPUInstanceID> m_Updates;
    vector<GPUInstanceID> m_Moving;
    uint32_t m_Active = 0;

  public:
    GPUInstanceID Register(const GPUInstanceData &data)
    {
        GPUInstanceID id;
        if (m_Free.empty())
        {
            if (m_Data.size() >= UINT32_MAX)
            {
                throw runtime_error("GPU scene instance ID limit reached");
            }
            id = static_cast<uint32_t>(m_Data.size());
            m_Data.push_back(data);
            m_Generations.push_back(0);
            m_Dirty.push_back(0);
        }
        else
        {
            id = m_Free.back();
            m_Free.pop_back();
            m_Data[id] = data;
        }
        m_Data[id].Flags |= 1u;
        ++m_Generations[id];
        ++m_Active;
        MarkDirty(id);
        return id;
    }
    void Remove(GPUInstanceID id)
    {
        if (!IsActive(id))
        {
            return;
        }
        m_Data[id] = {};
        m_Free.push_back(id);
        --m_Active;
        MarkDirty(id);
    }
    bool IsActive(GPUInstanceID id) const { return id < m_Data.size() && (m_Data[id].Flags & 1u); }
    uint64_t Generation(GPUInstanceID id) const { return IsActive(id) ? m_Generations[id] : 0; }
    void Update(GPUInstanceID id, const GPUInstanceData &data)
    {
        if (!IsActive(id))
        {
            throw runtime_error("Updating a dead GPU scene instance");
        }
        if (memcmp(&m_Data[id], &data, sizeof(data)) == 0)
        {
            return;
        }
        if (memcmp(&m_Data[id].World, &data.World, sizeof(data.World)) != 0)
        {
            m_Moving.push_back(id);
        }
        if (m_Data[id].MeshIndex != data.MeshIndex ||
            m_Data[id].VirtualGeometryAssetIndex != data.VirtualGeometryAssetIndex)
        {
            ++m_Generations[id];
        }
        m_Data[id] = data;
        MarkDirty(id);
    }
    void SettlePreviousTransforms()
    {
        // One follow-up update clears velocity on the first stationary frame after a move.
        for (GPUInstanceID id : m_Moving)
        {
            if (IsActive(id) &&
                memcmp(&m_Data[id].PreviousWorld, &m_Data[id].World, sizeof(m_Data[id].World)) != 0)
            {
                m_Data[id].PreviousWorld = m_Data[id].World;
                MarkDirty(id);
            }
        }
        m_Moving.clear();
    }
    void MarkDirty(GPUInstanceID id)
    {
        if (!m_Dirty.at(id))
        {
            m_Dirty[id] = 1;
            m_Updates.push_back(id);
        }
    }
    void ClearUpdates()
    {
        for (GPUInstanceID id : m_Updates)
        {
            m_Dirty[id] = 0;
        }
        m_Updates.clear();
    }
    uint32_t ActiveCount() const { return m_Active; }
    const vector<GPUInstanceData> &Data() const { return m_Data; }
    const vector<GPUInstanceID> &Updates() const { return m_Updates; }
};

===== FILE: rendering\gpuscene\gpuscenetypes.h =====
#pragma once
#include <DirectXMath.h>
#include <cstdint>
#include <cstddef>
#include <array>

using GPUInstanceID = uint32_t;
using GPUMeshID = uint32_t;
using GPUMaterialID = uint32_t;
inline constexpr GPUInstanceID InvalidGPUInstanceID = UINT32_MAX;
inline constexpr uint32_t GpuSceneInitialCapacity = 1024;
inline constexpr uint32_t GpuSceneMaterialParameterVectors = 160;

enum class GpuSceneDirtyFlags : uint32_t
{
    None = 0,
    Transform = 1,
    Mesh = 2,
    Material = 4,
    Bounds = 8,
    All = 15
};
inline GpuSceneDirtyFlags operator|(GpuSceneDirtyFlags first, GpuSceneDirtyFlags second)
{
    return static_cast<GpuSceneDirtyFlags>(static_cast<uint32_t>(first) | static_cast<uint32_t>(second));
}

struct GPUInstanceData
{
    DirectX::XMFLOAT4X4 World{};
    DirectX::XMFLOAT4X4 PreviousWorld{};
    uint32_t MeshIndex = 0;
    uint32_t MaterialIndex = 0;
    uint32_t Flags = 0; // bit 0: active; bit 1: frustum; bit 2: GPU opaque; bit 3: moving; bit 4: native hierarchy eligible.
    uint32_t Entity = UINT32_MAX;
    DirectX::XMFLOAT4 BoundsCenter{}; // World-space AABB.
    DirectX::XMFLOAT4 BoundsExtents{};
    DirectX::XMFLOAT4 LocalCenter{};
    DirectX::XMFLOAT4 LocalExtents{};
    DirectX::XMFLOAT4 LodDistances{}; // Preserve existing component metadata; no new LOD selection.
    uint32_t LODGroupIndex = UINT32_MAX;
    uint32_t VirtualGeometryAssetIndex = UINT32_MAX;
    uint32_t VisibilityPadding[2]{};
};
struct GPUMeshData
{
    uint32_t VertexAddressLow = 0;
    uint32_t VertexAddressHigh = 0;
    uint32_t IndexAddressLow = 0;
    uint32_t IndexAddressHigh = 0;
    uint32_t VertexCount = 0;
    uint32_t IndexCount = 0;
    uint32_t StartIndex = 0;
    int32_t BaseVertex = 0;
    DirectX::XMFLOAT4 BoundsCenter{};
    DirectX::XMFLOAT4 BoundsExtents{};
};
struct GPUMaterialData
{
    DirectX::XMFLOAT4 BaseColor{1, 1, 1, 1};
    DirectX::XMFLOAT4 Surface{};
    uint32_t AlbedoTextureIndex = UINT32_MAX;
    uint32_t NormalTextureIndex = UINT32_MAX;
    uint32_t Flags = 0;
    uint32_t ShaderClass = 0;
    uint32_t ParameterVectorCount = 0;
    uint32_t ShaderMode = 0;
    uint32_t Padding[2]{};
    array<DirectX::XMFLOAT4, GpuSceneMaterialParameterVectors> ShadingParameters{};
};
static_assert(sizeof(GPUInstanceData) == 240);
static_assert(offsetof(GPUInstanceData, LODGroupIndex) == 224);
static_assert(offsetof(GPUInstanceData, VirtualGeometryAssetIndex) == 228);
static_assert(offsetof(GPUInstanceData, PreviousWorld) == 64);
static_assert(offsetof(GPUInstanceData, MeshIndex) == 128);
static_assert(offsetof(GPUInstanceData, BoundsCenter) == 144);
static_assert(offsetof(GPUInstanceData, LocalCenter) == 176);
static_assert(sizeof(GPUMeshData) == 64);
static_assert(sizeof(GPUMaterialData) == 2624);
static_assert(offsetof(GPUMaterialData, ShadingParameters) == 64);

struct GpuSceneStatistics
{
    uint32_t InstanceSlots = 0;
    uint32_t ActiveInstances = 0;
    uint32_t InstanceCapacity = 0;
    uint32_t Meshes = 0;
    uint32_t Materials = 0;
    uint32_t DirtyInstances = 0;
    uint32_t EntitiesProcessed = 0;
    uint64_t UploadedBytes = 0;
    uint64_t InstanceUploadedBytes = 0;
    uint64_t BufferMemoryBytes = 0;
    double UpdateCpuMilliseconds = 0;
};

#include "pch.h"

namespace

uint32_t failures = 0;

bool legacyCulling = false;
uint64_t currentFrame = 0;
uint32_t residentDrawCulls = 0, legacyDrawCulls = 0;
XMFLOAT4X4 comparisonProjection{};
vector<RenderCapture::TextureData> referenceGBuffer;
bool Enabled()
{
    char value[8]{};
    return GetEnvironmentVariableA("DX12_GPU_SCENE_STRESS_TEST", value, sizeof(value)) && atoi(value) != 0;
}
void Check(bool passed, const char *name)
{
    WriteGraphicsLog("GPU Scene validation: %s %s\n", passed ? "PASS" : "FAIL", name);
    if (!passed)
    {
        ++failures;
    }
}
EntityID CreateFixture(bool skipCulling = false)
{
    Entity entity = World::CreateEntity();
    entity.Add<TransformComponent>().Add<MeshComponent>().Add<MaterialComponent>();
    auto &transform = entity.Get<TransformComponent>();
    transform.Position = XMFLOAT3(100000, 0, 0);
    entity.Get<MeshComponent>() = sharedMesh;
    if (skipCulling)
    {
        entity.Add<InstancingComponent>();
        entity.Get<InstancingComponent>().EnableFrustumCulling = false;
    }
    // Reuse the renderer's default primitive shader and the shared geometry.
    // Opaque drawing remains on the existing CPU path during this phase.
    return entity.GetID();
}
bool CpuVisible(const GPUInstanceData &instance, const XMMATRIX &viewProjection)
{
    if (!(instance.Flags & 1u))
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (!(instance.Flags & 2u))
    {
        return true;
    }
    uint32_t outside = 63;
    for (uint32_t corner = 0; corner < 8; ++corner)
    {
        XMFLOAT4 position;
        const auto &c = instance.BoundsCenter;
        const auto &e = instance.BoundsExtents;
        XMStoreFloat4(&position, XMVector4Transform(XMVectorSet(c.x + ((corner & 1) ? e.x : -e.x),
                                                                c.y + ((corner & 2) ? e.y : -e.y),
                                                                c.z + ((corner & 4) ? e.z : -e.z), 1),
                                                    viewProjection));
        const uint32_t mask = (position.x < -position.w ? 1u : 0u) | (position.x > position.w ? 2u : 0u) |
                              (position.y < -position.w ? 4u : 0u) | (position.y > position.w ? 8u : 0u) |
                              (position.z < 0 ? 16u : 0u) | (position.z > position.w ? 32u : 0u);
        outside &= mask;
    }
    return !outside;
}
void Readback()
{
    vector<uint8_t> instanceBytes, visibilityBytes, meshBytes, materialBytes;
    const auto &stats = GpuScene::Statistics();
    const auto state = D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_NON_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE;
    const bool read =
        RenderCapture::ReadBuffer(GpuScene::InstanceBuffer(), state,
                                  uint64_t(stats.InstanceSlots) * sizeof(GPUInstanceData), instanceBytes) &&
        RenderCapture::ReadBuffer(GpuScene::VisibilityBuffer(), state, uint64_t(stats.InstanceSlots) * 4,
                                  visibilityBytes) &&
        RenderCapture::ReadBuffer(GpuScene::MeshBuffer(), state, uint64_t(stats.Meshes) * sizeof(GPUMeshData),
                                  meshBytes) &&
        RenderCapture::ReadBuffer(GpuScene::MaterialBuffer(), state,
                                  uint64_t(stats.Materials) * sizeof(GPUMaterialData), materialBytes);
    Check(read, "GPU buffer readback");
    if (!read)
    {
        return;
    }
    XMMATRIX view, projection;
    Camera::GetCameraMatrices(Camera::GetCameraEntity(), view, projection);
    bool matching = true, visibilityMatching = true, shared = true, meshReference = true;
    uint32_t visible = 0;
    uint32_t mesh = UINT32_MAX, material = UINT32_MAX;
    for (EntityID entity : entities)
    {
        const auto id = Entity(entity).GetGPUInstanceID();
        const auto *cached = GpuScene::GetInstance(id);
        if (!cached || id >= stats.InstanceSlots)
        {
            matching = false;
            continue;
        }
        const auto *gpu = reinterpret_cast<const GPUInstanceData *>(instanceBytes.data()) + id;
        matching &= memcmp(cached, gpu, sizeof(*gpu)) == 0;
        const uint32_t result = reinterpret_cast<const uint32_t *>(visibilityBytes.data())[id];
        visibilityMatching &= result == (CpuVisible(*cached, view * projection) ? 1u : 0u);
        visible += result;
        if (mesh == UINT32_MAX)
        {
            mesh = cached->MeshIndex;
            material = cached->MaterialIndex;
        }
        // Later material edits intentionally diverge one instance's shared reference.
        const auto &sourceMesh = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<MeshComponent>(entity);
        if (sourceMesh.VertexBuffer == sharedMesh.VertexBuffer)
        {
            shared &= cached->MeshIndex == mesh;
        }
        const auto *meshData = reinterpret_cast<const GPUMeshData *>(meshBytes.data()) + cached->MeshIndex;
        const uint64_t vertexAddress =
            uint64_t(meshData->VertexAddressLow) | (uint64_t(meshData->VertexAddressHigh) << 32);
        meshReference &= vertexAddress == sourceMesh.VertexBuffer->GetGPUVirtualAddress();
        const auto *gpuMaterial =
            reinterpret_cast<const GPUMaterialData *>(materialBytes.data()) + cached->MaterialIndex;
        matching &= gpuMaterial->ParameterVectorCount > 0 &&
                    gpuMaterial->ParameterVectorCount <= GpuSceneMaterialParameterVectors;
        const auto expectedMaterial =
            MaterialBindings::BuildGpuSceneMaterial(ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<MaterialComponent>(entity));
        matching &= memcmp(gpuMaterial, &expectedMaterial, sizeof(expectedMaterial)) == 0;
    }
    Check(matching, "CPU/HLSL layout and resident instance/material bytes");
    Check(visibilityMatching && visible == 1, "10000 resident GPU frustum results match CPU reference");
    Check(shared && meshReference, "10000 instances share existing vertex buffer reference");
}
} // namespace

void GpuSceneValidation::BeforeFrame(uint64_t frame)
{
    if (!Enabled())
    {
        return;
    }
    currentFrame = frame;
    char cpuGeometry[8]{};
    if (GetEnvironmentVariableA("DX12_GPU_SCENE_CPU_GEOMETRY", cpuGeometry, sizeof(cpuGeometry)) &&
        atoi(cpuGeometry) != 0)
    {
        // Isolate scene bookkeeping from both GPU geometry drawing paths.
        GPUDrivenRenderer::SetEnabled(false);
        MeshShaderRenderer::GetSettings().Enabled = false;
    }
    legacyCulling = frame == 81;
    residentDrawCulls = legacyDrawCulls = 0;
    if (frame == 60)
    {
        Entity source = World::CreateEntity();
        source.Add<MeshComponent>();
        vector<Vertex> triangle(3);
        triangle[0].Pos = {-0.5f, 0, 0};
        triangle[1].Pos = {0.5f, 0, 0};
        triangle[2].Pos = {0, 1, 0};
        Check(PrimitiveGeometry::UploadVertices(source.GetID(), triangle), "create shared fixture geometry");
        sharedMesh = source.Get<MeshComponent>();
        World::DestroyEntity(source);
        entities.push_back(CreateFixture(true));
    }
    if (frame == 61 || frame == 62)
    {
        const size_t count = frame == 61 ? 1000 : 10000;
        while (entities.size() < count)
        {
            entities.push_back(CreateFixture());
        }
        WriteGraphicsLog("GPU Scene fixture creation finished: %zu entities\n", entities.size());
    }
    if (frame == 66)
    {
        auto &transform = Entity(entities[6789]).Get<TransformComponent>();
        transform.Position.x += 7;
        transform.IsDirty = true;
    }
    if (frame == 69)
    {
        removed = Entity(entities[6789]).GetGPUInstanceID();
        World::DestroyEntity(Entity(entities[6789]));
    }
    if (frame == 70)
    {
        entities[6789] = CreateFixture();
    }
    if (frame == 71)
    {
        sharedMaterial = GpuScene::GetInstance(Entity(entities[6789]).GetGPUInstanceID())->MaterialIndex;
        Entity(entities[6789]).Get<MaterialComponent>().Roughness = 0.81f;
    }
    if (frame == 73)
    {
        Entity entity(entities[6789]);
        entity.Add<AABBComponent>();
        entity.Get<AABBComponent>().Center = {0.5f, 0.2f, 0};
        entity.Get<AABBComponent>().Extents = {1, 2, 3};
        auto &transform = entity.Get<TransformComponent>();
        transform.Scale = {-2, 0.5f, 3};
        transform.Rotation = {0.2f, 0.5f, 0.1f};
        transform.IsDirty = true;
    }
    if (frame == 74)
    {
        previousMesh = GpuScene::GetInstance(Entity(entities[6791]).GetGPUInstanceID())->MeshIndex;
        vector<Vertex> triangle(3);
        triangle[0].Pos = {-1, 0, 0};
        triangle[1].Pos = {1, 0, 0};
        triangle[2].Pos = {0, 2, 0};
        Check(PrimitiveGeometry::UploadVertices(entities[6791], triangle), "replace one shared mesh instance geometry");
    }
    if (frame == 75)
    {
        filesystem::create_directories("build/gpuscene");
        ofstream mesh("build/gpuscene/culling-fixture.obj");
        mesh << "v -1 0 0\nv 0 2 0\nv 1 0 0\nvt 0 0\nvt 0.5 1\nvt 1 0\nvn 0 0 -1\nf 1/1/1 2/2/1 3/3/1\n";
        mesh.close();
        const int model = ModelManager::LoadStaticModel("build/gpuscene/culling-fixture.obj", false);
        Check(model >= 0, "load indexed model fixture for resident indirect culling");
        if (model >= 0)
        {
            for (int i = 0; i < 2; ++i)
            {
                Entity entity = World::CreateEntity();
                entity.Add<TransformComponent>().Add<StaticModelComponent>().Add<MaterialComponent>();
                entity.Get<StaticModelComponent>().ModelId = model;
                entity.Get<TransformComponent>().Position = {static_cast<float>(i * 3), 1, 0};
            }
        }
    }
    if (frame == 80 || frame == 81)
    {
        Raytracing::GetSettings().Enabled = false;
        RendererSettings::SetMeshShadersEnabled(false);
        RendererSettings::SetTwoPhaseOcclusionEnabled(false);
    }
}

void GpuSceneValidation::BeforeScene()
{
    if (!Enabled())
    {
        return;
    }
    const EntityID camera = Camera::GetCameraEntity();
    auto &data = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<CameraComponent>(camera);
    if (currentFrame == 80)
    {
        comparisonProjection = data.ProjectionMatrix;
    }
    if (currentFrame == 81)
    {
        data.ProjectionMatrix = comparisonProjection;
    }
}
bool GpuSceneValidation::UseLegacyCulling()
{
    return legacyCulling;
}
void GpuSceneValidation::RecordModelCull(bool resident)
{
    if (resident)
    {
        ++residentDrawCulls;
    }
    else
    {
        ++legacyDrawCulls;
    }
}

void GpuSceneValidation::AfterFrame(uint64_t frame)
{
    if (!Enabled() || frame < 60)
    {
        return;
    }
    const auto &stats = GpuScene::Statistics();
    if (frame <= 75)
    {
        WriteGraphicsLog("GPU Scene frame %llu: active=%u dirty=%u entities=%u instanceUpload=%llu totalUpload=%llu "
                         "capacity=%u cpu=%.3f ms\n",
                         frame, stats.ActiveInstances, stats.DirtyInstances, stats.EntitiesProcessed,
                         stats.InstanceUploadedBytes, stats.UploadedBytes, stats.InstanceCapacity,
                         stats.UpdateCpuMilliseconds);
    }
    if (frame == 60 || frame == 61 || frame == 62)
    {
        bool registered = true, shared = true;
        const auto *first = GpuScene::GetInstance(Entity(entities.front()).GetGPUInstanceID());
        for (EntityID entity : entities)
        {
            const auto *data = GpuScene::GetInstance(Entity(entity).GetGPUInstanceID());
            registered &= data && data->Entity == entity;
            shared &=
                first && data && first->MeshIndex == data->MeshIndex && first->MaterialIndex == data->MaterialIndex;
        }
        Check(registered && entities.size() == (frame == 60   ? 1
                                                : frame == 61 ? 1000
                                                              : 10000),
              "1/1000/10000 ECS instance registration");
        Check(shared, "mesh and material records are shared");
    }
    if (frame == 63 || frame == 66 || frame == 70 || frame == 71 || frame == 74)
    {
        Readback();
    }
    if (frame == 65 || frame == 68)
    {
        Check(stats.InstanceUploadedBytes == 0 && stats.DirtyInstances == 0,
              "unchanged scene performs zero instance upload");
    }
    if (frame == 66)
    {
        Check(stats.DirtyInstances == 1 && stats.InstanceUploadedBytes == sizeof(GPUInstanceData),
              "one of 10000 moves: exactly 224 bytes uploaded");
    }
    if (frame == 67)
    {
        Check(stats.DirtyInstances == 1 && stats.InstanceUploadedBytes == sizeof(GPUInstanceData),
              "one temporal history settle update");
    }
    if (frame == 69)
    {
        vector<uint8_t> bytes;
        Check(!GpuScene::GetInstance(removed), "destroyed instance is inactive");
        const bool read =
            RenderCapture::ReadBuffer(GpuScene::VisibilityBuffer(), D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_NON_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE,
                                      uint64_t(stats.InstanceSlots) * 4, bytes);
        Check(read && reinterpret_cast<const uint32_t *>(bytes.data())[removed] == 0,
              "deleted slot is skipped by GPU culling");
    }
    if (frame == 70)
    {
        Check(Entity(entities[6789]).GetGPUInstanceID() == removed, "free list reuses removed GPU ID");
    }
    if (frame == 71)
    {
        const auto *changed = GpuScene::GetInstance(Entity(entities[6789]).GetGPUInstanceID());
        const auto *untouched = GpuScene::GetInstance(Entity(entities[6790]).GetGPUInstanceID());
        Check(changed && untouched && changed->MaterialIndex != sharedMaterial &&
                  untouched->MaterialIndex == sharedMaterial,
              "material edit preserves other instances' shared material");
    }
    if (frame == 73)
    {
        const EntityID entity = entities[6789];
        const auto *instance = GpuScene::GetInstance(Entity(entity).GetGPUInstanceID());
        const auto &local = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<AABBComponent>(entity);
        const auto &transform = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<TransformComponent>(entity);
        XMFLOAT3 minimum{FLT_MAX, FLT_MAX, FLT_MAX}, maximum{-FLT_MAX, -FLT_MAX, -FLT_MAX};
        for (uint32_t corner = 0; corner < 8; ++corner)
        {
            XMFLOAT3 point;
            XMStoreFloat3(&point,
                          XMVector3TransformCoord(
                              XMVectorSet(local.Center.x + ((corner & 1) ? local.Extents.x : -local.Extents.x),
                                          local.Center.y + ((corner & 2) ? local.Extents.y : -local.Extents.y),
                                          local.Center.z + ((corner & 4) ? local.Extents.z : -local.Extents.z), 1),
                              XMLoadFloat4x4(&transform.WorldMatrix)));
            minimum = {(min)(minimum.x, point.x), (min)(minimum.y, point.y), (min)(minimum.z, point.z)};
            maximum = {(max)(maximum.x, point.x), (max)(maximum.y, point.y), (max)(maximum.z, point.z)};
        }
        Check(instance && abs(instance->BoundsCenter.x - (minimum.x + maximum.x) * 0.5f) < 0.02f &&
                  abs(instance->BoundsExtents.x - (maximum.x - minimum.x) * 0.5f) < 0.02f &&
                  abs(instance->BoundsExtents.y - (maximum.y - minimum.y) * 0.5f) < 0.002f &&
                  abs(instance->BoundsExtents.z - (maximum.z - minimum.z) * 0.5f) < 0.002f,
              "rotated negative scale and overridden bounds match transformed corners");
    }
    if (frame == 74)
    {
        const auto *changed = GpuScene::GetInstance(Entity(entities[6791]).GetGPUInstanceID());
        const auto *untouched = GpuScene::GetInstance(Entity(entities[6792]).GetGPUInstanceID());
        Check(changed && untouched && changed->MeshIndex != previousMesh && untouched->MeshIndex == previousMesh,
              "mesh replacement preserves shared geometry and stable instance IDs");
    }
    if (frame == 80 || frame == 81)
    {
        Check(frame == 80 ? residentDrawCulls > 0 : legacyDrawCulls > 0,
              "indexed model rendering executes resident/legacy GPU culling path");
        // Compare the opaque render targets before temporal DLSS/NRD can change
        // their histories. The camera projection is identical for these frames.
        bool matching = true;
        const GBufferType targets[] = {GBufferType::BASE_COLOR, GBufferType::NORMAL, GBufferType::MATERIAL};
        for (size_t i = 0; i < size(targets); ++i)
        {
            RenderCapture::TextureData capture;
            if (!RenderCapture::ReadTexture(RenderTargets::GetGBufferResource(targets[i]), capture))
            {
                matching = false;
                continue;
            }
            if (frame == 80)
            {
                referenceGBuffer.push_back(move(capture));
            }
            else if (i >= referenceGBuffer.size())
            {
                matching = false;
            }
            else
            {
                const auto &previous = referenceGBuffer[i];
                matching &= previous.Width == capture.Width && previous.Height == capture.Height &&
                            previous.Format == capture.Format;
                const uint32_t bytesPerPixel = capture.Format == DXGI_FORMAT_R16G16B16A16_FLOAT ? 8 : 4;
                if (matching)
                {
                    for (UINT row = 0; row < capture.Height; ++row)
                    {
                        matching &= memcmp(previous.Bytes.data() + row * previous.RowPitch,
                                                capture.Bytes.data() + row * capture.RowPitch,
                                                capture.Width * bytesPerPixel) == 0;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        Check(matching, frame == 80 ? "capture resident rendering GBuffer"
                                    : "resident/legacy albedo, normal and material GBuffer match exactly");
        for (const auto &pass : RenderProfiler::GetLatest().Passes)
        {
            if (pass.Name == "GPU Scene" || pass.Name == "GPU Scene Culling" || pass.Name == "GPU Scene Update")
            {
                WriteGraphicsLog("GPU Scene profiler: %s GPU %.4f ms CPU %.4f ms\n", pass.Name.c_str(), pass.GpuMs,
                                 pass.CpuMs);
            }
        }
    }
}
uint32_t GpuSceneValidation::Failures()
{
    return failures;
}

#include "pch.h"

static bool g_DeviceRemovalLogged = false;
static bool g_GpuBasedValidationEnabled = false;
bool GraphicsDevice::GpuBasedValidationEnabled() { return g_GpuBasedValidationEnabled; }


bool GraphicsDevice::Init(HWND hwnd)
{
	g_DeviceRemovalLogged = false;
    g_GpuBasedValidationEnabled = false;
	m_FrameIndex = 0;
	m_FenceEvent = nullptr;
	m_FrameLatencyWaitableObject = nullptr;
	for (UINT i = 0; i < g_kFRAME_COUNT; ++i)
	{
		m_FenceValues[i] = 0;
	}
	m_Hwnd = hwnd;

	RECT rc;
	GetClientRect(hwnd, &rc);
	m_Width = rc.right - rc.left;
	m_Height = rc.bottom - rc.top;

	if (m_Width == 0) m_Width = g_kSCREEN_WIDTH;
	if (m_Height == 0) m_Height = g_kSCREEN_HEIGHT;

	m_SceneWidth = max((UINT)roundf(m_Width * m_ResolutionScale), 1u);
	m_SceneHeight = max((UINT)roundf(m_Height * m_ResolutionScale), 1u);

	ComPtr<ID3D12DeviceRemovedExtendedDataSettings> dredSettings;
	if (SUCCEEDED(D3D12GetDebugInterface(IID_PPV_ARGS(&dredSettings))))
	{
		dredSettings->SetAutoBreadcrumbsEnablement(D3D12_DRED_ENABLEMENT_FORCED_ON);
		dredSettings->SetPageFaultEnablement(D3D12_DRED_ENABLEMENT_FORCED_ON);
	}
	ComPtr<ID3D12DeviceRemovedExtendedDataSettings1> dredSettings1;
	if (SUCCEEDED(D3D12GetDebugInterface(IID_PPV_ARGS(&dredSettings1))))
	{
		dredSettings1->SetBreadcrumbContextEnablement(D3D12_DRED_ENABLEMENT_FORCED_ON);
	}

#ifdef _DEBUG
	ComPtr<ID3D12Debug> debugController;
	if (SUCCEEDED(D3D12GetDebugInterface(IID_PPV_ARGS(&debugController))))
	{
		debugController->EnableDebugLayer();
		char gpuValidation[8]{};
		if (GetEnvironmentVariableA("DX12_GPU_BASED_VALIDATION", gpuValidation, sizeof(gpuValidation)) && atoi(gpuValidation))
		{
			ComPtr<ID3D12Debug1> validation;
			if (SUCCEEDED(debugController.As(&validation)))
			{
				validation->SetEnableGPUBasedValidation(TRUE);
                g_GpuBasedValidationEnabled = true;
				WriteGraphicsLog("GPU Based Validation enabled\n");
			}
		}
	}
#endif

	WriteGraphicsLog("Step: CreateDXGIFactory2\n");
	HRESULT hr = CreateDXGIFactory2(0, IID_PPV_ARGS(&m_Factory));
	if (FAILED(hr))
	{
		WriteGraphicsLog("ERROR: CreateDXGIFactory2 failed\n");
		return false;
	}

	m_AllowTearing = false;
	ComPtr<IDXGIFactory5> factory5;
	if (SUCCEEDED(m_Factory.As(&factory5)))
	{
		BOOL allowTearing = FALSE;
		if (SUCCEEDED(factory5->CheckFeatureSupport(
			DXGI_FEATURE_PRESENT_ALLOW_TEARING,
			&allowTearing,
			sizeof(allowTearing))))
		{
			m_AllowTearing = allowTearing == TRUE;
		}
	}

	WriteGraphicsLog("Step: D3D12CreateDevice\n");
	ComPtr<IDXGIFactory6> adapterFactory;
	ComPtr<IDXGIAdapter1> selectedAdapter;
	if (SUCCEEDED(m_Factory.As(&adapterFactory)))
	{
		for (UINT adapterIndex = 0; ; ++adapterIndex)
		{
			selectedAdapter.Reset();
			const HRESULT adapterResult = adapterFactory->EnumAdapterByGpuPreference(
				adapterIndex, DXGI_GPU_PREFERENCE_HIGH_PERFORMANCE, IID_PPV_ARGS(&selectedAdapter));
			if (FAILED(adapterResult))
			{
				break;
			}
			DXGI_ADAPTER_DESC1 adapterDescription{};
			if (FAILED(selectedAdapter->GetDesc1(&adapterDescription)) ||
				(adapterDescription.Flags & DXGI_ADAPTER_FLAG_SOFTWARE) != 0)
			{
				continue;
			}
			if (SUCCEEDED(D3D12CreateDevice(selectedAdapter.Get(), D3D_FEATURE_LEVEL_11_0, IID_PPV_ARGS(&m_Device))))
			{
				char adapterName[256]{};
				WideCharToMultiByte(CP_UTF8, 0, adapterDescription.Description, -1, adapterName, sizeof(adapterName), nullptr, nullptr);
				WriteGraphicsLog("Adapter: %s\n", adapterName);
				break;
			}
		}
	}
	hr = S_OK;
	if (!m_Device)
	{
		hr = D3D12CreateDevice(nullptr, D3D_FEATURE_LEVEL_11_0, IID_PPV_ARGS(&m_Device));
	}
	if (FAILED(hr))
	{
		WriteGraphicsLog("ERROR: D3D12CreateDevice failed\n");
		return false;
	}

	D3D12_COMMAND_QUEUE_DESC queueDesc {};
	queueDesc.Type = D3D12_COMMAND_LIST_TYPE_DIRECT;
	hr = m_Device->CreateCommandQueue(&queueDesc, IID_PPV_ARGS(&m_CommandQueue));
	if (FAILED(hr))
	{
		WriteGraphicsLog("ERROR: CreateCommandQueue failed\n");
		return false;
	}
	m_CommandQueue->SetName(L"Main Direct Queue");

	DXGI_SWAP_CHAIN_DESC1 swapChainDesc {};
	swapChainDesc.BufferCount = g_kFRAME_COUNT;
	swapChainDesc.Width = m_Width;
	swapChainDesc.Height = m_Height;
	swapChainDesc.Format = DXGI_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM;
	swapChainDesc.BufferUsage = DXGI_USAGE_RENDER_TARGET_OUTPUT;
	swapChainDesc.SwapEffect = DXGI_SWAP_EFFECT_FLIP_DISCARD;
	swapChainDesc.SampleDesc.Count = 1;
	UINT tearingFlag;
	if (m_AllowTearing)
	{
		tearingFlag = DXGI_SWAP_CHAIN_FLAG_ALLOW_TEARING;
	}
	else
	{
		tearingFlag = 0;
	}
	swapChainDesc.Flags = DXGI_SWAP_CHAIN_FLAG_FRAME_LATENCY_WAITABLE_OBJECT |
		(tearingFlag);

	ComPtr<IDXGISwapChain1> sc1;
	hr = m_Factory->CreateSwapChainForHwnd(m_CommandQueue.Get(), hwnd, &swapChainDesc, nullptr, nullptr, &sc1);
	if (FAILED(hr))
	{
		WriteGraphicsLog("ERROR: CreateSwapChainForHwnd failed\n");
		return false;
	}
	sc1.As(&m_SwapChain);
	if (m_SwapChain)
	{


		m_SwapChain->SetMaximumFrameLatency(2);
		m_FrameLatencyWaitableObject = m_SwapChain->GetFrameLatencyWaitableObject();
	}
	m_FrameIndex = m_SwapChain->GetCurrentBackBufferIndex();

	D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_HEAP_DESC rtvDesc {};
	rtvDesc.NumDescriptors = g_kFRAME_COUNT;
	rtvDesc.Type = D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_HEAP_TYPE_RTV;
	hr = m_Device->CreateDescriptorHeap(&rtvDesc, IID_PPV_ARGS(&m_RtvHeap));
	if (FAILED(hr))
	{
		WriteGraphicsLog("ERROR: CreateDescriptorHeap(RTV) failed\n");
		return false;
	}

	UINT rtvSize = m_Device->GetDescriptorHandleIncrementSize(D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_HEAP_TYPE_RTV);
	CD3DX12_CPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE rtvHandle(m_RtvHeap->GetCPUDescriptorHandleForHeapStart());
	for (UINT n = 0; n < g_kFRAME_COUNT; n++)
	{
		m_SwapChain->GetBuffer(n, IID_PPV_ARGS(&m_RenderTargets[n]));
		m_Device->CreateRenderTargetView(m_RenderTargets[n].Get(), nullptr, rtvHandle);
		rtvHandle.Offset(1, rtvSize);
	}

	for (UINT n = 0; n < g_kFRAME_COUNT; n++)
	{
		hr = m_Device->CreateCommandAllocator(D3D12_COMMAND_LIST_TYPE_DIRECT, IID_PPV_ARGS(&m_CommandAllocator[n]));
		if (FAILED(hr))
		{
			WriteGraphicsLog("ERROR: CreateCommandAllocator failed\n");
			return false;
		}
	}

	WriteGraphicsLog("Step: CreateCommandList\n");
	hr = m_Device->CreateCommandList(0, D3D12_COMMAND_LIST_TYPE_DIRECT, m_CommandAllocator[0].Get(), nullptr, IID_PPV_ARGS(&m_CommandList));
	if (FAILED(hr))
	{
		WriteGraphicsLog("ERROR: CreateCommandList failed\n");
		return false;
	}
	m_CommandList->Close();
	m_CommandList->SetName(L"Main Frame Command List");

	WriteGraphicsLog("Step: CreateFence\n");
	hr = m_Device->CreateFence(0, D3D12_FENCE_FLAG_NONE, IID_PPV_ARGS(&m_Fence));
	if (FAILED(hr))
	{
		WriteGraphicsLog("ERROR: CreateFence failed\n");
		return false;
	}
	m_FenceEvent = CreateEvent(nullptr, FALSE, FALSE, nullptr);
	m_CurrentFenceValue = 0;
	for (UINT i = 0; i < g_kFRAME_COUNT; i++)
	{
		m_FenceValues[i] = 0;
	}

	CD3DX12_DESCRIPTOR_RANGE ranges[1];
	ranges[0].Init(D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_RANGE_TYPE_CBV, 1, 0);

	CD3DX12_DESCRIPTOR_RANGE rangesTex[1];
	rangesTex[0].Init(D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_RANGE_TYPE_SRV, 1, 0, 0, D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_RANGE_OFFSET_APPEND);
	CD3DX12_DESCRIPTOR_RANGE rangesShadowTex[1];
	rangesShadowTex[0].Init(D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_RANGE_TYPE_SRV, 1, 1, 0, D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_RANGE_OFFSET_APPEND);
	CD3DX12_DESCRIPTOR_RANGE rangesNormalTex[1];
	rangesNormalTex[0].Init(D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_RANGE_TYPE_SRV, 1, 2, 0, D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_RANGE_OFFSET_APPEND);
	CD3DX12_DESCRIPTOR_RANGE rangesEnvironmentTex[1];
	rangesEnvironmentTex[0].Init(D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_RANGE_TYPE_SRV, 1, 6, 0, D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_RANGE_OFFSET_APPEND);
	CD3DX12_DESCRIPTOR_RANGE rangesSceneColorTex[1];
	rangesSceneColorTex[0].Init(D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_RANGE_TYPE_SRV, 1, 3, 0, D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_RANGE_OFFSET_APPEND);
	CD3DX12_DESCRIPTOR_RANGE meshHiZRanges[2];
	meshHiZRanges[0].Init(D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_RANGE_TYPE_SRV, 1, 22);
	meshHiZRanges[1].Init(D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_RANGE_TYPE_SRV, 1, 23);

    CD3DX12_DESCRIPTOR_RANGE assetTextures;
    assetTextures.Init(D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_RANGE_TYPE_SRV, 512, 0, 1);
    CD3DX12_DESCRIPTOR_RANGE forwardResources[13];
    const UINT forwardRegisters[] = {26, 27, 12, 16, 17, 31, 32, 13, 14, 28, 35, 36, 29};
    for (UINT index = 0; index < _countof(forwardRegisters); ++index)
    {
        forwardResources[index].Init(D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_RANGE_TYPE_SRV, 1, forwardRegisters[index]);
    }
	CD3DX12_ROOT_PARAMETER rootParametersAll[34];
	rootParametersAll[0].InitAsDescriptorTable(1, &ranges[0], D3D12_SHADER_VISIBILITY_ALL);
	rootParametersAll[1].InitAsDescriptorTable(1, &rangesTex[0], D3D12_SHADER_VISIBILITY_ALL);
	rootParametersAll[2].InitAsConstantBufferView(1, 0, D3D12_SHADER_VISIBILITY_PIXEL);
	rootParametersAll[3].InitAsConstantBufferView(2, 0, D3D12_SHADER_VISIBILITY_PIXEL);
	rootParametersAll[4].InitAsDescriptorTable(1, &rangesShadowTex[0], D3D12_SHADER_VISIBILITY_PIXEL);
	rootParametersAll[5].InitAsConstantBufferView(3, 0, D3D12_SHADER_VISIBILITY_ALL);
	rootParametersAll[6].InitAsDescriptorTable(1, &rangesNormalTex[0], D3D12_SHADER_VISIBILITY_PIXEL);
	rootParametersAll[7].InitAsDescriptorTable(1, &rangesEnvironmentTex[0], D3D12_SHADER_VISIBILITY_PIXEL);
	rootParametersAll[8].InitAsDescriptorTable(1, &rangesSceneColorTex[0], D3D12_SHADER_VISIBILITY_PIXEL);
	rootParametersAll[9].InitAsShaderResourceView(0, 2, D3D12_SHADER_VISIBILITY_VERTEX);
	rootParametersAll[10].InitAsShaderResourceView(11, 0, D3D12_SHADER_VISIBILITY_PIXEL);
	rootParametersAll[11].InitAsShaderResourceView(20, 0, D3D12_SHADER_VISIBILITY_ALL);
	rootParametersAll[12].InitAsShaderResourceView(21, 0, D3D12_SHADER_VISIBILITY_ALL);
	rootParametersAll[13].InitAsConstants(16, 4, 0, D3D12_SHADER_VISIBILITY_ALL);
	rootParametersAll[14].InitAsDescriptorTable(1, &meshHiZRanges[0], D3D12_SHADER_VISIBILITY_ALL);
	rootParametersAll[15].InitAsDescriptorTable(1, &meshHiZRanges[1], D3D12_SHADER_VISIBILITY_ALL);
	rootParametersAll[16].InitAsShaderResourceView(25, 0, D3D12_SHADER_VISIBILITY_PIXEL);
	rootParametersAll[17].InitAsConstantBufferView(5, 0, D3D12_SHADER_VISIBILITY_PIXEL);
    rootParametersAll[18].InitAsDescriptorTable(1, &assetTextures, D3D12_SHADER_VISIBILITY_PIXEL);
    for (UINT index = 0; index < 7; ++index)
    {
        rootParametersAll[19 + index].InitAsDescriptorTable(1, &forwardResources[index], D3D12_SHADER_VISIBILITY_PIXEL);
    }
    rootParametersAll[26].InitAsConstantBufferView(6, 0, D3D12_SHADER_VISIBILITY_PIXEL);
    rootParametersAll[27].InitAsConstantBufferView(9, 0, D3D12_SHADER_VISIBILITY_PIXEL);
    for (UINT index = 7; index < _countof(forwardResources); ++index)
    {
        rootParametersAll[21 + index].InitAsDescriptorTable(1, &forwardResources[index], D3D12_SHADER_VISIBILITY_PIXEL);
    }

	CD3DX12_STATIC_SAMPLER_DESC sampler {};


	sampler.Filter = D3D12_FILTER_ANISOTROPIC;
	sampler.AddressU = D3D12_TEXTURE_ADDRESS_MODE_WRAP;
	sampler.AddressV = D3D12_TEXTURE_ADDRESS_MODE_WRAP;
	sampler.AddressW = D3D12_TEXTURE_ADDRESS_MODE_WRAP;
	sampler.MipLODBias = 0.0f;
	sampler.MaxAnisotropy = 16;
	sampler.ComparisonFunc = D3D12_COMPARISON_FUNC_NEVER;
	sampler.BorderColor = D3D12_STATIC_BORDER_COLOR_TRANSPARENT_BLACK;
	sampler.MinLOD = 0.0f;
	sampler.MaxLOD = D3D12_FLOAT32_MAX;
	sampler.ShaderRegister = 0;
	sampler.RegisterSpace = 0;
	sampler.ShaderVisibility = D3D12_SHADER_VISIBILITY_ALL;

	CD3DX12_STATIC_SAMPLER_DESC staticSamplers[5] {};
    staticSamplers[4] = CD3DX12_STATIC_SAMPLER_DESC(4, D3D12_FILTER_MIN_MAG_MIP_LINEAR);
    staticSamplers[3] = CD3DX12_STATIC_SAMPLER_DESC(3, D3D12_FILTER_MIN_MAG_MIP_LINEAR);
	staticSamplers[0] = sampler;
	staticSamplers[1].Filter = D3D12_FILTER_COMPARISON_MIN_MAG_LINEAR_MIP_POINT;
	staticSamplers[1].AddressU = D3D12_TEXTURE_ADDRESS_MODE_BORDER;
	staticSamplers[1].AddressV = D3D12_TEXTURE_ADDRESS_MODE_BORDER;
	staticSamplers[1].AddressW = D3D12_TEXTURE_ADDRESS_MODE_BORDER;
	staticSamplers[1].MipLODBias = 0.0f;
	staticSamplers[1].MaxAnisotropy = 1;
	staticSamplers[1].ComparisonFunc = D3D12_COMPARISON_FUNC_LESS_EQUAL;
	staticSamplers[1].BorderColor = D3D12_STATIC_BORDER_COLOR_OPAQUE_WHITE;
	staticSamplers[1].MinLOD = 0.0f;
	staticSamplers[1].MaxLOD = D3D12_FLOAT32_MAX;
	staticSamplers[1].ShaderRegister = 1;
	staticSamplers[1].RegisterSpace = 0;
	staticSamplers[1].ShaderVisibility = D3D12_SHADER_VISIBILITY_PIXEL;
	staticSamplers[2] = CD3DX12_STATIC_SAMPLER_DESC(
		2,
		D3D12_FILTER_MIN_MAG_MIP_POINT,
		D3D12_TEXTURE_ADDRESS_MODE_CLAMP,
		D3D12_TEXTURE_ADDRESS_MODE_CLAMP,
		D3D12_TEXTURE_ADDRESS_MODE_CLAMP,
		0.0f,
		1,
		D3D12_COMPARISON_FUNC_NEVER,
		D3D12_STATIC_BORDER_COLOR_OPAQUE_WHITE,
		0.0f,
		D3D12_FLOAT32_MAX,
		D3D12_SHADER_VISIBILITY_ALL);

	CD3DX12_ROOT_SIGNATURE_DESC rootSignatureDesc;
	rootSignatureDesc.Init(_countof(rootParametersAll), rootParametersAll, _countof(staticSamplers), staticSamplers, D3D12_ROOT_SIGNATURE_FLAG_ALLOW_INPUT_ASSEMBLER_INPUT_LAYOUT);
	ComPtr<ID3DBlob> signature;
	ComPtr<ID3DBlob> error;
	WriteGraphicsLog("Step: D3D12SerializeRootSignature\n");
	hr = D3D12SerializeRootSignature(&rootSignatureDesc, D3D_ROOT_SIGNATURE_VERSION_1, &signature, &error);
	if (FAILED(hr))
	{
		WriteGraphicsLog("ERROR: D3D12SerializeRootSignature failed\n");
		if (error)
		{
			Debug::Log("%s\\n", (char*)error->GetBufferPointer());
			FILE* fp = nullptr;
			fopen_s(&fp, "error_log.txt", "w");
			if (fp) {
				fprintf(fp, "%s\n", (char*)error->GetBufferPointer());
				fclose(fp);
			}
		}
		return false;
	}
	WriteGraphicsLog("Step: CreateRootSignature\n");
	hr = m_Device->CreateRootSignature(0, signature->GetBufferPointer(), signature->GetBufferSize(), IID_PPV_ARGS(&m_RootSignature));
	if (FAILED(hr))
	{
		WriteGraphicsLog("ERROR: CreateRootSignature failed\n");
		return false;
	}

	D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_HEAP_DESC cbvHeapDesc {};
	cbvHeapDesc.NumDescriptors = g_kENGINE_DESCRIPTOR_END + 1 + g_kTHUMBNAIL_DESCRIPTOR_COUNT + ImGuiManager::kSrvDescriptorCount + 16384;
	cbvHeapDesc.Type = D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_HEAP_TYPE_CBV_SRV_UAV;
	cbvHeapDesc.Flags = D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_HEAP_FLAG_SHADER_VISIBLE;
	WriteGraphicsLog("Step: CreateDescriptorHeap(CBV)\n");
	hr = m_Device->CreateDescriptorHeap(&cbvHeapDesc, IID_PPV_ARGS(&m_CbvHeap));
	if (FAILED(hr))
	{
		WriteGraphicsLog("ERROR: CreateDescriptorHeap(CBV) failed\n");
		return false;
	}

	m_PipelineState = nullptr;

	m_Viewport = CD3DX12_VIEWPORT(0.0f, 0.0f, (float)m_SceneWidth, (float)m_SceneHeight);
	m_ScissorRect = CD3DX12_RECT(0, 0, m_SceneWidth, m_SceneHeight);
	m_FullViewport = CD3DX12_VIEWPORT(0.0f, 0.0f, (float)m_Width, (float)m_Height);
	m_FullScissorRect = CD3DX12_RECT(0, 0, m_Width, m_Height);

	const UINT totalCbSize = g_kCB_ALIGNED_SIZE * g_kCBV_COUNT;
	auto cbDesc = CD3DX12_RESOURCE_DESC::Buffer(totalCbSize);
	auto cbHeapProps = CD3DX12_HEAP_PROPERTIES(D3D12_HEAP_TYPE_UPLOAD);
	hr = m_Device->CreateCommittedResource(
		&cbHeapProps,
		D3D12_HEAP_FLAG_NONE,
		&cbDesc,
		D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_GENERIC_READ,
		nullptr,
		IID_PPV_ARGS(&m_ConstantBuffer));
	if (FAILED(hr))
	{
		WriteGraphicsLog("ERROR: CreateCommittedResource(CB) failed\n");
		return false;
	}

	D3D12_CONSTANT_BUFFER_VIEW_DESC cbvDesc {};
	cbvDesc.SizeInBytes = g_kCB_ALIGNED_SIZE;
	CD3DX12_CPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE cbvHandle(m_CbvHeap->GetCPUDescriptorHandleForHeapStart());
	m_CbvIncrementSize = m_Device->GetDescriptorHandleIncrementSize(D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_HEAP_TYPE_CBV_SRV_UAV);
	UINT cbvIncrement = m_CbvIncrementSize;
	for (uint32_t i = 0; i < g_kCBV_COUNT; ++i)
	{
		cbvDesc.BufferLocation = m_ConstantBuffer->GetGPUVirtualAddress() + (i * g_kCB_ALIGNED_SIZE);
		m_Device->CreateConstantBufferView(&cbvDesc, cbvHandle);
		cbvHandle.Offset(1, cbvIncrement);
	}

	CD3DX12_RANGE readRange(0, 0);
	m_ConstantBuffer->Map(0, &readRange, reinterpret_cast<void**>(&m_pCbvDataBegin));

	WriteGraphicsLog("Step: CreateDepthBuffer\n");
if (!RenderTargets::CreateDepthBuffer())
	{
		return false;
	}

	WriteGraphicsLog("Step: CreateModelPipeline\n");
if (!ShaderPipelines::CreateModelPipeline())
	{
		return false;
	}

	const UINT dynamicVertexBufferSize = g_kMAX_DYNAMIC_VERTICES * sizeof(Vertex);
	auto dvbDesc = CD3DX12_RESOURCE_DESC::Buffer(dynamicVertexBufferSize);
	auto dvbHeapProps = CD3DX12_HEAP_PROPERTIES(D3D12_HEAP_TYPE_UPLOAD);
	hr = m_Device->CreateCommittedResource(
		&dvbHeapProps,
		D3D12_HEAP_FLAG_NONE,
		&dvbDesc,
		D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_GENERIC_READ,
		nullptr,
		IID_PPV_ARGS(&m_DynamicVertexBuffer));
	if (FAILED(hr))
	{
		WriteGraphicsLog("ERROR: CreateCommittedResource(Dynamic VB) failed\n");
		return false;
	}

	m_DynamicVertexBuffer->Map(0, &readRange, reinterpret_cast<void**>(&m_pDynamicVertexDataBegin));
	m_DynamicVertexBufferView.BufferLocation = m_DynamicVertexBuffer->GetGPUVirtualAddress();
	m_DynamicVertexBufferView.SizeInBytes = dynamicVertexBufferSize;
	m_DynamicVertexBufferView.StrideInBytes = sizeof(Vertex);
	m_DynamicVertexOffset = 0;

	WriteGraphicsLog("Step: TextureManager::Init\n");
TextureManager::Init();
    MaterialManager::Init();

	WriteGraphicsLog("Step: CreatePostProcessPipeline\n");
if (!ShaderPipelines::CreatePostProcessPipeline()) return false;

	WriteGraphicsLog("Step: SpatialUpscaler::Initialize\n");
	SpatialUpscaler::Initialize(m_Device.Get(), m_CbvHeap.Get(), m_CbvIncrementSize);
	VisibilityBuffer::Initialize(m_Device.Get(), m_CbvHeap.Get(), m_CbvIncrementSize);
	ScreenSpaceEffects::Initialize(m_Device.Get(), m_CbvHeap.Get(), m_CbvIncrementSize);
	CloudRenderer::Initialize(m_Device.Get(), m_CbvHeap.Get(), m_CbvIncrementSize);
	Raytracing::Initialize(m_Device.Get(), m_CbvHeap.Get(), m_CbvIncrementSize);
	DlssUpscaler::Initialize(m_Device.Get(), m_CbvHeap.Get(), m_CbvIncrementSize);
	OcclusionCulling::Initialize(m_Device.Get(), m_CbvHeap.Get(), m_CbvIncrementSize);
	MeshShaderPipeline::Initialize(m_Device.Get(), ShaderPipelines::GetModelRootSignature());
	MeshShaderRenderer::QuerySupport(m_Device.Get());
	LightInstanceBuilder::Initialize(m_Device.Get());

	WriteGraphicsLog("Step: CreateSceneRenderTarget\n");
if (!RenderTargets::CreateSceneRenderTarget()) return false;

	WriteGraphicsLog("Step: CreateSkinningPipeline\n");
if (!ShaderPipelines::CreateSkinningPipeline()) return false;

	WriteGraphicsLog("Step: CreateShadowDepthBuffer\n");
if (!RenderTargets::CreateShadowDepthBuffer()) return false;

	WriteGraphicsLog("Step: ImGuiManager::Init\n");
if (!ImGuiManager::Init(
		m_Hwnd,
		m_Device.Get(),
		m_CommandQueue.Get(),
		g_kFRAME_COUNT,
		DXGI_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM,
		m_CbvHeap.Get(),
		RenderTargets::GetImGuiCpuHandle(),
		RenderTargets::GetImGuiGpuHandle()))
	{
		WriteGraphicsLog("ERROR: ImGuiManager::Init failed\n");
		return false;
	}

	return true;
}

void GraphicsDevice::Uninit()
{
	WaitForGpuIdle();
    ScenePasses::ReleaseStaticShadowCache();

    AssetThumbnailManager::Shutdown();
	ImGuiManager::Uninit();

	MaterialPreview::Shutdown();
    TransmittanceShadows::Shutdown();
    MaterialManager::Shutdown();
	TextureManager::Uninit();

	if (m_ConstantBuffer)
	{
		m_ConstantBuffer->Unmap(0, nullptr);
		m_pCbvDataBegin = nullptr;
	}
	if (m_PostProcessConstantBuffer)
	{
		m_PostProcessConstantBuffer->Unmap(0, nullptr);
		m_pPostProcessCbvDataBegin = nullptr;
	}

	m_PsoCache.clear();
	m_PostProcessPsoMap.clear();
	m_BloomExtractPso.Reset();
	m_AtmospherePso.Reset();

	if (m_DynamicVertexBuffer)
	{
		m_DynamicVertexBuffer->Unmap(0, nullptr);
		m_DynamicVertexBuffer.Reset();
	}

	m_ModelPipelineState.Reset();
	m_ModelRootSignature.Reset();
	m_DepthStencilBuffer.Reset();
	m_DsvHeap.Reset();
	m_PipelineState.Reset();
	m_ConstantBuffer.Reset();
	m_PostProcessConstantBuffer.Reset();
	m_PostProcessRootSignature.Reset();
	m_UpscaleRootSignature.Reset();
	SpatialUpscaler::Shutdown();
	VisibilityBuffer::Shutdown();
	ScreenSpaceEffects::Shutdown();
	CloudRenderer::Shutdown();
	Raytracing::Shutdown();
	VertexDeformation::Shutdown();
	DlssUpscaler::Shutdown();
	OcclusionCulling::Shutdown();
	GpuScene::Shutdown();
	MeshShaderPipeline::Shutdown();
	LightInstanceBuilder::Shutdown();
    RenderTargets::ReleaseGBufferResources();
	m_SceneRenderTarget.Reset();
	m_PostProcessRenderTarget.Reset();
	m_PreUpscaleAaRenderTarget.Reset();
	m_PreUpscaleAaHistory.Reset();
	m_EditorSceneRenderTarget.Reset();
	m_TransparentSceneCopy.Reset();
	m_SceneRtvHeap.Reset();
	m_CbvHeap.Reset();
	m_RootSignature.Reset();
	m_CommandList.Reset();
	for (UINT n = 0; n < g_kFRAME_COUNT; n++)
	{
		m_CommandAllocator[n].Reset();
	}
	m_Fence.Reset();
	for (UINT n = 0; n < g_kFRAME_COUNT; n++)
	{
		m_RenderTargets[n].Reset();
	}
	m_RtvHeap.Reset();
	if (m_FrameLatencyWaitableObject)
	{
		CloseHandle(m_FrameLatencyWaitableObject);
		m_FrameLatencyWaitableObject = nullptr;
	}
	m_SwapChain.Reset();
	m_CommandQueue.Reset();
	m_Factory.Reset();
	m_Device.Reset();

	if (m_FenceEvent)
	{
		CloseHandle(m_FenceEvent);
		m_FenceEvent = nullptr;
	}
}

bool GraphicsDevice::CheckDeviceHealth(HRESULT operationResult, const char* operation)
{
	if (!m_Device) return false;
	const HRESULT removedReason = m_Device->GetDeviceRemovedReason();
	if (SUCCEEDED(operationResult) && SUCCEEDED(removedReason)) return true;
	if (g_DeviceRemovalLogged) return false;
	g_DeviceRemovalLogged = true;

	FILE* log = nullptr;
	fopen_s(&log, "device_removed.log", "a");
	if (!log) return false;
	const char* operationName;
	if (operation)
	{
		operationName = operation;
	}
	else
	{
		operationName = "unknown";
	}
	fprintf(log, "\nDEVICE REMOVED: operation=%s operationHr=0x%08X reason=0x%08X\n",
		operationName, operationResult, removedReason);

#ifdef _DEBUG
	ComPtr<ID3D12InfoQueue> infoQueue;
	if (SUCCEEDED(m_Device.As(&infoQueue)))
	{
		const UINT64 messageCount = infoQueue->GetNumStoredMessagesAllowedByRetrievalFilter();
		UINT64 firstMessage;
		if (messageCount > 256u)
		{
			firstMessage = messageCount - 256u;
		}
		else
		{
			firstMessage = 0u;
		}
		for (UINT64 messageIndex = firstMessage; messageIndex < messageCount; ++messageIndex)
		{
			SIZE_T messageSize = 0;
			if (FAILED(infoQueue->GetMessage(messageIndex, nullptr, &messageSize)) || messageSize == 0) continue;
			vector<BYTE> messageStorage(messageSize);
			auto* message = reinterpret_cast<D3D12_MESSAGE*>(messageStorage.data());
			if (SUCCEEDED(infoQueue->GetMessage(messageIndex, message, &messageSize)))
				{
					const char* messageDescription;
					if (message->pDescription)
					{
						messageDescription = message->pDescription;
					}
					else
					{
						messageDescription = "<empty>";
					}
					fprintf(log, "DebugLayer[%llu] severity=%u id=%u: %s\n",
						static_cast<unsigned long long>(messageIndex), static_cast<UINT>(message->Severity),
						static_cast<UINT>(message->ID), messageDescription);
				}
		}
	}
#endif

	ComPtr<ID3D12DeviceRemovedExtendedData1> dred;
	if (SUCCEEDED(m_Device.As(&dred)))
	{
		D3D12_DRED_AUTO_BREADCRUMBS_OUTPUT1 breadcrumbs{};
		if (SUCCEEDED(dred->GetAutoBreadcrumbsOutput1(&breadcrumbs)))
		{
			UINT nodeCount = 0;
			for (auto* node = breadcrumbs.pHeadAutoBreadcrumbNode; node && nodeCount < 64; node = node->pNext, ++nodeCount)
			{
				UINT completed;
				if (node->pLastBreadcrumbValue)
				{
					completed = *node->pLastBreadcrumbValue;
				}
				else
				{
					completed = 0;
				}
				UINT operationIndex;
				if (node->BreadcrumbCount > 0)
				{
					operationIndex = min(completed, node->BreadcrumbCount - 1u);
				}
				else
				{
					operationIndex = 0u;
				}
				UINT lastOperation;
				if (node->pCommandHistory && node->BreadcrumbCount > 0)
				{
					lastOperation = static_cast<UINT>(node->pCommandHistory[operationIndex]);
				}
				else
				{
					lastOperation = UINT_MAX;
				}
				const char* queueName;
				if (node->pCommandQueueDebugNameA)
				{
					queueName = node->pCommandQueueDebugNameA;
				}
				else
				{
					queueName = "<unnamed>";
				}
				const char* commandListName;
				if (node->pCommandListDebugNameA)
				{
					commandListName = node->pCommandListDebugNameA;
				}
				else
				{
					commandListName = "<unnamed>";
				}
				fprintf(log, "Breadcrumb[%u]: queue=%s list=%s completed=%u/%u lastOp=%u\n",
					nodeCount,
					queueName,
					commandListName,
					completed, node->BreadcrumbCount, lastOperation);
				if (node->pCommandHistory && node->BreadcrumbCount > 0)
				{
					UINT begin;
					if (completed > 12u)
					{
						begin = completed - 12u;
					}
					else
					{
						begin = 0u;
					}
					const UINT end = min(completed + 4u, node->BreadcrumbCount);
					fprintf(log, "  Operations:");
					for (UINT index = begin; index < end; ++index)
						{
							const char* completionMarker;
							if (index == completed)
							{
								completionMarker = "*";
							}
							else
							{
								completionMarker = "";
							}
							fprintf(log, " %u:%u%s", index, static_cast<UINT>(node->pCommandHistory[index]), completionMarker);
						}
					fprintf(log, "\n");
				}
				for (UINT contextIndex = 0; contextIndex < node->BreadcrumbContextsCount; ++contextIndex)
				{
					const auto& context = node->pBreadcrumbContexts[contextIndex];
					if (context.BreadcrumbIndex + 32u >= completed && context.BreadcrumbIndex <= completed + 4u)
						{
							const wchar_t* contextName;
							if (context.pContextString)
							{
								contextName = context.pContextString;
							}
							else
							{
								contextName = L"<unnamed>";
							}
							fprintf(log, "  Context[%u] @%u: %ls\n", contextIndex, context.BreadcrumbIndex,
								contextName);
						}
				}
			}
		}

		D3D12_DRED_PAGE_FAULT_OUTPUT1 pageFault{};
		if (SUCCEEDED(dred->GetPageFaultAllocationOutput1(&pageFault)))
		{
			fprintf(log, "PageFaultVA=0x%016llX\n", static_cast<unsigned long long>(pageFault.PageFaultVA));
			UINT allocationCount = 0;
			for (auto* node = pageFault.pHeadExistingAllocationNode; node && allocationCount < 32;
				node = node->pNext, ++allocationCount)
			{
				const char* objectName;
				if (node->ObjectNameA)
				{
					objectName = node->ObjectNameA;
				}
				else
				{
					objectName = "<unnamed>";
				}
				fprintf(log, "ExistingAllocation[%u]: %s type=%u\n", allocationCount,
					objectName, static_cast<UINT>(node->AllocationType));
			}
			allocationCount = 0;
			for (auto* node = pageFault.pHeadRecentFreedAllocationNode; node && allocationCount < 32;
				node = node->pNext, ++allocationCount)
			{
				const char* objectNameValue;
				if (node->ObjectNameA)
				{
					objectNameValue = node->ObjectNameA;
				}
				else
				{
					objectNameValue = "<unnamed>";
				}
				fprintf(log, "RecentFreedAllocation[%u]: %s type=%u\n", allocationCount,
					objectNameValue, static_cast<UINT>(node->AllocationType));
			}
		}
	}
	fclose(log);
	return false;
}

bool GraphicsDevice::WaitForGpuIdle()
{
	if (!m_CommandQueue || !m_Fence || !m_FenceEvent) return false;
	const UINT64 fenceValue = ++m_CurrentFenceValue;
	const HRESULT signalHr = m_CommandQueue->Signal(m_Fence.Get(), fenceValue);
	if (!CheckDeviceHealth(signalHr, "GPU idle fence signal")) return false;
	if (m_Fence->GetCompletedValue() < fenceValue)
	{
		const HRESULT eventHr = m_Fence->SetEventOnCompletion(fenceValue, m_FenceEvent);
		if (FAILED(eventHr)) return false;
		WaitForSingleObject(m_FenceEvent, INFINITE);
	}
	return CheckDeviceHealth(S_OK, "GPU idle wait");
}

void GraphicsDevice::SubmitForExternalCompute()
{
    // Submit the pack dispatch so the external CUDA stream can wait on it.
    // Do not reset the allocator: its earlier commands may still be executing.
    RenderProfiler::PrepareCommandListSplit(m_CommandList.Get());
    if (!CheckDeviceHealth(m_CommandList->Close(), "OptiX command list close"))
    {
        // Submission failure is fatal: callers cannot safely resume recording or
        // reconstruct resource states from an unsubmitted, invalid command list.
        WriteGraphicsLog("Fatal OptiX command-list close failure.\n");
        std::abort();
    }
    ID3D12CommandList* lists[] = {m_CommandList.Get()};
    m_CommandQueue->ExecuteCommandLists(1, lists);
    if (!CheckDeviceHealth(m_CommandList->Reset(m_CommandAllocator[m_FrameIndex].Get(), nullptr), "OptiX command list reset"))
    {
        WriteGraphicsLog("Fatal OptiX command-list reset failure.\n");
        std::abort();
    }
    // Reset invalidates graphics state. Restore the common scene raster state;
    // downstream passes bind their own root signatures, PSOs, targets and tables.
    m_CommandList->RSSetViewports(1, &m_Viewport);
    m_CommandList->RSSetScissorRects(1, &m_ScissorRect);
    ID3D12DescriptorHeap* heaps[] = {m_CbvHeap.Get()};
    m_CommandList->SetDescriptorHeaps(1, heaps);
}

#include "pch.h"
#include "graphicslog.h"

void WriteGraphicsLog(const char* format, ...)
{
	FILE* fp = nullptr;
	fopen_s(&fp, "init_log.txt", "a");
	if (!fp)
	{
		return;
	}
	va_list arguments;
	va_start(arguments, format);
	vfprintf(fp, format, arguments);
	va_end(arguments);
	fclose(fp);
}

	bool EnsureLightTileIndexBuffers(ID3D12Device* device)
	{
		if (!device)
		{
			return false;
		}
		const UINT64 bufferSize =
			static_cast<UINT64>(RendererState::g_kMAX_LIGHT_TILE_COUNT) *
			RendererState::g_kMAX_LIGHTS_PER_TILE * sizeof(uint32_t);
		for (UINT frame = 0; frame < RendererState::g_kFRAME_COUNT; ++frame)
		{
			if (g_LightTileIndexBuffers[frame] && g_LightTileIndexData[frame])
			{
				continue;
			}
			auto heapProperties = CD3DX12_HEAP_PROPERTIES(D3D12_HEAP_TYPE_UPLOAD);
			auto bufferDescription = CD3DX12_RESOURCE_DESC::Buffer(bufferSize);
			if (FAILED(device->CreateCommittedResource(
				&heapProperties,
				D3D12_HEAP_FLAG_NONE,
				&bufferDescription,
				D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_GENERIC_READ,
				nullptr,
				IID_PPV_ARGS(&g_LightTileIndexBuffers[frame]))))
			{
				return false;
			}
			g_LightTileIndexBuffers[frame]->SetName(L"LightTileIndexBuffer");
			if (FAILED(g_LightTileIndexBuffers[frame]->Map(
				0, nullptr, reinterpret_cast<void**>(&g_LightTileIndexData[frame]))))
			{
				g_LightTileIndexBuffers[frame].Reset();
				return false;
			}
		}
		return true;
	}

	XMFLOAT3 NormalizeFloat3(const XMFLOAT3& value, const XMFLOAT3& fallback)
	{
		XMVECTOR v = XMLoadFloat3(&value);
		if (XMVectorGetX(XMVector3LengthSq(v)) <= 0.000001f) return fallback;
		XMFLOAT3 result{};
		XMStoreFloat3(&result, XMVector3Normalize(v));
		return result;
	}

	XMFLOAT3 GetActiveCameraPosition()
