	uint64_t HashGeometry(const void* data, size_t size)
	{
		uint64_t hash = 1469598103934665603ull;
		const auto* bytes = static_cast<const uint8_t*>(data);
		for (size_t i = 0; i < size; ++i)
		{
			hash ^= bytes[i];
			hash *= 1099511628211ull;
		}
		return hash;
	}

	struct MaterialPartShaderConstants
	{
		XMFLOAT4 Basic{};
		XMFLOAT4 Base{};
		XMFLOAT4 Shadow0{};
		XMFLOAT4 Shadow1{};
		XMFLOAT4 Highlight{};
		XMFLOAT4 RimStyle{};
		XMFLOAT4 RimLight{};
		XMFLOAT4 Skin0{};
		XMFLOAT4 Skin1{};
	};

	struct PBRConstants
	{
		float Metallic = 0.0f;
		float Roughness = 0.5f;
		float Fresnel = 0.04f;
		float NormalBlend = 0.0f;
		float NormalBias = 0.0f;
		float BaseSaturation = 1.2f;
		float BaseBrightness = 1.0f;
		float ShadowThreshold = 0.44f;
		float ShadowSoftness = 0.045f;
		float ShadowStrength = 1.0f;
		float MidStrength = 1.0f;
		float LitStrength = 1.0f;
		float RimStrength = 0.45f;
		float RimThreshold = 0.70f;
		float RimSoftness = 0.055f;
		float RimPower = 1.0f;
		XMFLOAT3 RimColor = { 0.38f, 0.48f, 0.80f };
		float RimAlbedoBlend = 0.20f;
		float RimLightBlend = 0.35f;
		float SpecularStrength = 0.35f;
		float SpecularThreshold = 0.35f;
		float KawaiiBlend = 1.0f;
		float SkinScatterStrength = 1.0f;
		float SkinScatterWrap = 0.42f;
		float SkinBacklightStrength = 1.0f;
		float SkinRimScatterStrength = 1.0f;
		float SkinOilSpecularStrength = 1.0f;
		float SkinShadowScatter = 0.54f;
		float CastShadowThreshold = 0.28f;
		float CastShadowSoftness = 0.10f;
        // HLSL starts the next float4 at a 16-byte boundary after float3 PBRPadding.
		float Padding[4]{};
		XMFLOAT4 Transparent0 = { 1.50f, 0.98f, 0.02f, 0.035f };
		XMFLOAT4 Transparent1 = { 0.10f, 0.02f, 0.01f, 0.005f };
		MaterialPartShaderConstants PartParams[kMaterialPartParamCount]{};
        XMFLOAT4 AssetBaseColor{1, 1, 1, 1};
        XMFLOAT4 AssetSurface{1, 1, 0, 0.5f}; // Normal scale, AO strength, enabled, alpha cutoff.
        XMFLOAT4 AssetEmission{};
        XMUINT4 AssetTextures{UINT32_MAX, UINT32_MAX, UINT32_MAX, 0}; // MR, AO, emissive, surface/cull flags.
	};

	void WriteMaterialPartConstants(PBRConstants& constants, int index, const MaterialPartParams& params)
	{
		if (index < 0 || index >= kMaterialPartParamCount)
		{
			return;
		}

		constants.PartParams[index].Basic = XMFLOAT4(params.Metallic, params.Roughness, params.Fresnel, params.NormalBlend);
		constants.PartParams[index].Base = XMFLOAT4(params.NormalBias, params.BaseSaturation, params.BaseBrightness, params.KawaiiBlend);
		constants.PartParams[index].Shadow0 = XMFLOAT4(params.ShadowThreshold, params.ShadowSoftness, params.ShadowStrength, params.MidStrength);
		constants.PartParams[index].Shadow1 = XMFLOAT4(params.LitStrength, params.CastShadowThreshold, params.CastShadowSoftness, 0.0f);
		constants.PartParams[index].Highlight = XMFLOAT4(params.RimStrength, params.RimThreshold, params.SpecularStrength, params.SpecularThreshold);
		constants.PartParams[index].RimStyle = XMFLOAT4(params.RimSoftness, params.RimPower, params.RimAlbedoBlend, params.RimLightBlend);
		constants.PartParams[index].RimLight = XMFLOAT4(params.RimColor.x, params.RimColor.y, params.RimColor.z, 1.0f);
		constants.PartParams[index].Skin0 = XMFLOAT4(params.SkinScatterStrength, params.SkinScatterWrap, params.SkinBacklightStrength, params.SkinRimScatterStrength);
		constants.PartParams[index].Skin1 = XMFLOAT4(params.SkinOilSpecularStrength, params.SkinShadowScatter, 0.0f, 0.0f);
	}

	PBRConstants BuildPBRConstantsFromMaterial(const MaterialComponent& material)
	{
		PBRConstants constants{};
		constants.Metallic = material.Metallic;
		constants.Roughness = material.Roughness;
		constants.Fresnel = material.Fresnel;
		constants.NormalBlend = material.NormalBlend;
		constants.NormalBias = material.NormalBias;
		constants.BaseSaturation = material.BaseSaturation;
		constants.BaseBrightness = material.BaseBrightness;
		constants.ShadowThreshold = material.ShadowThreshold;
		constants.ShadowSoftness = material.ShadowSoftness;
		constants.ShadowStrength = material.ShadowStrength;
		constants.MidStrength = material.MidStrength;
		constants.LitStrength = material.LitStrength;
		constants.RimStrength = material.RimStrength;
		constants.RimThreshold = material.RimThreshold;
		constants.RimSoftness = material.RimSoftness;
		constants.RimPower = material.RimPower;
		constants.RimColor = material.RimColor;
		constants.RimAlbedoBlend = material.RimAlbedoBlend;
		constants.RimLightBlend = material.RimLightBlend;
		constants.SpecularStrength = material.SpecularStrength;
		constants.SpecularThreshold = material.SpecularThreshold;
		constants.KawaiiBlend = material.KawaiiBlend;
		constants.SkinScatterStrength = material.SkinScatterStrength;
		constants.SkinScatterWrap = material.SkinScatterWrap;
		constants.SkinBacklightStrength = material.SkinBacklightStrength;
		constants.SkinRimScatterStrength = material.SkinRimScatterStrength;
		constants.SkinOilSpecularStrength = material.SkinOilSpecularStrength;
		constants.SkinShadowScatter = material.SkinShadowScatter;
		constants.CastShadowThreshold = material.CastShadowThreshold;
		constants.CastShadowSoftness = material.CastShadowSoftness;
        constants.Padding[1] = static_cast<float>(MaterialSystem::ResolveShadowMode(material));
        constants.Padding[2] = material.ShadowCutoff;
		constants.Transparent0 = XMFLOAT4(
			max(material.IOR, 1.0f),
			clamp(material.Transmission, 0.0f, 1.0f),
			clamp(material.TransmissionRoughness, 0.0f, 1.0f),
			max(material.RefractionStrength, 0.0f));
		constants.Transparent1 = XMFLOAT4(
			max(material.Thickness, 0.0f),
			max(material.AbsorptionCoefficient.x, 0.0f),
			max(material.AbsorptionCoefficient.y, 0.0f),
			max(material.AbsorptionCoefficient.z, 0.0f));
		for (int i = 0; i < kMaterialPartParamCount; ++i)
		{
			WriteMaterialPartConstants(constants, i, material.PartParams[i]);
		}
        constants.AssetBaseColor = material.BaseColor;
        constants.AssetSurface = {material.NormalScale, material.AOStrength, 0, material.AlphaCutoff};
        if (material.RuntimeHandle != 0)
        {
            constants.AssetSurface.z = 1.0f;
        }
        constants.AssetEmission = {material.EmissiveColor.x, material.EmissiveColor.y,
            material.EmissiveColor.z, material.EmissiveIntensity};
        auto textureOffset = [](int descriptor)
        {
            if (descriptor < static_cast<int>(FrameConstants::g_kTEXTURE_SRV_START_INDEX))
            {
                return UINT32_MAX;
            }
            return static_cast<uint32_t>(descriptor) - FrameConstants::g_kTEXTURE_SRV_START_INDEX;
        };
        constants.AssetTextures = {textureOffset(material.MetallicRoughnessID),
            textureOffset(material.AOTextureID), textureOffset(material.EmissiveTextureID),
            static_cast<uint32_t>(material.AssetSurface) |
            (static_cast<uint32_t>(material.DoubleSided ? MaterialCull::None : material.AssetCull) << 2)};
		return constants;
	}

	const MaterialComponent& GetDeferredLightingMaterial()
	{
		static MaterialComponent defaultMaterial{};
		EntityID fallbackEntity = g_kINVALID_ENTITY;
		EntityID litEntity = g_kINVALID_ENTITY;
		EntityID selfShadowEntity = g_kINVALID_ENTITY;
		EntityID toonEntity = g_kINVALID_ENTITY;

		for (EntityID entity : World::GetView<MaterialComponent>())
		{
			const auto& material = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<MaterialComponent>(entity);
			if (material.ShaderClassMode != MaterialMode::Manual)
			{
				continue;
			}

			if (fallbackEntity == g_kINVALID_ENTITY)
			{
				fallbackEntity = entity;
			}
			if (material.ShaderClass == ShaderClass::Lit && litEntity == g_kINVALID_ENTITY)
			{
				litEntity = entity;
			}
			if (material.ShaderClass == ShaderClass::SelfShadow && selfShadowEntity == g_kINVALID_ENTITY)
			{
				selfShadowEntity = entity;
			}
			if (material.ShaderClass == ShaderClass::Toon && toonEntity == g_kINVALID_ENTITY)
			{
				toonEntity = entity;
			}
		}

		if (litEntity != g_kINVALID_ENTITY)
		{
			return ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<MaterialComponent>(litEntity);
		}

		if (selfShadowEntity != g_kINVALID_ENTITY)
		{
			return ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<MaterialComponent>(selfShadowEntity);
		}

		if (toonEntity != g_kINVALID_ENTITY)
		{
			return ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<MaterialComponent>(toonEntity);
		}

		if (fallbackEntity != g_kINVALID_ENTITY)
		{
			return ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<MaterialComponent>(fallbackEntity);
		}

		return defaultMaterial;
	}

}

GPUMaterialData MaterialBindings::BuildGpuSceneMaterial(const MaterialComponent& material)
{
    GPUMaterialData result{};
    result.BaseColor = material.BaseColor;
    result.BaseColor.w *= material.Alpha;
    result.Surface = XMFLOAT4(material.Metallic, material.Roughness, material.Fresnel, material.NormalBlend);
    result.AlbedoTextureIndex = material.TextureID >= 0 ? static_cast<uint32_t>(material.TextureID) : UINT32_MAX;
    result.NormalTextureIndex = material.NormalMapID >= 0 ? static_cast<uint32_t>(material.NormalMapID) : UINT32_MAX;
    result.Flags = (material.UseTexture ? 1u : 0u) | (MaterialSystem::IsTransparentMaterial(material) ? 2u : 0u) |
        (material.DoubleSided ? 4u : 0u);
    result.ShaderClass = static_cast<uint32_t>(material.ShaderClass);
    result.ShaderMode = static_cast<uint32_t>(material.ShaderClassMode);
    const auto constants = BuildPBRConstantsFromMaterial(material);
    static_assert(sizeof(constants) <= sizeof(result.ShadingParameters));
    result.ParameterVectorCount = (sizeof(constants) + 15) / 16;
    memcpy(result.ShadingParameters.data(), &constants, sizeof(constants));
    return result;
}

D3D12_GPU_VIRTUAL_ADDRESS MaterialBindings::GetPBRConstantBufferAddress(UINT slot)
{
	if (!m_PBRConstantBuffer)
	{
		return 0;
	}
	UINT safeSlot;
	if (slot < g_kPBR_CB_SLOT_COUNT)
	{
		safeSlot = slot;
	}
	else
	{
		safeSlot = 0;
	}
	const UINT frameSlot = GraphicsDevice::GetFrameIndex() * g_kPBR_CB_SLOT_COUNT + safeSlot;
	return m_PBRConstantBuffer->GetGPUVirtualAddress() +
		frameSlot * g_kPBR_CB_ALIGNED_SIZE;
}

void MaterialBindings::SetMaterial(const EntityID entityID, const MaterialComponent& material)
{
	if (!m_pPBRCbvDataBegin || !m_PBRConstantBuffer || !m_CommandList)
	{
		return;
	}

	UINT slot;
	if (entityID < g_kMAX_ENTITIES)
	{
		slot = entityID + 1;
	}
	else
	{
		slot = 0;
	}
	PBRConstants constants = BuildPBRConstantsFromMaterial(material);
	static_assert(sizeof(constants) <= g_kPBR_CB_ALIGNED_SIZE,
		"Material constants must fit within one per-entity frame slot");
    static_assert(offsetof(PBRConstants, AssetBaseColor) == 146 * 16);
    const auto textureHeap = FrameConstants::GetCbvHeap();
    if (textureHeap)
    {
        m_CommandList->SetGraphicsRootDescriptorTable(18, CD3DX12_GPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE(
            textureHeap->GetGPUDescriptorHandleForHeapStart(), FrameConstants::g_kTEXTURE_SRV_START_INDEX,
            FrameConstants::GetCbvIncrementSize()));
    }
    if (material.RuntimeHandle != 0)
    {
        auto& runtime = MaterialManager::GetRuntime(material.RuntimeHandle);
        if (!runtime.Constants)
        {
            const auto heap = CD3DX12_HEAP_PROPERTIES(D3D12_HEAP_TYPE_UPLOAD);
            const auto description = CD3DX12_RESOURCE_DESC::Buffer(g_kPBR_CB_ALIGNED_SIZE * g_kFRAME_COUNT);
            if (FAILED(m_Device->CreateCommittedResource(&heap, D3D12_HEAP_FLAG_NONE, &description,
                D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_GENERIC_READ, nullptr, IID_PPV_ARGS(&runtime.Constants))) ||
                FAILED(runtime.Constants->Map(0, nullptr, reinterpret_cast<void**>(&runtime.MappedConstants))))
            {
                runtime.Error = "Failed to create material constant buffer";
                runtime.Constants.Reset();
                return;
            }
        }
        const auto frame = GraphicsDevice::GetFrameIndex();
        if (runtime.UploadedRevision[frame] != runtime.Revision)
        {
            memcpy(runtime.MappedConstants + frame * g_kPBR_CB_ALIGNED_SIZE, &constants, sizeof(constants));
            runtime.UploadedRevision[frame] = runtime.Revision;
        }
        m_CommandList->SetGraphicsRootConstantBufferView(3,
            runtime.Constants->GetGPUVirtualAddress() + frame * g_kPBR_CB_ALIGNED_SIZE);
        return;
    }

	const UINT frameSlot = GraphicsDevice::GetFrameIndex() * g_kPBR_CB_SLOT_COUNT + slot;
	auto* dst = static_cast<UINT8*>(m_pPBRCbvDataBegin) + frameSlot * g_kPBR_CB_ALIGNED_SIZE;
	memcpy(dst, &constants, sizeof(constants));
	m_CommandList->SetGraphicsRootConstantBufferView(3, GetPBRConstantBufferAddress(slot));
}

bool MaterialBindings::SetPreviewMaterial(const MaterialComponent& material, ID3D12Resource* buffer, UINT textureBase,
    UINT partIndex, UINT partsPerFrame)
{
    if (!buffer) return false;
    auto constants = BuildPBRConstantsFromMaterial(material);
    constants.AssetSurface.z = 1.0f;
    auto offset = [textureBase](int descriptor)
    {
        return descriptor >= static_cast<int>(textureBase) ? static_cast<uint32_t>(descriptor) - textureBase : UINT32_MAX;
    };
    constants.AssetTextures.x = offset(material.MetallicRoughnessID);
    constants.AssetTextures.y = offset(material.AOTextureID);
    constants.AssetTextures.z = offset(material.EmissiveTextureID);
    uint8_t* mapped = nullptr;
    if (FAILED(buffer->Map(0, nullptr, reinterpret_cast<void**>(&mapped)))) return false;
    const auto frameOffset = (GraphicsDevice::GetFrameIndex() * partsPerFrame + partIndex) * g_kPBR_CB_ALIGNED_SIZE;
    memcpy(mapped + frameOffset, &constants, sizeof(constants));
    buffer->Unmap(0, nullptr);
    m_CommandList->SetGraphicsRootConstantBufferView(3, buffer->GetGPUVirtualAddress() + frameOffset);
    m_CommandList->SetGraphicsRootDescriptorTable(18, CD3DX12_GPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE(
        FrameConstants::GetCbvHeap()->GetGPUDescriptorHandleForHeapStart(), textureBase, FrameConstants::GetCbvIncrementSize()));
    return true;
}

uint64_t MaterialBindings::GetMaterialBatchHash(const MaterialComponent& material)
{
	const PBRConstants constants = BuildPBRConstantsFromMaterial(material);
	uint64_t hash = HashGeometry(&constants, sizeof(constants));
	struct BatchMaterialState
	{
		int ShaderMode = 0;
		int ShaderClassValue = 0;
		float Alpha = 1.0f;
		UINT IsTransparent = 0;
		UINT UseTexture = 0;
		UINT UseNormalMap = 0;
	} state{};
	state.ShaderMode = static_cast<int>(material.ShaderClassMode);
	state.ShaderClassValue = static_cast<int>(material.ShaderClass);
	state.Alpha = material.Alpha;
	state.IsTransparent = static_cast<UINT>(material.IsTransparent);
	state.UseTexture = static_cast<UINT>(material.UseTexture);
	state.UseNormalMap = static_cast<UINT>(material.NormalMapID >= 0);
	const uint64_t stateHash = HashGeometry(&state, sizeof(state));

	hash ^= stateHash + 0x9e3779b97f4a7c15ull + (hash << 6) + (hash >> 2);
	return hash;
}

void MaterialBindings::BindAssetSlot(EntityID entity, const MaterialComponent& material, int modelTexture)
{
    ConstantBuffer3D constants;
    memcpy(&constants, FrameConstants::GetConstantBufferPtr() + entity * FrameConstants::g_kCB_ALIGNED_SIZE, sizeof(constants));
    constants.UseTexture = static_cast<int>(material.UseTexture);
    const bool useModelTexture = material.RuntimeHandle == 0 && modelTexture >= 0;
    if (useModelTexture)
    {
        constants.UseTexture = 1;
    }
    constants.UseNormalMap = static_cast<int>(material.NormalMapID >= 0);
    constants.MaterialMode = static_cast<int>(material.ShaderClassMode);
    constants.ShaderClass = static_cast<int>(material.ShaderClass);
    constants.MaterialMetallic = material.Metallic;
    constants.MaterialRoughness = material.Roughness;
    constants.MaterialFresnel = material.Fresnel;
    constants.MaterialAlpha = material.Alpha;
    constants.MaterialIsTransparent = static_cast<int>(material.IsTransparent);
    if (TransmittanceShadows::IsActive())
    {
        bool thinSheet = false;
        if (ComponentManager::HasComponent<SpriteComponent>(entity))
            thinSheet = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<SpriteComponent>(entity).Is3D;
        if (ComponentManager::HasComponent<MeshComponent>(entity))
        {
            const auto& mesh = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<MeshComponent>(entity);
            const auto& extents = mesh.LocalBoundsExtents;
            thinSheet |= mesh.HasLocalBounds && min(extents.x, min(extents.y, extents.z)) < 0.000001f;
        }
        if (thinSheet) constants.MaterialIsTransparent |= 2;
    }
    m_CommandList->SetGraphicsRootDescriptorTable(0, FrameConstants::AllocateTransientConstantBuffer(constants));
    SetMaterial(entity, material);
    int base = TextureManager::GetDefaultTextureIndex();
    int normal = base;
    if (material.TextureID >= 0)
    {
        base = material.TextureID;
    }
    if (useModelTexture)
    {
        base = modelTexture;
    }
    if (material.NormalMapID >= 0)
    {
        normal = material.NormalMapID;
    }
    const auto heap = FrameConstants::GetCbvHeap()->GetGPUDescriptorHandleForHeapStart();
    m_CommandList->SetGraphicsRootDescriptorTable(1, CD3DX12_GPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE(heap, base, FrameConstants::GetCbvIncrementSize()));
    m_CommandList->SetGraphicsRootDescriptorTable(6, CD3DX12_GPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE(heap, normal, FrameConstants::GetCbvIncrementSize()));
    for (int descriptor : {base, normal, material.MetallicRoughnessID, material.AOTextureID, material.EmissiveTextureID})
    {
        if (descriptor >= 0)
        {
            TextureManager::TouchTexture(descriptor);
        }
    }
}

void MaterialBindings::UpdateDeferredLightingMaterial()
{
	if (m_pPBRCbvDataBegin)
	{
		PBRConstants pbrConstants = BuildPBRConstantsFromMaterial(GetDeferredLightingMaterial());
		auto* pbrDst = static_cast<UINT8*>(m_pPBRCbvDataBegin) +
			GraphicsDevice::GetFrameIndex() * g_kPBR_CB_SLOT_COUNT * g_kPBR_CB_ALIGNED_SIZE;
		memcpy(pbrDst, &pbrConstants, sizeof(pbrConstants));
	}
}

StaticModelVertex Vertex(float x, float y, float z, float nx, float ny, float nz, float u, float v)
{
    return {{x, y, z}, {nx, ny, nz}, {u, v}, {1, 1, 1, 11}};
}

void Triangle(vector<StaticModelVertex>& vertices, StaticModelVertex first,
    StaticModelVertex second, StaticModelVertex third)
{
    const auto edge1 = XMVectorSubtract(XMLoadFloat3(&second.Position), XMLoadFloat3(&first.Position));
    const auto edge2 = XMVectorSubtract(XMLoadFloat3(&third.Position), XMLoadFloat3(&first.Position));
    if (XMVectorGetX(XMVector3Dot(XMVector3Cross(edge1, edge2), XMLoadFloat3(&first.Normal))) < 0)
    {
        swap(second, third);
    }
    vertices.push_back(first);
    vertices.push_back(second);
    vertices.push_back(third);
}

vector<StaticModelVertex> MakeGeometry(int shape)
{
    vector<StaticModelVertex> vertices;
    if (shape == 0)
    {
        auto sphereVertex = [](int latitude, int longitude)
        {
            const float u = longitude / 32.0f;
            const float v = latitude / 16.0f;
            const float angle = u * XM_2PI;
            const float polar = v * XM_PI;
            const float x = sinf(polar) * cosf(angle);
            const float y = cosf(polar);
            const float z = sinf(polar) * sinf(angle);
            return Vertex(x, y, z, x, y, z, u, v);
        };
        for (int latitude = 0; latitude < 16; ++latitude)
        {
            for (int longitude = 0; longitude < 32; ++longitude)
            {
                const auto first = sphereVertex(latitude, longitude);
                const auto second = sphereVertex(latitude + 1, longitude);
                const auto third = sphereVertex(latitude + 1, longitude + 1);
                const auto fourth = sphereVertex(latitude, longitude + 1);
                Triangle(vertices, first, second, third);
                Triangle(vertices, first, third, fourth);
            }
        }
    }
    else
    {
        const int faces = 6;
        for (int face = 0; face < faces; ++face)
        {
            if (shape == 2 && face != 4)
            {
                continue;
            }
            const int axis = face / 2;
            float direction = -1.0f;
            if ((face & 1) != 0)
            {
                direction = 1.0f;
            }
            array<StaticModelVertex, 4> corners;
            for (int corner = 0; corner < 4; ++corner)
            {
                float position[3]{};
                float normal[3]{};
                position[axis] = direction;
                normal[axis] = direction;
                position[(axis + 1) % 3] = ((corner & 1) != 0) ? 1.0f : -1.0f;
                position[(axis + 2) % 3] = ((corner & 2) != 0) ? 1.0f : -1.0f;
                if (shape == 2)
                {
                    position[axis] = 0;
                }
                corners[corner] = Vertex(position[0], position[1], position[2], normal[0], normal[1], normal[2],
                    static_cast<float>(corner & 1), static_cast<float>((corner >> 1) & 1));
            }
            Triangle(vertices, corners[0], corners[1], corners[2]);
            Triangle(vertices, corners[1], corners[3], corners[2]);
        }
    }
    return vertices;
}

bool PreviewState::Initialize()
{
    if (Target)
    {
        return true;
    }
    auto* device = GraphicsDevice::GetDevice();
    if (!device)
    {
        return false;
    }
    const auto defaultHeap = CD3DX12_HEAP_PROPERTIES(D3D12_HEAP_TYPE_DEFAULT);
    auto target = CD3DX12_RESOURCE_DESC::Tex2D(GetSceneColorFormat(), Size, Size, 1, 1, 1, 0,
        D3D12_RESOURCE_FLAG_ALLOW_RENDER_TARGET);
    D3D12_CLEAR_VALUE clear{};
    clear.Format = target.Format;
    clear.Color[0] = 0.12f;
    clear.Color[1] = 0.13f;
    clear.Color[2] = 0.16f;
    clear.Color[3] = 1;
    if (FAILED(device->CreateCommittedResource(&defaultHeap, D3D12_HEAP_FLAG_NONE, &target,
        D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE, &clear, IID_PPV_ARGS(&Target))))
    {
        Error = "Failed to create material preview target";
        return false;
    }
    target.Format = DXGI_FORMAT_D32_FLOAT;
    target.Flags = D3D12_RESOURCE_FLAG_ALLOW_DEPTH_STENCIL;
    clear.Format = target.Format;
    clear.DepthStencil.Depth = 1;
    if (FAILED(device->CreateCommittedResource(&defaultHeap, D3D12_HEAP_FLAG_NONE, &target,
        D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_DEPTH_WRITE, &clear, IID_PPV_ARGS(&Depth))))
    {
        Error = "Failed to create preview depth";
        Target.Reset();
        return false;
    }
    D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_HEAP_DESC heap{};
    heap.NumDescriptors = 1;
    heap.Type = D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_HEAP_TYPE_RTV;
    if (FAILED(device->CreateDescriptorHeap(&heap, IID_PPV_ARGS(&RTVHeap))))
    {
        Target.Reset();
        return false;
    }
    heap.Type = D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_HEAP_TYPE_DSV;
    if (FAILED(device->CreateDescriptorHeap(&heap, IID_PPV_ARGS(&DSVHeap))))
    {
        Target.Reset();
        return false;
    }
    device->CreateRenderTargetView(Target.Get(), nullptr, RTVHeap->GetCPUDescriptorHandleForHeapStart());
    device->CreateDepthStencilView(Depth.Get(), nullptr, DSVHeap->GetCPUDescriptorHandleForHeapStart());
    D3D12_SHADER_RESOURCE_VIEW_DESC srv{};
    srv.Format = Target->GetDesc().Format;
    srv.ViewDimension = D3D12_SRV_DIMENSION_TEXTURE2D;
    srv.Shader4ComponentMapping = D3D12_DEFAULT_SHADER_4_COMPONENT_MAPPING;
    srv.Texture2D.MipLevels = 1;
    device->CreateShaderResourceView(Target.Get(), &srv, CpuSrv());
    const auto uploadHeap = CD3DX12_HEAP_PROPERTIES(D3D12_HEAP_TYPE_UPLOAD);
    const auto lightDescription = CD3DX12_RESOURCE_DESC::Buffer(constantBytes * g_kFRAME_COUNT);
    if (FAILED(device->CreateCommittedResource(&uploadHeap, D3D12_HEAP_FLAG_NONE, &lightDescription,
        D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_GENERIC_READ, nullptr, IID_PPV_ARGS(&Lights))) ||
        FAILED(Lights->Map(0, nullptr, reinterpret_cast<void**>(&MappedLights))))
    {
        Error = "Failed to create preview lighting constants";
        Target.Reset();
        return false;
    }
    memset(MappedLights, 0, constantBytes * g_kFRAME_COUNT);
    const int shapeCount = SrvIndex == g_kMATERIAL_PREVIEW_SRV_INDEX ? 3 : 1;
    for (int shape = 0; shape < shapeCount; ++shape)
    {
        const auto vertices = MakeGeometry(shape);
        const UINT bytes = static_cast<UINT>(vertices.size() * sizeof(StaticModelVertex));
        const auto description = CD3DX12_RESOURCE_DESC::Buffer(bytes);
        if (FAILED(device->CreateCommittedResource(&uploadHeap, D3D12_HEAP_FLAG_NONE, &description,
            D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_GENERIC_READ, nullptr, IID_PPV_ARGS(&Vertices[shape]))))
        {
            Error = "Failed to create preview mesh";
            Target.Reset();
            return false;
        }
        void* mapped = nullptr;
        if (FAILED(Vertices[shape]->Map(0, nullptr, &mapped)))
        {
            Target.Reset();
            return false;
        }
        memcpy(mapped, vertices.data(), bytes);
        Vertices[shape]->Unmap(0, nullptr);
        Counts[shape] = static_cast<UINT>(vertices.size());
        Views[shape] = {Vertices[shape]->GetGPUVirtualAddress(), bytes, sizeof(StaticModelVertex)};
    }
    return true;
}

ID3D12PipelineState* PreviewState::Pipeline(const MaterialComponent& material)
{
    size_t index = static_cast<size_t>(material.AssetCull);
    if (!material.AssetDepthWrite || material.IsTransparent)
    {
        index += 3;
    }
    if (material.IsTransparent)
    {
        index += 6;
    }
    if (Pipelines[index])
    {
        return Pipelines[index].Get();
    }
    ComPtr<ID3DBlob> vertex;
    ComPtr<ID3DBlob> pixel;
    ShaderDescription shader;
    shader.csoPath = "shader/hlsl/build/modelshaderVS.cso";
    shader.ppBlob = vertex.GetAddressOf();
    if (!ShaderPipelines::LoadShaderBlob(shader))
    {
        Error = "Preview failed to load production vertex shader";
        return nullptr;
    }
    shader.csoPath = "shader/hlsl/build/modelshaderPS.cso";
    shader.ppBlob = pixel.GetAddressOf();
    if (!ShaderPipelines::LoadShaderBlob(shader))
    {
        Error = "Preview failed to load production PBR shader";
        return nullptr;
    }
    D3D12_GRAPHICS_PIPELINE_STATE_DESC description{};
    description.pRootSignature = ShaderPipelines::GetModelRootSignature();
    description.VS = CD3DX12_SHADER_BYTECODE(vertex.Get());
    description.PS = CD3DX12_SHADER_BYTECODE(pixel.Get());
    description.RasterizerState = CD3DX12_RASTERIZER_DESC(D3D12_DEFAULT);
    if (material.AssetCull == MaterialCull::None)
    {
        description.RasterizerState.CullMode = D3D12_CULL_MODE_NONE;
    }
    else if (material.AssetCull == MaterialCull::Front)
    {
        description.RasterizerState.CullMode = D3D12_CULL_MODE_FRONT;
    }
    description.DepthStencilState = CD3DX12_DEPTH_STENCIL_DESC(D3D12_DEFAULT);
    if (!material.AssetDepthWrite || material.IsTransparent)
    {
        description.DepthStencilState.DepthWriteMask = D3D12_DEPTH_WRITE_MASK_ZERO;
    }
    description.BlendState = CD3DX12_BLEND_DESC(D3D12_DEFAULT);
    if (material.IsTransparent)
    {
        auto& blend = description.BlendState.RenderTarget[0];
        blend.BlendEnable = TRUE;
        blend.SrcBlend = D3D12_BLEND_ONE;
        blend.DestBlend = D3D12_BLEND_INV_SRC_ALPHA;
        blend.SrcBlendAlpha = D3D12_BLEND_ONE;
        blend.DestBlendAlpha = D3D12_BLEND_INV_SRC_ALPHA;
    }
    description.SampleMask = UINT_MAX;
    description.PrimitiveTopologyType = D3D12_PRIMITIVE_TOPOLOGY_TYPE_TRIANGLE;
    description.NumRenderTargets = 1;
    description.RTVFormats[0] = Target->GetDesc().Format;
    description.DSVFormat = DXGI_FORMAT_D32_FLOAT;
    description.SampleDesc.Count = 1;
    const D3D12_INPUT_ELEMENT_DESC layout[] = {
        {"POSITION", 0, DXGI_FORMAT_R32G32B32_FLOAT, 0, 0, D3D12_INPUT_CLASSIFICATION_PER_VERTEX_DATA, 0},
        {"NORMAL", 0, DXGI_FORMAT_R32G32B32_FLOAT, 0, 12, D3D12_INPUT_CLASSIFICATION_PER_VERTEX_DATA, 0},
        {"TEXCOORD", 0, DXGI_FORMAT_R32G32_FLOAT, 0, 24, D3D12_INPUT_CLASSIFICATION_PER_VERTEX_DATA, 0},
        {"COLOR", 0, DXGI_FORMAT_R32G32B32A32_FLOAT, 0, 32, D3D12_INPUT_CLASSIFICATION_PER_VERTEX_DATA, 0}};
    description.InputLayout = {layout, 4};
    if (FAILED(GraphicsDevice::GetDevice()->CreateGraphicsPipelineState(&description, IID_PPV_ARGS(&Pipelines[index]))))
    {
        Error = "Failed to create production preview PSO";
        return nullptr;
    }
    return Pipelines[index].Get();
}
}

void MaterialPreview::SetVisible(bool visible)
{
    preview.Visible = visible;
}

void MaterialPreview::DrawControls()
{
    ImGui::SetNextItemWidth(95);
    ImGui::Combo("##PreviewMesh", &preview.Shape, "Sphere\0Cube\0Plane\0");
    ImGui::SameLine();
    if (ImGui::Button("Reset Camera"))
    {
        preview.Yaw = 0.45f;
        preview.Pitch = 0.2f;
        preview.Distance = 4.5f;
    }
    ImGui::SameLine();
    ImGui::SetNextItemWidth(95);
    ImGui::SliderFloat("Light", &preview.LightIntensity, 0, 5);
    ImGui::SameLine();
    ImGui::Checkbox("Scene IBL", &preview.SceneEnvironment);
}

void MaterialPreview::DrawImage(AssetHandle material)
{
    preview.Material = material;
    preview.Visible = true;
    if (!preview.Initialize())
    {
        ImGui::TextWrapped("%s", preview.Error.c_str());
        return;
    }
    const auto available = ImGui::GetContentRegionAvail();
    const float side = min(available.x, available.y);
    ImGui::PushStyleVar(ImGuiStyleVar_FramePadding, ImVec2(0, 0));
    ImGui::ImageButton("##PreviewOrbit", reinterpret_cast<ImTextureData*>(preview.GpuSrv().ptr),
        ImVec2(side, side), ImVec2(0, 0), ImVec2(1, 1), ImVec4(0, 0, 0, 0));
    ImGui::PopStyleVar();
    const auto imageMinimum = ImGui::GetItemRectMin();
    const auto imageMaximum = ImGui::GetItemRectMax();
    MaterialValidation::CaptureDropTarget("Preview", imageMinimum.x, imageMinimum.y, imageMaximum.x, imageMaximum.y);
    if (ImGui::IsItemActive() && ImGui::IsMouseDragging(ImGuiMouseButton_Left))
    {
        const auto& input = ImGui::GetIO();
        preview.Yaw += input.MouseDelta.x * 0.01f;
        preview.Pitch = clamp(preview.Pitch + input.MouseDelta.y * 0.01f, -1.4f, 1.4f);
    }
    if (ImGui::IsItemHovered())
    {
        auto& input = ImGui::GetIO();
        preview.Distance = clamp(preview.Distance - input.MouseWheel * 0.25f, 1.5f, 12.0f);
    }
    if (!preview.Error.empty())
    {
        ImGui::TextWrapped("%s", preview.Error.c_str());
    }
}

namespace
{
bool RenderPreview(PreviewState& preview, const MaterialComponent& material,
    UINT firstVertex = 0, UINT vertexCount = 0, UINT partIndex = 0, UINT partCount = 1)
{
    auto* pipeline = preview.Pipeline(material);
    if (!pipeline) return false;
    auto* commands = GraphicsDevice::GetCommandList();
    auto barrier = CD3DX12_RESOURCE_BARRIER::Transition(preview.Target.Get(),
        D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_RENDER_TARGET);
    if (partIndex == 0) commands->ResourceBarrier(1, &barrier);
    const auto rtv = preview.RTVHeap->GetCPUDescriptorHandleForHeapStart();
    const auto dsv = preview.DSVHeap->GetCPUDescriptorHandleForHeapStart();
    const float background[4] = {0.12f, 0.13f, 0.16f, 1};
    if (partIndex == 0)
    {
        commands->ClearRenderTargetView(rtv, background, 0, nullptr);
        commands->ClearDepthStencilView(dsv, D3D12_CLEAR_FLAG_DEPTH, 1, 0, 0, nullptr);
    }
    commands->OMSetRenderTargets(1, &rtv, FALSE, &dsv);
    const D3D12_VIEWPORT viewport = {0, 0, static_cast<float>(preview.Size), static_cast<float>(preview.Size), 0, 1};
    const D3D12_RECT scissor = {0, 0, static_cast<LONG>(preview.Size), static_cast<LONG>(preview.Size)};
    commands->RSSetViewports(1, &viewport);
    commands->RSSetScissorRects(1, &scissor);
    ScenePasses::BeginPass(ShaderPipelines::GetModelRootSignature(), D3D_PRIMITIVE_TOPOLOGY_TRIANGLELIST);
    commands->SetPipelineState(pipeline);
    auto* lights = reinterpret_cast<XMFLOAT4*>(preview.MappedLights + GraphicsDevice::GetFrameIndex() * constantBytes);
    memset(lights, 0, constantBytes);
    lights[0] = {-0.5f, 0.7f, -0.8f, 0};
    lights[1] = {1.0f, 0.96f, 0.9f, preview.LightIntensity};
    lights[4] = {1, 0, 0, 0};
    lights[5] = lights[0];
    lights[5 + RendererState::g_kMAX_SHADER_LIGHTS] = lights[1];
    // Match LightParams in common.hlsl: four vector arrays, then one matrix array.
    constexpr size_t shadowDataOffset = 5 + 8 * RendererState::g_kMAX_SHADER_LIGHTS;
    constexpr size_t flagsOffset = shadowDataOffset + RendererState::g_kMAX_SHADER_LIGHTS;
    lights[shadowDataOffset] = {-1, 0, 0, 0}; // The studio light has no scene shadow map.
    lights[flagsOffset] = {1, 1, 0, 0}; // Enable physical lighting in opaque and forward passes.
    commands->SetGraphicsRootConstantBufferView(2, preview.Lights->GetGPUVirtualAddress() + GraphicsDevice::GetFrameIndex() * constantBytes);
    // Zero shadow and ray flags for this isolated preview scene.
    const auto zeroAddress = preview.Lights->GetGPUVirtualAddress() + GraphicsDevice::GetFrameIndex() * constantBytes + constantBytes - 256;
    commands->SetGraphicsRootConstantBufferView(5, zeroAddress);
    commands->SetGraphicsRootConstantBufferView(17, zeroAddress);
    commands->SetGraphicsRootConstantBufferView(26, zeroAddress);
    commands->SetGraphicsRootConstantBufferView(27, zeroAddress);
    const XMFLOAT3 eye = {sinf(preview.Yaw) * cosf(preview.Pitch) * preview.Distance + preview.Center.x,
        sinf(preview.Pitch) * preview.Distance + preview.Center.y, -cosf(preview.Yaw) * cosf(preview.Pitch) * preview.Distance + preview.Center.z};
    ConstantBuffer3D constants;
    constants.World = XMMatrixIdentity();
    constants.View = XMMatrixTranspose(XMMatrixLookAtLH(XMLoadFloat3(&eye), XMLoadFloat3(&preview.Center), XMVectorSet(0, 1, 0, 0)));
    constants.Projection = XMMatrixTranspose(XMMatrixPerspectiveFovLH(XM_PIDIV4, 1, preview.Near, preview.Far));
    constants.CameraPos = eye;
    constants.UseTexture = material.UseTexture;
    constants.UseNormalMap = material.NormalMapID >= 0;
    constants.MaterialMode = 1;
    constants.ShaderClass = static_cast<int>(ShaderClass::PBR);
    constants.MaterialMetallic = material.Metallic;
    constants.MaterialRoughness = material.Roughness;
    constants.MaterialFresnel = material.Fresnel;
    constants.MaterialAlpha = material.Alpha;
    constants.ViewportSize = {static_cast<float>(preview.Size), static_cast<float>(preview.Size)};
    constants.MaterialIsTransparent = material.IsTransparent;
    const auto drawConstants = FrameConstants::AllocateTransientConstantBuffer(constants);
    if (!drawConstants.ptr)
    {
        preview.Error = "Preview frame constant budget exhausted";
        const auto restore = CD3DX12_RESOURCE_BARRIER::Transition(preview.Target.Get(),
            D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_RENDER_TARGET, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE);
        commands->ResourceBarrier(1, &restore);
        return false;
    }
    commands->SetGraphicsRootDescriptorTable(0, drawConstants);
    if (preview.PreviewConstants)
    {
        if (!MaterialBindings::SetPreviewMaterial(material, preview.PreviewConstants.Get(), RendererState::g_kTHUMBNAIL_DESCRIPTOR_START, partIndex, partCount)) return false;
    }
    else MaterialBindings::SetMaterial(g_kINVALID_ENTITY, material);
    const auto heap = FrameConstants::GetCbvHeap()->GetGPUDescriptorHandleForHeapStart();
    const auto increment = FrameConstants::GetCbvIncrementSize();
    int albedo = TextureManager::GetDefaultTextureIndex();
    int normal = albedo;
    if (material.TextureID >= 0)
    {
        albedo = material.TextureID;
    }
    if (material.NormalMapID >= 0)
    {
        normal = material.NormalMapID;
    }
    commands->SetGraphicsRootDescriptorTable(1, CD3DX12_GPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE(heap, albedo, increment));
    commands->SetGraphicsRootDescriptorTable(6, CD3DX12_GPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE(heap, normal, increment));
    if (!preview.SceneEnvironment)
    {
        commands->SetGraphicsRootDescriptorTable(7, CD3DX12_GPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE(heap,
            TextureManager::GetDefaultTextureIndex(), increment));
    }
    commands->IASetVertexBuffers(0, 1, &preview.Views[preview.Shape]);
    commands->IASetIndexBuffer(nullptr);
    commands->DrawInstanced(vertexCount ? vertexCount : preview.Counts[preview.Shape], 1, firstVertex, 0);
    barrier = CD3DX12_RESOURCE_BARRIER::Transition(preview.Target.Get(),
        D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_RENDER_TARGET, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE);
    if (partIndex + 1 == partCount) commands->ResourceBarrier(1, &barrier);
    return true;
}

}

void MaterialPreview::Render()
{
    if (!preview.Visible || !preview.Material || !preview.Initialize()) return;
    auto& runtime = MaterialManager::GetRuntime(preview.Material);
    for (int texture : runtime.TextureDescriptors)
    {
        if (texture >= 0) TextureManager::TouchTexture(texture);
    }
    RenderPreview(preview, runtime.Binding);
}

void MaterialPreview::Shutdown()
{
    preview = PreviewState{};
}

ID3D12Resource* MaterialPreview::GetTarget()
{
    return preview.Target.Get();
}

void MaterialPreview::SetMesh(Mesh mesh)
{
    preview.Shape = static_cast<int>(mesh);
}

void MaterialPreview::SetLightIntensity(float intensity)
{
    preview.LightIntensity = clamp(intensity, 0.0f, 5.0f);
}

struct ThumbnailPreviewContext::Impl
{
    PreviewState State;
    bool GeometryUploaded = false;
    UINT MaterialSlots = 1;
};

ThumbnailPreviewContext::ThumbnailPreviewContext() : m_Impl(std::make_unique<Impl>()) {}
ThumbnailPreviewContext::~ThumbnailPreviewContext() = default;

bool ThumbnailPreviewContext::Initialize(UINT size, UINT descriptorIndex)
{
    auto& state = m_Impl->State;
    state.Size = size;
    state.SrvIndex = descriptorIndex;
    state.SceneEnvironment = false;
    const auto sphereFit = FitThumbnailCamera(1.0f);
    state.Distance = sphereFit.Distance;
    state.Near = sphereFit.Near;
    state.Far = sphereFit.Far;
    if (!state.Initialize()) return false;
    const auto heap = CD3DX12_HEAP_PROPERTIES(D3D12_HEAP_TYPE_UPLOAD);
    const auto description = CD3DX12_RESOURCE_DESC::Buffer(RendererState::g_kPBR_CB_ALIGNED_SIZE * RendererState::g_kFRAME_COUNT);
    return SUCCEEDED(GraphicsDevice::GetDevice()->CreateCommittedResource(&heap, D3D12_HEAP_FLAG_NONE,
        &description, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_GENERIC_READ, nullptr, IID_PPV_ARGS(&state.PreviewConstants)));
}

bool ThumbnailPreviewContext::Render(const MaterialComponent& material, const std::vector<StaticModelVertex>& geometry,
    const std::vector<ThumbnailPreviewPart>& parts)
{
    auto& state = m_Impl->State;
    if (!geometry.empty() && !m_Impl->GeometryUploaded)
    {
        XMFLOAT3 low = geometry.front().Position;
        XMFLOAT3 high = low;
        for (const auto& vertex : geometry)
        {
            const auto p = vertex.Position;
            if (!std::isfinite(p.x) || !std::isfinite(p.y) || !std::isfinite(p.z)) return false;
            low = {std::min(low.x, p.x), std::min(low.y, p.y), std::min(low.z, p.z)};
            high = {std::max(high.x, p.x), std::max(high.y, p.y), std::max(high.z, p.z)};
        }
        state.Center = {(low.x + high.x) * 0.5f, (low.y + high.y) * 0.5f, (low.z + high.z) * 0.5f};
        const float x = (high.x - low.x) * 0.5f, y = (high.y - low.y) * 0.5f, z = (high.z - low.z) * 0.5f;
        const auto fit = FitThumbnailCamera(std::sqrt(x*x + y*y + z*z));
        if (!fit.Valid || geometry.size() > UINT_MAX / sizeof(StaticModelVertex)) return false;
        state.Distance = fit.Distance;
        state.Near = fit.Near;
        state.Far = fit.Far;
        const UINT bytes = static_cast<UINT>(geometry.size() * sizeof(StaticModelVertex));
        const auto heap = CD3DX12_HEAP_PROPERTIES(D3D12_HEAP_TYPE_UPLOAD);
        const auto description = CD3DX12_RESOURCE_DESC::Buffer(bytes);
        state.Vertices[0].Reset();
        if (FAILED(GraphicsDevice::GetDevice()->CreateCommittedResource(&heap, D3D12_HEAP_FLAG_NONE,
            &description, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_GENERIC_READ, nullptr, IID_PPV_ARGS(&state.Vertices[0])))) return false;
        void* mapped = nullptr;
        if (FAILED(state.Vertices[0]->Map(0, nullptr, &mapped))) return false;
        memcpy(mapped, geometry.data(), bytes);
        state.Vertices[0]->Unmap(0, nullptr);
        state.Views[0] = {state.Vertices[0]->GetGPUVirtualAddress(), bytes, sizeof(StaticModelVertex)};
        state.Counts[0] = static_cast<UINT>(geometry.size());
        m_Impl->GeometryUploaded = true;
    }
    if (parts.empty()) return RenderPreview(state, material);
    const UINT count = static_cast<UINT>(parts.size());
    if (m_Impl->MaterialSlots != count)
    {
        const auto heap = CD3DX12_HEAP_PROPERTIES(D3D12_HEAP_TYPE_UPLOAD);
        const auto description = CD3DX12_RESOURCE_DESC::Buffer(RendererState::g_kPBR_CB_ALIGNED_SIZE * RendererState::g_kFRAME_COUNT * static_cast<UINT64>(count));
        state.PreviewConstants.Reset();
        if (FAILED(GraphicsDevice::GetDevice()->CreateCommittedResource(&heap, D3D12_HEAP_FLAG_NONE,
            &description, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_GENERIC_READ, nullptr, IID_PPV_ARGS(&state.PreviewConstants)))) return false;
        m_Impl->MaterialSlots = count;
    }
    // Resolve pipelines before recording any pass; a failed material cannot leave the target half rendered.
    for (const auto& part : parts) if (!state.Pipeline(part.Material)) return false;
    for (UINT index = 0; index < count; ++index)
    {
        const auto& part = parts[index];
        if (!RenderPreview(state, part.Material, part.FirstVertex, part.VertexCount, index, count)) return false;
    }
    return true;
}

ID3D12Resource* ThumbnailPreviewContext::GetTarget() const { return m_Impl->State.Target.Get(); }
uint64_t ThumbnailPreviewContext::MemoryBytes() const
{
    const auto& state = m_Impl->State;
    uint64_t bytes = 0;
    const auto add = [&bytes](const ComPtr<ID3D12Resource>& resource)
    {
        if (!resource) return;
        const auto description = resource->GetDesc();
        bytes += GraphicsDevice::GetDevice()->GetResourceAllocationInfo(0, 1, &description).SizeInBytes;
    };
    add(state.Target);
    add(state.Depth);
    add(state.Lights);
    add(state.PreviewConstants);
    for (const auto& buffer : state.Vertices) add(buffer);
    return bytes;
}

===== FILE: rendering\materialpreview.h =====
#pragma once
#include "materialasset.h"
struct ID3D12Resource;

class MaterialPreview
{
public:
    enum class Mesh { Sphere, Cube, Plane };
    static void SetVisible(bool visible);
    static void DrawControls();
    static void DrawImage(AssetHandle material);
    static void Render();
    static void Shutdown();
    static ID3D12Resource* GetTarget();
    static void SetMesh(Mesh mesh);

===== FILE: rendering\meshdispatch.h =====
#pragma once
#include <cstdint>

namespace MeshDispatch
{
constexpr uint32_t TrianglesPerMeshlet = 64;
constexpr uint32_t GroupsPerPage = 65535;
constexpr uint32_t MeshletCount(uint32_t elementCount)
{
    const uint32_t triangles = elementCount / 3;
    return triangles / TrianglesPerMeshlet + (triangles % TrianglesPerMeshlet != 0);
}
constexpr uint32_t PageSize(uint32_t meshlets, uint32_t first, uint32_t limit = GroupsPerPage)
{
    if (first >= meshlets) return 0;
    if (!limit || limit > GroupsPerPage) limit = GroupsPerPage;
    const uint32_t remaining = meshlets - first;
    return remaining < limit ? remaining : limit;
}
}

#include "meshletbuilder.h"
#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>
#include <fstream>
#include <limits>
#include <stdexcept>
#include <cstring>

namespace Meshlets
{
namespace
{
Position Sub(Position a, Position b)
{
    return {a.X - b.X, a.Y - b.Y, a.Z - b.Z};
}
Position Add(Position a, Position b)
{
    return {a.X + b.X, a.Y + b.Y, a.Z + b.Z};
}
Position Scale(Position a, float s)
{
    return {a.X * s, a.Y * s, a.Z * s};
}
float Dot(Position a, Position b)
{
    return a.X * b.X + a.Y * b.Y + a.Z * b.Z;
}
float Length(Position a)
{
    return std::sqrt(Dot(a, a));
}
Position Cross(Position a, Position b)
{
    return {a.Y * b.Z - a.Z * b.Y, a.Z * b.X - a.X * b.Z, a.X * b.Y - a.Y * b.X};
}
bool Finite(Position p)
{
    return std::isfinite(p.X) && std::isfinite(p.Y) && std::isfinite(p.Z);
}
bool ConfigValid(BuildConfig c)
{
    return c.MaxVertices >= 3 && c.MaxVertices <= 64 && c.MaxPrimitives >= 1 && c.MaxPrimitives <= 126 &&
           c.MeshletsPerCluster >= 1 && c.MeshletsPerCluster <= 256;
}
Bounds ComputeBounds(const Asset &asset, const Meshlet &meshlet, std::span<const Position> positions)
{
    Position minimum = positions[asset.Vertices[meshlet.VertexOffset]], maximum = minimum;
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < meshlet.VertexCount; ++i)
    {
        auto p = positions[asset.Vertices[meshlet.VertexOffset + i]];
        minimum = {std::min(minimum.X, p.X), std::min(minimum.Y, p.Y), std::min(minimum.Z, p.Z)};
        maximum = {std::max(maximum.X, p.X), std::max(maximum.Y, p.Y), std::max(maximum.Z, p.Z)};
    }
    Bounds bounds;
    bounds.Center = Scale(Add(minimum, maximum), 0.5f);
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < meshlet.VertexCount; ++i)
        bounds.Radius = std::max(
            bounds.Radius, Length(Sub(positions[asset.Vertices[meshlet.VertexOffset + i]], bounds.Center)));
    bounds.Radius = std::nextafter(bounds.Radius, std::numeric_limits<float>::infinity());
    std::vector<Position> normals;
    Position sum{};
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < meshlet.PrimitiveCount; ++i)
    {
        uint32_t packed = asset.Primitives[meshlet.PrimitiveOffset + i];
        auto vertex = [&](uint32_t lane) {
            return positions[asset.Vertices[meshlet.VertexOffset + ((packed >> (lane * 8)) & 255)]];
        };
        auto n = Cross(Sub(vertex(1), vertex(0)), Sub(vertex(2), vertex(0)));
        float length = Length(n);
        if (length <= 1e-12f)
            continue;
        n = Scale(n, 1 / length);
        normals.push_back(n);
        sum = Add(sum, n);
    }
    if (Length(sum) > 1e-6f)
    {
        bounds.ConeAxis = Scale(sum, 1 / Length(sum));
        float cosine = 1;
        for (auto n : normals)
            cosine = std::min(cosine, Dot(n, bounds.ConeAxis));
        if (cosine > 0.001f)
            bounds.ConeCutoff = std::min(1.f, std::sqrt(std::max(0.f, 1 - cosine * cosine)) + 1e-5f);
    }
    return bounds;
}
struct Header
{
    uint32_t Magic = 0x354c534d, Version = 2;
    uint64_t Key = 0;
    uint64_t PayloadHash = 0;
    BuildConfig Config;
    uint32_t Counts[5]{};
};
uint64_t PayloadHash(const Asset &asset)
{
    uint64_t hash = 14695981039346656037ull;
    auto consume = [&](const auto &values) {
        const auto *bytes = reinterpret_cast<const uint8_t *>(values.data());
        for (size_t i = 0; i < values.size() * sizeof(values[0]); ++i)
        {
            hash ^= bytes[i];
            hash *= 1099511628211ull;
        }
    };
    consume(asset.Meshlets);
    consume(asset.Vertices);
    consume(asset.Primitives);
    consume(asset.Bounds);
    consume(asset.Clusters);
    return hash;
}
template <class T> bool Write(std::ofstream &stream, const std::vector<T> &data)
{
    stream.write(reinterpret_cast<const char *>(data.data()), std::streamsize(data.size() * sizeof(T)));
    return bool(stream);
}
template <class T> bool Read(std::ifstream &stream, std::vector<T> &data, uint32_t count)
{
    data.resize(count);
    stream.read(reinterpret_cast<char *>(data.data()), std::streamsize(data.size() * sizeof(T)));
    return bool(stream);
}
} // namespace
void RefreshMeshletBounds(Asset &asset, std::span<const Position> positions)
{
    asset.Bounds.resize(asset.Meshlets.size());
    for (size_t i=0;i<asset.Meshlets.size();++i)
        asset.Bounds[i]=ComputeBounds(asset,asset.Meshlets[i],positions);
}
Asset Build(std::span<const Position> positions, std::span<const uint32_t> indices, BuildConfig config)
{
    if (!ConfigValid(config) || indices.size() % 3)
        throw std::invalid_argument("Invalid meshlet build configuration/triangle list");
    if (indices.size() > UINT32_MAX || positions.size() > UINT32_MAX)
        throw std::overflow_error("Meshlet geometry too large");
    for (auto p : positions)
        if (!Finite(p))
            throw std::invalid_argument("Non-finite meshlet position");
    for (auto index : indices)
        if (index >= positions.size())
            throw std::out_of_range("Meshlet vertex index");
    Asset asset;
    asset.Config = config;
    Meshlet current;
    std::vector<uint32_t> local;
    auto finish = [&]() {
        if (!current.PrimitiveCount)
            return;
        current.VertexCount = static_cast<uint32_t>(local.size());
        asset.Vertices.insert(asset.Vertices.end(), local.begin(), local.end());
        asset.Meshlets.push_back(current);
        asset.Bounds.push_back(ComputeBounds(asset, current, positions));
        current = {static_cast<uint32_t>(asset.Vertices.size()), 0,
                   static_cast<uint32_t>(asset.Primitives.size()), 0};
        local.clear();
    };
    for (size_t i = 0; i < indices.size(); i += 3)
    {
        uint32_t extra = 0;
        for (uint32_t j = 0; j < 3; ++j)
        {
            bool earlier = false;
            for (uint32_t k = 0; k < j; ++k)
                earlier |= indices[i + k] == indices[i + j];
            if (!earlier && std::find(local.begin(), local.end(), indices[i + j]) == local.end())
                ++extra;
        }
        if (current.PrimitiveCount >= config.MaxPrimitives || local.size() + extra > config.MaxVertices)
            finish();
        uint32_t packed = 0;
        for (uint32_t j = 0; j < 3; ++j)
        {
            auto found = std::find(local.begin(), local.end(), indices[i + j]);
            uint32_t index = static_cast<uint32_t>(found - local.begin());
            if (found == local.end())
                local.push_back(indices[i + j]);
            packed |= index << (j * 8);
        }
        asset.Primitives.push_back(packed);
        ++current.PrimitiveCount;
    }
    finish();
    for (uint32_t first = 0; first < asset.Meshlets.size(); first += config.MeshletsPerCluster)
    {
        Cluster cluster;
        cluster.MeshletOffset = first;
        cluster.MeshletCount =
            std::min(config.MeshletsPerCluster, static_cast<uint32_t>(asset.Meshlets.size()) - first);
        Position minimum = asset.Bounds[first].Center, maximum = minimum;
        for (uint32_t j = 0; j < cluster.MeshletCount; ++j)
        {
            const auto &b = asset.Bounds[first + j];
            minimum = {std::min(minimum.X, b.Center.X - b.Radius), std::min(minimum.Y, b.Center.Y - b.Radius),
                       std::min(minimum.Z, b.Center.Z - b.Radius)};
            maximum = {std::max(maximum.X, b.Center.X + b.Radius), std::max(maximum.Y, b.Center.Y + b.Radius),
                       std::max(maximum.Z, b.Center.Z + b.Radius)};
        }
        cluster.Bounds.Center = Scale(Add(minimum, maximum), 0.5f);
        for (uint32_t j = 0; j < cluster.MeshletCount; ++j)
        {
            const auto &b = asset.Bounds[first + j];
            cluster.Bounds.Radius =
                std::max(cluster.Bounds.Radius, Length(Sub(b.Center, cluster.Bounds.Center)) + b.Radius);
        }
        cluster.Bounds.Radius = std::nextafter(cluster.Bounds.Radius, std::numeric_limits<float>::infinity());
        asset.Clusters.push_back(cluster);
    }
    std::string error;
    if (!Validate(asset, positions, error))
        throw std::runtime_error(error);
    return asset;
}
bool Validate(const Asset &asset, std::span<const Position> positions, std::string &error)
{
    auto fail = [&](const char *message) {
        error = message;
        return false;
    };
    if (!ConfigValid(asset.Config) || asset.Meshlets.size() != asset.Bounds.size())
        return fail("Invalid meshlet config/bounds count");
    for (auto p : positions)
        if (!Finite(p))
            return fail("Non-finite geometry");
    uint64_t vertices = 0, primitives = 0;
    for (size_t id = 0; id < asset.Meshlets.size(); ++id)
    {
        const auto &m = asset.Meshlets[id];
        const auto &b = asset.Bounds[id];
        if (m.VertexOffset != vertices || m.PrimitiveOffset != primitives || !m.VertexCount ||
            !m.PrimitiveCount || m.VertexCount > asset.Config.MaxVertices ||
            m.PrimitiveCount > asset.Config.MaxPrimitives ||
            uint64_t(m.VertexOffset) + m.VertexCount > asset.Vertices.size() ||
            uint64_t(m.PrimitiveOffset) + m.PrimitiveCount > asset.Primitives.size())
            return fail("Invalid meshlet range");
        if (!Finite(b.Center) || !std::isfinite(b.Radius) || b.Radius < 0 || !Finite(b.ConeAxis) ||
            !std::isfinite(b.ConeCutoff) || b.ConeCutoff < 0 || b.ConeCutoff > 1)
            return fail("Invalid bounds/cone");
        for (uint32_t i = 0; i < m.VertexCount; ++i)
        {
            auto index = asset.Vertices[m.VertexOffset + i];
            if (index >= positions.size() || Length(Sub(positions[index], b.Center)) > b.Radius + 1e-5f)
                return fail("Invalid vertex/bounds containment");
        }
        for (uint32_t i = 0; i < m.PrimitiveCount; ++i)
        {
            uint32_t packed = asset.Primitives[m.PrimitiveOffset + i];
            if (packed >> 24)
                return fail("Invalid packed primitive");
            for (uint32_t j = 0; j < 3; ++j)
                if (((packed >> (j * 8)) & 255) >= m.VertexCount)
                    return fail("Invalid primitive index");
        }
        auto computed = ComputeBounds(asset, m, positions);
        if (b.ConeCutoff < 1 &&
            (std::abs(Length(b.ConeAxis) - 1) > 1e-4f || Dot(b.ConeAxis, computed.ConeAxis) < 0.99999f ||
             b.ConeCutoff + 1e-6f < computed.ConeCutoff))
            return fail("Unsafe normal cone");
        vertices += m.VertexCount;
        primitives += m.PrimitiveCount;
    }
    if (vertices != asset.Vertices.size() || primitives != asset.Primitives.size())
        return fail("Unreferenced meshlet data");
    uint64_t children = 0;
    for (const auto &c : asset.Clusters)
    {
        if (c.MeshletOffset != children || !c.MeshletCount ||
            c.MeshletCount > asset.Config.MeshletsPerCluster ||
            uint64_t(c.MeshletOffset) + c.MeshletCount > asset.Meshlets.size() || !Finite(c.Bounds.Center) ||
            !std::isfinite(c.Bounds.Radius) || c.Bounds.Radius < 0 || c.Bounds.ConeCutoff != 1)
            return fail("Invalid cluster");
        for (uint32_t j = 0; j < c.MeshletCount; ++j)
        {
            const auto &b = asset.Bounds[c.MeshletOffset + j];
            if (Length(Sub(b.Center, c.Bounds.Center)) + b.Radius > c.Bounds.Radius + 1e-5f)
                return fail("Cluster does not contain child");
        }
        children += c.MeshletCount;
    }
    if (children != asset.Meshlets.size())
        return fail("Incomplete cluster hierarchy");
    error.clear();
    return true;
}
uint64_t GeometryKey(std::span<const Position> positions, std::span<const uint32_t> indices,
                     BuildConfig config)
{
    uint64_t hash = 14695981039346656037ull;
    auto consume = [&](const void *data, size_t bytes) {
        auto p = static_cast<const uint8_t *>(data);
        for (size_t i = 0; i < bytes; ++i)
        {
            hash ^= p[i];
            hash *= 1099511628211ull;
        }
    };
    consume(&config, sizeof(config));
    consume(positions.data(), positions.size_bytes());
    consume(indices.data(), indices.size_bytes());
    return hash;
}
bool Save(const std::filesystem::path &path, const Asset &asset, uint64_t key)
{
    try
    {
        if (!path.parent_path().empty())
            std::filesystem::create_directories(path.parent_path());
        Header header;
        header.Key = key;
        header.PayloadHash = PayloadHash(asset);
        header.Config = asset.Config;
        header.Counts[0] = static_cast<uint32_t>(asset.Meshlets.size());
        header.Counts[1] = static_cast<uint32_t>(asset.Vertices.size());
        header.Counts[2] = static_cast<uint32_t>(asset.Primitives.size());
        header.Counts[3] = static_cast<uint32_t>(asset.Bounds.size());
        header.Counts[4] = static_cast<uint32_t>(asset.Clusters.size());
        std::ofstream stream(path, std::ios::binary | std::ios::trunc);
        stream.write(reinterpret_cast<const char *>(&header), sizeof(header));
        return Write(stream, asset.Meshlets) && Write(stream, asset.Vertices) &&
               Write(stream, asset.Primitives) && Write(stream, asset.Bounds) &&
               Write(stream, asset.Clusters);
    }
    catch (...)
    {
        return false;
    }
}
bool Load(const std::filesystem::path &path, Asset &asset, uint64_t key, std::span<const Position> positions)
{
    try
    {
        std::ifstream stream(path, std::ios::binary | std::ios::ate);
        if (!stream)
            return false;
        const auto bytes = stream.tellg();
        stream.seekg(0);
        Header header;
        stream.read(reinterpret_cast<char *>(&header), sizeof(header));
        if (!stream || header.Magic != 0x354c534d || header.Version != 2 || header.Key != key ||
            !ConfigValid(header.Config))
            return false;
        const uint64_t expected = sizeof(header) + uint64_t(header.Counts[0]) * sizeof(Meshlet) +
                                  uint64_t(header.Counts[1]) * 4 + uint64_t(header.Counts[2]) * 4 +
                                  uint64_t(header.Counts[3]) * sizeof(Bounds) +
                                  uint64_t(header.Counts[4]) * sizeof(Cluster);
        if (expected != static_cast<uint64_t>(bytes) || expected > uint64_t(2) * 1024 * 1024 * 1024)
            return false;
        Asset loaded;
        loaded.Config = header.Config;
        if (!Read(stream, loaded.Meshlets, header.Counts[0]) ||
            !Read(stream, loaded.Vertices, header.Counts[1]) ||
            !Read(stream, loaded.Primitives, header.Counts[2]) ||
            !Read(stream, loaded.Bounds, header.Counts[3]) ||
            !Read(stream, loaded.Clusters, header.Counts[4]))
            return false;
        std::string error;
        if (PayloadHash(loaded) != header.PayloadHash || !Validate(loaded, positions, error))
            return false;
        asset = std::move(loaded);
        return true;
    }
    catch (...)
    {
        return false;
    }
}
std::array<uint32_t, 3> DispatchDimensions(uint32_t count)
{
    const uint32_t x = std::min(count, 65535u);
    return {x, count ? static_cast<uint32_t>((uint64_t(count) + x - 1) / x) : 1u, 1u};
}
} // namespace Meshlets

struct State
{
    struct Entry { Meshlets::Asset Asset; uint32_t BaseVertex = 0; };
    unordered_map<uint32_t, Entry> Entries;
    Meshlets::Asset Data;
    vector<Meshlets::Range> Ranges;
    unordered_map<uint32_t, Meshlets::Range> DisabledRanges;
    GpuSceneBuffer Meshlets, Vertices, Primitives, Bounds, Clusters, Range;
    bool Dirty = false;
    bool Rebuild = false;

void BuildImportedMesh(StaticMeshData &mesh)
{
    mesh.VirtualGeometryLODs = {};
    mesh.MeshletLODs = {};
    mesh.VirtualGeometryBuilds = {};
    mesh.VirtualGeometryBuildError.clear();
    if (!mesh.VirtualGeometrySettings.Enabled)
    {
        return;
    }
    std::string eligibilityReason;
    if (!CanUseVirtualGeometry(mesh, eligibilityReason))
    {
        mesh.VirtualGeometryBuildError = eligibilityReason;
        WriteGraphicsLog("VirtualGeometry import fallback (%s): %s\n",
            mesh.MeshName.c_str(), eligibilityReason.c_str());
        return;
    }
    try
    {
        vector<VirtualGeometryVertex> vertices;
        vertices.reserve(mesh.CpuVertices.size());
        for (const auto &v : mesh.CpuVertices)
            vertices.push_back({{v.Position.x,v.Position.y,v.Position.z},
                {v.Normal.x,v.Normal.y,v.Normal.z}, {v.TexCoord.x,v.TexCoord.y},
                {v.Diffuse.x,v.Diffuse.y,v.Diffuse.z,v.Diffuse.w}});
        for (uint32_t lod = 0; lod < StaticMeshData::LodCount; ++lod)
        {
            const auto &indices = lod ? mesh.CpuLodIndices[lod - 1] : mesh.CpuIndices;
            if (indices.empty())
                continue;
            if (mesh.VirtualGeometrySettings.BackgroundBuild)
            {
                if (lod != 0)
                {
                    continue; // Native hierarchy replaces discrete LODs; legacy indices remain available.
                }
                mesh.VirtualGeometryBuilds[lod] = VirtualGeometryRuntime::AcquireAsync(
                    std::move(vertices), indices, 0, mesh.AppliedMaterialPartId, mesh.VirtualGeometrySettings);
                continue;
            }
            auto asset = VirtualGeometryRuntime::Acquire(vertices, indices, 0, mesh.AppliedMaterialPartId,
                "asset/virtualgeometry-cache", mesh.VirtualGeometrySettings);
            mesh.VirtualGeometryLODs[lod] = asset;
            if (asset->Error.empty()) mesh.MeshletLODs[lod] = asset->Meshlets;
            else
            {
                mesh.VirtualGeometryBuildError = asset->Error;
                WriteGraphicsLog("Nanite import fallback (%s LOD%u): %s\n", mesh.MeshName.c_str(),lod,asset->Error.c_str());
            }
        }
    }
    catch (const exception &error)
    {
        mesh.VirtualGeometryLODs = {};
        mesh.MeshletLODs = {};
        mesh.VirtualGeometryBuildError = error.what();
        WriteGraphicsLog("Meshlet import fallback: %s\n", error.what());
    }
}
bool PollImportedMesh(StaticMeshData& mesh)
{
    bool changed = false;
    for (uint32_t lod = 0; lod < StaticMeshData::LodCount; ++lod)
    {
        auto& pending = mesh.VirtualGeometryBuilds[lod];
        if (!pending.valid() || pending.wait_for(std::chrono::seconds(0)) != std::future_status::ready)
        {
            continue;
        }
        try
        {
            const auto asset = pending.get();
            if (asset && asset->Error.empty())
            {
                mesh.VirtualGeometryLODs[lod] = asset;
                mesh.MeshletLODs[lod] = asset->Meshlets;
            }
            else
            {
                mesh.VirtualGeometryBuildError = asset ? asset->Error : "No VirtualGeometry build result";
            }
        }
        catch (const std::exception& error)
        {
            mesh.VirtualGeometryBuildError = error.what();
        }
        pending = {};
        changed = true;
    }
    if (changed)
    {
        GPUDrivenRenderer::UpdateGeometry(mesh);
    }
    return changed;
}
void Register(uint32_t meshID, const Meshlets::Asset &asset, uint32_t baseVertex)
{
    auto &state = Data();
    if (state.Ranges.size() <= meshID)
    {
        state.Ranges.resize(size_t(meshID) + 1);
        state.Dirty = true; // Upload new zero ranges even when a legacy asset has no meshlets.
    }
    if (state.DisabledRanges.contains(meshID) || state.Ranges[meshID].MeshletCount || asset.Meshlets.empty())
        return;
    state.Entries[meshID] = {asset, baseVertex};
    auto &data = state.Data;
    const uint64_t limits[] = {
        data.Meshlets.size() + asset.Meshlets.size(), data.Vertices.size() + asset.Vertices.size(),
        data.Primitives.size() + asset.Primitives.size(), data.Clusters.size() + asset.Clusters.size()};
    for (auto limit : limits)
        if (limit > UINT32_MAX)
            throw overflow_error("Global meshlet range overflow");
    Meshlets::Range range{
        static_cast<uint32_t>(data.Meshlets.size()), static_cast<uint32_t>(asset.Meshlets.size()),
        static_cast<uint32_t>(data.Clusters.size()), static_cast<uint32_t>(asset.Clusters.size())};
    uint32_t vertexOffset = static_cast<uint32_t>(data.Vertices.size()),
             primitiveOffset = static_cast<uint32_t>(data.Primitives.size());
    for (auto meshlet : asset.Meshlets)
    {
        meshlet.VertexOffset += vertexOffset;
        meshlet.PrimitiveOffset += primitiveOffset;
        data.Meshlets.push_back(meshlet);
    }
    for (auto vertex : asset.Vertices)
    {
        if (uint64_t(baseVertex) + vertex > UINT32_MAX)
            throw overflow_error("Meshlet global vertex overflow");
        data.Vertices.push_back(baseVertex + vertex);
    }
    data.Primitives.insert(data.Primitives.end(), asset.Primitives.begin(), asset.Primitives.end());
    data.Bounds.insert(data.Bounds.end(), asset.Bounds.begin(), asset.Bounds.end());
    for (auto cluster : asset.Clusters)
    {
        cluster.MeshletOffset += range.MeshletOffset;
        data.Clusters.push_back(cluster);
    }
    state.Ranges[meshID] = range;
    state.Dirty = true;
}
void Replace(uint32_t meshID, const Meshlets::Asset &asset, uint32_t baseVertex)
{
    auto &state = Data();
    state.DisabledRanges.erase(meshID);
    state.Entries[meshID] = {asset, baseVertex};
    state.Rebuild = true;
    state.Dirty = true;
}
void Invalidate(uint32_t meshID)
{
    if (meshID < Data().Ranges.size())
    {
        if (Data().Ranges[meshID].MeshletCount)
            Data().DisabledRanges[meshID] = Data().Ranges[meshID];
        Data().Ranges[meshID] = {};
        Data().Dirty = true;
    }
}
void RestoreForValidation(uint32_t meshID)
{
    auto &state = Data();
    const auto found = state.DisabledRanges.find(meshID);
    if (found != state.DisabledRanges.end())
    {
        state.DisabledRanges.erase(found);
        state.Rebuild = true;
        state.Dirty = true;
    }
}
void Prepare(RenderGraph &graph, uint32_t meshes)
{
    auto &state = Data();
    if (state.Dirty || state.PreviousActive != GpuScene::Statistics().ActiveInstances)
    {
        state.PreviousActive = GpuScene::Statistics().ActiveInstances;
        unordered_set<uint32_t> used, groups;
        for (uint32_t slot = 0; slot < GpuScene::Statistics().InstanceSlots; ++slot)
        {
            const auto *instance = GpuScene::GetInstance(slot);
            if (!instance || !(instance->Flags & 1u))
                continue;
            used.insert(instance->MeshIndex);
            groups.insert(instance->LODGroupIndex);
        }
        for (auto group : groups)
            for (auto id : GPUVisibility::LODMeshes(group))
                used.insert(id);
        for (auto it = state.Entries.begin(); it != state.Entries.end();)
        {
            if (!used.contains(it->first))
            {
                state.DisabledRanges.erase(it->first);
                it = state.Entries.erase(it);
                state.Rebuild = true;
            }
            else
                ++it;
        }
    }
    if (state.Rebuild)
    {
        // Compact once per frame after all edits. Keep GPU buffers alive; their upload
        // resources and resized allocations retain the existing frame/fence lifetime.
        auto entries = move(state.Entries);
        state.Data = {};
        state.Ranges.assign(max(size_t(meshes), state.Ranges.size()), {});
        vector<uint32_t> ids;
        for (const auto &[id, entry] : entries)
            ids.push_back(id);
        sort(ids.begin(), ids.end());
        for (auto id : ids)
        {
            const auto &entry = entries.at(id);
            if (!state.DisabledRanges.contains(id))
                Register(id, entry.Asset, entry.BaseVertex);
        }
        // Disabled assets retain source data for validation restore.
        for (auto id : ids)
            if (state.DisabledRanges.contains(id))
                state.Entries[id] = move(entries.at(id));
        state.Rebuild = false;
        state.Dirty = true;
    }
    if (state.Ranges.size() < meshes)
    {
        state.Ranges.resize(meshes);
        state.Dirty = true;
    }
    const uint32_t frame = GraphicsDevice::GetFrameIndex();
    auto upload = [&](GpuSceneBuffer &buffer, const auto &values, const char *name) {
        using Element = typename decay_t<decltype(values)>::value_type;
        buffer.BeginFrame(frame);
        bool resized = buffer.Ensure(GraphicsDevice::GetDevice(), static_cast<uint32_t>(values.size()),
                                     sizeof(Element), frame, L"Global Meshlet Asset");
        vector<uint32_t> changes;
        if (state.Dirty || resized)
        {
            changes.resize(values.size());
            iota(changes.begin(), changes.end(), 0u);
        }
        uint64_t bytes = buffer.Stage(GraphicsDevice::GetDevice(), frame, values.data(),
                                      static_cast<uint32_t>(values.size()), changes);
        RenderGraph::ImportedResource input{};
        input.Name = name;
        input.Resource = buffer.Resource();
        input.InitialState = buffer.State;
        input.HasFinalState = true;
        input.FinalState = D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_NON_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE;
        buffer.State = input.FinalState;
        auto handle = graph.ImportResource(input);
        if (bytes)
        {
            auto *target = &buffer;
            graph.AddPass(
                name, [=](RenderGraph::PassBuilder &b) { b.Write(handle, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_COPY_DEST); },
                [=](ID3D12GraphicsCommandList *list) { target->Copy(list, frame); });
        }
    };
    upload(state.Meshlets, state.Data.Meshlets, "Global Meshlet Upload");
    upload(state.Vertices, state.Data.Vertices, "Meshlet Remap Upload");
    upload(state.Primitives, state.Data.Primitives, "Meshlet Primitive Upload");
    upload(state.Bounds, state.Data.Bounds, "Meshlet Bounds Upload");
    upload(state.Clusters, state.Data.Clusters, "Cluster Upload");
    upload(state.Range, state.Ranges, "Meshlet Range Upload");
    state.Dirty = false;
}
const vector<Meshlets::Range> &Ranges()
{
    return Data().Ranges;
}
const Meshlets::Asset &AssetData()
{
    return Data().Data;
}
GpuSceneBuffer &MeshletBuffer()
{
    return Data().Meshlets;
}
GpuSceneBuffer &VertexBuffer()
{
    return Data().Vertices;
}
GpuSceneBuffer &PrimitiveBuffer()
{
    return Data().Primitives;
}
GpuSceneBuffer &BoundsBuffer()

    return Data().Bounds;
}
GpuSceneBuffer &ClusterBuffer()

    return Data().Clusters;

GpuSceneBuffer &RangeBuffer()

    return Data().Range;
}
uint64_t MemoryBytes()
{
    auto &s = Data();
    return s.Meshlets.MemoryBytes() + s.Vertices.MemoryBytes() + s.Primitives.MemoryBytes() +
           s.Bounds.MemoryBytes() + s.Clusters.MemoryBytes() + s.Range.MemoryBytes();
}
void Shutdown()
{
    Data() = {};
}

void Check(bool success, const char *name)
{
    WriteGraphicsLog("Meshlet validation: %s %s\n", success ? "PASS" : "FAIL", name);
    if (!success)
        ++failures;
}
void Grid(const string &path, uint32_t size, uint32_t parts = 1)
{
    ofstream file(path);
    if (parts > 1)
    {
        auto mtl = filesystem::path(path).replace_extension(".mtl");
        ofstream material(mtl);
        file << "mtllib " << mtl.filename().string() << '\n';
        for (uint32_t part = 0; part < parts; ++part)
            material << "newmtl Section" << part << "\nKd " << 0.2f + 0.1f * part << " 1 1\n";
    }
    file << "vn 0 0 -1\n";
    for (uint32_t y = 0; y <= size; ++y)
        for (uint32_t x = 0; x <= size; ++x)
            file << "v " << float(x) * 4 / size - 2 << ' ' << float(y) * 4 / size - 2 << " 0\n";
    for (uint32_t part = 0; part < parts; ++part)
    {
        file << "g Section" << part << "\nusemtl Section" << part << '\n';
        for (uint32_t y = 0; y < size; ++y)
            for (uint32_t x = 0; x < size; ++x)
            {
                if (y * parts / size != part)
                    continue;
                uint32_t a = y * (size + 1) + x + 1, b = a + 1, c = a + size + 1, d = c + 1;
                file << "f " << a << "//1 " << c << "//1 " << b << "//1\nf " << b << "//1 " << c << "//1 "
                     << d << "//1\n";
            }
    }
}
void Clear()
{
    for (auto id : fixtures)
        World::DestroyEntity(Entity(id));
    fixtures.clear();
}
void WritePrimitives()
{
    ofstream box("build/meshlets/cube.obj");
    box << "v -1 -1 -1\nv 1 -1 -1\nv 1 1 -1\nv -1 1 -1\nv -1 -1 1\nv 1 -1 1\nv 1 1 1\nv -1 1 1\n";
    box << "f 1 3 2\nf 1 4 3\nf 5 6 7\nf 5 7 8\nf 1 5 8\nf 1 8 4\nf 2 3 7\nf 2 7 6\nf 1 2 6\nf 1 6 5\nf 4 8 "
           "7\nf 4 7 3\n";
    ofstream ball("build/meshlets/sphere.obj");
    constexpr uint32_t latitude = 24, longitude = 48;
    for (uint32_t y = 0; y <= latitude; ++y)
        for (uint32_t x = 0; x <= longitude; ++x)
        {
            float phi = XM_PI * float(y) / latitude, theta = XM_2PI * float(x) / longitude;
            ball << "v " << sinf(phi) * cosf(theta) << ' ' << cosf(phi) << ' ' << sinf(phi) * sinf(theta)
                 << '\n';
        }
    for (uint32_t y = 0; y < latitude; ++y)
        for (uint32_t x = 0; x < longitude; ++x)
        {
            uint32_t a = y * (longitude + 1) + x + 1, b = a + 1, c = a + longitude + 1, d = c + 1;
            ball << "f " << a << ' ' << b << ' ' << c << "\nf " << b << ' ' << d << ' ' << c << '\n';
        }
}
void Grow(size_t count, int mesh)
{
    while (fixtures.size() < count)
    {
        Entity e = World::CreateEntity();
        if (!e.IsValid())
        {
            Check(false, "ECS capacity");
            break;
        }
        e.Add<TransformComponent>()
            .Add<StaticModelComponent>()
            .Add<MaterialComponent>()
            .Add<ShaderComponent>()
            .Add<NameComponent>();
        e.Get<NameComponent>().Name = "Meshlet fixture";
        e.Get<StaticModelComponent>().ModelId = mesh;
        auto &mat = e.Get<MaterialComponent>();
        mat.ShaderClassMode = MaterialMode::Manual;
        mat.ShaderClass = ShaderClass::PBR;
        mat.Roughness = 0.6f;
        mat.Metallic = 0.2f;
        auto &t = e.Get<TransformComponent>();
        if (count > 1)
        {
            size_t i = fixtures.size();
            t.Position = {float(i % 100) * 0.09f - 4.5f, float((i / 100) % 100) * 0.09f - 4.5f, 0};
            t.Scale = {0.018f, 0.018f, 0.018f};
        }
        t.IsDirty = true;
        fixtures.push_back(e.GetID());
    }
}
void Capture(bool compare, bool compareVelocity = true)
{
    vector<RenderCapture::TextureData> output(6);
    bool read = true;
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < 6; ++i)
        read &= RenderCapture::ReadTexture(
            RenderTargets::GetGBufferResource(i == 5 ? GBufferType::VELOCITY : static_cast<GBufferType>(i)),
            output[i]);
    Check(read, "read GBuffer");
    if (!read)
        return;
    if (!compare)
    {
        reference = move(output);
        return;
    }
    uint64_t changed = 0, total = 0, paddingChanged = 0;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < output.size(); ++i)
    {
        if (i >= reference.size() || output[i].Width != reference[i].Width ||
            output[i].Height != reference[i].Height || output[i].Format != reference[i].Format ||
            output[i].RowPitch != reference[i].RowPitch ||
            output[i].Bytes.size() != reference[i].Bytes.size())
        {
            Check(false, "matching GBuffer dimensions and format");
            return;
        }
        if (i == 5)
        {
            if (!compareVelocity)
                continue;
            float maximumMotionError = 0;
            for (uint32_t y = 0; y < output[i].Height; ++y)
                for (uint32_t x = 0; x < output[i].Width; ++x)
                {
                    auto *current =
                        reinterpret_cast<const uint16_t *>(output[i].Bytes.data() + y * output[i].RowPitch) +
                        x * 4;
                    auto *previous = reinterpret_cast<const uint16_t *>(reference[i].Bytes.data() +
                                                                        y * reference[i].RowPitch) +
                                     x * 4;
                    for (uint32_t lane = 2; lane < 4; ++lane)
                        maximumMotionError = (max)(maximumMotionError,
                                                        abs(RenderCapture::HalfToFloat(current[lane]) -
                                                                 RenderCapture::HalfToFloat(previous[lane])));
                }
            WriteGraphicsLog("Meshlet velocity comparison maximum UV error=%.8f\n", maximumMotionError);
            Check(maximumMotionError < 0.00001f, "Traditional/Mesh Shader velocity UV agreement");
            continue; // Encoded display channels magnify tiny near-zero floating-point errors.
        }
        if (i >= reference.size() || reference[i].Bytes.size() != output[i].Bytes.size())
        {
            Check(false, "matching GBuffer dimensions");
            return;
        }
        const auto description = RenderTargets::GetGBufferResource(static_cast<GBufferType>(i))->GetDesc();
        UINT64 rowBytes = 0;
        GraphicsDevice::GetDevice()->GetCopyableFootprints(&description, 0, 1, 0, nullptr, nullptr,
                                                          &rowBytes, nullptr);
        uint64_t targetChanged = 0;
        for (uint32_t y = 0; y < output[i].Height; ++y)
        {
            const size_t row = size_t(y) * output[i].RowPitch;
            // CopyTextureRegion does not define row padding. Compare only actual texel bytes.
            for (size_t b = 0; b < rowBytes; ++b)
            {
                targetChanged += abs(int(output[i].Bytes[row + b]) -
                                          int(reference[i].Bytes[row + b])) > 1;
                ++total;
            }
            const size_t end = (min)(row + output[i].RowPitch, output[i].Bytes.size());
            for (size_t b = row + size_t(rowBytes); b < end; ++b)
                paddingChanged += abs(int(output[i].Bytes[b]) - int(reference[i].Bytes[b])) > 1;
        }
        changed += targetChanged;
        WriteGraphicsLog("Meshlet image target=%zu changed texel bytes=%llu\n", i, targetChanged);
    }
    WriteGraphicsLog("Meshlet image comparison changed=%llu total=%llu ignoredPaddingChanges=%llu\n",
                     changed, total, paddingChanged);
    Check(changed <= total / 10000, "Traditional/Mesh Shader GBuffer agreement");
}
array<uint32_t, 16> Stats()
{
    array<uint32_t, 16> stats{};
    vector<uint8_t> bytes;
    Check(MeshShaderRenderer::IsActive(), "GPU Mesh Shader path active");
    if (MeshShaderRenderer::IsActive() &&
        RenderCapture::ReadBuffer(MeshShaderRenderer::StatisticsBuffer(),
                                  D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_NON_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE, 64, bytes))
        memcpy(stats.data(), bytes.data(), 64);
    else
        Check(false, "read Meshlet counters");
    return stats;
}
