constexpr UINT kFrames = 3;
constexpr UINT kMaxDispatches = 128;
constexpr nrd::Identifier kIdentifier = 0;

DXGI_FORMAT ToDxgi(nrd::Format format)
{
    constexpr DXGI_FORMAT formats[] = {
        DXGI_FORMAT_R8_UNORM, DXGI_FORMAT_R8_SNORM, DXGI_FORMAT_R8_UINT, DXGI_FORMAT_R8_SINT,
        DXGI_FORMAT_R8G8_UNORM, DXGI_FORMAT_R8G8_SNORM, DXGI_FORMAT_R8G8_UINT, DXGI_FORMAT_R8G8_SINT,
        DXGI_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM, DXGI_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_SNORM, DXGI_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UINT,
        DXGI_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_SINT, DXGI_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM_SRGB,
        DXGI_FORMAT_R16_UNORM, DXGI_FORMAT_R16_SNORM, DXGI_FORMAT_R16_UINT, DXGI_FORMAT_R16_SINT, DXGI_FORMAT_R16_FLOAT,
        DXGI_FORMAT_R16G16_UNORM, DXGI_FORMAT_R16G16_SNORM, DXGI_FORMAT_R16G16_UINT, DXGI_FORMAT_R16G16_SINT, DXGI_FORMAT_R16G16_FLOAT,
        DXGI_FORMAT_R16G16B16A16_UNORM, DXGI_FORMAT_R16G16B16A16_SNORM, DXGI_FORMAT_R16G16B16A16_UINT,
        DXGI_FORMAT_R16G16B16A16_SINT, DXGI_FORMAT_R16G16B16A16_FLOAT,
        DXGI_FORMAT_R32_UINT, DXGI_FORMAT_R32_SINT, DXGI_FORMAT_R32_FLOAT,
        DXGI_FORMAT_R32G32_UINT, DXGI_FORMAT_R32G32_SINT, DXGI_FORMAT_R32G32_FLOAT,
        DXGI_FORMAT_R32G32B32_UINT, DXGI_FORMAT_R32G32B32_SINT, DXGI_FORMAT_R32G32B32_FLOAT,
        DXGI_FORMAT_R32G32B32A32_UINT, DXGI_FORMAT_R32G32B32A32_SINT, DXGI_FORMAT_R32G32B32A32_FLOAT,
        DXGI_FORMAT_R10G10B10A2_UNORM, DXGI_FORMAT_R10G10B10A2_UINT,
        DXGI_FORMAT_R11G11B10_FLOAT, DXGI_FORMAT_R9G9B9E5_SHAREDEXP
    };
    static_assert(size(formats) == static_cast<size_t>(nrd::Format::MAX_NUM));
    const auto index = static_cast<size_t>(format);
    return index < size(formats) ? formats[index] : DXGI_FORMAT_UNKNOWN;
}

struct Texture
{
    ComPtr<ID3D12Resource> Resource;
    D3D12_RESOURCE_STATES State = D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_COMMON;
};

void Transition(ID3D12GraphicsCommandList* commands, ID3D12Resource* resource,
    D3D12_RESOURCE_STATES& state, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATES target)
{
    if (state != target)
    {
        const auto barrier = CD3DX12_RESOURCE_BARRIER::Transition(resource, state, target);
        commands->ResourceBarrier(1, &barrier);
        state = target;
    }
    else if (target == D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS)
    {
        const auto barrier = CD3DX12_RESOURCE_BARRIER::UAV(resource);
        commands->ResourceBarrier(1, &barrier);
    }
}
}

struct NrdDenoiser::Impl
{
    nrd::Instance* Instance = nullptr;
    ComPtr<ID3D12Device> Device;
    ComPtr<ID3D12RootSignature> Root;
    ComPtr<ID3D12DescriptorHeap> Heap;
    ComPtr<ID3D12Resource> Constants;
    vector<ComPtr<ID3D12PipelineState>> Pipelines;
    vector<Texture> Permanent, Transient;
    Texture Output;
    NrdSignal Signal = NrdSignal::Shadow;
    UINT Width = 0, Height = 0;
    UINT Increment = 0, DescriptorsPerFrame = 0, ConstantStride = 0;
    UINT SrvCount = 0, UavCount = 0, Dispatches = 0;
    bool FirstFrame = true;
    UINT LastSequence = 0;
    bool RestartedHistory = false;

    ~Impl() { if (Instance) nrd::DestroyInstance(*Instance); }

    bool CreateTexture(Texture& texture, DXGI_FORMAT format, UINT factor, const wchar_t* name)
    {
        const auto heap = CD3DX12_HEAP_PROPERTIES(D3D12_HEAP_TYPE_DEFAULT);
        const auto description = CD3DX12_RESOURCE_DESC::Tex2D(format,
            (Width + factor - 1) / factor, (Height + factor - 1) / factor,
            1, 1, 1, 0, D3D12_RESOURCE_FLAG_ALLOW_UNORDERED_ACCESS);
        if (FAILED(Device->CreateCommittedResource(&heap, D3D12_HEAP_FLAG_NONE, &description,
            texture.State, nullptr, IID_PPV_ARGS(&texture.Resource)))) return false;
        texture.Resource->SetName(name);
        return true;
    }

    bool Create(NrdSignal signal, UINT width, UINT height)
    {
        Signal = signal;
        Width = width;
        Height = height;
        const nrd::DenoiserDesc denoiser{ kIdentifier,
            signal == NrdSignal::Shadow ? nrd::Denoiser::SIGMA_SHADOW : signal == NrdSignal::Specular ?
                nrd::Denoiser::REBLUR_SPECULAR : signal == NrdSignal::Diffuse ?
                nrd::Denoiser::REBLUR_DIFFUSE : nrd::Denoiser::REBLUR_DIFFUSE_OCCLUSION };
        const nrd::InstanceCreationDesc creation{ {}, &denoiser, 1 };
        if (nrd::CreateInstance(creation, Instance) != nrd::Result::SUCCESS) return false;
        const auto& description = *nrd::GetInstanceDesc(*Instance);
        SrvCount = (max)(1u, description.descriptorPoolDesc.perSetTexturesMaxNum);
        UavCount = (max)(1u, description.descriptorPoolDesc.perSetStorageTexturesMaxNum);
        ConstantStride = (description.constantBufferMaxDataSize + 255u) & ~255u;
        DescriptorsPerFrame = (SrvCount + UavCount) * kMaxDispatches;
        Increment = Device->GetDescriptorHandleIncrementSize(D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_HEAP_TYPE_CBV_SRV_UAV);

        CD3DX12_DESCRIPTOR_RANGE ranges[2];
        ranges[0].Init(D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_RANGE_TYPE_SRV, SrvCount,
            description.resourcesBaseRegisterIndex, description.resourcesSpaceIndex);
        ranges[1].Init(D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_RANGE_TYPE_UAV, UavCount,
            description.resourcesBaseRegisterIndex, description.resourcesSpaceIndex);
        CD3DX12_ROOT_PARAMETER parameters[3];
        parameters[0].InitAsConstantBufferView(description.constantBufferRegisterIndex,
            description.constantBufferAndSamplersSpaceIndex);
        parameters[1].InitAsDescriptorTable(1, &ranges[0]);
        parameters[2].InitAsDescriptorTable(1, &ranges[1]);
        vector<CD3DX12_STATIC_SAMPLER_DESC> samplers;
        for (UINT index = 0; index < description.samplersNum; ++index)
        {
            samplers.emplace_back(description.samplersBaseRegisterIndex + index,
                description.samplers[index] == nrd::Sampler::NEAREST_CLAMP ?
                    D3D12_FILTER_MIN_MAG_MIP_POINT : D3D12_FILTER_MIN_MAG_MIP_LINEAR,
                D3D12_TEXTURE_ADDRESS_MODE_CLAMP, D3D12_TEXTURE_ADDRESS_MODE_CLAMP,
                D3D12_TEXTURE_ADDRESS_MODE_CLAMP, 0, 1, D3D12_COMPARISON_FUNC_ALWAYS,
                D3D12_STATIC_BORDER_COLOR_TRANSPARENT_BLACK, 0, D3D12_FLOAT32_MAX,
                D3D12_SHADER_VISIBILITY_ALL, description.constantBufferAndSamplersSpaceIndex);
        }
        const CD3DX12_ROOT_SIGNATURE_DESC rootDescription(3, parameters,
            static_cast<UINT>(samplers.size()), samplers.data());
        ComPtr<ID3DBlob> serialized, errors;
        if (FAILED(D3D12SerializeRootSignature(&rootDescription, D3D_ROOT_SIGNATURE_VERSION_1, &serialized, &errors)) ||
            FAILED(Device->CreateRootSignature(0, serialized->GetBufferPointer(), serialized->GetBufferSize(),
                IID_PPV_ARGS(&Root)))) return false;
        Pipelines.resize(description.pipelinesNum);
        for (UINT index = 0; index < description.pipelinesNum; ++index)
        {
            const auto shader = description.pipelines[index].computeShaderDXIL;
            if (!shader.bytecode || !shader.size) return false;
            D3D12_COMPUTE_PIPELINE_STATE_DESC pipeline{};
            pipeline.pRootSignature = Root.Get();
            pipeline.CS = { shader.bytecode, static_cast<SIZE_T>(shader.size) };
            if (FAILED(Device->CreateComputePipelineState(&pipeline, IID_PPV_ARGS(&Pipelines[index])))) return false;
        }
        D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_HEAP_DESC descriptorHeap{};
        descriptorHeap.Type = D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_HEAP_TYPE_CBV_SRV_UAV;
        descriptorHeap.Flags = D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_HEAP_FLAG_SHADER_VISIBLE;
        descriptorHeap.NumDescriptors = DescriptorsPerFrame * kFrames;
        if (FAILED(Device->CreateDescriptorHeap(&descriptorHeap, IID_PPV_ARGS(&Heap)))) return false;
        const auto upload = CD3DX12_HEAP_PROPERTIES(D3D12_HEAP_TYPE_UPLOAD);
        const auto buffer = CD3DX12_RESOURCE_DESC::Buffer(UINT64(ConstantStride) * kMaxDispatches * kFrames);
        if (FAILED(Device->CreateCommittedResource(&upload, D3D12_HEAP_FLAG_NONE, &buffer,
            D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_GENERIC_READ, nullptr, IID_PPV_ARGS(&Constants)))) return false;
        Permanent.resize(description.permanentPoolSize);
        Transient.resize(description.transientPoolSize);
        const auto allocatePool = [&](auto& pool, const nrd::TextureDesc* textures, const wchar_t* name)
        {
            for (size_t index = 0; index < pool.size(); ++index)
                if (!CreateTexture(pool[index], ToDxgi(textures[index].format), textures[index].downsampleFactor, name)) return false;
            return true;
        };
        if (!allocatePool(Permanent, description.permanentPool, L"NRD Permanent History") ||
            !allocatePool(Transient, description.transientPool, L"NRD Transient Pool") ||
            !CreateTexture(Output, Signal == NrdSignal::Shadow ? DXGI_FORMAT_R8_UNORM :
                (Signal == NrdSignal::Specular || Signal == NrdSignal::Diffuse) ? DXGI_FORMAT_R16G16B16A16_FLOAT : DXGI_FORMAT_R16_UNORM,
                1, L"NVIDIA NRD Denoised Signal")) return false;
        WriteGraphicsLog("NRD: %s %s initialized, extent=%ux%u pipelines=%u history=%u transient=%u\n",
            NrdDenoiser::GetVersion(), nrd::GetDenoiserString(denoiser.denoiser), Width, Height,
            description.pipelinesNum, description.permanentPoolSize, description.transientPoolSize);
        return true;
    }

    bool Execute(ID3D12GraphicsCommandList* commands, const NrdInputs& inputs, const NrdFrame& frame)
    {
        Dispatches = 0;
        if (!commands || !inputs.Motion.Resource || !inputs.NormalRoughness.Resource ||
            !inputs.ViewZ.Resource || !inputs.NoisySignal.Resource) return false;
        if (abs(frame.Jitter.x) > 0.5f || abs(frame.Jitter.y) > 0.5f ||
            abs(frame.PreviousJitter.x) > 0.5f || abs(frame.PreviousJitter.y) > 0.5f)
        {
            WriteGraphicsLog("NRD: rejected projection jitter sequence=%u size=%ux%u current=(%.7f,%.7f) previous=(%.7f,%.7f)\n",
                frame.Sequence, Width, Height, frame.Jitter.x, frame.Jitter.y, frame.PreviousJitter.x, frame.PreviousJitter.y);
            return false;
        }
        nrd::CommonSettings common;
        memcpy(common.worldToViewMatrix, &frame.View, sizeof(frame.View));
        memcpy(common.viewToClipMatrix, &frame.Projection, sizeof(frame.Projection));
        memcpy(common.worldToViewMatrixPrev, &frame.PreviousView, sizeof(frame.PreviousView));
        memcpy(common.viewToClipMatrixPrev, &frame.PreviousProjection, sizeof(frame.PreviousProjection));
        common.resourceSize[0] = common.resourceSizePrev[0] = common.rectSize[0] = common.rectSizePrev[0] = static_cast<uint16_t>(Width);
        common.resourceSize[1] = common.resourceSizePrev[1] = common.rectSize[1] = common.rectSizePrev[1] = static_cast<uint16_t>(Height);
        common.cameraJitter[0] = frame.Jitter.x;
        common.cameraJitter[1] = frame.Jitter.y;
        common.cameraJitterPrev[0] = frame.PreviousJitter.x;
        common.cameraJitterPrev[1] = frame.PreviousJitter.y;
        common.frameIndex = frame.Sequence;
        common.denoisingRange = frame.Range;
        common.accumulationMode = FirstFrame ? nrd::AccumulationMode::CLEAR_AND_RESTART :
            (frame.ResetHistory || frame.Sequence - LastSequence != 1u) ?
                nrd::AccumulationMode::RESTART : nrd::AccumulationMode::CONTINUE;
        if (nrd::SetCommonSettings(*Instance, common) != nrd::Result::SUCCESS) return false;
        if (Signal == NrdSignal::Shadow)
        {
            nrd::SigmaSettings settings;
            settings.lightDirection[0] = frame.LightDirection.x;
            settings.lightDirection[1] = frame.LightDirection.y;
            settings.lightDirection[2] = frame.LightDirection.z;
            if (nrd::SetDenoiserSettings(*Instance, kIdentifier, &settings) != nrd::Result::SUCCESS) return false;
        }
        if (Signal == NrdSignal::Diffuse)
        {
            nrd::ReblurSettings settings;
            settings.checkerboardMode = nrd::CheckerboardMode::BLACK;
            // Keep a small spatial footprint after convergence, rather than exposing
            // individual checkerboard samples around high contrast emissive objects.
            settings.minBlurRadius = 2.0f;
            settings.maxAccumulatedFrameNum = 16;
            settings.maxFastAccumulatedFrameNum = 4;
            settings.fireflySuppressorMinRelativeScale = 1.5f;
            if (nrd::SetDenoiserSettings(*Instance, kIdentifier, &settings) != nrd::Result::SUCCESS) return false;
        }
        if (Signal == NrdSignal::AmbientOcclusion)
        {
            nrd::ReblurSettings settings;
            settings.hitDistanceParameters.A = frame.AmbientRadius;
            settings.hitDistanceParameters.B = 0.000001f;
            settings.hitDistanceParameters.C = 1.0f;
            if (nrd::SetDenoiserSettings(*Instance, kIdentifier, &settings) != nrd::Result::SUCCESS) return false;
        }
        const nrd::DispatchDesc* dispatches = nullptr;
        uint32_t count = 0;
        if (nrd::GetComputeDispatches(*Instance, &kIdentifier, 1, dispatches, count) != nrd::Result::SUCCESS ||
            count > kMaxDispatches) return false;

        // Validate the entire dispatch sequence before recording commands or changing states.
        map<ID3D12Resource*, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATES> externalStates;
        for (const auto& texture : { inputs.Motion, inputs.NormalRoughness, inputs.ViewZ, inputs.NoisySignal })
            externalStates[texture.Resource] = texture.State;
        const auto resolve = [&](const nrd::ResourceDesc& resource) -> ID3D12Resource*
        {
            switch (resource.type)
            {
            case nrd::ResourceType::PERMANENT_POOL: return resource.indexInPool < Permanent.size() ? Permanent[resource.indexInPool].Resource.Get() : nullptr;
            case nrd::ResourceType::TRANSIENT_POOL: return resource.indexInPool < Transient.size() ? Transient[resource.indexInPool].Resource.Get() : nullptr;
            case nrd::ResourceType::IN_MV: return inputs.Motion.Resource;
            case nrd::ResourceType::IN_NORMAL_ROUGHNESS: return inputs.NormalRoughness.Resource;
            case nrd::ResourceType::IN_VIEWZ: return inputs.ViewZ.Resource;
            case nrd::ResourceType::IN_PENUMBRA:
            case nrd::ResourceType::IN_DIFF_HITDIST:
            case nrd::ResourceType::IN_DIFF_RADIANCE_HITDIST:
            case nrd::ResourceType::IN_SPEC_RADIANCE_HITDIST: return inputs.NoisySignal.Resource;
            case nrd::ResourceType::OUT_SHADOW_TRANSLUCENCY:
            case nrd::ResourceType::OUT_DIFF_HITDIST:
            case nrd::ResourceType::OUT_DIFF_RADIANCE_HITDIST:
            case nrd::ResourceType::OUT_SPEC_RADIANCE_HITDIST: return Output.Resource.Get();
            default: return nullptr;
            }
        };
        for (UINT dispatch = 0; dispatch < count; ++dispatch)
            for (UINT index = 0; index < dispatches[dispatch].resourcesNum; ++index)
                if (!resolve(dispatches[dispatch].resources[index])) return false;

        BYTE* mapped = nullptr;
        const CD3DX12_RANGE noRead(0, 0);
        if (FAILED(Constants->Map(0, &noRead, reinterpret_cast<void**>(&mapped)))) return false;
        const UINT frameSlot = frame.FrameIndex % kFrames;
        ID3D12DescriptorHeap* heaps[] = { Heap.Get() };
        commands->SetDescriptorHeaps(1, heaps);
        commands->SetComputeRootSignature(Root.Get());
        const auto& description = *nrd::GetInstanceDesc(*Instance);
        for (UINT dispatchIndex = 0; dispatchIndex < count; ++dispatchIndex)
        {
            const auto& dispatch = dispatches[dispatchIndex];
            const auto& pipeline = description.pipelines[dispatch.pipelineIndex];
            const UINT descriptorBase = frameSlot * DescriptorsPerFrame + dispatchIndex * (SrvCount + UavCount);
            const auto cpu = [&](UINT offset) { return CD3DX12_CPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE(Heap->GetCPUDescriptorHandleForHeapStart(), descriptorBase + offset, Increment); };
            const auto gpu = [&](UINT offset) { return CD3DX12_GPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE(Heap->GetGPUDescriptorHandleForHeapStart(), descriptorBase + offset, Increment); };
            UINT resourceIndex = 0;
            for (UINT rangeIndex = 0; rangeIndex < pipeline.resourceRangesNum; ++rangeIndex)
            {
                const auto& range = pipeline.resourceRanges[rangeIndex];
                const bool writable = range.descriptorType == nrd::DescriptorType::STORAGE_TEXTURE;
                for (UINT index = 0; index < range.descriptorsNum; ++index, ++resourceIndex)
                {
                    const auto& binding = dispatch.resources[resourceIndex];
                    auto* resource = resolve(binding);
                    D3D12_RESOURCE_STATES* state = nullptr;
                    if (binding.type == nrd::ResourceType::PERMANENT_POOL) state = &Permanent[binding.indexInPool].State;
                    else if (binding.type == nrd::ResourceType::TRANSIENT_POOL) state = &Transient[binding.indexInPool].State;
                    else if (resource == Output.Resource.Get()) state = &Output.State;
                    else state = &externalStates.at(resource);
                    Transition(commands, resource, *state, writable ? D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS : D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_NON_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE);
                    if (writable)
                    {
                        D3D12_UNORDERED_ACCESS_VIEW_DESC view{};
                        view.Format = resource->GetDesc().Format;
                        view.ViewDimension = D3D12_UAV_DIMENSION_TEXTURE2D;
                        Device->CreateUnorderedAccessView(resource, nullptr, &view, cpu(SrvCount + index));
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        D3D12_SHADER_RESOURCE_VIEW_DESC view{};
                        view.Format = resource->GetDesc().Format;
                        view.Shader4ComponentMapping = D3D12_DEFAULT_SHADER_4_COMPONENT_MAPPING;
                        view.ViewDimension = D3D12_SRV_DIMENSION_TEXTURE2D;
                        view.Texture2D.MipLevels = 1;
                        Device->CreateShaderResourceView(resource, &view, cpu(index));
                    }
                }
            }
            const UINT64 constantOffset = (UINT64(frameSlot) * kMaxDispatches + dispatchIndex) * ConstantStride;
            if (dispatch.constantBufferDataSize)
                memcpy(mapped + constantOffset, dispatch.constantBufferData, dispatch.constantBufferDataSize);
            commands->SetPipelineState(Pipelines[dispatch.pipelineIndex].Get());
            commands->SetComputeRootConstantBufferView(0, Constants->GetGPUVirtualAddress() + constantOffset);
            commands->SetComputeRootDescriptorTable(1, gpu(0));
            commands->SetComputeRootDescriptorTable(2, gpu(SrvCount));
            commands->Dispatch(dispatch.gridWidth, dispatch.gridHeight, 1);
        }
        Constants->Unmap(0, nullptr);
        for (const auto& input : { inputs.Motion, inputs.NormalRoughness, inputs.ViewZ, inputs.NoisySignal })
            Transition(commands, input.Resource, externalStates.at(input.Resource), input.State);
        Transition(commands, Output.Resource.Get(), Output.State, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE);
        Dispatches = count;
        RestartedHistory = common.accumulationMode != nrd::AccumulationMode::CONTINUE;
        FirstFrame = false;
        LastSequence = frame.Sequence;
        return true;
    }
};
#else
struct NrdDenoiser::Impl {};
#endif

NrdDenoiser::NrdDenoiser() = default;
NrdDenoiser::~NrdDenoiser() = default;
bool NrdDenoiser::Initialize(ID3D12Device* device, NrdSignal signal, UINT width, UINT height)
{
#if defined(RENDERINGPROJECT_USE_NRD)
    if (!device || !width || !height || width > UINT16_MAX || height > UINT16_MAX) return false;
    auto created = make_unique<Impl>();
    created->Device = device;
    if (!created->Create(signal, width, height)) return false;
    m_Impl = move(created);
    return true;
#else
    return false;
#endif
}
bool NrdDenoiser::Execute(ID3D12GraphicsCommandList* commands, const NrdInputs& inputs, const NrdFrame& frame)
{
#if defined(RENDERINGPROJECT_USE_NRD)
    return m_Impl && m_Impl->Execute(commands, inputs, frame);
#else
    return false;
#endif
}
ID3D12Resource* NrdDenoiser::GetOutput() const
{
#if defined(RENDERINGPROJECT_USE_NRD)
    return m_Impl ? m_Impl->Output.Resource.Get() : nullptr;
#else
    return nullptr;
#endif
}
UINT NrdDenoiser::GetDispatchCount() const
{
#if defined(RENDERINGPROJECT_USE_NRD)
    return m_Impl ? m_Impl->Dispatches : 0;
#else
    return 0;
#endif
}
bool NrdDenoiser::DidRestartHistory() const
{
#if defined(RENDERINGPROJECT_USE_NRD)
    return m_Impl && m_Impl->RestartedHistory;
#else
    return false;
#endif
}
bool NrdDenoiser::IsCompiled()
{
#if defined(RENDERINGPROJECT_USE_NRD)
    return true;
#else
    return false;
#endif
}
const char* NrdDenoiser::GetVersion()
{
#if defined(RENDERINGPROJECT_USE_NRD)
    return "4.17.3";
#else
    return "SDK 未導入";
#endif
}

===== FILE: rendering\nrddenoiser.h =====
#pragma once
#include "pch.h"
#include <memory>

enum class NrdSignal { Shadow, Specular, AmbientOcclusion, Diffuse };

struct NrdTexture
{
    ID3D12Resource* Resource = nullptr;
    D3D12_RESOURCE_STATES State = D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE;
};

struct NrdInputs
{
    NrdTexture Motion;
    NrdTexture NormalRoughness;
    NrdTexture ViewZ;
    NrdTexture NoisySignal;
};

struct NrdFrame
{
    XMFLOAT4X4 View{};
    XMFLOAT4X4 Projection{};
    XMFLOAT4X4 PreviousView{};
    XMFLOAT4X4 PreviousProjection{};
    XMFLOAT2 Jitter{};
    XMFLOAT2 PreviousJitter{};
    XMFLOAT3 LightDirection{};
    UINT FrameIndex = 0; // safe engine frame slot
    UINT Sequence = 0;   // consecutive temporal frame number
    float Range = 2000.0f;
    float AmbientRadius = 1.5f;
    bool ResetHistory = false;
};

// Native D3D12 integration of NVIDIA NRD. Each signal/light owns its temporal history.
// Execute restores input states; the result is returned in PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE state.
class NrdDenoiser
{
public:
    NrdDenoiser();
    ~NrdDenoiser();
    NrdDenoiser(const NrdDenoiser&) = delete;
    NrdDenoiser& operator=(const NrdDenoiser&) = delete;
    bool Initialize(ID3D12Device* device, NrdSignal signal, UINT width, UINT height);
    bool Execute(ID3D12GraphicsCommandList* commands, const NrdInputs& inputs, const NrdFrame& frame);
    ID3D12Resource* GetOutput() const;
    UINT GetDispatchCount() const;
    bool DidRestartHistory() const;
    static bool IsCompiled();
    static const char* GetVersion();
private:
    struct Impl;
    unique_ptr<Impl> m_Impl;
};

===== FILE: rendering\occlusionculling.cpp =====
#include "pch.h"
#include "occlusionculling.h"
#include "gpudriven/gpudrivenrenderer.h"
#include "graphicsdevice.h"
#include "renderersettings.h"
#include "rendererstate.h"
#include "rendergraph.h"
#include "renderprofiler.h"
#include "virtualgeometry/virtualgeometrytraversal.h"

static ComPtr<ID3D12Device> g_Device;
static ComPtr<ID3D12DescriptorHeap> g_Heap;
static UINT g_Increment = 0;
static ComPtr<ID3D12RootSignature> g_RootSignature;
static ComPtr<ID3D12PipelineState> g_ReducePso, g_CopyPso, g_DebugPso;
static ComPtr<ID3D12Resource> g_DebugTexture;
static UINT g_DebugMip = 0;
static bool g_DebugEnabled = false, g_DebugReady = false;
static ComPtr<ID3D12Resource> g_OccluderDepth;
static ComPtr<ID3D12DescriptorHeap> g_OccluderDsv;
static ComPtr<ID3D12Resource> g_HiZ[2];
static UINT g_Width = 0;
static UINT g_Height = 0;
static UINT g_MipCount = 0;
static UINT g_PreviousIndex = 0;
static UINT g_CurrentIndex = 1;
static UINT g_Phase = 0;
static bool g_PreviousValid = false;
static bool g_CurrentValid = false;

static D3D12_CPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE Cpu(UINT index)
{
    return CD3DX12_CPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE(g_Heap->GetCPUDescriptorHandleForHeapStart(), index, g_Increment);
}
static D3D12_GPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE Gpu(UINT index)
{
    return CD3DX12_GPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE(g_Heap->GetGPUDescriptorHandleForHeapStart(), index, g_Increment);
}
static bool LoadPipeline(const wchar_t *path, ComPtr<ID3D12PipelineState> &output)
{
    ComPtr<ID3DBlob> shader;
    if (FAILED(D3DReadFileToBlob(path, &shader)))
    {
        return false;
    }
    D3D12_COMPUTE_PIPELINE_STATE_DESC desc{};
    desc.pRootSignature = g_RootSignature.Get();
    desc.CS = CD3DX12_SHADER_BYTECODE(shader.Get());
    return SUCCEEDED(g_Device->CreateComputePipelineState(&desc, IID_PPV_ARGS(&output)));
}

bool OcclusionCulling::Initialize(ID3D12Device *device, ID3D12DescriptorHeap *heap, UINT descriptorIncrement)
{
    Shutdown();
    if (!device || !heap || descriptorIncrement == 0)
    {
        return false;
    }
    g_Device = device;
    g_Heap = heap;
    g_Increment = descriptorIncrement;
    CD3DX12_DESCRIPTOR_RANGE ranges[2];
    ranges[0].Init(D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_RANGE_TYPE_SRV, 1, 0);
    ranges[1].Init(D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_RANGE_TYPE_UAV, 1, 0);
    CD3DX12_ROOT_PARAMETER parameters[3];
    parameters[0].InitAsDescriptorTable(1, &ranges[0]);
    parameters[1].InitAsDescriptorTable(1, &ranges[1]);
    parameters[2].InitAsConstants(4, 0);
    CD3DX12_ROOT_SIGNATURE_DESC desc(_countof(parameters), parameters, 0, nullptr, D3D12_ROOT_SIGNATURE_FLAG_NONE);
    ComPtr<ID3DBlob> serialized;
    ComPtr<ID3DBlob> errors;
    if (FAILED(D3D12SerializeRootSignature(&desc, D3D_ROOT_SIGNATURE_VERSION_1, &serialized, &errors)))
    {
        if (errors)
        {
            Debug::Log("Hi-Z root signature: %s\n", static_cast<const char *>(errors->GetBufferPointer()));
        }
        return false;
    }
    if (FAILED(device->CreateRootSignature(0, serialized->GetBufferPointer(), serialized->GetBufferSize(),
                                           IID_PPV_ARGS(&g_RootSignature))))
    {
        return false;
    }
    D3D12_SHADER_RESOURCE_VIEW_DESC nullSrv{};
    nullSrv.Shader4ComponentMapping = D3D12_DEFAULT_SHADER_4_COMPONENT_MAPPING;
    nullSrv.Format = DXGI_FORMAT_R32_FLOAT;
    nullSrv.ViewDimension = D3D12_SRV_DIMENSION_TEXTURE2D;
    nullSrv.Texture2D.MipLevels = 1;
    for (UINT i = 0; i < 2; ++i)
    {
        device->CreateShaderResourceView(nullptr, &nullSrv, Cpu(RendererState::g_kHIZ_SRV_START_INDEX + i));
    }
    return LoadPipeline(L"shader/hlsl/build/HiZReduceCS.cso", g_ReducePso) &&
           LoadPipeline(L"shader/hlsl/build/HiZCopyCS.cso", g_CopyPso) &&
           LoadPipeline(L"shader/hlsl/build/HiZDebugCS.cso", g_DebugPso);
}

void OcclusionCulling::Shutdown()
{
    g_HiZ[0].Reset();
    g_HiZ[1].Reset();
    g_ReducePso.Reset();
    g_CopyPso.Reset();
    g_OccluderDepth.Reset();
    g_OccluderDsv.Reset();
    g_DebugPso.Reset();
    g_DebugTexture.Reset();
    g_DebugReady = g_DebugEnabled = false;
    g_RootSignature.Reset();
    g_Heap.Reset();
    g_Device.Reset();
    g_Increment = g_Width = g_Height = g_MipCount = g_Phase = 0;
    g_PreviousIndex = 0;
    g_CurrentIndex = 1;
    g_PreviousValid = g_CurrentValid = false;
}

bool OcclusionCulling::Resize(UINT width, UINT height)
{
    if (!g_Device || !g_Heap || width == 0 || height == 0)
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (width == g_Width && height == g_Height && g_HiZ[0] && g_HiZ[1])
    {
        return true;
    }
    if (!GraphicsDevice::WaitForGpuIdle())
    {
        return false;
    }
    g_Width = width;
    g_Height = height;
    g_MipCount = min<UINT>(1u + static_cast<UINT>(floor(log2(static_cast<double>(max(width, height))))),
                           RendererState::g_kHIZ_MAX_MIPS);
    g_PreviousValid = g_CurrentValid = false;
    g_PreviousIndex = 0;
    g_CurrentIndex = 1;
    auto heapProperties = CD3DX12_HEAP_PROPERTIES(D3D12_HEAP_TYPE_DEFAULT);
    auto resourceDesc =
        CD3DX12_RESOURCE_DESC::Tex2D(DXGI_FORMAT_R32_FLOAT, width, height, 1, static_cast<UINT16>(g_MipCount), 1, 0,
                                     D3D12_RESOURCE_FLAG_ALLOW_UNORDERED_ACCESS);
    for (UINT texture = 0; texture < 2; ++texture)
    {
        g_HiZ[texture].Reset();
        if (FAILED(g_Device->CreateCommittedResource(&heapProperties, D3D12_HEAP_FLAG_NONE, &resourceDesc, ReadState(),
                                                     nullptr, IID_PPV_ARGS(&g_HiZ[texture]))))
        {
            return false;
        }
        D3D12_SHADER_RESOURCE_VIEW_DESC srv{};
        srv.Shader4ComponentMapping = D3D12_DEFAULT_SHADER_4_COMPONENT_MAPPING;
        srv.Format = DXGI_FORMAT_R32_FLOAT;
        srv.ViewDimension = D3D12_SRV_DIMENSION_TEXTURE2D;
        srv.Texture2D.MipLevels = g_MipCount;
        g_Device->CreateShaderResourceView(g_HiZ[texture].Get(), &srv,
                                           Cpu(RendererState::g_kHIZ_SRV_START_INDEX + texture));
        for (UINT mip = 0; mip < g_MipCount; ++mip)
        {
            D3D12_SHADER_RESOURCE_VIEW_DESC mipSrv = srv;
            mipSrv.Texture2D.MostDetailedMip = mip;
            mipSrv.Texture2D.MipLevels = 1;
            g_Device->CreateShaderResourceView(
                g_HiZ[texture].Get(), &mipSrv,
                Cpu(RendererState::g_kHIZ_MIP_SRV_START_INDEX + texture * RendererState::g_kHIZ_MAX_MIPS + mip));
            D3D12_UNORDERED_ACCESS_VIEW_DESC uav{};
            uav.Format = DXGI_FORMAT_R32_FLOAT;
            uav.ViewDimension = D3D12_UAV_DIMENSION_TEXTURE2D;
            uav.Texture2D.MipSlice = mip;
            g_Device->CreateUnorderedAccessView(
                g_HiZ[texture].Get(), nullptr, &uav,
                Cpu(RendererState::g_kHIZ_UAV_START_INDEX + texture * RendererState::g_kHIZ_MAX_MIPS + mip));
        }
    }
    auto depthDesc = CD3DX12_RESOURCE_DESC::Tex2D(DXGI_FORMAT_R32_TYPELESS, width, height, 1, 1, 1, 0,
                                                  D3D12_RESOURCE_FLAG_ALLOW_DEPTH_STENCIL);
    D3D12_CLEAR_VALUE clear{};
    clear.Format = DXGI_FORMAT_D32_FLOAT;
    clear.DepthStencil.Depth = 1;
    g_OccluderDepth.Reset();
    if (FAILED(g_Device->CreateCommittedResource(&heapProperties, D3D12_HEAP_FLAG_NONE, &depthDesc,
                                                 D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_NON_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE, &clear,
                                                 IID_PPV_ARGS(&g_OccluderDepth))))
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (!g_OccluderDsv)
    {
        D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_HEAP_DESC desc{};
        desc.Type = D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_HEAP_TYPE_DSV;
        desc.NumDescriptors = 1;
        if (FAILED(g_Device->CreateDescriptorHeap(&desc, IID_PPV_ARGS(&g_OccluderDsv))))
        {
            return false;
        }
    }
    D3D12_DEPTH_STENCIL_VIEW_DESC dsv{};
    dsv.Format = DXGI_FORMAT_D32_FLOAT;
    dsv.ViewDimension = D3D12_DSV_DIMENSION_TEXTURE2D;
    g_Device->CreateDepthStencilView(g_OccluderDepth.Get(), &dsv, g_OccluderDsv->GetCPUDescriptorHandleForHeapStart());
    D3D12_SHADER_RESOURCE_VIEW_DESC srv{};
    srv.Shader4ComponentMapping = D3D12_DEFAULT_SHADER_4_COMPONENT_MAPPING;
    srv.Format = DXGI_FORMAT_R32_FLOAT;
    srv.ViewDimension = D3D12_SRV_DIMENSION_TEXTURE2D;
    srv.Texture2D.MipLevels = 1;
    g_Device->CreateShaderResourceView(g_OccluderDepth.Get(), &srv, Cpu(RendererState::g_kHIZ_SOURCE_SRV_INDEX));
    if (!g_DebugTexture)
    {
        const auto debugDesc = CD3DX12_RESOURCE_DESC::Tex2D(DXGI_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM, 320, 180, 1, 1, 1, 0,
                                                            D3D12_RESOURCE_FLAG_ALLOW_UNORDERED_ACCESS);
        if (FAILED(g_Device->CreateCommittedResource(&heapProperties, D3D12_HEAP_FLAG_NONE, &debugDesc,
                                                     D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE, nullptr,
                                                     IID_PPV_ARGS(&g_DebugTexture))))
        {
            return false;
        }
        srv.Format = DXGI_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM;
        g_Device->CreateShaderResourceView(g_DebugTexture.Get(), &srv, Cpu(RendererState::g_kHIZ_DEBUG_SRV_INDEX));
        D3D12_UNORDERED_ACCESS_VIEW_DESC uav{};
        uav.Format = srv.Format;
        uav.ViewDimension = D3D12_UAV_DIMENSION_TEXTURE2D;
        g_Device->CreateUnorderedAccessView(g_DebugTexture.Get(), nullptr, &uav,
                                            Cpu(RendererState::g_kHIZ_DEBUG_UAV_INDEX));
    }
    return true;
}

bool OcclusionCulling::IsAvailable()
{
    return g_RootSignature && g_ReducePso && g_HiZ[0] && g_HiZ[1];
}

void OcclusionCulling::BeginPhaseOne()
{
    g_Phase = static_cast<UINT>((!GPUDrivenRenderer::IsActive() || VirtualGeometryTraversal::TwoPassActive()) && RendererSettings::GetTwoPhaseOcclusionEnabled() &&
                                IsAvailable());
    g_CurrentValid = false;
}

void OcclusionCulling::BuildCurrent(ID3D12GraphicsCommandList *commands, ID3D12Resource *depth)
{
    if (!commands || !depth || g_Phase != 1u || !IsAvailable())
    {
        return;
    }
    // Legacy caller places depth in COPY_SOURCE. The graph restores that state.
    const auto desc = depth->GetDesc();
    const auto srv = Gpu(desc.Width == GraphicsDevice::GetWidth() && desc.Height == GraphicsDevice::GetHeight()
                             ? RendererState::g_kDEPTH_SRV_INDEX
                             : RendererState::g_kLOW_RES_DEPTH_SRV_INDEX);
    BuildPyramid(commands, depth, srv, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_COPY_SOURCE);
}

void OcclusionCulling::BuildTemporal(ID3D12GraphicsCommandList *commands, ID3D12Resource *depth,
                                     D3D12_GPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE srv)
{
    BuildPyramid(commands, depth, srv, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_NON_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE);
}

void OcclusionCulling::BuildPyramid(ID3D12GraphicsCommandList *commands, ID3D12Resource *depth,
                                    D3D12_GPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE srv, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATES depthState)
{
    if (!commands || !depth || !IsAvailable())
    {
        return;
    }
    RenderProfiler::ScopedEvent profile("Hi-Z Build", commands);
    RenderGraph graph;
    RenderGraph::ImportedResource input{};
    input.Name = "Hi-Z Source Depth";
    input.Resource = depth;
    input.InitialState = input.FinalState = depthState;
    input.HasFinalState = true;
    const auto source = graph.ImportResource(input);
    vector<RenderGraph::ResourceHandle> mips;
    for (UINT mip = 0; mip < g_MipCount; ++mip)
    {
        input.Name = "Hi-Z Mip";
        input.Resource = g_HiZ[g_CurrentIndex].Get();
        input.InitialState = input.FinalState = ReadState();
        input.Subresource = mip;
        mips.push_back(graph.ImportResource(input));
    }
    for (UINT mip = 0; mip < g_MipCount; ++mip)
    {
        const auto read = mip == 0 ? source : mips[mip - 1];
        const auto write = mips[mip];
        graph.AddPass(
            "Hi-Z Mip Generation",
            [=](RenderGraph::PassBuilder &builder) {
                builder.Read(read, mip == 0 ? D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_NON_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE : ReadState())
                    .Write(write, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS);
            },
            [=](ID3D12GraphicsCommandList *list) {
                ID3D12DescriptorHeap *heap = g_Heap.Get();
                list->SetDescriptorHeaps(1, &heap);
                list->SetComputeRootSignature(g_RootSignature.Get());
                list->SetPipelineState(mip == 0 ? g_CopyPso.Get() : g_ReducePso.Get());
                list->SetComputeRootDescriptorTable(0, mip == 0 ? srv
                                                                : Gpu(RendererState::g_kHIZ_MIP_SRV_START_INDEX +
                                                                      g_CurrentIndex * RendererState::g_kHIZ_MAX_MIPS +
                                                                      mip - 1));
                list->SetComputeRootDescriptorTable(1, Gpu(RendererState::g_kHIZ_UAV_START_INDEX +
                                                           g_CurrentIndex * RendererState::g_kHIZ_MAX_MIPS + mip));
                const UINT width = max(g_Width >> mip, 1u), height = max(g_Height >> mip, 1u);
                const UINT constants[4] = {width, height, 0, 0};
                list->SetComputeRoot32BitConstants(2, 4, constants, 0);
                list->Dispatch((width + 7) / 8, (height + 7) / 8, 1);
            });
    }
    if (g_DebugEnabled && g_DebugTexture)
    {
        input.Name = "Hi-Z Grayscale Preview";
        input.Resource = g_DebugTexture.Get();
        input.Subresource = 0;
        input.InitialState = input.FinalState = D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE;
        const auto preview = graph.ImportResource(input);
        const UINT mip = min(g_DebugMip, g_MipCount - 1);
        graph.AddPass(
            "Hi-Z Debug Preview",
            [=](RenderGraph::PassBuilder &builder) {
                builder.Read(mips[mip], ReadState()).Write(preview, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS);
            },
            [=](ID3D12GraphicsCommandList *list) {
                list->SetComputeRootSignature(g_RootSignature.Get());
                list->SetPipelineState(g_DebugPso.Get());
                list->SetComputeRootDescriptorTable(0, Gpu(RendererState::g_kHIZ_MIP_SRV_START_INDEX +
                                                           g_CurrentIndex * RendererState::g_kHIZ_MAX_MIPS + mip));
                list->SetComputeRootDescriptorTable(1, Gpu(RendererState::g_kHIZ_DEBUG_UAV_INDEX));
                const UINT constants[4] = {320, 180, 0, 0};
                list->SetComputeRoot32BitConstants(2, 4, constants, 0);
                list->Dispatch(40, 23, 1);
                g_DebugReady = true;
            });
    }
    if (!graph.Compile() || !graph.Execute(commands))
    {
        throw runtime_error(graph.GetLastError());
    }
    g_CurrentValid = true;
}

void OcclusionCulling::InvalidateHistory()
{
    g_PreviousValid = false;
}
ID3D12Resource *OcclusionCulling::GetPreviousResource()
{
    return g_HiZ[g_PreviousIndex].Get();
}
ID3D12Resource *OcclusionCulling::GetCurrentResource()
{
    return g_HiZ[g_CurrentIndex].Get();
}
ID3D12Resource *OcclusionCulling::GetOccluderDepth()
{
    return g_OccluderDepth.Get();
}
D3D12_CPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE OcclusionCulling::GetOccluderDsv()
{
    return g_OccluderDsv->GetCPUDescriptorHandleForHeapStart();
}
D3D12_GPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE OcclusionCulling::GetOccluderSrv()
{
    return Gpu(RendererState::g_kHIZ_SOURCE_SRV_INDEX);
}
D3D12_GPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE OcclusionCulling::GetDebugMipSrv(UINT mip)
{
    if (g_DebugReady)
    {
        return Gpu(RendererState::g_kHIZ_DEBUG_SRV_INDEX);
    }
    return Gpu(RendererState::g_kHIZ_MIP_SRV_START_INDEX + g_PreviousIndex * RendererState::g_kHIZ_MAX_MIPS +
               min(mip, g_MipCount - 1));
}
void OcclusionCulling::SetDebugPreview(UINT mip, bool enabled)
{
    g_DebugMip = mip;
    g_DebugEnabled = enabled;
}

void OcclusionCulling::BeginPhaseTwo()
{
    if (g_Phase == 1u && g_CurrentValid)
    {
        g_Phase = 2u;
    }
}

void OcclusionCulling::EndFrame()
{
    if (g_CurrentValid)
    {
        g_PreviousIndex = g_CurrentIndex;
        g_CurrentIndex = 1u - g_CurrentIndex;
        g_PreviousValid = true;
    }
    g_CurrentValid = false;
    g_Phase = 0;
}

UINT OcclusionCulling::GetPhase()
{
    return g_Phase;
}
bool OcclusionCulling::HasHierarchyForCurrentPhase()
{
    if (g_Phase == 1u)
    {
        return g_PreviousValid;
    }
    return (g_Phase == 2u && g_CurrentValid);
}
D3D12_GPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE OcclusionCulling::GetHierarchySrv()
{
    UINT index;
    if (g_Phase == 2u)
    {
        index = g_CurrentIndex;
    }
    else
    {
        index = g_PreviousIndex;
    }
    return Gpu(RendererState::g_kHIZ_SRV_START_INDEX + index);
}
D3D12_GPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE OcclusionCulling::GetPreviousSrv()
{
    return Gpu(RendererState::g_kHIZ_SRV_START_INDEX + g_PreviousIndex);
}
D3D12_GPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE OcclusionCulling::GetCurrentSrv()
{
    return Gpu(RendererState::g_kHIZ_SRV_START_INDEX + g_CurrentIndex);
}
bool OcclusionCulling::HasPrevious()
{
    return g_PreviousValid;
}
bool OcclusionCulling::HasCurrent()
{
    return g_CurrentValid;
}
UINT OcclusionCulling::GetWidth()
{
    return g_Width;
}
UINT OcclusionCulling::GetHeight()
{
    return g_Height;
}
UINT OcclusionCulling::GetMipCount()
{
    return g_MipCount;
}

===== FILE: rendering\optixdenoiser.cpp =====
#include "pch.h"
#include "optixdenoiser.h"
#include "optixinterop.h"
#include "graphicsdevice.h"
#include "graphicslog.h"
#include "rendererstate.h"

namespace
{
constexpr UINT kFrames = RendererState::g_kFRAME_COUNT;
constexpr UINT kDescriptors = 7;
ComPtr<ID3D12Device> g_Device;
ComPtr<ID3D12RootSignature> g_Root;
ComPtr<ID3D12PipelineState> g_Pack, g_Unpack;
UINT g_Increment = 0;
bool g_RuntimeFailed = false;

struct Constants
{
    XMFLOAT4X4 WorldToView{};
    XMUINT4 ExtentFlags{};
    XMFLOAT4 Parameters{};
};
static_assert(sizeof(Constants) <= 256);

void Transition(ID3D12GraphicsCommandList* commands, ID3D12Resource* resource,
    D3D12_RESOURCE_STATES before, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATES after)
{
    const auto barrier = CD3DX12_RESOURCE_BARRIER::Transition(resource, before, after);
    commands->ResourceBarrier(1, &barrier);
}
}

struct OptixDenoiser::Impl
{
    OptixInterop Interop;
    array<ComPtr<ID3D12DescriptorHeap>, kFrames> Heaps;
    ComPtr<ID3D12Resource> ConstantBuffer;

    bool Ensure(UINT slot)
    {
        if (!ConstantBuffer)
        {
            const auto heap = CD3DX12_HEAP_PROPERTIES(D3D12_HEAP_TYPE_UPLOAD);
            const auto desc = CD3DX12_RESOURCE_DESC::Buffer(256 * kFrames);
            if (FAILED(g_Device->CreateCommittedResource(&heap, D3D12_HEAP_FLAG_NONE, &desc,
                D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_GENERIC_READ, nullptr, IID_PPV_ARGS(&ConstantBuffer))))
            {
                return false;
            }
        }
        if (!Heaps[slot])
        {
            D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_HEAP_DESC desc{};
            desc.Type = D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_HEAP_TYPE_CBV_SRV_UAV;
            desc.NumDescriptors = kDescriptors;
            desc.Flags = D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_HEAP_FLAG_SHADER_VISIBLE;
            if (FAILED(g_Device->CreateDescriptorHeap(&desc, IID_PPV_ARGS(&Heaps[slot]))))
            {
                return false;
            }
        }
        return true;
    }
};

OptixDenoiser::OptixDenoiser() : m_Impl(make_unique<Impl>()) {}
OptixDenoiser::~OptixDenoiser() = default;

bool OptixDenoiser::Initialize(ID3D12Device* device)
{
    g_RuntimeFailed = false;
    if (!OptixInterop::Initialize(device))
    {
        return false;
    }
    g_Device = device;
    g_Increment = device->GetDescriptorHandleIncrementSize(D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_HEAP_TYPE_CBV_SRV_UAV);
    CD3DX12_DESCRIPTOR_RANGE ranges[2];
    ranges[0].Init(D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_RANGE_TYPE_SRV, 4, 0);
    ranges[1].Init(D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_RANGE_TYPE_UAV, 2, 0);
    CD3DX12_ROOT_PARAMETER params[3];
    params[0].InitAsConstantBufferView(0);
    params[1].InitAsDescriptorTable(1, &ranges[0]);
    params[2].InitAsDescriptorTable(1, &ranges[1]);
    const CD3DX12_ROOT_SIGNATURE_DESC root(3, params);
    ComPtr<ID3DBlob> blob, errors;
    if (FAILED(D3D12SerializeRootSignature(&root, D3D_ROOT_SIGNATURE_VERSION_1, &blob, &errors)) ||
        FAILED(device->CreateRootSignature(0, blob->GetBufferPointer(), blob->GetBufferSize(), IID_PPV_ARGS(&g_Root))))
    {
        return false;
    }
    const auto compile = [&](const char* entry, ComPtr<ID3D12PipelineState>& pipeline)
    {
        blob.Reset();
        errors.Reset();
        if (FAILED(D3DCompileFromFile(L"shader/hlsl/OptixDenoiserCS.hlsl", nullptr, D3D_COMPILE_STANDARD_FILE_INCLUDE,
            entry, "cs_6_5", D3DCOMPILE_OPTIMIZATION_LEVEL3, 0, &blob, &errors)))
        {
            WriteGraphicsLog("OptiX packing shader failed: %s\n", errors ? static_cast<const char*>(errors->GetBufferPointer()) : entry);
            return false;
        }
        D3D12_COMPUTE_PIPELINE_STATE_DESC desc{};
        desc.pRootSignature = g_Root.Get();
        desc.CS = CD3DX12_SHADER_BYTECODE(blob.Get());
        return SUCCEEDED(device->CreateComputePipelineState(&desc, IID_PPV_ARGS(&pipeline)));
    };
    return compile("Pack", g_Pack) && compile("Unpack", g_Unpack);
}

void OptixDenoiser::Shutdown()
{
    g_Pack.Reset();
    g_Unpack.Reset();
    g_Root.Reset();
    g_Device.Reset();
    OptixInterop::Shutdown();
}
bool OptixDenoiser::IsAvailable()
{
    return !g_RuntimeFailed && OptixInterop::IsAvailable() && g_Pack && g_Unpack;
}
const char* OptixDenoiser::GetStatus()
{
    if (g_RuntimeFailed)
    {
        return "OptiX stopped after a runtime failure; NRD fallback is active (see graphics log)";
    }
    if (OptixInterop::IsAvailable() && (!g_Pack || !g_Unpack))
    {
        return "OptiX packing pipeline unavailable; NRD fallback is active";
    }
    return OptixInterop::GetStatus();
}

bool OptixDenoiser::Execute(ID3D12GraphicsCommandList* commands, ID3D12Resource* noisy,
    ID3D12Resource* depth, ID3D12Resource* normal, ID3D12Resource* result,
    const NrdFrame& frame, bool nrdPacked, bool preserveHitDistance, float intensity)
{
    if (!IsAvailable() || !commands || !noisy || !depth || !normal || !result)
    {
        return false;
    }
    const UINT slot = frame.FrameIndex % kFrames;
    const auto extent = noisy->GetDesc();
    const UINT width = static_cast<UINT>(extent.Width);
    const UINT height = extent.Height;
    if (!m_Impl->Ensure(slot) || !m_Impl->Interop.Ensure(width, height, slot))
    {
        g_RuntimeFailed = true;
        WriteGraphicsLog("OptiX resources unavailable; falling back to NRD: %s\n", OptixInterop::GetStatus());
        return false;
    }
    auto* shared = m_Impl->Interop.GetSharedBuffer(slot);
    auto* heap = m_Impl->Heaps[slot].Get();
    const auto cpu = [&](UINT index) { return CD3DX12_CPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE(heap->GetCPUDescriptorHandleForHeapStart(), index, g_Increment); };
    const auto gpu = [&](UINT index) { return CD3DX12_GPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE(heap->GetGPUDescriptorHandleForHeapStart(), index, g_Increment); };
    array<ID3D12Resource*, 3> textures{noisy, depth, normal};
    for (UINT index = 0; index < textures.size(); ++index)
    {
        D3D12_SHADER_RESOURCE_VIEW_DESC srv{};
        srv.Format = textures[index]->GetDesc().Format;
        if (srv.Format == DXGI_FORMAT_R32_TYPELESS)
        {
            srv.Format = DXGI_FORMAT_R32_FLOAT;
        }
        srv.ViewDimension = D3D12_SRV_DIMENSION_TEXTURE2D;
        srv.Shader4ComponentMapping = D3D12_DEFAULT_SHADER_4_COMPONENT_MAPPING;
        srv.Texture2D.MipLevels = 1;
        g_Device->CreateShaderResourceView(textures[index], &srv, cpu(index));
    }
    D3D12_SHADER_RESOURCE_VIEW_DESC bufferSrv{};
    bufferSrv.Format = DXGI_FORMAT_UNKNOWN;
    bufferSrv.ViewDimension = D3D12_SRV_DIMENSION_BUFFER;
    bufferSrv.Shader4ComponentMapping = D3D12_DEFAULT_SHADER_4_COMPONENT_MAPPING;
    bufferSrv.Buffer.NumElements = width * height * 4;
    bufferSrv.Buffer.StructureByteStride = 16;
    g_Device->CreateShaderResourceView(shared, &bufferSrv, cpu(3));
    D3D12_UNORDERED_ACCESS_VIEW_DESC bufferUav{};
    bufferUav.Format = DXGI_FORMAT_UNKNOWN;
    bufferUav.ViewDimension = D3D12_UAV_DIMENSION_BUFFER;
    bufferUav.Buffer.NumElements = width * height * 4;
    bufferUav.Buffer.StructureByteStride = 16;
    g_Device->CreateUnorderedAccessView(shared, nullptr, &bufferUav, cpu(4));
    D3D12_UNORDERED_ACCESS_VIEW_DESC outputUav{};
    outputUav.Format = result->GetDesc().Format;
    outputUav.ViewDimension = D3D12_UAV_DIMENSION_TEXTURE2D;
    g_Device->CreateUnorderedAccessView(result, nullptr, &outputUav, cpu(5));

    Constants constants;
    XMStoreFloat4x4(&constants.WorldToView, XMMatrixTranspose(XMLoadFloat4x4(&frame.View)));
    constants.ExtentFlags = {width, height, static_cast<UINT>(nrdPacked), static_cast<UINT>(preserveHitDistance)};
    constants.Parameters.x = intensity;
    void* mapped = nullptr;
    const D3D12_RANGE noRead{0, 0};
    if (FAILED(m_Impl->ConstantBuffer->Map(0, &noRead, &mapped)))
    {
        return false;
    }
    memcpy(static_cast<uint8_t*>(mapped) + 256 * slot, &constants, sizeof(constants));
    m_Impl->ConstantBuffer->Unmap(0, nullptr);
    const auto bind = [&](ID3D12PipelineState* pipeline)
    {
        commands->SetDescriptorHeaps(1, &heap);
        commands->SetComputeRootSignature(g_Root.Get());
        commands->SetPipelineState(pipeline);
        commands->SetComputeRootConstantBufferView(0, m_Impl->ConstantBuffer->GetGPUVirtualAddress() + 256 * slot);
        commands->SetComputeRootDescriptorTable(1, gpu(0));
        commands->SetComputeRootDescriptorTable(2, gpu(4));
    };
    Transition(commands, noisy, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_NON_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE);
    Transition(commands, shared, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_COMMON, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS);
    bind(g_Pack.Get());
    commands->Dispatch((width + 7) / 8, (height + 7) / 8, 1);
    Transition(commands, shared, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_COMMON);
    GraphicsDevice::SubmitForExternalCompute();
    const bool denoised = m_Impl->Interop.Enqueue(GraphicsDevice::GetCommandQueue(), slot);
    if (!denoised)
    {
        g_RuntimeFailed = true;
        WriteGraphicsLog("OptiX runtime failure; falling back to NRD: %s\n", OptixInterop::GetStatus());
    }
    if (denoised)
    {
        Transition(commands, shared, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_COMMON, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_NON_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE);
        Transition(commands, result, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS);
        bind(g_Unpack.Get());
        commands->Dispatch((width + 7) / 8, (height + 7) / 8, 1);
        Transition(commands, result, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE);
        Transition(commands, shared, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_NON_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_COMMON);
    }
    Transition(commands, noisy, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_NON_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE);
    return denoised;
}

===== FILE: rendering\optixdenoiser.h =====
#pragma once
#include "nrddenoiser.h"

// D3D12 packing/dispatch integration. OptixInterop owns CUDA/OptiX resources.
class OptixDenoiser
{
public:
    OptixDenoiser();
    ~OptixDenoiser();
    static bool Initialize(ID3D12Device* device);
    static void Shutdown();
    static bool IsAvailable();
    static const char* GetStatus();
    bool Execute(ID3D12GraphicsCommandList* commands, ID3D12Resource* noisy,
        ID3D12Resource* depth, ID3D12Resource* normal, ID3D12Resource* result,
        const NrdFrame& frame, bool nrdPacked, bool preserveHitDistance, float intensity);
private:
    struct Impl;
    unique_ptr<Impl> m_Impl;
};

struct CudaDriver
{
    HMODULE module = nullptr;
#define CUDA_ENTRY(name) decltype(&name) name = nullptr;
    CUDA_ENTRY(cuInit)
    CUDA_ENTRY(cuDeviceGetCount)
    CUDA_ENTRY(cuDeviceGet)
    CUDA_ENTRY(cuDeviceGetLuid)
    CUDA_ENTRY(cuDevicePrimaryCtxRetain)
    CUDA_ENTRY(cuDevicePrimaryCtxRelease)
    CUDA_ENTRY(cuCtxPushCurrent)
    CUDA_ENTRY(cuCtxPopCurrent)
    CUDA_ENTRY(cuStreamCreate)
    CUDA_ENTRY(cuStreamDestroy)
    CUDA_ENTRY(cuStreamSynchronize)
    CUDA_ENTRY(cuMemAlloc)
    CUDA_ENTRY(cuMemFree)
    CUDA_ENTRY(cuImportExternalMemory)
    CUDA_ENTRY(cuExternalMemoryGetMappedBuffer)
    CUDA_ENTRY(cuDestroyExternalMemory)
    CUDA_ENTRY(cuImportExternalSemaphore)
    CUDA_ENTRY(cuDestroyExternalSemaphore)
    CUDA_ENTRY(cuWaitExternalSemaphoresAsync)
    CUDA_ENTRY(cuSignalExternalSemaphoresAsync)
#undef CUDA_ENTRY
    bool Load()
    {
        module = LoadLibraryExW(L"nvcuda.dll", nullptr, LOAD_LIBRARY_SEARCH_SYSTEM32);
        if (!module)
        {
            return false;
        }
#define CUDA_LOAD(name, symbol) name = reinterpret_cast<decltype(name)>(GetProcAddress(module, symbol)); if (!name) { return false; }
        CUDA_LOAD(cuInit, "cuInit")
        CUDA_LOAD(cuDeviceGetCount, "cuDeviceGetCount")
        CUDA_LOAD(cuDeviceGet, "cuDeviceGet")
        CUDA_LOAD(cuDeviceGetLuid, "cuDeviceGetLuid")
        CUDA_LOAD(cuDevicePrimaryCtxRetain, "cuDevicePrimaryCtxRetain")
        CUDA_LOAD(cuDevicePrimaryCtxRelease, "cuDevicePrimaryCtxRelease_v2")
        CUDA_LOAD(cuCtxPushCurrent, "cuCtxPushCurrent_v2")
        CUDA_LOAD(cuCtxPopCurrent, "cuCtxPopCurrent_v2")
        CUDA_LOAD(cuStreamCreate, "cuStreamCreate")
        CUDA_LOAD(cuStreamDestroy, "cuStreamDestroy_v2")
        CUDA_LOAD(cuStreamSynchronize, "cuStreamSynchronize")
        CUDA_LOAD(cuMemAlloc, "cuMemAlloc_v2")
        CUDA_LOAD(cuMemFree, "cuMemFree_v2")
        CUDA_LOAD(cuImportExternalMemory, "cuImportExternalMemory")
        CUDA_LOAD(cuExternalMemoryGetMappedBuffer, "cuExternalMemoryGetMappedBuffer")
        CUDA_LOAD(cuDestroyExternalMemory, "cuDestroyExternalMemory")
        CUDA_LOAD(cuImportExternalSemaphore, "cuImportExternalSemaphore")
        CUDA_LOAD(cuDestroyExternalSemaphore, "cuDestroyExternalSemaphore")
        CUDA_LOAD(cuWaitExternalSemaphoresAsync, "cuWaitExternalSemaphoresAsync")
        CUDA_LOAD(cuSignalExternalSemaphoresAsync, "cuSignalExternalSemaphoresAsync")
#undef CUDA_LOAD
        return true;
    }

CudaDriver driver;
ComPtr<ID3D12Device> device;
CUdevice cudaDevice = 0;
CUcontext context = nullptr;
CUstream stream = nullptr;
OptixDeviceContext optixContext = nullptr;
void* optixLibrary = nullptr;
bool available = false;
std::string status = "OptiX has not been initialized";

bool Fail(const char* operation, int code)
{
    status = std::string(operation) + " failed (" + std::to_string(code) + ")";
    WriteGraphicsLog("OptiX: %s\n", status.c_str());
    return false;
}
struct ContextScope
{
    bool active = false;
    ContextScope()
    {
        if (context)
        {
            active = driver.cuCtxPushCurrent(context) == CUDA_SUCCESS;
        }
    }
    ~ContextScope()
    {
        if (active)
        {
            CUcontext previous = nullptr;
            driver.cuCtxPopCurrent(&previous);
        }
    }
};
bool Cuda(CUresult result, const char* operation)
{
    if (result != CUDA_SUCCESS)
    {
        return Fail(operation, static_cast<int>(result));
    }
    return true;
}
bool Optix(OptixResult result, const char* operation)
{
    if (result != OPTIX_SUCCESS)
    {
        return Fail(operation, static_cast<int>(result));
    }
    return true;
}

struct OptixInterop::Impl
{
    struct Slot
    {
        ComPtr<ID3D12Resource> buffer;
        CUexternalMemory memory = nullptr;
        CUdeviceptr pointer = 0;
    };
    static std::vector<Impl*> instances;
    std::vector<Slot> slots;
    ComPtr<ID3D12Fence> fence;
    CUexternalSemaphore semaphore = nullptr;
    UINT width = 0;
    UINT height = 0;
    UINT64 fenceValue = 0;
    size_t planeBytes = 0;
    OptixDenoiser denoiser = nullptr;
    CUdeviceptr state = 0;
    CUdeviceptr scratch = 0;
    CUdeviceptr intensity = 0;
    size_t stateBytes = 0;
    size_t scratchBytes = 0;

    Impl()
    {
        instances.push_back(this);
    }
    ~Impl()
    {
        Release();
        instances.erase(std::remove(instances.begin(), instances.end(), this), instances.end());
    }
    void Release()
    {
        if (!context)
        {
            return;
        }
        // Resize/destruction is rare; keep both APIs idle before unmapping shared storage.
        GraphicsDevice::WaitForGpuIdle();
        ContextScope scope;
        if (!scope.active)
        {
            return;
        }
        driver.cuStreamSynchronize(stream);
        for (Slot& slot : slots)
        {
            if (slot.pointer)
            {
                driver.cuMemFree(slot.pointer);
            }
            if (slot.memory)
            {
                driver.cuDestroyExternalMemory(slot.memory);
            }
        }
        slots.clear();
        if (semaphore)
        {
            driver.cuDestroyExternalSemaphore(semaphore);
            semaphore = nullptr;
        }
        fence.Reset();
        if (denoiser)
        {
            optixDenoiserDestroy(denoiser);
            denoiser = nullptr;
        }
        if (state)
        {
            driver.cuMemFree(state);
            state = 0;
        }
        if (scratch)
        {
            driver.cuMemFree(scratch);
            scratch = 0;
        }
        if (intensity)
        {
            driver.cuMemFree(intensity);
            intensity = 0;
        }
        width = 0;
        height = 0;
        fenceValue = 0;
    }
    bool CreateWorkspace(UINT newWidth, UINT newHeight)
    {
        OptixDenoiserOptions options = {};
        options.guideAlbedo = 1;
        options.guideNormal = 1;
        options.denoiseAlpha = OPTIX_DENOISER_ALPHA_MODE_COPY;
        if (!Optix(optixDenoiserCreate(optixContext, OPTIX_DENOISER_MODEL_KIND_HDR, &options, &denoiser), "create HDR denoiser"))
        {
            return false;
        }
        OptixDenoiserSizes sizes = {};
        if (!Optix(optixDenoiserComputeMemoryResources(denoiser, newWidth, newHeight, &sizes), "query denoiser workspace"))
        {
            return false;
        }
        stateBytes = sizes.stateSizeInBytes;
        scratchBytes = (std::max)(sizes.withoutOverlapScratchSizeInBytes, sizes.computeIntensitySizeInBytes);
        if (!Cuda(driver.cuMemAlloc(&state, stateBytes), "allocate denoiser state") ||
            !Cuda(driver.cuMemAlloc(&scratch, scratchBytes), "allocate denoiser scratch") ||
            !Cuda(driver.cuMemAlloc(&intensity, sizeof(float)), "allocate HDR intensity"))
        {
            return false;
        }
        if (!Optix(optixDenoiserSetup(denoiser, stream, newWidth, newHeight, state, stateBytes, scratch, scratchBytes), "set up denoiser"))
        {
            return false;
        }
        HRESULT result = device->CreateFence(0, D3D12_FENCE_FLAG_SHARED, IID_PPV_ARGS(&fence));
        if (FAILED(result))
        {
            return Fail("create shared fence", result);
        }
        HANDLE sharedHandle = nullptr;
        result = device->CreateSharedHandle(fence.Get(), nullptr, GENERIC_ALL, nullptr, &sharedHandle);
        if (FAILED(result))
        {
            return Fail("share D3D12 fence", result);
        }
        CUDA_EXTERNAL_SEMAPHORE_HANDLE_DESC descriptor = {};
        descriptor.type = CU_EXTERNAL_SEMAPHORE_HANDLE_TYPE_D3D12_FENCE;
        descriptor.handle.win32.handle = sharedHandle;
        CUresult imported = driver.cuImportExternalSemaphore(&semaphore, &descriptor);
        CloseHandle(sharedHandle);
        if (!Cuda(imported, "import shared D3D12 fence"))
        {
            return false;
        }
        width = newWidth;
        height = newHeight;
        planeBytes = static_cast<size_t>(width) * height * 16;
        return true;
    }
    bool CreateSlot(UINT index)
    {
        if (slots.size() <= index)
        {
            slots.resize(static_cast<size_t>(index) + 1);
        }
        Slot& slot = slots[index];
        D3D12_HEAP_PROPERTIES heap = {};
        heap.Type = D3D12_HEAP_TYPE_DEFAULT;
        D3D12_RESOURCE_DESC description = {};
        description.Dimension = D3D12_RESOURCE_DIMENSION_BUFFER;
        description.Width = planeBytes * 4;
        description.Height = 1;
        description.DepthOrArraySize = 1;
        description.MipLevels = 1;
        description.SampleDesc.Count = 1;
        description.Layout = D3D12_TEXTURE_LAYOUT_ROW_MAJOR;
        description.Flags = D3D12_RESOURCE_FLAG_ALLOW_UNORDERED_ACCESS;
        HRESULT result = device->CreateCommittedResource(&heap, D3D12_HEAP_FLAG_SHARED, &description,
            D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_COMMON, nullptr, IID_PPV_ARGS(&slot.buffer));
        if (FAILED(result))
        {
            return Fail("create shared image buffer", result);
        }
        HANDLE sharedHandle = nullptr;
        result = device->CreateSharedHandle(slot.buffer.Get(), nullptr, GENERIC_ALL, nullptr, &sharedHandle);
        if (FAILED(result))
        {
            return Fail("share image buffer", result);
        }
        CUDA_EXTERNAL_MEMORY_HANDLE_DESC descriptor = {};
        descriptor.type = CU_EXTERNAL_MEMORY_HANDLE_TYPE_D3D12_RESOURCE;
        descriptor.handle.win32.handle = sharedHandle;
        descriptor.size = device->GetResourceAllocationInfo(0, 1, &description).SizeInBytes;
        descriptor.flags = CUDA_EXTERNAL_MEMORY_DEDICATED;
        CUresult imported = driver.cuImportExternalMemory(&slot.memory, &descriptor);
        CloseHandle(sharedHandle);
        if (!Cuda(imported, "import shared image buffer"))
        {
            return false;
        }
        CUDA_EXTERNAL_MEMORY_BUFFER_DESC mapping = {};
        mapping.size = planeBytes * 4;
        return Cuda(driver.cuExternalMemoryGetMappedBuffer(&slot.pointer, slot.memory, &mapping), "map shared image buffer");
    }
    OptixImage2D Image(CUdeviceptr pointer) const
    {
        OptixImage2D image = {};
        image.data = pointer;
        image.width = width;
        image.height = height;
        image.rowStrideInBytes = width * 16;
        image.pixelStrideInBytes = 16;
        image.format = OPTIX_PIXEL_FORMAT_FLOAT4;
        return image;
    }
};
std::vector<OptixInterop::Impl*> OptixInterop::Impl::instances;

OptixInterop::OptixInterop() : impl(std::make_unique<Impl>()) {}
OptixInterop::~OptixInterop() = default;

bool OptixInterop::Initialize(ID3D12Device* graphicsDevice)
{
    if (available)
    {
        return device.Get() == graphicsDevice;
    }
    Shutdown();
    if (!graphicsDevice)
    {
        return Fail("initialize without a D3D12 device", E_INVALIDARG);
    }
    if (!driver.Load())
    {
        Fail("load CUDA driver", GetLastError());
        Shutdown();
        return false;
    }
    if (!Cuda(driver.cuInit(0), "initialize CUDA"))
    {
        Shutdown();
        return false;
    }
    int deviceCount = 0;
    if (!Cuda(driver.cuDeviceGetCount(&deviceCount), "enumerate CUDA adapters"))
    {
        Shutdown();
        return false;
    }
    const LUID adapterLuid = graphicsDevice->GetAdapterLuid();
    bool matched = false;
    for (int index = 0; index < deviceCount; ++index)
    {
        CUdevice candidate = 0;
        char candidateLuid[8] = {};
        unsigned int nodeMask = 0;
        if (driver.cuDeviceGet(&candidate, index) == CUDA_SUCCESS &&
            driver.cuDeviceGetLuid(candidateLuid, &nodeMask, candidate) == CUDA_SUCCESS &&
            memcmp(candidateLuid, &adapterLuid, sizeof(adapterLuid)) == 0)
        {
            cudaDevice = candidate;
            matched = true;
            break;
        }
    }
    if (!matched)
    {
        Fail("match CUDA adapter to D3D12 LUID", -1);
        Shutdown();
        return false;
    }
    if (!Cuda(driver.cuDevicePrimaryCtxRetain(&context, cudaDevice), "retain CUDA primary context"))
    {
        Shutdown();
        return false;
    }
    bool initialized = false;
    {
        ContextScope scope;
        if (scope.active && Cuda(driver.cuStreamCreate(&stream, CU_STREAM_NON_BLOCKING), "create CUDA stream") &&
            Optix(optixInitWithHandle(&optixLibrary), "load OptiX driver"))
        {
            OptixDeviceContextOptions options = {};
            initialized = Optix(optixDeviceContextCreate(context, &options, &optixContext), "create OptiX context");
        }
    }
    if (!initialized)
    {
        Shutdown();
        return false;
    }
    device = graphicsDevice;
    available = true;
    status = "OptiX HDR denoiser ready (CUDA/D3D12 shared GPU memory)";
    WriteGraphicsLog("OptiX: %s\n", status.c_str());
    return true;
}
void OptixInterop::Shutdown()
{
    available = false;
    for (Impl* instance : Impl::instances)
    {
        instance->Release();
    }
    if (context)
    {
        {
            ContextScope scope;
            if (scope.active)
            {
                if (stream)
                {
                    driver.cuStreamSynchronize(stream);
                }
                if (optixContext)
                {
                    optixDeviceContextDestroy(optixContext);
                    optixContext = nullptr;
                }
                if (stream)
                {
                    driver.cuStreamDestroy(stream);
                    stream = nullptr;
                }
            }
        }
        driver.cuDevicePrimaryCtxRelease(cudaDevice);
        context = nullptr;
    }
    if (optixLibrary)
    {
        optixUninitWithHandle(optixLibrary);
        optixLibrary = nullptr;
    }
    device.Reset();
    if (driver.module)
    {
        FreeLibrary(driver.module);
        driver = {};
    }
}
bool OptixInterop::IsAvailable() { return available; }
const char* OptixInterop::GetStatus() { return status.c_str(); }

bool OptixInterop::Ensure(UINT width, UINT height, UINT frameIndex)
{
    if (!available || width == 0 || height == 0 || width > UINT_MAX / 16 ||
        static_cast<uint64_t>(width) * height > (std::numeric_limits<size_t>::max)() / 64)
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (impl->width != width || impl->height != height)
    {
        impl->Release();
    }
    ContextScope scope;
    if (!scope.active)
    {
        return Fail("push CUDA context", -1);
    }
    if (!impl->denoiser && !impl->CreateWorkspace(width, height))
    {
        impl->Release();
        return false;
    }
    if (frameIndex >= impl->slots.size() || !impl->slots[frameIndex].pointer)
    {
        if (!impl->CreateSlot(frameIndex))
        {
            impl->Release();
            return false;
        }
    }
    return true;
}
ID3D12Resource* OptixInterop::GetSharedBuffer(UINT frameIndex) const
{
    if (frameIndex >= impl->slots.size())
    {
        return nullptr;
    }
    return impl->slots[frameIndex].buffer.Get();
}
bool OptixInterop::Enqueue(ID3D12CommandQueue* queue, UINT frameIndex)
{
    if (!available || !queue || frameIndex >= impl->slots.size() || !impl->slots[frameIndex].pointer)
    {
        return false;
    }
    ContextScope scope;
    if (!scope.active)
    {
        return Fail("push CUDA context", -1);
    }
    const UINT64 readyValue = impl->fenceValue + 1;
    const UINT64 finishedValue = impl->fenceValue + 2;
    HRESULT result = queue->Signal(impl->fence.Get(), readyValue);
    if (FAILED(result))
    {
        return Fail("signal D3D12 input completion", result);
    }
    impl->fenceValue = finishedValue;
    CUDA_EXTERNAL_SEMAPHORE_WAIT_PARAMS wait = {};
    wait.params.fence.value = readyValue;
    if (!Cuda(driver.cuWaitExternalSemaphoresAsync(&impl->semaphore, &wait, 1, stream), "wait for D3D12 inputs"))
    {
        return false;
    }
    const CUdeviceptr pointer = impl->slots[frameIndex].pointer;
    OptixDenoiserLayer layer = {};
    layer.input = impl->Image(pointer);
    layer.output = impl->Image(pointer + impl->planeBytes * 3);
    OptixDenoiserGuideLayer guides = {};
    guides.normal = impl->Image(pointer + impl->planeBytes);
    guides.albedo = impl->Image(pointer + impl->planeBytes * 2);
    OptixDenoiserParams parameters = {};
    parameters.hdrIntensity = impl->intensity;
    bool denoised = Optix(optixDenoiserComputeIntensity(impl->denoiser, stream, &layer.input,
        impl->intensity, impl->scratch, impl->scratchBytes), "compute HDR intensity");
    if (denoised)
    {
        denoised = Optix(optixDenoiserInvoke(impl->denoiser, stream, &parameters, impl->state,
            impl->stateBytes, &guides, &layer, 1, 0, 0, impl->scratch, impl->scratchBytes), "invoke HDR denoiser");
    }
    CUDA_EXTERNAL_SEMAPHORE_SIGNAL_PARAMS signal = {};
    signal.params.fence.value = finishedValue;
    if (!Cuda(driver.cuSignalExternalSemaphoresAsync(&impl->semaphore, &signal, 1, stream), "signal CUDA completion"))
    {
        // Never enqueue a graphics wait unless CUDA has accepted its matching signal.
        // Drain exceptional partial work before the caller reuses these resources.
        driver.cuStreamSynchronize(stream);
        available = false;
        return false;
    }
    result = queue->Wait(impl->fence.Get(), finishedValue);
    if (FAILED(result))
    {
        driver.cuStreamSynchronize(stream);
        return Fail("wait for CUDA completion", result);
    }
    return denoised;
}
#else
struct OptixInterop::Impl {};
OptixInterop::OptixInterop() : impl(std::make_unique<Impl>()) {}
OptixInterop::~OptixInterop() = default;
bool OptixInterop::Initialize(ID3D12Device*) { return false; }
void OptixInterop::Shutdown() {}
bool OptixInterop::IsAvailable() { return false; }
const char* OptixInterop::GetStatus() { return "OptiX support was not enabled in this build"; }
bool OptixInterop::Ensure(UINT, UINT, UINT) { return false; }
ID3D12Resource* OptixInterop::GetSharedBuffer(UINT) const { return nullptr; }
bool OptixInterop::Enqueue(ID3D12CommandQueue*, UINT) { return false; }

namespace
