D3D12_CPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE Cpu(ID3D12DescriptorHeap* heap, UINT index)
{
    return CD3DX12_CPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE(heap->GetCPUDescriptorHandleForHeapStart(), index, g_Increment);
}
D3D12_GPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE Gpu(ID3D12DescriptorHeap* heap, UINT index)
{
    return CD3DX12_GPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE(heap->GetGPUDescriptorHandleForHeapStart(), index, g_Increment);
}
bool EnsureUpload(ComPtr<ID3D12Resource>& resource, UINT64 bytes)
{
    if (resource && resource->GetDesc().Width >= bytes) return true;
    const auto heap = CD3DX12_HEAP_PROPERTIES(D3D12_HEAP_TYPE_UPLOAD);
    const auto desc = CD3DX12_RESOURCE_DESC::Buffer(bytes);
    return SUCCEEDED(g_Device->CreateCommittedResource(&heap, D3D12_HEAP_FLAG_NONE, &desc,
        D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_GENERIC_READ, nullptr, IID_PPV_ARGS(resource.ReleaseAndGetAddressOf())));
}
bool Upload(ID3D12Resource* resource, const void* data, size_t bytes)
{
    void* mapped = nullptr;
    D3D12_RANGE noRead{ 0, 0 };
    if (FAILED(resource->Map(0, &noRead, &mapped))) return false;
    memcpy(mapped, data, bytes);
    resource->Unmap(0, nullptr);
    return true;
}
void HashEmission(uint64_t& signature, const void* data, size_t bytes)
{
    const auto* values = static_cast<const uint8_t*>(data);
    for (size_t index = 0; index < bytes; ++index)
    {
        signature ^= values[index];
        signature *= 1099511628211ull;
    }
}
void TextureSrv(ID3D12Resource* resource, D3D12_CPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE handle, UINT minimumResidentMip = 0)
{
    D3D12_SHADER_RESOURCE_VIEW_DESC desc{};
    desc.ViewDimension = D3D12_SRV_DIMENSION_TEXTURE2D;
    desc.Format = resource ? resource->GetDesc().Format : DXGI_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM;
    if (desc.Format == DXGI_FORMAT_R32_TYPELESS) desc.Format = DXGI_FORMAT_R32_FLOAT;
    desc.Shader4ComponentMapping = D3D12_DEFAULT_SHADER_4_COMPONENT_MAPPING;
    desc.Texture2D.MipLevels = resource ? resource->GetDesc().MipLevels : 1;
    desc.Texture2D.ResourceMinLODClamp = static_cast<float>(minimumResidentMip);
    g_Device->CreateShaderResourceView(resource, &desc, handle);
}
void BufferSrv(ID3D12Resource* resource, D3D12_CPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE handle)
{
    D3D12_SHADER_RESOURCE_VIEW_DESC desc{};
    desc.ViewDimension = D3D12_SRV_DIMENSION_BUFFER;
    desc.Format = DXGI_FORMAT_R32_TYPELESS;
    desc.Shader4ComponentMapping = D3D12_DEFAULT_SHADER_4_COMPONENT_MAPPING;
    desc.Buffer.NumElements = resource ? static_cast<UINT>(resource->GetDesc().Width / 4) : 1;
    desc.Buffer.Flags = D3D12_BUFFER_SRV_FLAG_RAW;
    g_Device->CreateShaderResourceView(resource, &desc, handle);
}
bool EnsureFrame(FrameResources& frame, UINT slot, UINT width, UINT height)
{
    if (!frame.Heap)
    {
        D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_HEAP_DESC desc{};
        desc.Type = D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_HEAP_TYPE_CBV_SRV_UAV;
        desc.Flags = D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_HEAP_FLAG_SHADER_VISIBLE;
        desc.NumDescriptors = kEmissionDescriptors + kMaximumMeshes;
        if (FAILED(g_Device->CreateDescriptorHeap(&desc, IID_PPV_ARGS(&frame.Heap)))) return false;
    }
    if (!EnsureUpload(frame.Constants, 256)) return false;
    if (frame.Width != width || frame.Height != height)
    {
        // This slot is reused only after its frame fence has completed.
        frame.Noisy.Reset();
        frame.Result.Reset();
        frame.GiNoisy.Reset();
        frame.GiResult.Reset();
        frame.Width = width;
        frame.Height = height;
        g_GiHistoryValid = false;
    }
    const auto heap = CD3DX12_HEAP_PROPERTIES(D3D12_HEAP_TYPE_DEFAULT);
    const auto desc = CD3DX12_RESOURCE_DESC::Tex2D(DXGI_FORMAT_R16G16B16A16_FLOAT,
        width, height, 1, 1, 1, 0, D3D12_RESOURCE_FLAG_ALLOW_UNORDERED_ACCESS);
    const auto ensureSignal = [&](ComPtr<ID3D12Resource>& noisy, ComPtr<ID3D12Resource>& result,
        UINT firstUav, UINT resultSrv, const wchar_t* name)
    {
        if (noisy && result)
        {
            return true;
        }
        for (auto* resource : {addressof(noisy), addressof(result)})
        {
            if (FAILED(g_Device->CreateCommittedResource(&heap, D3D12_HEAP_FLAG_NONE, &desc,
                D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE, nullptr, IID_PPV_ARGS(resource->ReleaseAndGetAddressOf()))))
            {
                return false;
            }
            (*resource)->SetName(name);
        }
        TextureSrv(result.Get(), Cpu(g_EngineHeap.Get(), resultSrv + slot));
        D3D12_UNORDERED_ACCESS_VIEW_DESC uav{};
        uav.Format = desc.Format;
        uav.ViewDimension = D3D12_UAV_DIMENSION_TEXTURE2D;
        g_Device->CreateUnorderedAccessView(noisy.Get(), nullptr, &uav, Cpu(frame.Heap.Get(), firstUav));
        g_Device->CreateUnorderedAccessView(result.Get(), nullptr, &uav, Cpu(frame.Heap.Get(), firstUav + 1));
        return true;
    };
    if (Raytracing::GetSettings().Reflections &&
        !ensureSignal(frame.Noisy, frame.Result, 4, kResultSrv, L"Ray Reflection Radiance"))
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (RendererSettings::GetRealtimeGiEnabled() &&
        !ensureSignal(frame.GiNoisy, frame.GiResult, 6, kGiSrv, L"Realtime GI Irradiance"))
    {
        return false;
    }
    return true;
}
void Transition(ID3D12GraphicsCommandList* commands, ID3D12Resource* resource,
    D3D12_RESOURCE_STATES before, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATES after)
{
    if (!resource || before == after) return;
    const auto barrier = CD3DX12_RESOURCE_BARRIER::Transition(resource, before, after);
    commands->ResourceBarrier(1, &barrier);
}
}

bool RayReflections::Initialize(ID3D12Device* device, ID3D12DescriptorHeap* engineHeap, UINT increment)
{
    g_Device = device; g_EngineHeap = engineHeap; g_Increment = increment;
    CD3DX12_DESCRIPTOR_RANGE ranges[6];
    ranges[0].Init(D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_RANGE_TYPE_SRV, 4, 1);
    ranges[1].Init(D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_RANGE_TYPE_UAV, 2, 0);
    for (UINT i = 2; i < 6; ++i) ranges[i].Init(D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_RANGE_TYPE_SRV, kMaximumMeshes, 0, i - 1);
    CD3DX12_ROOT_PARAMETER parameters[13];
    parameters[0].InitAsShaderResourceView(25);
    parameters[1].InitAsShaderResourceView(0);
    parameters[2].InitAsConstantBufferView(6);
    parameters[3].InitAsConstantBufferView(1);
    parameters[4].InitAsConstantBufferView(5);
    for (UINT i = 0; i < 5; ++i) parameters[5 + i].InitAsDescriptorTable(1, &ranges[i]);
    parameters[10].InitAsShaderResourceView(5);
    parameters[11].InitAsDescriptorTable(1, &ranges[5]);
    parameters[12].InitAsShaderResourceView(6);
    CD3DX12_STATIC_SAMPLER_DESC sampler(0, D3D12_FILTER_MIN_MAG_MIP_LINEAR,
        D3D12_TEXTURE_ADDRESS_MODE_WRAP, D3D12_TEXTURE_ADDRESS_MODE_WRAP, D3D12_TEXTURE_ADDRESS_MODE_WRAP);
    const CD3DX12_ROOT_SIGNATURE_DESC root(13, parameters, 1, &sampler);
    ComPtr<ID3DBlob> blob, errors;
    if (FAILED(D3D12SerializeRootSignature(&root, D3D_ROOT_SIGNATURE_VERSION_1, &blob, &errors)) ||
        FAILED(device->CreateRootSignature(0, blob->GetBufferPointer(), blob->GetBufferSize(), IID_PPV_ARGS(&g_Root)))) return false;
    const D3D_SHADER_MACRO defines[] = { { "USE_NRD", NrdDenoiser::IsCompiled() ? "1" : "0" }, {} };
    auto compile = [&](const char* entry, ComPtr<ID3D12PipelineState>& pipeline)
    {
        blob.Reset(); errors.Reset();
        if (FAILED(D3DCompileFromFile(L"shader/hlsl/RayReflectionsCS.hlsl", defines, D3D_COMPILE_STANDARD_FILE_INCLUDE,
            entry, "cs_6_5", D3DCOMPILE_OPTIMIZATION_LEVEL3, 0, &blob, &errors)))
        {
            WriteGraphicsLog("DXR reflection shader failed: %s\n", errors ? static_cast<const char*>(errors->GetBufferPointer()) : entry);
            return false;
        }
        D3D12_COMPUTE_PIPELINE_STATE_DESC desc{};
        desc.pRootSignature = g_Root.Get(); desc.CS = CD3DX12_SHADER_BYTECODE(blob.Get());
        return SUCCEEDED(device->CreateComputePipelineState(&desc, IID_PPV_ARGS(&pipeline)));
    };
    return compile("main", g_Trace) && compile("TraceDiffuse", g_GiTrace) &&
        compile("FilterDiffuse", g_GiFilter) &&
        (!NrdDenoiser::IsCompiled() || (compile("Compose", g_Compose) && compile("ComposeDiffuse", g_GiCompose)));
}

void RayReflections::Shutdown()
{
    g_OptixGi.reset();
    g_OptixReflections.reset();
    g_OptixGiActive = g_OptixReflectionActive = false;
    g_GiDenoiser.reset();
    g_GiTrace.Reset();
    g_GiCompose.Reset();
    g_GiFilter.Reset();
    g_GiActive = g_GiHistoryValid = false;
    g_GiEmissionSignature = 0;
    g_GiWidth = g_GiHeight = 0;
    g_Denoiser.reset(); g_Frames = {}; g_Root.Reset(); g_Trace.Reset(); g_Compose.Reset();
    g_Device.Reset(); g_EngineHeap.Reset(); g_Width = g_Height = g_Dispatches = 0; g_HistoryValid = false;
}

bool RayReflections::Execute(ID3D12GraphicsCommandList* commands, ID3D12Resource* scene,
    const vector<RaytracingGeometry>& geometry, const NrdFrame& nrdFrame,
    const array<ComPtr<ID3D12Resource>, 4>& guides, bool denoise)
{
    g_Dispatches = 0;
    g_OptixGiActive = g_OptixReflectionActive = false;
    g_GiActive = false;
    if (!commands || !scene || !g_Trace || geometry.empty()) return false;
    const UINT slot = nrdFrame.FrameIndex % kFrames;
    g_LastFrame = slot;
    auto* depth = RenderTargets::GetGBufferResource(GBufferType::DEPTH);
    auto* normal = RenderTargets::GetGBufferResource(GBufferType::NORMAL);
    auto* material = RenderTargets::GetGBufferResource(GBufferType::MATERIAL);
    if (!depth || !normal || !material) return false;
    const auto extent = depth->GetDesc();
    auto& frame = g_Frames[slot];
    if (!EnsureFrame(frame, slot, static_cast<UINT>(extent.Width), extent.Height)) return false;
    frame.Geometry = geometry;
    const UINT count = static_cast<UINT>((min)(geometry.size(), static_cast<size_t>(kMaximumMeshes)));
    vector<MeshConstants> meshes(count);
    vector<UINT> emitters;
    map<ID3D12Resource*, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATES> sampledResources;
    sampledResources.emplace(depth, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE);
    sampledResources.emplace(normal, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE);
    sampledResources.emplace(material, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE);
    for (UINT i = 0; i < count; ++i)
    {
        const auto& geometry = frame.Geometry[i];
        auto& mesh = meshes[i];
        const XMMATRIX world = XMLoadFloat4x4(&geometry.World);
        XMStoreFloat4x4(&mesh.World, XMMatrixTranspose(world));
        XMStoreFloat4x4(&mesh.NormalToWorld, XMMatrixInverse(nullptr, world));
        mesh.Layout = { geometry.VertexView.StrideInBytes,
            geometry.Indices ? (geometry.IndexView.Format == DXGI_FORMAT_R16_UINT ? 16u : 32u) : 0u,
            static_cast<UINT>(geometry.VertexView.BufferLocation - geometry.Vertices->GetGPUVirtualAddress()),
            geometry.Indices ? static_cast<UINT>(geometry.IndexView.BufferLocation - geometry.Indices->GetGPUVirtualAddress()) : 0u };
        mesh.Material = { geometry.Roughness, geometry.Metallic, static_cast<float>(geometry.Texture != nullptr), 0 };
        mesh.BaseColor = geometry.BaseColor;
        mesh.Emission = geometry.Emission;
        UINT triangleCount = geometry.IndexCount / 3;
        if (!geometry.Indices)
        {
            triangleCount = geometry.VertexView.SizeInBytes / geometry.VertexView.StrideInBytes / 3;
        }
        mesh.Surface = { triangleCount, static_cast<UINT>(geometry.EmissionTexture != nullptr), 0, 0 };
        if (geometry.Emission.w > 0 && (geometry.Emission.x > 0 || geometry.Emission.y > 0 || geometry.Emission.z > 0))
        {
            emitters.push_back(i);
        }
        TextureSrv(geometry.EmissionTexture.Get(), Cpu(frame.Heap.Get(), kEmissionDescriptors + i), geometry.EmissionResidentMip);
        if (geometry.EmissionTexture)
        {
            sampledResources.emplace(geometry.EmissionTexture.Get(), D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE);
        }
        BufferSrv(geometry.Vertices.Get(), Cpu(frame.Heap.Get(), kVertexDescriptors + i));
        BufferSrv(geometry.Indices.Get(), Cpu(frame.Heap.Get(), kIndexDescriptors + i));
        if (geometry.Texture)
        {
            TextureSrv(geometry.Texture.Get(), Cpu(frame.Heap.Get(), kTextureDescriptors + i), geometry.TextureResidentMip);
            sampledResources.emplace(geometry.Texture.Get(), D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE);
        }
        else TextureSrv(nullptr, Cpu(frame.Heap.Get(), kTextureDescriptors + i));
        sampledResources.emplace(geometry.Vertices.Get(), geometry.VertexState);
        if (geometry.Indices) sampledResources.emplace(geometry.Indices.Get(), geometry.IndexState);
    }
    if (!EnsureUpload(frame.Meshes, meshes.size() * sizeof(MeshConstants)) ||
        !Upload(frame.Meshes.Get(), meshes.data(), meshes.size() * sizeof(MeshConstants))) return false;
    if (!EnsureUpload(frame.Emitters, (max)(size_t(4), emitters.size() * sizeof(UINT))) ||
        (!emitters.empty() && !Upload(frame.Emitters.Get(), emitters.data(), emitters.size() * sizeof(UINT)))) return false;
    FrameConstants constants;
    vector<ReflectionLight> lights;
    lights.reserve(RendererState::g_kMAX_SHADER_LIGHTS);
    for (EntityID entity : World::GetView<LightComponent, TransformComponent>())
    {
        const auto& light = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<LightComponent>(entity);
        if (!light.IsActive || !light.AffectsOpaque || light.RenderMode != LightRenderMode::Physical || light.Intensity <= 0) continue;
        if (lights.size() >= RendererState::g_kMAX_SHADER_LIGHTS) break;
        const auto& transform = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<TransformComponent>(entity);
        XMFLOAT3 direction;
        XMStoreFloat3(&direction, XMVector3Normalize(XMLoadFloat3(&light.Direction)));
        ReflectionLight entry;
        entry.Direction = { direction.x, direction.y, direction.z, light.Range };
        entry.Color = { light.Color.x, light.Color.y, light.Color.z, light.Intensity * 1.35f };
        entry.PositionType = { transform.Position.x, transform.Position.y, transform.Position.z, static_cast<float>(light.Type) };
        entry.Extras = { cosf(XMConvertToRadians(light.InnerAngle)), cosf(XMConvertToRadians(light.OuterAngle)),
            light.VolumeDensity, static_cast<float>(light.VolumeShape) };
        entry.Flags.x = static_cast<UINT>(light.CastShadow);
        lights.push_back(entry);
    }
    if (!EnsureUpload(frame.Lights, (max)(sizeof(ReflectionLight), lights.size() * sizeof(ReflectionLight))) ||
        (!lights.empty() && !Upload(frame.Lights.Get(), lights.data(), lights.size() * sizeof(ReflectionLight)))) return false;
    const XMMATRIX view = XMLoadFloat4x4(&nrdFrame.View);
    XMMATRIX projection = XMLoadFloat4x4(&nrdFrame.Projection);
    // Restore the jitter used by this frame's GBuffer.
    XMFLOAT4X4 jittered; XMStoreFloat4x4(&jittered, projection);
    jittered._31 = -nrdFrame.Jitter.x * 2 / frame.Width;
    jittered._32 = nrdFrame.Jitter.y * 2 / frame.Height;
    projection = XMLoadFloat4x4(&jittered);
    XMStoreFloat4x4(&constants.InvViewProjection, XMMatrixTranspose(XMMatrixInverse(nullptr, view * projection)));
    XMStoreFloat4x4(&constants.View, XMMatrixTranspose(view));
    XMStoreFloat4x4(&constants.ViewProjection, XMMatrixTranspose(view * projection));
    XMStoreFloat4(&constants.Camera, XMMatrixInverse(nullptr, view).r[3]);
    constants.Camera.w = nrdFrame.Range;
    constants.Extent = { frame.Width, frame.Height, nrdFrame.Sequence, static_cast<UINT>(lights.size()) };
    // Motion guides cannot detect a change in emitted radiance on a stationary mesh.
    // Restart only this signal when the emissive material or emitter transform changes.
    uint64_t emissionSignature = 14695981039346656037ull;
    for (UINT emitter : emitters)
    {
        const auto& source = frame.Geometry[emitter];
        HashEmission(emissionSignature, &emitter, sizeof(emitter));
        HashEmission(emissionSignature, &source.Emission, sizeof(source.Emission));
        HashEmission(emissionSignature, &source.World, sizeof(source.World));
        const auto texture = reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>(source.EmissionTexture.Get());
        HashEmission(emissionSignature, &texture, sizeof(texture));
    }
    const float giDistance = RendererSettings::GetGiDistance();
    HashEmission(emissionSignature, &giDistance, sizeof(giDistance));
    if (emissionSignature != g_GiEmissionSignature)
    {
        g_GiHistoryValid = false;
        g_GiEmissionSignature = emissionSignature;
    }
    const bool useOptix = denoise && Raytracing::GetSettings().RadianceDenoiser == Raytracing::DenoiserType::Optix &&
        OptixDenoiser::IsAvailable();
    const bool useGiDenoiser = denoise && !useOptix && NrdDenoiser::IsCompiled() && guides[0] && guides[1] && guides[2];
    constants.GiParameters = { RendererSettings::GetGiDistance(), RendererSettings::GetSsgiIntensity(),
        static_cast<float>(useGiDenoiser), static_cast<float>(emitters.size()) };
    if (!Upload(frame.Constants.Get(), &constants, sizeof(constants))) return false;
    for (auto [resource, state] : sampledResources)
        if ((state & D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_NON_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE) == 0)
            Transition(commands, resource, state, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_NON_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE);
    for (UINT i = 0; i < 3; ++i)
    {
        const auto type = i == 0 ? GBufferType::DEPTH : i == 1 ? GBufferType::NORMAL : GBufferType::MATERIAL;
        TextureSrv(RenderTargets::GetGBufferResource(type), Cpu(frame.Heap.Get(), i));
        TextureSrv(RenderTargets::GetGBufferResource(type), Cpu(frame.Heap.Get(), 8 + i));
    }
    TextureSrv(nullptr, Cpu(frame.Heap.Get(), 3));
    auto bind = [&](ID3D12PipelineState* pipeline)
    {
        ID3D12DescriptorHeap* heaps[] = { frame.Heap.Get() }; commands->SetDescriptorHeaps(1, heaps);
        commands->SetComputeRootSignature(g_Root.Get()); commands->SetPipelineState(pipeline);
        commands->SetComputeRootShaderResourceView(0, scene->GetGPUVirtualAddress());
        commands->SetComputeRootShaderResourceView(1, frame.Meshes->GetGPUVirtualAddress());
        commands->SetComputeRootConstantBufferView(2, frame.Constants->GetGPUVirtualAddress());
        commands->SetComputeRootConstantBufferView(3, LightingResources::GetCurrentLightConstantBufferAddress());
        commands->SetComputeRootConstantBufferView(4, Raytracing::GetLightingConstantsAddress(slot));
        commands->SetComputeRootDescriptorTable(5, Gpu(frame.Heap.Get(), 0));
        commands->SetComputeRootDescriptorTable(6, Gpu(frame.Heap.Get(), 4));
        commands->SetComputeRootDescriptorTable(7, Gpu(frame.Heap.Get(), kVertexDescriptors));
        commands->SetComputeRootDescriptorTable(8, Gpu(frame.Heap.Get(), kIndexDescriptors));
        commands->SetComputeRootDescriptorTable(9, Gpu(frame.Heap.Get(), kTextureDescriptors));
        commands->SetComputeRootShaderResourceView(10, frame.Lights->GetGPUVirtualAddress());
        commands->SetComputeRootDescriptorTable(11, Gpu(frame.Heap.Get(), kEmissionDescriptors));
        commands->SetComputeRootShaderResourceView(12, frame.Emitters->GetGPUVirtualAddress());
    };
    if (Raytracing::GetSettings().Reflections)
    {
        Transition(commands, frame.Noisy.Get(), D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS);
        Transition(commands, frame.Result.Get(), D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS);
        bind(g_Trace.Get()); commands->Dispatch((frame.Width + 7) / 8, (frame.Height + 7) / 8, 1);
        Transition(commands, frame.Noisy.Get(), D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE);
        Transition(commands, frame.Result.Get(), D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE);
        // NRD owns a separate heap and restores these four input states.
        if (useOptix)
        {
            if (!g_OptixReflections)
            {
                g_OptixReflections = make_unique<OptixDenoiser>();
            }
            g_OptixReflectionActive = g_OptixReflections->Execute(commands, frame.Noisy.Get(), depth, normal,
                frame.Result.Get(), nrdFrame, NrdDenoiser::IsCompiled(), true, 1.0f);
            g_HistoryValid = false;
        }
        else if (denoise && NrdDenoiser::IsCompiled() && guides[0] && guides[1] && guides[2])
        {
            if (!g_Denoiser || g_Width != frame.Width || g_Height != frame.Height)
            {
                if (GraphicsDevice::WaitForGpuIdle())
                {
                    auto created = make_unique<NrdDenoiser>();
                    if (created->Initialize(g_Device.Get(), NrdSignal::Specular, frame.Width, frame.Height))
                    { g_Denoiser = move(created); g_Width = frame.Width; g_Height = frame.Height; g_HistoryValid = false; }
                }
            }
            NrdFrame temporalFrame = nrdFrame;
            temporalFrame.ResetHistory = temporalFrame.ResetHistory || !g_HistoryValid;
            NrdInputs inputs{ {guides[0].Get()}, {guides[1].Get()}, {guides[2].Get()}, {frame.Noisy.Get()} };
            if (g_Denoiser && g_Width == frame.Width && g_Height == frame.Height && g_Denoiser->Execute(commands, inputs, temporalFrame))
            {
                TextureSrv(g_Denoiser->GetOutput(), Cpu(frame.Heap.Get(), 3));
                Transition(commands, g_Denoiser->GetOutput(), D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_NON_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE);
                Transition(commands, frame.Result.Get(), D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS);
                bind(g_Compose.Get()); commands->Dispatch((frame.Width + 7) / 8, (frame.Height + 7) / 8, 1);
                Transition(commands, frame.Result.Get(), D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE);
                Transition(commands, g_Denoiser->GetOutput(), D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_NON_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE);
                g_Dispatches = g_Denoiser->GetDispatchCount(); g_HistoryValid = true;
            }
            else g_HistoryValid = false;
        }
        else g_HistoryValid = false;
    }
    if (RendererSettings::GetRealtimeGiEnabled())
    {
        RenderProfiler::ScopedEvent profile("Realtime GI Trace and Filter", commands);
        Transition(commands, frame.GiNoisy.Get(), D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS);
        Transition(commands, frame.GiResult.Get(), D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS);
        bind(g_GiTrace.Get());
        commands->SetComputeRootDescriptorTable(5, Gpu(frame.Heap.Get(), 8));
        commands->SetComputeRootDescriptorTable(6, Gpu(frame.Heap.Get(), 6));
        UINT traceWidth = frame.Width;
        if (useGiDenoiser)
        {
            traceWidth = (traceWidth + 1) / 2;
        }
        commands->Dispatch((traceWidth + 7) / 8, (frame.Height + 7) / 8, 1);
        Transition(commands, frame.GiNoisy.Get(), D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE);
        Transition(commands, frame.GiResult.Get(), D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE);
        bool filtered = false;
        bool temporalFiltered = false;
        if (useOptix)
        {
            if (!g_OptixGi)
            {
                g_OptixGi = make_unique<OptixDenoiser>();
            }
            g_OptixGiActive = g_OptixGi->Execute(commands, frame.GiNoisy.Get(), depth, normal,
                frame.GiResult.Get(), nrdFrame, NrdDenoiser::IsCompiled(), false, RendererSettings::GetSsgiIntensity());
            filtered = g_OptixGiActive;
        }
        if (useGiDenoiser)
        {
            if (!g_GiDenoiser || g_GiWidth != frame.Width || g_GiHeight != frame.Height)
            {
                // Resize destroys resources referenced by earlier frames only after their fences complete.
                if (!GraphicsDevice::WaitForGpuIdle()) return false;
                auto created = make_unique<NrdDenoiser>();
                if (created->Initialize(g_Device.Get(), NrdSignal::Diffuse, frame.Width, frame.Height))
                {
                    g_GiDenoiser = move(created);
                    g_GiWidth = frame.Width;
                    g_GiHeight = frame.Height;
                    g_GiHistoryValid = false;
                }
            }
            NrdFrame temporalFrame = nrdFrame;
            temporalFrame.ResetHistory |= !g_GiHistoryValid;
            NrdInputs inputs{ {guides[0].Get()}, {guides[1].Get()}, {guides[2].Get()}, {frame.GiNoisy.Get()} };
            if (g_GiDenoiser && g_GiWidth == frame.Width && g_GiHeight == frame.Height &&
                g_GiDenoiser->Execute(commands, inputs, temporalFrame))
            {
                TextureSrv(g_GiDenoiser->GetOutput(), Cpu(frame.Heap.Get(), 11));
                Transition(commands, g_GiDenoiser->GetOutput(), D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_NON_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE);
                Transition(commands, frame.GiResult.Get(), D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS);
                bind(g_GiCompose.Get());
                commands->SetComputeRootDescriptorTable(5, Gpu(frame.Heap.Get(), 8));
                commands->SetComputeRootDescriptorTable(6, Gpu(frame.Heap.Get(), 6));
                commands->Dispatch((frame.Width + 7) / 8, (frame.Height + 7) / 8, 1);
                Transition(commands, frame.GiResult.Get(), D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE);
                Transition(commands, g_GiDenoiser->GetOutput(), D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_NON_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE);
                g_Dispatches += g_GiDenoiser->GetDispatchCount();
                filtered = true;
                temporalFiltered = true;
            }
        }
        if (!filtered)
        {
            TextureSrv(frame.GiNoisy.Get(), Cpu(frame.Heap.Get(), 11));
            Transition(commands, frame.GiNoisy.Get(), D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_NON_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE);
            Transition(commands, frame.GiResult.Get(), D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS);
            bind(g_GiFilter.Get());
            commands->SetComputeRootDescriptorTable(5, Gpu(frame.Heap.Get(), 8));
            commands->SetComputeRootDescriptorTable(6, Gpu(frame.Heap.Get(), 6));
            commands->Dispatch((frame.Width + 7) / 8, (frame.Height + 7) / 8, 1);
            Transition(commands, frame.GiResult.Get(), D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE);
            Transition(commands, frame.GiNoisy.Get(), D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_NON_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE);
        }
        g_GiHistoryValid = temporalFiltered;
        g_GiActive = true;
    }
    else
    {
        g_GiHistoryValid = false;
    }
    for (auto [resource, state] : sampledResources)
        if ((state & D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_NON_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE) == 0)
            Transition(commands, resource, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_NON_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE, state);
    ID3D12DescriptorHeap* engine[] = { g_EngineHeap.Get() }; commands->SetDescriptorHeaps(1, engine);
    return true;
}
D3D12_GPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE RayReflections::GetResultSrv(UINT frameIndex)
{
    return Gpu(g_EngineHeap.Get(), kResultSrv + frameIndex % kFrames);
}
UINT RayReflections::GetDenoiserDispatchCount() { return g_Dispatches; }

    // command list. Keep replaced resources until this frame's fence is reused.

    UINT Height = 0;
};

D3D12_CPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE Cpu(UINT index)
{
    return CD3DX12_CPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE(g_Heap->GetCPUDescriptorHandleForHeapStart(), index, g_Increment);

bool EnsureBuffer(ComPtr<ID3D12Resource>& resource, UINT64 bytes,
    D3D12_HEAP_TYPE heapType, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATES state, const wchar_t* name)
{
    bytes = (bytes + 255ull) & ~255ull;
    if (resource && resource->GetDesc().Width >= bytes)
    {
        return true;
    }
    const auto heap = CD3DX12_HEAP_PROPERTIES(heapType);
    D3D12_RESOURCE_FLAGS flags = D3D12_RESOURCE_FLAG_NONE;
    if (heapType == D3D12_HEAP_TYPE_DEFAULT)
    {
        flags = D3D12_RESOURCE_FLAG_ALLOW_UNORDERED_ACCESS;
    }
    const auto description = CD3DX12_RESOURCE_DESC::Buffer(bytes, flags);
    ComPtr<ID3D12Resource> created;
    const HRESULT result = g_Device->CreateCommittedResource(&heap, D3D12_HEAP_FLAG_NONE,
        &description, state, nullptr, IID_PPV_ARGS(&created));
    if (FAILED(result))
    {
        Debug::Log("DXR: buffer allocation failed (0x%08X)\n", static_cast<unsigned int>(result));
        return false;
    }
    created->SetName(name);
    if (resource) g_Frames[g_FrameIndex].Retired.push_back(resource);
    resource = move(created);
    return true;
}

void Transition(ID3D12GraphicsCommandList* commandList, ID3D12Resource* resource,
    D3D12_RESOURCE_STATES before, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATES after)
{
    if (resource && before != after && before != D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_GENERIC_READ &&
        after != D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_GENERIC_READ)
    {
        const auto barrier = CD3DX12_RESOURCE_BARRIER::Transition(resource, before, after);
        commandList->ResourceBarrier(1, &barrier);
    }
}

bool EnsureOutput(FrameResources& frame, UINT width, UINT height)
{
    if (frame.Result && frame.Width == width && frame.Height == height)
    {
        return true;
    }
    const auto heap = CD3DX12_HEAP_PROPERTIES(D3D12_HEAP_TYPE_DEFAULT);
    const auto description = CD3DX12_RESOURCE_DESC::Tex2D(DXGI_FORMAT_R16G16_FLOAT,
        width, height, 1, 1, 1, 0, D3D12_RESOURCE_FLAG_ALLOW_UNORDERED_ACCESS);
    ComPtr<ID3D12Resource> created;
    if (FAILED(g_Device->CreateCommittedResource(&heap, D3D12_HEAP_FLAG_NONE, &description,
        D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE, nullptr, IID_PPV_ARGS(&created))))
    {
        return false;
    }
    created->SetName(L"Raytraced Sun Shadow and AO");
    frame.Result = move(created);
    frame.Width = width;
    frame.Height = height;
    D3D12_SHADER_RESOURCE_VIEW_DESC srv{};
    srv.Format = description.Format;
    srv.ViewDimension = D3D12_SRV_DIMENSION_TEXTURE2D;
    srv.Shader4ComponentMapping = D3D12_DEFAULT_SHADER_4_COMPONENT_MAPPING;
    srv.Texture2D.MipLevels = 1;
    g_Device->CreateShaderResourceView(frame.Result.Get(), &srv, Cpu(kSrvStart + g_FrameIndex));
    D3D12_UNORDERED_ACCESS_VIEW_DESC uav{};
    uav.Format = description.Format;
    uav.ViewDimension = D3D12_UAV_DIMENSION_TEXTURE2D;
    g_Device->CreateUnorderedAccessView(frame.Result.Get(), nullptr, &uav, Cpu(kUavStart + g_FrameIndex));
    return true;
}

bool EnsureDenoiser(FrameResources& frame)
{
    if (!NrdDenoiser::IsCompiled() || !g_ComposeShadow) return false;
    constexpr DXGI_FORMAT formats[] = { DXGI_FORMAT_R16G16_FLOAT, DXGI_FORMAT_R10G10B10A2_UNORM,
        DXGI_FORMAT_R32_FLOAT, DXGI_FORMAT_R16_FLOAT };
    for (UINT index = 0; index < frame.Guides.size(); ++index)
    {
        auto& guide = frame.Guides[index];
        if (guide && guide->GetDesc().Width == frame.Width && guide->GetDesc().Height == frame.Height) continue;
        const auto heap = CD3DX12_HEAP_PROPERTIES(D3D12_HEAP_TYPE_DEFAULT);
        const auto description = CD3DX12_RESOURCE_DESC::Tex2D(formats[index], frame.Width, frame.Height,
            1, 1, 1, 0, D3D12_RESOURCE_FLAG_ALLOW_UNORDERED_ACCESS);
        if (FAILED(g_Device->CreateCommittedResource(&heap, D3D12_HEAP_FLAG_NONE, &description,
            D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE, nullptr, IID_PPV_ARGS(guide.ReleaseAndGetAddressOf())))) return false;
        guide->SetName(L"NRD Primary Surface Guide");
        D3D12_UNORDERED_ACCESS_VIEW_DESC uav{};
        uav.Format = formats[index];
        uav.ViewDimension = D3D12_UAV_DIMENSION_TEXTURE2D;
        g_Device->CreateUnorderedAccessView(guide.Get(), nullptr, &uav, Cpu(kGuideUavStart + g_FrameIndex * 5 + index));
    }
    if (!frame.AmbientGuide || frame.AmbientGuide->GetDesc().Width != frame.Width || frame.AmbientGuide->GetDesc().Height != frame.Height)
    {
        const auto heap = CD3DX12_HEAP_PROPERTIES(D3D12_HEAP_TYPE_DEFAULT);
        const auto desc = CD3DX12_RESOURCE_DESC::Tex2D(DXGI_FORMAT_R16_FLOAT, frame.Width, frame.Height,
            1, 1, 1, 0, D3D12_RESOURCE_FLAG_ALLOW_UNORDERED_ACCESS);
        if (FAILED(g_Device->CreateCommittedResource(&heap, D3D12_HEAP_FLAG_NONE, &desc,
            D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE, nullptr, IID_PPV_ARGS(frame.AmbientGuide.ReleaseAndGetAddressOf())))) return false;
        D3D12_UNORDERED_ACCESS_VIEW_DESC uav{};
        uav.Format = desc.Format; uav.ViewDimension = D3D12_UAV_DIMENSION_TEXTURE2D;
        g_Device->CreateUnorderedAccessView(frame.AmbientGuide.Get(), nullptr, &uav, Cpu(kGuideUavStart + g_FrameIndex * 5 + 4));
    }
    if (!g_NrdSun || g_NrdWidth != frame.Width || g_NrdHeight != frame.Height)
    {
        // Histories are shared across queued frames; retire them only after the queue has completed.
        if (!GraphicsDevice::WaitForGpuIdle()) return false;
        auto created = make_unique<NrdDenoiser>();
        if (!created->Initialize(g_Device.Get(), NrdSignal::Shadow, frame.Width, frame.Height)) return false;
        auto ambient = make_unique<NrdDenoiser>();
        if (!ambient->Initialize(g_Device.Get(), NrdSignal::AmbientOcclusion, frame.Width, frame.Height)) return false;
        g_NrdSun = move(created);
        g_NrdAmbient = move(ambient);
        g_NrdWidth = frame.Width;
        g_NrdHeight = frame.Height;
        g_NrdHistoryValid = false;
    }
    return true;
}

// Each BLAS owns its scratch allocation, so independent builds can overlap.
// Restore geometry states even if allocation of a later BLAS fails.
class GeometryReadBatch
{
public:
    explicit GeometryReadBatch(ID3D12GraphicsCommandList* commandList) : m_CommandList(commandList) {}

    void Add(ID3D12Resource* resource, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATES state)
    {
        if (!resource || state == D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_GENERIC_READ ||
            state == D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_NON_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE ||
            !m_Resources.emplace(resource, state).second)
        {
            return;
        }
        m_ReadBarriers.push_back(CD3DX12_RESOURCE_BARRIER::Transition(
            resource, state, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_NON_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE));
        m_FinishBarriers.push_back(CD3DX12_RESOURCE_BARRIER::Transition(
            resource, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_NON_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE, state));
    }

    void Begin()
    {
        if (!m_ReadBarriers.empty())
        {
            m_CommandList->ResourceBarrier(static_cast<UINT>(m_ReadBarriers.size()), m_ReadBarriers.data());
        }
    }

    void PrepareUpdate(ID3D12Resource* result)
    {
        // Raster lighting may query this frame slot's previous TLAS before
        // Execute updates its BLASes. Finish those reads before refitting.
        if (result)
        {
            m_ReadBarriers.push_back(CD3DX12_RESOURCE_BARRIER::UAV(result));
        }
    }

    void CompleteBuild(ID3D12Resource* result)
    {
        m_FinishBarriers.push_back(CD3DX12_RESOURCE_BARRIER::UAV(result));
    }

    void Finish()
    {
        if (!m_FinishBarriers.empty())
        {
            m_CommandList->ResourceBarrier(static_cast<UINT>(m_FinishBarriers.size()), m_FinishBarriers.data());
            m_FinishBarriers.clear();
        }
    }

    ~GeometryReadBatch() { Finish(); }

private:
    ID3D12GraphicsCommandList* m_CommandList;
    map<ID3D12Resource*, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATES> m_Resources;
    vector<D3D12_RESOURCE_BARRIER> m_ReadBarriers;
    vector<D3D12_RESOURCE_BARRIER> m_FinishBarriers;
};

bool BuildBottomLevel(ID3D12GraphicsCommandList4* commandList, const RaytracingGeometry& geometry,
    BottomLevel& level, GeometryReadBatch& geometryReads)
{
    level.LastSeen = g_Serial;
    if (level.Result && (!geometry.Deforming || level.LastBuilt == g_Serial))
    {
        return true;
    }
    D3D12_RAYTRACING_GEOMETRY_DESC description{};
    description.Type = D3D12_RAYTRACING_GEOMETRY_TYPE_TRIANGLES;
    description.Flags = D3D12_RAYTRACING_GEOMETRY_FLAG_OPAQUE;
    description.Triangles.VertexBuffer.StartAddress = geometry.VertexView.BufferLocation;
    description.Triangles.VertexBuffer.StrideInBytes = geometry.VertexView.StrideInBytes;
    description.Triangles.VertexCount = geometry.VertexView.SizeInBytes / geometry.VertexView.StrideInBytes;
    description.Triangles.VertexFormat = DXGI_FORMAT_R32G32B32_FLOAT;
    description.Triangles.IndexBuffer = geometry.IndexView.BufferLocation;
    description.Triangles.IndexCount = geometry.IndexCount;
    description.Triangles.IndexFormat = geometry.IndexView.Format;
    if (!geometry.Indices)
    {
        description.Triangles.IndexFormat = DXGI_FORMAT_UNKNOWN;
    }
    D3D12_BUILD_RAYTRACING_ACCELERATION_STRUCTURE_INPUTS inputs{};
    inputs.Type = D3D12_RAYTRACING_ACCELERATION_STRUCTURE_TYPE_BOTTOM_LEVEL;
    inputs.DescsLayout = D3D12_ELEMENTS_LAYOUT_ARRAY;
    inputs.NumDescs = 1;
    inputs.pGeometryDescs = &description;
    inputs.Flags = D3D12_RAYTRACING_ACCELERATION_STRUCTURE_BUILD_FLAG_PREFER_FAST_TRACE;
    if (geometry.Deforming)
    {
        inputs.Flags = D3D12_RAYTRACING_ACCELERATION_STRUCTURE_BUILD_FLAG_ALLOW_UPDATE |
            D3D12_RAYTRACING_ACCELERATION_STRUCTURE_BUILD_FLAG_PREFER_FAST_BUILD;
    }
    D3D12_RAYTRACING_ACCELERATION_STRUCTURE_PREBUILD_INFO sizes{};
    g_Device->GetRaytracingAccelerationStructurePrebuildInfo(&inputs, &sizes);
    const bool update = geometry.Deforming && level.Result;
    if (sizes.ResultDataMaxSizeInBytes == 0 ||
        !EnsureBuffer(level.Result, sizes.ResultDataMaxSizeInBytes, D3D12_HEAP_TYPE_DEFAULT,
            D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_RAYTRACING_ACCELERATION_STRUCTURE, L"Scene BLAS") ||
        !EnsureBuffer(level.Scratch, (max)(sizes.ScratchDataSizeInBytes, sizes.UpdateScratchDataSizeInBytes),
            D3D12_HEAP_TYPE_DEFAULT, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS, L"BLAS Scratch"))
    {
        return false;
    }
    D3D12_BUILD_RAYTRACING_ACCELERATION_STRUCTURE_DESC build{};
    build.Inputs = inputs;
    build.DestAccelerationStructureData = level.Result->GetGPUVirtualAddress();
    build.ScratchAccelerationStructureData = level.Scratch->GetGPUVirtualAddress();
    if (update)
    {
        build.Inputs.Flags |= D3D12_RAYTRACING_ACCELERATION_STRUCTURE_BUILD_FLAG_PERFORM_UPDATE;
        build.SourceAccelerationStructureData = build.DestAccelerationStructureData;
    }
    // Upload heaps remain GENERIC_READ: it already includes NON_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE.
    commandList->BuildRaytracingAccelerationStructure(&build, 0, nullptr);
    geometryReads.CompleteBuild(level.Result.Get());
    level.Vertices = geometry.Vertices;
    level.Indices = geometry.Indices;
    level.LastBuilt = g_Serial;
    return true;
}

bool BuildScene(ID3D12GraphicsCommandList4* commandList, FrameResources& frame)
{
    RenderProfiler::ScopedEvent profile("DXR Acceleration Structures", commandList);
    const auto geometry = GatherRaytracingGeometry();
    frame.SceneGeometry.clear();
    vector<D3D12_RAYTRACING_INSTANCE_DESC> instances;
    instances.reserve((min)(geometry.size(), static_cast<size_t>(kMaximumInstances)));
    GeometryReadBatch geometryReads(commandList);
    // Match the instance limit and validity checks below. Cached static BLASes
    // need no input transitions; shared vertex/index resources transition once.
    size_t accepted = 0;
    for (const auto& entry : geometry)
    {
        if (accepted >= kMaximumInstances || entry.VertexView.StrideInBytes < sizeof(XMFLOAT3))
        {
            continue;
        }
        ++accepted;
        const GeometryKey key(entry.VertexView.BufferLocation, entry.IndexView.BufferLocation,
            entry.VertexView.SizeInBytes, entry.IndexCount, entry.VertexView.StrideInBytes);
        const auto bottom = frame.Geometry.find(key);
        if (bottom == frame.Geometry.end() || !bottom->second.Result || entry.Deforming)
        {
            geometryReads.Add(entry.Vertices.Get(), entry.VertexState);
            geometryReads.Add(entry.Indices.Get(), entry.IndexState);
            if (bottom != frame.Geometry.end())
            {
                geometryReads.PrepareUpdate(bottom->second.Result.Get());
            }
        }
    }
    geometryReads.Begin();
    for (const auto& entry : geometry)
    {
        if (instances.size() >= kMaximumInstances || entry.VertexView.StrideInBytes < sizeof(XMFLOAT3))
        {
            continue;
        }
        const GeometryKey key(entry.VertexView.BufferLocation, entry.IndexView.BufferLocation,
            entry.VertexView.SizeInBytes, entry.IndexCount, entry.VertexView.StrideInBytes);
        BottomLevel& bottom = frame.Geometry[key];
        if (!BuildBottomLevel(commandList, entry, bottom, geometryReads))
        {
            return false;
        }
        D3D12_RAYTRACING_INSTANCE_DESC instance{};
        XMFLOAT4X4 transform;
        XMStoreFloat4x4(&transform, XMMatrixTranspose(XMLoadFloat4x4(&entry.World)));
        memcpy(instance.Transform, &transform, sizeof(instance.Transform));
        instance.InstanceID = static_cast<UINT>(instances.size());
        // Bit zero is shadow visibility; bit one remains available to AO and reflections.
        instance.InstanceMask = entry.CastShadow ? 3 : 2;
        instance.Flags = D3D12_RAYTRACING_INSTANCE_FLAG_TRIANGLE_CULL_DISABLE;
        instance.AccelerationStructure = bottom.Result->GetGPUVirtualAddress();
        instances.push_back(instance);
        frame.SceneGeometry.push_back(entry);
    }
    // All BLAS writes must be visible before TLAS construction and ray queries.
    geometryReads.Finish();
    for (auto iterator = frame.Geometry.begin(); iterator != frame.Geometry.end();)
    {
        if (iterator->second.LastSeen != g_Serial)
        {
            const auto& bottom = iterator->second;
            if (bottom.Result) frame.Retired.push_back(bottom.Result);
            if (bottom.Scratch) frame.Retired.push_back(bottom.Scratch);
            if (bottom.Vertices) frame.Retired.push_back(bottom.Vertices);
            if (bottom.Indices) frame.Retired.push_back(bottom.Indices);
            iterator = frame.Geometry.erase(iterator);
        }
        else
        {
            ++iterator;
        }
    }
    g_InstanceCount = static_cast<UINT>(instances.size());
    if (instances.empty())
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (!EnsureBuffer(frame.Instances, instances.size() * sizeof(instances.front()), D3D12_HEAP_TYPE_UPLOAD,
        D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_GENERIC_READ, L"TLAS Instance Descriptions"))
    {
        return false;
    }
    void* mapped = nullptr;
    const CD3DX12_RANGE noRead(0, 0);
    if (FAILED(frame.Instances->Map(0, &noRead, &mapped)))
    {
        return false;
    }
    memcpy(mapped, instances.data(), instances.size() * sizeof(instances.front()));
    frame.Instances->Unmap(0, nullptr);
    D3D12_BUILD_RAYTRACING_ACCELERATION_STRUCTURE_INPUTS inputs{};
    inputs.Type = D3D12_RAYTRACING_ACCELERATION_STRUCTURE_TYPE_TOP_LEVEL;
    inputs.DescsLayout = D3D12_ELEMENTS_LAYOUT_ARRAY;
    inputs.NumDescs = g_InstanceCount;
    inputs.InstanceDescs = frame.Instances->GetGPUVirtualAddress();
    inputs.Flags = D3D12_RAYTRACING_ACCELERATION_STRUCTURE_BUILD_FLAG_PREFER_FAST_TRACE;
    D3D12_RAYTRACING_ACCELERATION_STRUCTURE_PREBUILD_INFO sizes{};
    g_Device->GetRaytracingAccelerationStructurePrebuildInfo(&inputs, &sizes);
    if (!EnsureBuffer(frame.TopLevel, sizes.ResultDataMaxSizeInBytes, D3D12_HEAP_TYPE_DEFAULT,
        D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_RAYTRACING_ACCELERATION_STRUCTURE, L"Scene TLAS") ||
        !EnsureBuffer(frame.Scratch, sizes.ScratchDataSizeInBytes, D3D12_HEAP_TYPE_DEFAULT,
            D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS, L"TLAS Scratch"))
    {
        return false;
    }
    D3D12_BUILD_RAYTRACING_ACCELERATION_STRUCTURE_DESC build{};
    build.Inputs = inputs;
    build.DestAccelerationStructureData = frame.TopLevel->GetGPUVirtualAddress();
    build.ScratchAccelerationStructureData = frame.Scratch->GetGPUVirtualAddress();
    commandList->BuildRaytracingAccelerationStructure(&build, 0, nullptr);
    const auto barrier = CD3DX12_RESOURCE_BARRIER::UAV(frame.TopLevel.Get());
    commandList->ResourceBarrier(1, &barrier);
    return true;
}

void FindSunDirection()
{
    g_SunDirection = {};
    for (EntityID entity : World::GetView<SunComponent, LightComponent>())
    {
        const auto& light = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<LightComponent>(entity);
        if (light.Type == LightType::Directional && light.RenderMode == LightRenderMode::Physical &&
            light.IsActive && light.CastShadow && light.AffectsOpaque && light.Intensity > 0.0f)
        {
            XMFLOAT3 direction;
            XMStoreFloat3(&direction, XMVector3Normalize(XMLoadFloat3(&light.Direction)));
            g_SunDirection = { direction.x, direction.y, direction.z, 1.0f };
            return;
        }
    }
}
}

bool Raytracing::Initialize(ID3D12Device* device, ID3D12DescriptorHeap* heap, UINT increment)
{
    Shutdown();
    g_Heap = heap;
    g_Increment = increment;
    if (!device || !heap || increment == 0)
    {
        return false;
    }
    D3D12_SHADER_RESOURCE_VIEW_DESC fallback{};
    fallback.Format = DXGI_FORMAT_R16G16_FLOAT;
    fallback.ViewDimension = D3D12_SRV_DIMENSION_TEXTURE2D;
    fallback.Shader4ComponentMapping = D3D12_DEFAULT_SHADER_4_COMPONENT_MAPPING;
    fallback.Texture2D.MipLevels = 1;
    device->CreateShaderResourceView(nullptr, &fallback, Cpu(kFallbackSrv));
	char disabled[8]{};
	if (GetEnvironmentVariableA("DX12_DISABLE_DXR", disabled, sizeof(disabled)) > 0 && atoi(disabled) != 0)
	{
		g_Status = "検証設定で DXR を無効にしています";
		WriteGraphicsLog("DXR: disabled by validation override; raster fallback\n");
		return false;
	}
    D3D12_FEATURE_DATA_D3D12_OPTIONS5 options{};
    D3D12_FEATURE_DATA_SHADER_MODEL shaderModel{ D3D_SHADER_MODEL_6_5 };
    if (FAILED(device->CheckFeatureSupport(D3D12_FEATURE_D3D12_OPTIONS5, &options, sizeof(options))) ||
        options.RaytracingTier < D3D12_RAYTRACING_TIER_1_1 ||
        FAILED(device->CheckFeatureSupport(D3D12_FEATURE_SHADER_MODEL, &shaderModel, sizeof(shaderModel))) ||
        shaderModel.HighestShaderModel < D3D_SHADER_MODEL_6_5 ||
        FAILED(device->QueryInterface(IID_PPV_ARGS(&g_Device))))
    {
        g_Status = "DXR Tier 1.1 / Shader Model 6.5 非対応";
        WriteGraphicsLog("DXR: unavailable; keeping raster rendering\n");
        return false;
    }
    CD3DX12_DESCRIPTOR_RANGE ranges[8];
    ranges[0].Init(D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_RANGE_TYPE_SRV, 1, 1);
    ranges[1].Init(D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_RANGE_TYPE_SRV, 1, 2);
    ranges[2].Init(D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_RANGE_TYPE_UAV, 1, 0);
    ranges[3].Init(D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_RANGE_TYPE_UAV, 5, 1);
    ranges[4].Init(D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_RANGE_TYPE_SRV, 1, 3);
    ranges[5].Init(D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_RANGE_TYPE_SRV, 1, 4);
    ranges[6].Init(D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_RANGE_TYPE_SRV, 1, 5);
    ranges[7].Init(D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_RANGE_TYPE_SRV, 1, 6);
    CD3DX12_ROOT_PARAMETER parameters[10];
    parameters[0].InitAsShaderResourceView(0);
    for (UINT index = 0; index < 3; ++index)
    {
        parameters[index + 1].InitAsDescriptorTable(1, &ranges[index]);
    }
    parameters[4].InitAsConstantBufferView(0);
    for (UINT index = 3; index < 8; ++index) parameters[index + 2].InitAsDescriptorTable(1, &ranges[index]);
    const CD3DX12_ROOT_SIGNATURE_DESC rootDescription(10, parameters);
    ComPtr<ID3DBlob> serialized;
    ComPtr<ID3DBlob> errors;
    if (FAILED(D3D12SerializeRootSignature(&rootDescription, D3D_ROOT_SIGNATURE_VERSION_1, &serialized, &errors)) ||
        FAILED(device->CreateRootSignature(0, serialized->GetBufferPointer(), serialized->GetBufferSize(),
            IID_PPV_ARGS(&g_RootSignature))))
    {
        g_Status = "DXR root signature 作成失敗";
        return false;
    }
    ComPtr<ID3DBlob> shader;
    if (FAILED(D3DReadFileToBlob(NrdDenoiser::IsCompiled() ?
        L"shader/hlsl/build/RaytracingNrdCS.cso" : L"shader/hlsl/build/RaytracingCS.cso", &shader)))
    {
        g_Status = "RaytracingCS.cso がありません";
        return false;
    }
    D3D12_COMPUTE_PIPELINE_STATE_DESC pipeline{};
    pipeline.pRootSignature = g_RootSignature.Get();
    pipeline.CS = CD3DX12_SHADER_BYTECODE(shader.Get());
    if (FAILED(device->CreateComputePipelineState(&pipeline, IID_PPV_ARGS(&g_Pipeline))) ||
        !EnsureBuffer(g_Constants, kConstantStride * kFrameCount, D3D12_HEAP_TYPE_UPLOAD,
            D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_GENERIC_READ, L"Raytracing Frame Constants") ||
        !EnsureBuffer(g_LightingConstants, kLightingStride * kFrameCount, D3D12_HEAP_TYPE_UPLOAD,
            D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_GENERIC_READ, L"Scene Ray Lighting Constants"))
    {
        g_Pipeline.Reset();
        g_Status = "DXR pipeline 作成失敗";
        return false;
    }
    if (NrdDenoiser::IsCompiled())
    {
        shader.Reset();
        if (FAILED(D3DReadFileToBlob(L"shader/hlsl/build/NrdComposeShadowCS.cso", &shader))) return false;
        pipeline.CS = CD3DX12_SHADER_BYTECODE(shader.Get());
        if (FAILED(device->CreateComputePipelineState(&pipeline, IID_PPV_ARGS(&g_ComposeShadow)))) return false;
        shader.Reset();
        if (FAILED(D3DReadFileToBlob(L"shader/hlsl/build/NrdComposeAmbientCS.cso", &shader))) return false;
        pipeline.CS = CD3DX12_SHADER_BYTECODE(shader.Get());
        if (FAILED(device->CreateComputePipelineState(&pipeline, IID_PPV_ARGS(&g_ComposeAmbient)))) return false;
    }
    g_Status = "DXR Tier 1.1 対応";
    void* lightingData = nullptr;
    D3D12_RANGE noRead{ 0, 0 };
    if (SUCCEEDED(g_LightingConstants->Map(0, &noRead, &lightingData)))
    {
        memset(lightingData, 0, kLightingStride * kFrameCount);
        g_LightingConstants->Unmap(0, nullptr);
    }
    if (!RayReflections::Initialize(device, heap, increment))
        WriteGraphicsLog("DXR: reflection pipeline initialization failed\n");
    if (!OptixDenoiser::Initialize(device))
    {
        WriteGraphicsLog("OptiX unavailable: %s\n", OptixDenoiser::GetStatus());
    }
    WriteGraphicsLog("DXR: Tier 1.1 inline raytracing ready\n");
    return true;
}

void Raytracing::Shutdown()
{
    RayReflections::Shutdown();
    OptixDenoiser::Shutdown();
    g_NrdSun.reset();
    g_NrdWidth = g_NrdHeight = g_NrdDispatchCount = 0;
    g_NrdHistoryValid = false;
    g_NrdCamera = g_kINVALID_ENTITY;
    g_ComposeShadow.Reset();
    g_ComposeAmbient.Reset();
    g_NrdAmbient.reset();
    g_Frames = {};
    g_Constants.Reset();
    g_LightingConstants.Reset();
    g_LightShadowFlags = {};
    g_Pipeline.Reset();
    g_RootSignature.Reset();
    g_Device.Reset();
    g_Heap.Reset();
    g_Active = false;
    g_ReflectionsActive = false;
    g_GiActive = false;
    g_ShadowHistoryValid = false;
    g_AmbientHistoryValid = false;
    g_InstanceCount = 0;
    g_Serial = 0;
}

void Raytracing::Execute(ID3D12GraphicsCommandList* commandList, ID3D12Resource* depth, ID3D12Resource* normal,
    D3D12_GPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE depthSrv, D3D12_GPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE normalSrv, UINT frameIndex)
{
    g_Active = false;
    g_ReflectionsActive = false;
    g_GiActive = false;
    const bool shadowHistoryValid = g_ShadowHistoryValid;
    const bool ambientHistoryValid = g_AmbientHistoryValid;
    g_ShadowHistoryValid = false;
    g_AmbientHistoryValid = false;
    g_NrdDispatchCount = 0;
    g_AmbientDispatchCount = 0;
    g_InstanceCount = 0;
    g_FrameIndex = frameIndex % kFrameCount;
    g_Frames[g_FrameIndex].Retired.clear();
    auto updateLighting = [&](bool sceneReady)
    {
        if (!g_LightingConstants) return;
        LightingConstants lighting{};
        lighting.Flags = { static_cast<float>(UsesRaytracedShadows()),
            static_cast<float>(UsesRaytracedShadows()), static_cast<float>(sceneReady), 0.0f };
        lighting.Parameters = { clamp(g_Settings.ShadowDistance, 1.0f, 2000.0f),
            clamp(g_Settings.NormalBias, 0.001f, 0.1f), 0.0f, 0.0f };
        lighting.Lights = g_LightShadowFlags;
        void* mapped = nullptr;
        D3D12_RANGE noRead{ 0, 0 };
        if (SUCCEEDED(g_LightingConstants->Map(0, &noRead, &mapped)))
        {
            memcpy(static_cast<BYTE*>(mapped) + g_FrameIndex * kLightingStride, &lighting, sizeof(lighting));
            g_LightingConstants->Unmap(0, nullptr);
        }
    };
    updateLighting(false);
    if (!IsAvailable() || !g_Settings.Enabled || (!UsesRaytracedShadows() && !UsesRaytracedAmbientOcclusion() && !g_Settings.Reflections && !RendererSettings::GetRealtimeGiEnabled()) ||
        !commandList || !depth || !normal)
    {
        g_NrdHistoryValid = false;
        return;
    }
    RenderProfiler::ScopedEvent profile("DXR Shadows / AO", commandList);
    ++g_Serial;
    FrameResources& frame = g_Frames[g_FrameIndex];
    const auto extent = depth->GetDesc();
    ComPtr<ID3D12GraphicsCommandList4> rayCommands;
    if (FAILED(commandList->QueryInterface(IID_PPV_ARGS(&rayCommands))) ||
        !EnsureOutput(frame, static_cast<UINT>(extent.Width), extent.Height) || !BuildScene(rayCommands.Get(), frame))
    {
        return;
    }
    FindSunDirection();
    const EntityID cameraEntity = Camera::GetCameraEntity();
    if (cameraEntity != g_NrdCamera) g_NrdHistoryValid = false;
    g_NrdCamera = cameraEntity;
    // The NRD-enabled trace shader always produces its four guides, even when denoising is switched off.
    const bool guidesReady = !NrdDenoiser::IsCompiled() || EnsureDenoiser(frame);
    if (!guidesReady) return;
    XMMATRIX view;
    XMMATRIX projection;
    Camera::GetCameraMatrices(Camera::GetCameraEntity(), view, projection);
    Constants constants{};
    XMStoreFloat4x4(&constants.InvViewProjection, XMMatrixTranspose(XMMatrixInverse(nullptr, view * projection)));
    constants.SunDirection = g_SunDirection;
    constants.ExtentSamples = { frame.Width, frame.Height, static_cast<UINT>(clamp(g_Settings.Samples, 1, 8)), static_cast<UINT>(g_Serial) };
    constants.Distances = { clamp(g_Settings.ShadowDistance, 1.0f, 2000.0f),
        clamp(g_Settings.AmbientRadius, 0.05f, 10.0f), clamp(g_Settings.NormalBias, 0.001f, 0.1f),
        clamp(g_Settings.SunAngularRadius, 0.0f, 0.05f) };
    constants.Features = { static_cast<UINT>(UsesRaytracedShadows()), static_cast<UINT>(UsesRaytracedAmbientOcclusion()),
        static_cast<UINT>(NrdDenoiser::IsCompiled() && g_Settings.Denoise), 0 };
    if (constants.Features.x == 0 && constants.Features.y == 0)
    {
        // Reflections still need the guides, but repeated unoccluded samples add no information.
        constants.ExtentSamples.z = 1;
    }
    XMStoreFloat4x4(&constants.WorldToView, XMMatrixTranspose(view));
    NrdFrame nrdFrame;
    XMStoreFloat4x4(&nrdFrame.View, view);
    XMStoreFloat4x4(&nrdFrame.Projection, projection);
    nrdFrame.Jitter = { -nrdFrame.Projection._31 * frame.Width * 0.5f, nrdFrame.Projection._32 * frame.Height * 0.5f };
    nrdFrame.Projection._31 = nrdFrame.Projection._32 = 0;
    nrdFrame.PreviousView = g_NrdHistoryValid ? g_PreviousNrdFrame.View : nrdFrame.View;
    nrdFrame.PreviousProjection = g_NrdHistoryValid ? g_PreviousNrdFrame.Projection : nrdFrame.Projection;
    nrdFrame.PreviousJitter = g_NrdHistoryValid ? g_PreviousNrdFrame.Jitter : nrdFrame.Jitter;
    nrdFrame.LightDirection = { g_SunDirection.x, g_SunDirection.y, g_SunDirection.z };
    nrdFrame.FrameIndex = g_FrameIndex;
    nrdFrame.Sequence = static_cast<UINT>(g_Serial);
    nrdFrame.Range = 2000.0f;
    nrdFrame.AmbientRadius = constants.Distances.y;
    if (ComponentManager::HasComponent<CameraComponent>(cameraEntity))
        nrdFrame.Range = (max)(ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<CameraComponent>(cameraEntity).FarClip, 1.0f);
    nrdFrame.ResetHistory = !g_NrdHistoryValid;
    constants.Jitter = { nrdFrame.Jitter.x, nrdFrame.Jitter.y, nrdFrame.PreviousJitter.x, nrdFrame.PreviousJitter.y };
    memcpy(&constants.Features.w, &nrdFrame.Range, sizeof(float));
    void* mapped = nullptr;
    const CD3DX12_RANGE noRead(0, 0);
    if (FAILED(g_Constants->Map(0, &noRead, &mapped)))
    {
        return;
    }
    memcpy(static_cast<BYTE*>(mapped) + g_FrameIndex * kConstantStride, &constants, sizeof(constants));
    g_Constants->Unmap(0, nullptr);
    Transition(commandList, depth, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_NON_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE);
    Transition(commandList, normal, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_NON_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE);
    Transition(commandList, frame.Result.Get(), D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS);
    ID3D12Resource* velocity = RenderTargets::GetGBufferResource(GBufferType::VELOCITY);
    ID3D12Resource* material = RenderTargets::GetGBufferResource(GBufferType::MATERIAL);
    if (NrdDenoiser::IsCompiled())
    {
        for (auto& guide : frame.Guides) Transition(commandList, guide.Get(), D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS);
        Transition(commandList, frame.AmbientGuide.Get(), D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS);
        Transition(commandList, velocity, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_NON_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE);
        Transition(commandList, material, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_NON_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE);
    }
    ID3D12DescriptorHeap* heaps[] = { g_Heap.Get() };
    commandList->SetDescriptorHeaps(1, heaps);
    commandList->SetComputeRootSignature(g_RootSignature.Get());
    commandList->SetPipelineState(g_Pipeline.Get());
    commandList->SetComputeRootShaderResourceView(0, frame.TopLevel->GetGPUVirtualAddress());
    commandList->SetComputeRootDescriptorTable(1, depthSrv);
    commandList->SetComputeRootDescriptorTable(2, normalSrv);
    commandList->SetComputeRootDescriptorTable(3, Gpu(kUavStart + g_FrameIndex));
    commandList->SetComputeRootConstantBufferView(4, g_Constants->GetGPUVirtualAddress() + g_FrameIndex * kConstantStride);
    if (NrdDenoiser::IsCompiled())
    {
        commandList->SetComputeRootDescriptorTable(5, Gpu(kGuideUavStart + g_FrameIndex * 5));
        commandList->SetComputeRootDescriptorTable(6, RenderTargets::GetGBufferSrvHandle(GBufferType::VELOCITY));
        commandList->SetComputeRootDescriptorTable(7, RenderTargets::GetGBufferSrvHandle(GBufferType::MATERIAL));
    }
    {
        RenderProfiler::ScopedEvent traceProfile("DXR Shadow / AO Trace", commandList);
        commandList->Dispatch((frame.Width + 7) / 8, (frame.Height + 7) / 8, 1);
    }
    Transition(commandList, frame.Result.Get(), D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE);
    if (NrdDenoiser::IsCompiled())
    {
        RenderProfiler::ScopedEvent denoiseProfile("DXR Shadow / AO Denoise and Compose", commandList);
        for (auto& guide : frame.Guides) Transition(commandList, guide.Get(), D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE);
        Transition(commandList, frame.AmbientGuide.Get(), D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE);
        Transition(commandList, velocity, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_NON_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE);
        Transition(commandList, material, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_NON_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE);
        const bool denoise = g_Settings.Denoise && UsesRaytracedShadows() && g_SunDirection.w > 0.5f;
        NrdFrame sunFrame = nrdFrame;
        sunFrame.ResetHistory |= !shadowHistoryValid;
        const auto& oldDirection = g_PreviousNrdFrame.LightDirection;
        const float directionSimilarity = oldDirection.x * nrdFrame.LightDirection.x +
            oldDirection.y * nrdFrame.LightDirection.y + oldDirection.z * nrdFrame.LightDirection.z;
        if (directionSimilarity < 0.99f) sunFrame.ResetHistory = true;
        if (denoise && g_NrdSun->Execute(commandList,
            { { frame.Guides[0].Get() }, { frame.Guides[1].Get() }, { frame.Guides[2].Get() }, { frame.Guides[3].Get() } }, sunFrame))
        {
            g_NrdDispatchCount = g_NrdSun->GetDispatchCount();
            g_ShadowHistoryValid = true;
            D3D12_SHADER_RESOURCE_VIEW_DESC srv{};
            srv.Format = DXGI_FORMAT_R8_UNORM;
            srv.ViewDimension = D3D12_SRV_DIMENSION_TEXTURE2D;
            srv.Shader4ComponentMapping = D3D12_DEFAULT_SHADER_4_COMPONENT_MAPPING;
            srv.Texture2D.MipLevels = 1;
            g_Device->CreateShaderResourceView(g_NrdSun->GetOutput(), &srv, Cpu(kNrdShadowSrvStart + g_FrameIndex));
            commandList->SetDescriptorHeaps(1, heaps);
            commandList->SetComputeRootSignature(g_RootSignature.Get());
            commandList->SetPipelineState(g_ComposeShadow.Get());
            commandList->SetComputeRootDescriptorTable(1, depthSrv);
            commandList->SetComputeRootDescriptorTable(3, Gpu(kUavStart + g_FrameIndex));
            commandList->SetComputeRootConstantBufferView(4, g_Constants->GetGPUVirtualAddress() + g_FrameIndex * kConstantStride);
            commandList->SetComputeRootDescriptorTable(8, Gpu(kNrdShadowSrvStart + g_FrameIndex));
            Transition(commandList, g_NrdSun->GetOutput(), D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_NON_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE);
            Transition(commandList, frame.Result.Get(), D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS);
            commandList->Dispatch((frame.Width + 7) / 8, (frame.Height + 7) / 8, 1);
            Transition(commandList, frame.Result.Get(), D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE);
            Transition(commandList, g_NrdSun->GetOutput(), D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_NON_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE);
            if (g_Serial == 1) WriteGraphicsLog("NRD: SIGMA GPU dispatches=%u\n", g_NrdDispatchCount);
        }
        NrdFrame ambientFrame = nrdFrame;
        ambientFrame.ResetHistory |= !ambientHistoryValid;
        if (g_Settings.Denoise && UsesRaytracedAmbientOcclusion() && g_NrdAmbient->Execute(commandList,
            { { frame.Guides[0].Get() }, { frame.Guides[1].Get() }, { frame.Guides[2].Get() }, { frame.AmbientGuide.Get() } }, ambientFrame))
        {
            g_AmbientDispatchCount = g_NrdAmbient->GetDispatchCount();
            g_AmbientHistoryValid = true;
            g_NrdDispatchCount += g_AmbientDispatchCount;
            D3D12_SHADER_RESOURCE_VIEW_DESC srv{};
            srv.Format = DXGI_FORMAT_R16_UNORM; srv.ViewDimension = D3D12_SRV_DIMENSION_TEXTURE2D;
            srv.Shader4ComponentMapping = D3D12_DEFAULT_SHADER_4_COMPONENT_MAPPING; srv.Texture2D.MipLevels = 1;
            g_Device->CreateShaderResourceView(g_NrdAmbient->GetOutput(), &srv, Cpu(kNrdAmbientSrvStart + g_FrameIndex));
            commandList->SetDescriptorHeaps(1, heaps);
            commandList->SetComputeRootSignature(g_RootSignature.Get()); commandList->SetPipelineState(g_ComposeAmbient.Get());
            commandList->SetComputeRootDescriptorTable(1, depthSrv);
            commandList->SetComputeRootDescriptorTable(3, Gpu(kUavStart + g_FrameIndex));
            commandList->SetComputeRootConstantBufferView(4, g_Constants->GetGPUVirtualAddress() + g_FrameIndex * kConstantStride);
            commandList->SetComputeRootDescriptorTable(9, Gpu(kNrdAmbientSrvStart + g_FrameIndex));
            Transition(commandList, g_NrdAmbient->GetOutput(), D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_NON_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE);
            Transition(commandList, frame.Result.Get(), D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS);
            commandList->Dispatch((frame.Width + 7) / 8, (frame.Height + 7) / 8, 1);
            Transition(commandList, frame.Result.Get(), D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE);
            Transition(commandList, g_NrdAmbient->GetOutput(), D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_NON_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE);
        }
        commandList->SetDescriptorHeaps(1, heaps);
    }
    Transition(commandList, depth, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_NON_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE);
    Transition(commandList, normal, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_NON_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE);
    g_Active = true;
    updateLighting(true);
    if (g_Settings.Reflections || RendererSettings::GetRealtimeGiEnabled())
    {
        RenderProfiler::ScopedEvent reflectionProfile("DXR Reflections", commandList);
        const bool radianceReady = RayReflections::Execute(commandList, frame.TopLevel.Get(), frame.SceneGeometry,
            nrdFrame, frame.Guides, g_Settings.Denoise);
        g_ReflectionsActive = radianceReady && g_Settings.Reflections;
        g_GiActive = radianceReady && RendererSettings::GetRealtimeGiEnabled() && RayReflections::IsGiActive();
    }
    if (g_ReflectionsActive || g_GiActive) g_NrdDispatchCount += RayReflections::GetDenoiserDispatchCount();
    // Camera and motion history belongs to the scene, independently of enabled denoiser signals.
    g_PreviousNrdFrame = nrdFrame;
    g_NrdHistoryValid = true;
	if (g_Serial == 1)
	{
		WriteGraphicsLog("DXR: first dispatch, instances=%u extent=%ux%u\n", g_InstanceCount, frame.Width, frame.Height);
	}
}

bool Raytracing::IsAvailable() { return g_Pipeline != nullptr; }
bool Raytracing::UsesRaytracedShadows()
{
    if (!IsAvailable() || !g_Settings.Enabled || g_Settings.RenderMode != Mode::Full || !g_Settings.Shadows)
    {
        return false;
    }
    // The current inline ray query forces opaque geometry. Cutout shadows use
    // the material-aware raster pass until the ray path can evaluate texture alpha.
    for (EntityID entity : World::GetView<MaterialComponent>())
    {
        const auto& source = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<MaterialComponent>(entity);
        const size_t count = max(size_t(1), source.MaterialSlots.size());
        for (size_t slot = 0; slot < count; ++slot)
        {
            const auto& material = MaterialManager::Resolve(source, slot);
            if ((MaterialSystem::ResolveShadowMode(material) == MaterialShadowMode::AlphaTest ||
                MaterialSystem::ResolveShadowMode(material) == MaterialShadowMode::Transmittance) && MaterialSystem::CastsShadow(material))
            {
                return false;
            }
        }
    }
    return true;
}
bool Raytracing::UsesRaytracedAmbientOcclusion()
{
    return IsAvailable() && g_Settings.Enabled && g_Settings.RenderMode == Mode::Full && g_Settings.AmbientOcclusion;
}
bool Raytracing::IsActive() { return g_Active; }
const char* Raytracing::GetStatus() { return g_Status; }
Raytracing::Settings& Raytracing::GetSettings() { return g_Settings; }
D3D12_GPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE Raytracing::GetResultSrv() { return Gpu(g_Active ? kSrvStart + g_FrameIndex : kFallbackSrv); }
XMFLOAT4 Raytracing::GetSunDirection() { return g_SunDirection; }
UINT Raytracing::GetInstanceCount() { return g_InstanceCount; }
UINT Raytracing::GetDenoiserDispatchCount() { return g_NrdDispatchCount; }
UINT Raytracing::GetAmbientDenoiserDispatchCount() { return g_AmbientDispatchCount; }
bool Raytracing::AreReflectionsActive() { return g_ReflectionsActive; }
D3D12_GPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE Raytracing::GetReflectionSrv()
{
    return g_ReflectionsActive ? RayReflections::GetResultSrv(g_FrameIndex) : GetResultSrv();
}
D3D12_GPU_VIRTUAL_ADDRESS Raytracing::GetLightingConstantsAddress(UINT frameIndex)
{
    return g_LightingConstants ? g_LightingConstants->GetGPUVirtualAddress() + (frameIndex % kFrameCount) * kLightingStride : 0;
}
void Raytracing::BeginLightList() { g_LightShadowFlags = {}; }
void Raytracing::SetLightShadowFlag(UINT index, bool castShadow)
{
    if (index < g_LightShadowFlags.size()) g_LightShadowFlags[index].x = static_cast<UINT>(castShadow);
}
void Raytracing::BindLighting(ID3D12GraphicsCommandList* commands, UINT sceneIndex, UINT constantsIndex)
{
    if (!commands || !g_LightingConstants) return;
    const UINT slot = GraphicsDevice::GetFrameIndex() % kFrameCount;
    commands->SetGraphicsRootShaderResourceView(sceneIndex,
        g_Frames[slot].TopLevel ? g_Frames[slot].TopLevel->GetGPUVirtualAddress() : 0);
    commands->SetGraphicsRootConstantBufferView(constantsIndex, g_LightingConstants->GetGPUVirtualAddress() + slot * kLightingStride);
}
ID3D12Resource* Raytracing::GetResultResource()
{
	if (!g_Active)
	{
		return nullptr;
	}
	return g_Frames[g_FrameIndex].Result.Get();
}

bool Raytracing::IsGiActive() { return g_GiActive; }
D3D12_GPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE Raytracing::GetGiSrv()
{
    return RayReflections::GetGiSrv(g_FrameIndex);
}

#include "pch.h"
#include "materialmanager.h"
#include "raytracingscene.h"

void SetMaterial(RaytracingGeometry& geometry, EntityID entity, int modelTexture = -1, size_t slot = 0)
{
    if (ComponentManager::HasComponent<MaterialComponent>(entity))
    {
        const auto& material = MaterialManager::Resolve(ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<MaterialComponent>(entity), slot);
        if (material.RuntimeHandle != 0)
        {
            geometry.BaseColor = material.BaseColor;
            geometry.Emission = { material.EmissiveColor.x, material.EmissiveColor.y,
                material.EmissiveColor.z, material.EmissiveIntensity };
            geometry.EmissionTexture = TextureManager::GetTextureResource(material.EmissiveTextureID);
            if (geometry.EmissionTexture)
            {
                TextureManager::TouchTexture(material.EmissiveTextureID);
                geometry.EmissionResidentMip = TextureManager::GetTextureResidentMip(material.EmissiveTextureID);
            }
        }
        geometry.Roughness = material.Roughness;
        geometry.Metallic = material.Metallic;
        geometry.CastShadow = MaterialSystem::CastsShadow(material);
        if (material.UseTexture)
        {
            geometry.TextureIndex = material.TextureID;
            if (material.RuntimeHandle == 0 && modelTexture >= 0)
            {
                geometry.TextureIndex = modelTexture;
            }
        }
    }
    else geometry.TextureIndex = modelTexture;
    geometry.Texture = TextureManager::GetTextureResource(geometry.TextureIndex);
    if (geometry.Texture)
    {
        TextureManager::TouchTexture(geometry.TextureIndex);
        geometry.TextureResidentMip = TextureManager::GetTextureResidentMip(geometry.TextureIndex);
    }
}
bool IsRayGeometryVisible(const MaterialComponent& material)
{
    float opacity = material.Alpha;
    if (material.RuntimeHandle != 0)
    {
        opacity *= material.BaseColor.w;
    }
    return opacity > 0.0f &&
        (!MaterialSystem::IsTransparentMaterial(material) || MaterialSystem::CastsShadow(material));
}

bool IsOpaqueCaster(EntityID entity)
{
	if (ComponentManager::HasComponent<MeshComponent>(entity) &&
		ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<MeshComponent>(entity).IsEnvironment)
	{
		return false;
	}
    if (ComponentManager::HasComponent<SunComponent>(entity) ||
        ComponentManager::HasComponent<SpriteComponent>(entity) ||
        ComponentManager::HasComponent<CameraComponent>(entity))
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (ComponentManager::HasComponent<MaterialComponent>(entity))
    {
        const auto& source = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<MaterialComponent>(entity);
        const size_t count = max(size_t(1), source.MaterialSlots.size());
        for (size_t slot = 0; slot < count; ++slot)
        {
            if (IsRayGeometryVisible(MaterialManager::Resolve(source, slot)))
            {
                return true;
            }
        }
        return false;
    }
    return true;
}

template<typename Model>
void AppendModel(vector<RaytracingGeometry>& geometry, EntityID entity, Model* model, bool deforming)
{
    if (!model || !IsOpaqueCaster(entity))
    {
        return;
    }
    const auto& transform = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<TransformComponent>(entity);
    for (UINT meshIndex = 0; meshIndex < model->GetMeshCount(); ++meshIndex)
    {
        const auto& mesh = model->GetMeshData(meshIndex);
        if (ComponentManager::HasComponent<MaterialComponent>(entity) &&
            !IsRayGeometryVisible(MaterialManager::Resolve(
                ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<MaterialComponent>(entity), meshIndex)))
        {
            continue;
        }
        if (!mesh.VertexBuffer || !mesh.IndexBuffer || mesh.IndexCount < 3)
        {
            continue;
        }
        RaytracingGeometry entry;
        entry.Vertices = mesh.VertexBuffer;
        entry.Indices = mesh.IndexBuffer;
        entry.VertexView = mesh.VertexBufferView;
        entry.IndexView = mesh.IndexBufferView;
        entry.IndexCount = mesh.IndexCount;
        entry.Deforming = deforming;
        entry.VertexState = D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_VERTEX_AND_CONSTANT_BUFFER;
        if (deforming)
        {
            // ModelSystem restores skinned output to UAV after each draw pass.
            entry.VertexState = D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS;
        }
        entry.IndexState = D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_INDEX_BUFFER;
        D3D12_HEAP_PROPERTIES heapProperties{};
        if (SUCCEEDED(entry.Vertices->GetHeapProperties(&heapProperties, nullptr)) &&
            heapProperties.Type == D3D12_HEAP_TYPE_UPLOAD)
        {
            entry.VertexState = D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_GENERIC_READ;
        }
        if (SUCCEEDED(entry.Indices->GetHeapProperties(&heapProperties, nullptr)) &&
            heapProperties.Type == D3D12_HEAP_TYPE_UPLOAD)
        {
            entry.IndexState = D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_GENERIC_READ;
        }
        entry.World = transform.WorldMatrix;
        SetMaterial(entry, entity, mesh.TextureIndex, meshIndex);
        VertexDeformationView deformation;
        if (!deforming && VertexDeformation::TryResolveStaticMesh(entity, meshIndex, deformation))
        {
            entry.Vertices = deformation.CurrentResource;
            entry.VertexView = deformation.CurrentView;
            entry.VertexState = D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_VERTEX_AND_CONSTANT_BUFFER;
            entry.Deforming = true;
        }
        geometry.push_back(move(entry));
    }
}
}

vector<RaytracingGeometry> GatherRaytracingGeometry()
{
    vector<RaytracingGeometry> geometry;
    geometry.reserve(World::GetView<MeshComponent>().size());
    for (EntityID entity : World::GetView<MeshComponent, TransformComponent>())
    {
        if (!IsOpaqueCaster(entity))
        {
            continue;
        }
        const auto& mesh = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<MeshComponent>(entity);
        if (!mesh.VertexBuffer || mesh.VertexCount < 3)
        {
            continue;
        }
        RaytracingGeometry entry;
        entry.Vertices = mesh.VertexBuffer;
        entry.VertexView = mesh.VertexBufferView;
        entry.World = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<TransformComponent>(entity).WorldMatrix;
        SetMaterial(entry, entity);
        VertexDeformationView deformation;
        if (VertexDeformation::TryResolveMesh(entity, deformation))
        {
            entry.Vertices = deformation.CurrentResource;
            entry.VertexView = deformation.CurrentView;
            entry.VertexState = D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_VERTEX_AND_CONSTANT_BUFFER;
            entry.Deforming = true;
        }
        geometry.push_back(move(entry));
    }
    for (EntityID entity : World::GetView<StaticModelComponent, TransformComponent>())
    {
        const auto& component = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<StaticModelComponent>(entity);
        AppendModel(geometry, entity, ModelManager::GetStaticModel(component.ModelId), false);
    }
    for (EntityID entity : World::GetView<AnimationModelComponent, TransformComponent>())
    {
        const auto& component = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<AnimationModelComponent>(entity);
        AppendModel(geometry, entity, ModelManager::GetAnimModel(component.ModelId), true);
    }
    return geometry;
}

#include "pch.h"
#include "rendercapture.h"
#include "graphicsdevice.h"
#include "graphicslog.h"
#include "rendertargets.h"
#include <d3d12sdklayers.h>
#include <wincodec.h>
#include <cmath>
#include <limits>
