bool ShaderPipelines::CreateSkinningPipeline()
{
	CD3DX12_DESCRIPTOR_RANGE ranges[4];
	ranges[0].Init(D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_RANGE_TYPE_SRV, 1, 0);
	ranges[1].Init(D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_RANGE_TYPE_SRV, 1, 1);
	ranges[2].Init(D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_RANGE_TYPE_UAV, 1, 0);
	ranges[3].Init(D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_RANGE_TYPE_CBV, 1, 0, 1);

	CD3DX12_ROOT_PARAMETER rootParams[4];
	rootParams[0].InitAsDescriptorTable(1, &ranges[0], D3D12_SHADER_VISIBILITY_ALL);
	rootParams[1].InitAsDescriptorTable(1, &ranges[1], D3D12_SHADER_VISIBILITY_ALL);
	rootParams[2].InitAsDescriptorTable(1, &ranges[2], D3D12_SHADER_VISIBILITY_ALL);
	rootParams[3].InitAsDescriptorTable(1, &ranges[3], D3D12_SHADER_VISIBILITY_ALL);

	CD3DX12_ROOT_SIGNATURE_DESC rsDesc;
	rsDesc.Init(_countof(rootParams), rootParams, 0, nullptr,
		D3D12_ROOT_SIGNATURE_FLAG_NONE);

	ComPtr<ID3DBlob> signature;
	ComPtr<ID3DBlob> error;
	HRESULT hr = D3D12SerializeRootSignature(&rsDesc, D3D_ROOT_SIGNATURE_VERSION_1, &signature, &error);
	if (FAILED(hr))
	{
		Debug::Log("ERROR: D3D12SerializeRootSignature(Skinning) failed\n");
		if (error) Debug::Log("%s\n", (char*)error->GetBufferPointer());
		return false;
	}
	hr = m_Device->CreateRootSignature(0, signature->GetBufferPointer(), signature->GetBufferSize(),
		IID_PPV_ARGS(&m_SkinningRootSignature));
	if (FAILED(hr))
	{
		Debug::Log("ERROR: CreateRootSignature(Skinning) failed\n");
		return false;
	}
	return PsoManager::CreateSkinningPso();
}

bool ShaderPipelines::LoadShaderBlob(const ShaderDescription& resource)
{
	const char* csoPath = resource.csoPath;
	ID3DBlob** ppBlob = resource.ppBlob;

	if (!csoPath || !ppBlob)
	{
		return false;
	}
	*ppBlob = nullptr;
	string key = csoPath;
	replace(key.begin(), key.end(), '\\', '/');
	const string leaf = filesystem::path(key).filename().string();
	const bool scenePixelShader = leaf.find("PS") != string::npos && Raytracing::IsAvailable();
	const bool sceneVertexShader = leaf.find("VS") != string::npos && Raytracing::IsAvailable();
	const bool sceneGeometryShader = leaf.find("GS") != string::npos && Raytracing::IsAvailable();
	const bool compileModern = scenePixelShader || sceneVertexShader || sceneGeometryShader;
	const string cacheKey = key + (compileModern ? ":DXR" : "");

	auto cached = g_ShaderBlobCache.find(cacheKey);
	if (cached != g_ShaderBlobCache.end())
	{
		*ppBlob = cached->second.Get();
		(*ppBlob)->AddRef();
		return true;
	}

	int len = MultiByteToWideChar(CP_UTF8, 0, csoPath, -1, NULL, 0);
	wstring wPath(len, 0);
	MultiByteToWideChar(CP_UTF8, 0, csoPath, -1, &wPath[0], len);

	HRESULT hr = E_FAIL;
	if (compileModern)
	{
		string source = key;
		const auto buildFolder = source.find("/build/");
		if (buildFolder != string::npos) source.erase(buildFolder, 6);
		source = filesystem::path(source).replace_extension(".hlsl").string();
		if (filesystem::exists(source))
		{
			const auto sourcePath = filesystem::path(source).wstring();
			const D3D_SHADER_MACRO defines[] = { { "SHADER_RAYTRACING", "1" }, {} };
			ComPtr<ID3DBlob> errors;
			hr = D3DCompileFromFile(sourcePath.c_str(), defines, D3D_COMPILE_STANDARD_FILE_INCLUDE,
				"main", scenePixelShader ? "ps_6_5" : sceneVertexShader ? "vs_6_5" : "gs_6_5",
                D3DCOMPILE_OPTIMIZATION_LEVEL3, 0, ppBlob, &errors);
			if (FAILED(hr))
			{
				WriteGraphicsLog("DXR pixel shader failed: %s %s\n", source.c_str(), errors ? static_cast<const char*>(errors->GetBufferPointer()) : "");
				return false;
			}
		}
	}
	if (FAILED(hr)) hr = D3DReadFileToBlob(wPath.c_str(), ppBlob);
	if (FAILED(hr))
	{
		char buf[256];
		sprintf_s(buf, "ERROR: Failed to load shader: %s (HRESULT: 0x%08X)\n", csoPath, hr);
		Debug::Log("%s", buf);
		return false;
	}

	g_ShaderBlobCache.emplace(cacheKey, *ppBlob);
	return true;
}

bool ShaderPipelines::CreateVertexShader(const ShaderDescription& resource)
{
	ShaderDescription shaderResource = resource;
	shaderResource.csoPath = resource.vsPath;
	return LoadShaderBlob(shaderResource);
}

bool ShaderPipelines::CreatePixelShader(const ShaderDescription& resource)
{
	ShaderDescription shaderResource = resource;
	shaderResource.csoPath = resource.psPath;
	return LoadShaderBlob(shaderResource);
}

static void ShaderLogToFile(const char* msg)
{
	FILE* fp = nullptr;
	fopen_s(&fp, "init_log.txt", "a");
	if (fp) { fprintf(fp, "%s", msg); fclose(fp); }
}

bool ShaderPipelines::CreatePostProcessPipeline()
{
	ShaderLogToFile("PP: setup ranges\n");
	CD3DX12_DESCRIPTOR_RANGE ranges[17];
	ranges[0].Init(D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_RANGE_TYPE_SRV, 5, 0);
	ranges[1].Init(D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_RANGE_TYPE_SRV, 1, 6);
	ranges[2].Init(D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_RANGE_TYPE_SRV, 1, 7);
	ranges[3].Init(D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_RANGE_TYPE_SRV, 1, 8);
	ranges[4].Init(D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_RANGE_TYPE_SRV, 1, 9);
	ranges[5].Init(D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_RANGE_TYPE_SRV, 1, 10);
	ranges[6].Init(D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_RANGE_TYPE_SRV, 1, 12);
	ranges[7].Init(D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_RANGE_TYPE_SRV, 1, 13);
	ranges[8].Init(D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_RANGE_TYPE_SRV, 1, 14);
	ranges[9].Init(D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_RANGE_TYPE_SRV, 1, 15);
	ranges[10].Init(D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_RANGE_TYPE_SRV, 1, 16);
	ranges[11].Init(D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_RANGE_TYPE_SRV, 1, 17);

	ranges[12].Init(D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_RANGE_TYPE_SRV, 1, 31);
	ranges[13].Init(D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_RANGE_TYPE_SRV, 1, 32);
	ranges[14].Init(D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_RANGE_TYPE_SRV, 1, 33);
    ranges[15].Init(D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_RANGE_TYPE_SRV, 1, 35);
    ranges[16].Init(D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_RANGE_TYPE_SRV, 1, 36);
	CD3DX12_ROOT_PARAMETER params[26];
	params[0].InitAsDescriptorTable(1, &ranges[0], D3D12_SHADER_VISIBILITY_PIXEL);
	params[1].InitAsConstantBufferView(0, 0, D3D12_SHADER_VISIBILITY_PIXEL);
	params[2].InitAsConstantBufferView(1, 0, D3D12_SHADER_VISIBILITY_PIXEL);
	params[3].InitAsDescriptorTable(1, &ranges[1], D3D12_SHADER_VISIBILITY_PIXEL);
	params[4].InitAsDescriptorTable(1, &ranges[2], D3D12_SHADER_VISIBILITY_PIXEL);
	params[5].InitAsConstantBufferView(3, 0, D3D12_SHADER_VISIBILITY_PIXEL);
	params[6].InitAsConstantBufferView(2, 0, D3D12_SHADER_VISIBILITY_PIXEL);
	params[7].InitAsDescriptorTable(1, &ranges[3], D3D12_SHADER_VISIBILITY_PIXEL);
	params[8].InitAsDescriptorTable(1, &ranges[4], D3D12_SHADER_VISIBILITY_PIXEL);
	params[9].InitAsDescriptorTable(1, &ranges[5], D3D12_SHADER_VISIBILITY_PIXEL);
	params[10].InitAsShaderResourceView(11, 0, D3D12_SHADER_VISIBILITY_PIXEL);
	params[11].InitAsDescriptorTable(1, &ranges[6], D3D12_SHADER_VISIBILITY_PIXEL);
	params[12].InitAsDescriptorTable(1, &ranges[7], D3D12_SHADER_VISIBILITY_PIXEL);
	params[13].InitAsDescriptorTable(1, &ranges[8], D3D12_SHADER_VISIBILITY_PIXEL);
	params[14].InitAsShaderResourceView(24, 0, D3D12_SHADER_VISIBILITY_PIXEL);
	params[15].InitAsDescriptorTable(1, &ranges[9], D3D12_SHADER_VISIBILITY_PIXEL);
	params[16].InitAsDescriptorTable(1, &ranges[10], D3D12_SHADER_VISIBILITY_PIXEL);
	params[17].InitAsShaderResourceView(25, 0, D3D12_SHADER_VISIBILITY_PIXEL);
	params[18].InitAsConstantBufferView(5, 0, D3D12_SHADER_VISIBILITY_PIXEL);
	params[19].InitAsDescriptorTable(1, &ranges[11], D3D12_SHADER_VISIBILITY_PIXEL);

	params[20].InitAsDescriptorTable(1, &ranges[12], D3D12_SHADER_VISIBILITY_PIXEL);
	params[21].InitAsDescriptorTable(1, &ranges[13], D3D12_SHADER_VISIBILITY_PIXEL);
	params[22].InitAsConstantBufferView(9, 0, D3D12_SHADER_VISIBILITY_PIXEL);
    params[23].InitAsDescriptorTable(1, &ranges[14], D3D12_SHADER_VISIBILITY_PIXEL);
    params[24].InitAsDescriptorTable(1, &ranges[15], D3D12_SHADER_VISIBILITY_PIXEL);
    params[25].InitAsDescriptorTable(1, &ranges[16], D3D12_SHADER_VISIBILITY_PIXEL);
	CD3DX12_STATIC_SAMPLER_DESC samplers[3] {};
	samplers[0] = CD3DX12_STATIC_SAMPLER_DESC(0, D3D12_FILTER_MIN_MAG_MIP_LINEAR);


	samplers[1] = CD3DX12_STATIC_SAMPLER_DESC(
		1,
		D3D12_FILTER_COMPARISON_MIN_MAG_LINEAR_MIP_POINT,
		D3D12_TEXTURE_ADDRESS_MODE_BORDER,
		D3D12_TEXTURE_ADDRESS_MODE_BORDER,
		D3D12_TEXTURE_ADDRESS_MODE_BORDER,
		0.0f,
		1,
		D3D12_COMPARISON_FUNC_LESS_EQUAL,
		D3D12_STATIC_BORDER_COLOR_OPAQUE_WHITE);
	samplers[2] = CD3DX12_STATIC_SAMPLER_DESC(3, D3D12_FILTER_MIN_MAG_MIP_LINEAR,
		D3D12_TEXTURE_ADDRESS_MODE_WRAP, D3D12_TEXTURE_ADDRESS_MODE_WRAP, D3D12_TEXTURE_ADDRESS_MODE_WRAP);
	samplers[2].ShaderVisibility = D3D12_SHADER_VISIBILITY_PIXEL;
	CD3DX12_ROOT_SIGNATURE_DESC rsDesc(_countof(params), params, _countof(samplers), samplers, D3D12_ROOT_SIGNATURE_FLAG_ALLOW_INPUT_ASSEMBLER_INPUT_LAYOUT);

	ComPtr<ID3DBlob> rsBlob, errBlob;
	ShaderLogToFile("PP: serialize root sig\n");
	HRESULT hr = D3D12SerializeRootSignature(&rsDesc, D3D_ROOT_SIGNATURE_VERSION_1, &rsBlob, &errBlob);
	if (FAILED(hr))
	{
		ShaderLogToFile("PP: FAIL SerializeRootSig\n");
		if (errBlob) ShaderLogToFile((const char*)errBlob->GetBufferPointer());
		return false;
	}
	ShaderLogToFile("PP: create root sig\n");
	hr = m_Device->CreateRootSignature(0, rsBlob->GetBufferPointer(), rsBlob->GetBufferSize(), IID_PPV_ARGS(&m_PostProcessRootSignature));
	if (FAILED(hr)) { ShaderLogToFile("PP: FAIL CreateRootSig\n"); return false; }

	auto cbHeapProps = CD3DX12_HEAP_PROPERTIES(D3D12_HEAP_TYPE_UPLOAD);
	auto cbDesc = CD3DX12_RESOURCE_DESC::Buffer(g_kPP_CB_ALIGNED_SIZE * g_kPP_CB_SLOTS_PER_FRAME * g_kFRAME_COUNT);
	ShaderLogToFile("PP: create PP CB\n");
	hr = m_Device->CreateCommittedResource(&cbHeapProps, D3D12_HEAP_FLAG_NONE, &cbDesc, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_GENERIC_READ, nullptr, IID_PPV_ARGS(&m_PostProcessConstantBuffer));
	if (FAILED(hr)) { ShaderLogToFile("PP: FAIL PP CB\n"); return false; }
	m_PostProcessConstantBuffer->Map(0, nullptr, reinterpret_cast<void**>(&m_pPostProcessCbvDataBegin));

	auto lightCbDesc = CD3DX12_RESOURCE_DESC::Buffer(g_kLIGHT_CB_ALIGNED_SIZE * g_kFRAME_COUNT);
	ShaderLogToFile("PP: create Light CB\n");
	hr = m_Device->CreateCommittedResource(&cbHeapProps, D3D12_HEAP_FLAG_NONE, &lightCbDesc, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_GENERIC_READ, nullptr, IID_PPV_ARGS(&m_LightConstantBuffer));
	if (FAILED(hr)) { ShaderLogToFile("PP: FAIL Light CB\n"); return false; }
	m_LightConstantBuffer->Map(0, nullptr, &m_pLightCbvDataBegin);

	auto pbrCbDesc = CD3DX12_RESOURCE_DESC::Buffer(g_kPBR_CB_ALIGNED_SIZE * g_kPBR_CB_TOTAL_SLOT_COUNT);
	ShaderLogToFile("PP: create PBR CB\n");
	hr = m_Device->CreateCommittedResource(&cbHeapProps, D3D12_HEAP_FLAG_NONE, &pbrCbDesc, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_GENERIC_READ, nullptr, IID_PPV_ARGS(&m_PBRConstantBuffer));
	if (FAILED(hr)) { ShaderLogToFile("PP: FAIL PBR CB\n"); return false; }
	m_PBRConstantBuffer->Map(0, nullptr, &m_pPBRCbvDataBegin);

	ShaderLogToFile("PP: create upscale root sig\n");
	{
		CD3DX12_DESCRIPTOR_RANGE upscaleRange[2];
		upscaleRange[0].Init(D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_RANGE_TYPE_SRV, 1, 0);
		upscaleRange[1].Init(D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_RANGE_TYPE_SRV, 1, 1);

		CD3DX12_ROOT_PARAMETER upscaleParams[3];
		upscaleParams[0].InitAsDescriptorTable(1, &upscaleRange[0], D3D12_SHADER_VISIBILITY_PIXEL);
		upscaleParams[1].InitAsDescriptorTable(1, &upscaleRange[1], D3D12_SHADER_VISIBILITY_PIXEL);
		upscaleParams[2].InitAsConstantBufferView(0, 0, D3D12_SHADER_VISIBILITY_PIXEL);

		CD3DX12_STATIC_SAMPLER_DESC upscaleSampler(0, D3D12_FILTER_MIN_MAG_MIP_LINEAR);
		CD3DX12_ROOT_SIGNATURE_DESC upscaleRsDesc(_countof(upscaleParams), upscaleParams, 1, &upscaleSampler, D3D12_ROOT_SIGNATURE_FLAG_ALLOW_INPUT_ASSEMBLER_INPUT_LAYOUT);

		ComPtr<ID3DBlob> rsBlob, errBlob;
		HRESULT hr = D3D12SerializeRootSignature(&upscaleRsDesc, D3D_ROOT_SIGNATURE_VERSION_1, &rsBlob, &errBlob);
		if (FAILED(hr))
		{
			ShaderLogToFile("PP: FAIL SerializeUpscaleRootSig\n");
			if (errBlob) ShaderLogToFile((const char*)errBlob->GetBufferPointer());
			return false;
		}
		hr = m_Device->CreateRootSignature(0, rsBlob->GetBufferPointer(), rsBlob->GetBufferSize(), IID_PPV_ARGS(&m_UpscaleRootSignature));
		if (FAILED(hr)) { ShaderLogToFile("PP: FAIL CreateUpscaleRootSig\n"); return false; }
	}

	ShaderLogToFile("PP: create AA root sig\n");
	{
		CD3DX12_DESCRIPTOR_RANGE aaRange[4];
		aaRange[0].Init(D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_RANGE_TYPE_SRV, 1, 0);
		aaRange[1].Init(D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_RANGE_TYPE_SRV, 1, 1);
		aaRange[2].Init(D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_RANGE_TYPE_SRV, 1, 2);
		aaRange[3].Init(D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_RANGE_TYPE_SRV, 1, 3);

		CD3DX12_ROOT_PARAMETER aaParams[6];
		aaParams[0].InitAsConstantBufferView(0, 0, D3D12_SHADER_VISIBILITY_PIXEL);
		aaParams[1].InitAsDescriptorTable(1, &aaRange[0], D3D12_SHADER_VISIBILITY_PIXEL);
		aaParams[2].InitAsDescriptorTable(1, &aaRange[1], D3D12_SHADER_VISIBILITY_PIXEL);
		aaParams[3].InitAsDescriptorTable(1, &aaRange[2], D3D12_SHADER_VISIBILITY_PIXEL);
		aaParams[4].InitAsConstants(20, 4, 0, D3D12_SHADER_VISIBILITY_PIXEL);
		aaParams[5].InitAsDescriptorTable(1, &aaRange[3], D3D12_SHADER_VISIBILITY_PIXEL);

		CD3DX12_STATIC_SAMPLER_DESC aaSampler(0, D3D12_FILTER_MIN_MAG_MIP_LINEAR);
		CD3DX12_ROOT_SIGNATURE_DESC aaRsDesc(_countof(aaParams), aaParams, 1, &aaSampler, D3D12_ROOT_SIGNATURE_FLAG_ALLOW_INPUT_ASSEMBLER_INPUT_LAYOUT);

		ComPtr<ID3DBlob> rsBlob, errBlob;
		HRESULT hr = D3D12SerializeRootSignature(&aaRsDesc, D3D_ROOT_SIGNATURE_VERSION_1, &rsBlob, &errBlob);
		if (FAILED(hr))
		{
			ShaderLogToFile("PP: FAIL SerializeAaRootSig\n");
			if (errBlob) ShaderLogToFile((const char*)errBlob->GetBufferPointer());
			return false;
		}
		hr = m_Device->CreateRootSignature(0, rsBlob->GetBufferPointer(), rsBlob->GetBufferSize(), IID_PPV_ARGS(&m_AaRootSignature));
		if (FAILED(hr)) { ShaderLogToFile("PP: FAIL CreateAaRootSig\n"); return false; }
	}

	ShaderLogToFile("PP: create PSOs\n");
	if (!PsoManager::CreatePostProcessPipelines()) { ShaderLogToFile("PP: FAIL CreatePostProcessPipelines\n"); return false; }
	if (!PsoManager::CreateAtmospherePso()) { ShaderLogToFile("PP: FAIL CreateAtmospherePso\n"); return false; }
	if (!PsoManager::CreateUpscalePso()) { ShaderLogToFile("PP: FAIL CreateUpscalePso\n"); return false; }
	if (!PsoManager::CreateUpscaleDepthPso()) { ShaderLogToFile("PP: FAIL CreateUpscaleDepthPso\n"); return false; }
	if (!PsoManager::CreateAaPsos()) { ShaderLogToFile("PP: FAIL CreateAaPsos\n"); return false; }
	if (!PsoManager::CreateVelocityPso()) { ShaderLogToFile("PP: FAIL CreateVelocityPso\n"); return false; }
	if (!PsoManager::CreateVelocityGeometryPso()) { ShaderLogToFile("PP: FAIL CreateVelocityGeometryPso\n"); return false; }
	ShaderLogToFile("PP: done\n");
	return true;
}

===== FILE: rendering\shadowpageregions.h =====
#pragma once
#include <cstddef>
#include <vector>
#include <cstdint>

namespace ShadowPages
{
inline bool NeedsStaticRefresh(bool cacheEnabled, bool mappingMatches, bool staticContentMatches)
{
    return !cacheEnabled || !mappingMatches || !staticContentMatches;
}
inline bool UpdateDue(uint64_t frame, unsigned level)
{
    const uint64_t period = uint64_t(1) << level;
    return frame % period == period / 2;
}
struct Tile
{
    unsigned X, Y;
    int LogicalX, LogicalY;
    unsigned Pass;
};
struct Region
{
    Tile First;
    unsigned Width, Height;
};

inline std::vector<Region> Merge(const std::vector<Tile>& tiles)
{
    std::vector<Region> regions;
    std::vector<bool> used(tiles.size(), false);
    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < tiles.size(); ++i)
    {
        if (used[i]) continue;
        const auto& first = tiles[i];
        auto find = [&](unsigned x, unsigned y) {
            for (std::size_t j = 0; j < tiles.size(); ++j)
                if (!used[j] && tiles[j].X == first.X + x && tiles[j].Y == first.Y + y &&
                    tiles[j].LogicalX == first.LogicalX + int(x) &&
                    tiles[j].LogicalY == first.LogicalY + int(y)) return j;
            return tiles.size();
        };
        unsigned width = 1, height = 1;
        while (find(width, 0) != tiles.size()) ++width;
        for (;; ++height)
        {
            bool complete = true;
            for (unsigned x = 0; x < width; ++x)
                if (find(x, height) == tiles.size()) { complete = false; break; }
            if (!complete) break;
        }
        for (unsigned y = 0; y < height; ++y)
            for (unsigned x = 0; x < width; ++x) used[find(x, y)] = true;
        regions.push_back({first, width, height});
    }
    return regions;
}
}

===== FILE: rendering\spatialupscaler.cpp =====
#include "pch.h"
#include "spatialupscaler.h"
#include "rendererstate.h"
#include "renderprofiler.h"

#include <cstddef>

#define A_CPU 1
#include "../../External/FidelityFX-FSR/ffx_a.h"
#include "../../External/FidelityFX-FSR/ffx_fsr1.h"
#include "../../External/NVIDIAImageScaling/NIS_Config.h"


	static ComPtr<ID3D12Device> g_Device;
	static ComPtr<ID3D12DescriptorHeap> g_DescriptorHeap;
	static UINT g_DescriptorIncrement = 0;
	static ComPtr<ID3D12RootSignature> g_RootSignature;
	static ComPtr<ID3D12PipelineState> g_FsrEasuPso;
	static ComPtr<ID3D12PipelineState> g_FsrRcasPso;
	static ComPtr<ID3D12PipelineState> g_NisPso;
	static ComPtr<ID3D12Resource> g_FsrScratch;
	static ComPtr<ID3D12Resource> g_NisScaleCoefficients;
	static ComPtr<ID3D12Resource> g_NisUsmCoefficients;
	static UINT g_OutputWidth = 0;
	static UINT g_OutputHeight = 0;
	DXGI_FORMAT g_OutputFormat = DXGI_FORMAT_UNKNOWN;

	struct FsrConstants
	{
		uint32_t Const0[4]{};
		uint32_t Const1[4]{};
		uint32_t Const2[4]{};
		uint32_t Const3[4]{};
		uint32_t DispatchInfo[4]{};
	};
	static_assert(sizeof(FsrConstants) == sizeof(uint32_t) * 20);


	constexpr UINT kNisConfigDwordCount = static_cast<UINT>(
		(offsetof(NISConfig, reserved1) + sizeof(NISConfig::reserved1)) / sizeof(uint32_t));

D3D12_CPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE SpatialUpscaler::CpuHandle(UINT index)
{
	return CD3DX12_CPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE(
		g_DescriptorHeap->GetCPUDescriptorHandleForHeapStart(),
		index,
		g_DescriptorIncrement);
}

D3D12_GPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE SpatialUpscaler::GpuHandle(UINT index)
{
	return CD3DX12_GPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE(
		g_DescriptorHeap->GetGPUDescriptorHandleForHeapStart(),
		index,
		g_DescriptorIncrement);
}

bool SpatialUpscaler::CreateRootSignature()
{
	CD3DX12_DESCRIPTOR_RANGE ranges[4];
	ranges[0].Init(D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_RANGE_TYPE_SRV, 1, 0);
	ranges[1].Init(D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_RANGE_TYPE_UAV, 1, 0);
	ranges[2].Init(D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_RANGE_TYPE_SRV, 1, 1);
	ranges[3].Init(D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_RANGE_TYPE_SRV, 1, 2);

	CD3DX12_ROOT_PARAMETER parameters[5];
	for (UINT i = 0; i < 4; ++i)
	{
		parameters[i].InitAsDescriptorTable(1, &ranges[i], D3D12_SHADER_VISIBILITY_ALL);
	}
	parameters[4].InitAsConstants(32, 0, 0, D3D12_SHADER_VISIBILITY_ALL);

	CD3DX12_STATIC_SAMPLER_DESC sampler(
		0,
		D3D12_FILTER_MIN_MAG_MIP_LINEAR,
		D3D12_TEXTURE_ADDRESS_MODE_CLAMP,
		D3D12_TEXTURE_ADDRESS_MODE_CLAMP,
		D3D12_TEXTURE_ADDRESS_MODE_CLAMP);
	CD3DX12_ROOT_SIGNATURE_DESC desc(
		_countof(parameters),
		parameters,
		1,
		&sampler,
		D3D12_ROOT_SIGNATURE_FLAG_NONE);

	ComPtr<ID3DBlob> serialized;
	ComPtr<ID3DBlob> errors;
	HRESULT hr = D3D12SerializeRootSignature(
		&desc,
		D3D_ROOT_SIGNATURE_VERSION_1,
		&serialized,
		&errors);
	if (FAILED(hr))
	{
		if (errors) Debug::Log("Spatial upscaler root signature: %s\n", static_cast<const char*>(errors->GetBufferPointer()));
		return false;
	}
	return SUCCEEDED(g_Device->CreateRootSignature(
		0,
		serialized->GetBufferPointer(),
		serialized->GetBufferSize(),
		IID_PPV_ARGS(&g_RootSignature)));
}

bool SpatialUpscaler::CreatePipeline(const wchar_t* path, ComPtr<ID3D12PipelineState>& output)
{
	ComPtr<ID3DBlob> shader;
	HRESULT hr = D3DReadFileToBlob(path, &shader);
	if (FAILED(hr))
	{
		Debug::Log("Spatial upscaler shader is missing (HRESULT 0x%08X).\n", hr);
		return false;
	}
	D3D12_COMPUTE_PIPELINE_STATE_DESC desc{};
	desc.pRootSignature = g_RootSignature.Get();
	desc.CS = CD3DX12_SHADER_BYTECODE(shader.Get());
	hr = g_Device->CreateComputePipelineState(&desc, IID_PPV_ARGS(&output));
	return SUCCEEDED(hr);
}

bool SpatialUpscaler::CreateNisCoefficientBuffers()
{
	auto createBuffer = [](const float* coefficients, ComPtr<ID3D12Resource>& resource, UINT descriptorIndex)
		{
			const UINT elementCount = static_cast<UINT>(kPhaseCount * 2);
			const UINT byteSize = elementCount * sizeof(float) * 4;
			auto heapProperties = CD3DX12_HEAP_PROPERTIES(D3D12_HEAP_TYPE_UPLOAD);
			auto desc = CD3DX12_RESOURCE_DESC::Buffer(byteSize);
			HRESULT hr = g_Device->CreateCommittedResource(
				&heapProperties,
				D3D12_HEAP_FLAG_NONE,
				&desc,
				D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_GENERIC_READ,
				nullptr,
				IID_PPV_ARGS(&resource));
			if (FAILED(hr)) return false;

			void* mapped = nullptr;
			CD3DX12_RANGE readRange(0, 0);
			if (FAILED(resource->Map(0, &readRange, &mapped))) return false;
			memcpy(mapped, coefficients, byteSize);
			resource->Unmap(0, nullptr);

			D3D12_SHADER_RESOURCE_VIEW_DESC srv{};
			srv.Shader4ComponentMapping = D3D12_DEFAULT_SHADER_4_COMPONENT_MAPPING;
			srv.Format = DXGI_FORMAT_R32_TYPELESS;
			srv.ViewDimension = D3D12_SRV_DIMENSION_BUFFER;
			srv.Buffer.NumElements = byteSize / sizeof(uint32_t);
			srv.Buffer.StructureByteStride = 0;
			srv.Buffer.Flags = D3D12_BUFFER_SRV_FLAG_RAW;
			g_Device->CreateShaderResourceView(resource.Get(), &srv, SpatialUpscaler::CpuHandle(descriptorIndex));
			return true;
		};

	return createBuffer(
		&coef_scale[0][0],
		g_NisScaleCoefficients,
		RendererState::g_kNIS_COEF_SCALE_SRV_INDEX) &&
		createBuffer(
			&coef_usm[0][0],
			g_NisUsmCoefficients,
			RendererState::g_kNIS_COEF_USM_SRV_INDEX);
}

bool SpatialUpscaler::Initialize(
	ID3D12Device* device,
	ID3D12DescriptorHeap* descriptorHeap,
	UINT descriptorIncrement)
{
	Shutdown();
	if (!device || !descriptorHeap || descriptorIncrement == 0) return false;
	g_Device = device;
	g_DescriptorHeap = descriptorHeap;
	g_DescriptorIncrement = descriptorIncrement;
	if (!CreateRootSignature()) return false;

	const bool fsrReady =
		CreatePipeline(L"shader/hlsl/build/FsrEasuCS.cso", g_FsrEasuPso) &&
		CreatePipeline(L"shader/hlsl/build/FsrRcasCS.cso", g_FsrRcasPso);
	const bool nisReady =
		CreatePipeline(L"shader/hlsl/build/NisScalerCS.cso", g_NisPso) &&
		CreateNisCoefficientBuffers();
	if (!fsrReady) Debug::Log("FidelityFX FSR 1 is unavailable; bilateral fallback remains active.\n");
	if (!nisReady) Debug::Log("NVIDIA Image Scaling is unavailable; bilateral fallback remains active.\n");
	return fsrReady || nisReady;
}

bool SpatialUpscaler::Resize(UINT outputWidth, UINT outputHeight, DXGI_FORMAT format)
{
	if (!g_Device || outputWidth == 0 || outputHeight == 0) return false;
	if (g_FsrScratch && g_OutputWidth == outputWidth && g_OutputHeight == outputHeight && g_OutputFormat == format)
	{
		return true;
	}
	g_FsrScratch.Reset();
	g_OutputWidth = outputWidth;
	g_OutputHeight = outputHeight;
	g_OutputFormat = format;

	auto heapProperties = CD3DX12_HEAP_PROPERTIES(D3D12_HEAP_TYPE_DEFAULT);
	auto desc = CD3DX12_RESOURCE_DESC::Tex2D(
		format,
		outputWidth,
		outputHeight,
		1,
		1,
		1,
		0,
		D3D12_RESOURCE_FLAG_ALLOW_UNORDERED_ACCESS);
	HRESULT hr = g_Device->CreateCommittedResource(
		&heapProperties,
		D3D12_HEAP_FLAG_NONE,
		&desc,
		D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_NON_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE,
		nullptr,
		IID_PPV_ARGS(&g_FsrScratch));
	if (FAILED(hr)) return false;
	g_FsrScratch->SetName(L"FSR EASU Output");

	D3D12_SHADER_RESOURCE_VIEW_DESC srv{};
	srv.Shader4ComponentMapping = D3D12_DEFAULT_SHADER_4_COMPONENT_MAPPING;
	srv.Format = format;
	srv.ViewDimension = D3D12_SRV_DIMENSION_TEXTURE2D;
	srv.Texture2D.MipLevels = 1;
	g_Device->CreateShaderResourceView(
		g_FsrScratch.Get(),
		&srv,
		CpuHandle(RendererState::g_kFSR_SCRATCH_SRV_INDEX));

	D3D12_UNORDERED_ACCESS_VIEW_DESC uav{};
	uav.Format = format;
	uav.ViewDimension = D3D12_UAV_DIMENSION_TEXTURE2D;
	g_Device->CreateUnorderedAccessView(
		g_FsrScratch.Get(),
		nullptr,
		&uav,
		CpuHandle(RendererState::g_kFSR_SCRATCH_UAV_INDEX));
	return true;
}

void SpatialUpscaler::Shutdown()
{
	g_FsrScratch.Reset();
	g_NisScaleCoefficients.Reset();
	g_NisUsmCoefficients.Reset();
	g_FsrEasuPso.Reset();
	g_FsrRcasPso.Reset();
	g_NisPso.Reset();
	g_RootSignature.Reset();
	g_DescriptorHeap.Reset();
	g_Device.Reset();
	g_DescriptorIncrement = 0;
	g_OutputWidth = 0;
	g_OutputHeight = 0;
	g_OutputFormat = DXGI_FORMAT_UNKNOWN;
}

bool SpatialUpscaler::IsAvailable(UpscaleMode mode)
{
	switch (mode)
	{
	case UpscaleMode::Fsr1: return g_FsrEasuPso && g_FsrRcasPso && g_FsrScratch;
	case UpscaleMode::Nis: return g_NisPso && g_NisScaleCoefficients && g_NisUsmCoefficients;
	default: return true;
	}
}

bool SpatialUpscaler::IsScaleSupported(
	UpscaleMode mode,
	UINT inputWidth,
	UINT inputHeight,
	UINT outputWidth,
	UINT outputHeight)
{
	if (inputWidth == 0 || inputHeight == 0 || outputWidth == 0 || outputHeight == 0)
	{
		return false;
	}
	if (mode != UpscaleMode::Nis)
	{
		return true;
	}


	return inputWidth <= outputWidth && inputHeight <= outputHeight &&
		static_cast<uint64_t>(inputWidth) * 2u >= outputWidth &&
		static_cast<uint64_t>(inputHeight) * 2u >= outputHeight;
}

bool SpatialUpscaler::Execute(
	ID3D12GraphicsCommandList* commandList,
	D3D12_GPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE inputSrv,
	ID3D12Resource* output,
	D3D12_GPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE outputUav,
	UINT inputWidth,
	UINT inputHeight,
	UINT outputWidth,
	UINT outputHeight,
	UpscaleMode mode)
{
	if (!commandList || !output || !g_RootSignature || !IsAvailable(mode) ||
		!IsScaleSupported(mode, inputWidth, inputHeight, outputWidth, outputHeight)) return false;
	ID3D12DescriptorHeap* heaps[] = { g_DescriptorHeap.Get() };
	commandList->SetDescriptorHeaps(_countof(heaps), heaps);
	commandList->SetComputeRootSignature(g_RootSignature.Get());

	if (mode == UpscaleMode::Fsr1)
	{
		FsrConstants constants{};
		FsrEasuCon(
			constants.Const0,
			constants.Const1,
			constants.Const2,
			constants.Const3,
			static_cast<float>(inputWidth),
			static_cast<float>(inputHeight),
			static_cast<float>(inputWidth),
			static_cast<float>(inputHeight),
			static_cast<float>(outputWidth),
			static_cast<float>(outputHeight));
		constants.DispatchInfo[0] = outputWidth;
		constants.DispatchInfo[1] = outputHeight;

		D3D12_RESOURCE_BARRIER scratchToUav = CD3DX12_RESOURCE_BARRIER::Transition(
			g_FsrScratch.Get(),
			D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_NON_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE,
			D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS);
		commandList->ResourceBarrier(1, &scratchToUav);
		commandList->SetPipelineState(g_FsrEasuPso.Get());
		commandList->SetComputeRootDescriptorTable(0, inputSrv);
		commandList->SetComputeRootDescriptorTable(1, GpuHandle(RendererState::g_kFSR_SCRATCH_UAV_INDEX));
		commandList->SetComputeRoot32BitConstants(4, 20, &constants, 0);
		commandList->Dispatch((outputWidth + 15u) / 16u, (outputHeight + 15u) / 16u, 1);

		D3D12_RESOURCE_BARRIER scratchToSrv = CD3DX12_RESOURCE_BARRIER::Transition(
			g_FsrScratch.Get(),
			D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS,
			D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_NON_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE);
		commandList->ResourceBarrier(1, &scratchToSrv);

		FsrConstants rcasConstants{};
		FsrRcasCon(rcasConstants.Const0, RendererSettings::GetFsrSharpness());
		rcasConstants.DispatchInfo[0] = outputWidth;
		rcasConstants.DispatchInfo[1] = outputHeight;
		commandList->SetPipelineState(g_FsrRcasPso.Get());
		commandList->SetComputeRootDescriptorTable(0, GpuHandle(RendererState::g_kFSR_SCRATCH_SRV_INDEX));
		commandList->SetComputeRootDescriptorTable(1, outputUav);
		commandList->SetComputeRoot32BitConstants(4, 20, &rcasConstants, 0);
		commandList->Dispatch((outputWidth + 15u) / 16u, (outputHeight + 15u) / 16u, 1);
		return true;
	}

	if (mode == UpscaleMode::Nis)
	{
		NISConfig config{};
		if (!NVScalerUpdateConfig(
			config,
			RendererSettings::GetNisSharpness(),
			0, 0, inputWidth, inputHeight, inputWidth, inputHeight,
			0, 0, outputWidth, outputHeight, outputWidth, outputHeight,
			NISHDRMode::None))
		{
			return false;
		}
		commandList->SetPipelineState(g_NisPso.Get());
		commandList->SetComputeRootDescriptorTable(0, inputSrv);
		commandList->SetComputeRootDescriptorTable(1, outputUav);
		commandList->SetComputeRootDescriptorTable(2, GpuHandle(RendererState::g_kNIS_COEF_SCALE_SRV_INDEX));
		commandList->SetComputeRootDescriptorTable(3, GpuHandle(RendererState::g_kNIS_COEF_USM_SRV_INDEX));
		commandList->SetComputeRoot32BitConstants(4, kNisConfigDwordCount, &config, 0);
		commandList->Dispatch((outputWidth + 31u) / 32u, (outputHeight + 23u) / 24u, 1);
		return true;
	}
	return false;
}

===== FILE: rendering\thumbnailmeshio.h =====
#pragma once
#include <cfileio.h>
#include <filesystem>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdint>
#include <limits>
#include <memory>
#include <vector>
#include <string>

// Only C data crosses the DLL boundary; Debug and Release STL layouts differ.
class ThumbnailMeshIO
{
public:
    explicit ThumbnailMeshIO(std::vector<std::filesystem::path>& files) : m_Files(files) {}
    aiFileIO Callbacks()
    {
        aiFileIO callbacks{};
        callbacks.UserData = reinterpret_cast<char*>(this);
        callbacks.OpenProc = [](aiFileIO* io, const char* path, const char* mode) -> aiFile*
        {
            if (!path || !mode || mode[0] != 'r') return nullptr;
            try { return reinterpret_cast<ThumbnailMeshIO*>(io->UserData)->Open(path); }
            catch (...) { return nullptr; }
        };
        callbacks.CloseProc = [](aiFileIO*, aiFile* file)
        {
            if (!file) return;
            std::fclose(reinterpret_cast<FILE*>(file->UserData));
            delete file;
        };
        return callbacks;
    }
private:
    aiFile* Open(const char* path)
    {
        const std::string bytes(path);
        const std::u8string utf8(bytes.begin(), bytes.end());
        const auto name = std::filesystem::absolute(std::filesystem::path(utf8)).lexically_normal();
        if (std::find(m_Files.begin(), m_Files.end(), name) == m_Files.end()) m_Files.push_back(name);
        auto file = std::make_unique<aiFile>();
        FILE* stream = nullptr;
        if (_wfopen_s(&stream, name.c_str(), L"rb") != 0) return nullptr;
        file->UserData = reinterpret_cast<char*>(stream);
        file->ReadProc = [](aiFile* file, char* output, size_t size, size_t count)
        { return std::fread(output, size, count, reinterpret_cast<FILE*>(file->UserData)); };
        file->WriteProc = [](aiFile*, const char*, size_t, size_t) -> size_t { return 0; };
        file->TellProc = [](aiFile* file) -> size_t
        { return static_cast<size_t>(_ftelli64(reinterpret_cast<FILE*>(file->UserData))); };
        file->FileSizeProc = [](aiFile* file) -> size_t
        {
            auto* stream = reinterpret_cast<FILE*>(file->UserData);
            const auto position = _ftelli64(stream);
            _fseeki64(stream, 0, SEEK_END);
            const auto bytes = _ftelli64(stream);
            _fseeki64(stream, position, SEEK_SET);
            return bytes >= 0 ? static_cast<size_t>(bytes) : 0;
        };
        file->SeekProc = [](aiFile* file, size_t offset, aiOrigin origin)
        {
            if (offset > static_cast<size_t>(std::numeric_limits<int64_t>::max())) return aiReturn_FAILURE;
            const int anchor = origin == aiOrigin_SET ? SEEK_SET : origin == aiOrigin_CUR ? SEEK_CUR : SEEK_END;
            const auto displacement = origin == aiOrigin_END ? -static_cast<int64_t>(offset) : static_cast<int64_t>(offset);
            return _fseeki64(reinterpret_cast<FILE*>(file->UserData), displacement, anchor) == 0 ? aiReturn_SUCCESS : aiReturn_FAILURE;
        };
        file->FlushProc = [](aiFile*) {};
        return file.release();
    }
    std::vector<std::filesystem::path>& m_Files;
};

uint64_t Combine(uint64_t hash, uint64_t value)
{
    return (hash ^ value) * 1099511628211ull;
}

bool Decode(ThumbnailSourceImage& source, UINT maximumSize, std::string& error)
{
    if (source.Borrowed || source.Decoded || (source.Path.empty() && source.Encoded.empty())) return true;
    DirectX::ScratchImage image;
    DirectX::TexMetadata metadata;
    auto extension = source.Path.extension().string();
    std::transform(extension.begin(), extension.end(), extension.begin(), [](unsigned char c) { return static_cast<char>(std::tolower(c)); });
    HRESULT result = E_FAIL;
    if (!source.Encoded.empty())
    {
        result = DirectX::LoadFromWICMemory(source.Encoded.data(), source.Encoded.size(), DirectX::WIC_FLAGS_NONE, &metadata, image);
        if (FAILED(result)) result = DirectX::LoadFromDDSMemory(source.Encoded.data(), source.Encoded.size(), DirectX::DDS_FLAGS_NONE, &metadata, image);
        if (FAILED(result)) result = DirectX::LoadFromTGAMemory(source.Encoded.data(), source.Encoded.size(), &metadata, image);
    }
    else if (extension == ".dds") result = DirectX::LoadFromDDSFile(source.Path.c_str(), DirectX::DDS_FLAGS_NONE, &metadata, image);
    else if (extension == ".tga") result = DirectX::LoadFromTGAFile(source.Path.c_str(), &metadata, image);
    else if (extension == ".hdr") result = DirectX::LoadFromHDRFile(source.Path.c_str(), &metadata, image);
    else result = DirectX::LoadFromWICFile(source.Path.c_str(), DirectX::WIC_FLAGS_NONE, &metadata, image);
    if (FAILED(result) || metadata.dimension != DirectX::TEX_DIMENSION_TEXTURE2D || metadata.arraySize != 1 || metadata.IsCubemap())
    {
        error = "Unsupported or unreadable 2D texture: " + source.Path.generic_string();
        return false;
    }
    DirectX::ScratchImage converted;
    if (DirectX::IsCompressed(metadata.format))
        result = DirectX::Decompress(*image.GetImage(0, 0, 0), DXGI_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM, converted);
    else if (metadata.format != DXGI_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM)
        result = DirectX::Convert(*image.GetImage(0, 0, 0), DXGI_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM, DirectX::TEX_FILTER_DEFAULT, 0, converted);
    else result = S_OK;
    if (FAILED(result)) { error = "Unsupported texture format"; return false; }
    const auto* pixels = converted.GetImageCount() ? converted.GetImage(0, 0, 0) : image.GetImage(0, 0, 0);
    const float scale = std::min(1.0f, static_cast<float>(maximumSize) / static_cast<float>(std::max(pixels->width, pixels->height)));
    source.Decoded = std::make_unique<DirectX::ScratchImage>();
    result = DirectX::Resize(*pixels, std::max<size_t>(1, static_cast<size_t>(pixels->width * scale)),
        std::max<size_t>(1, static_cast<size_t>(pixels->height * scale)), DirectX::TEX_FILTER_DEFAULT, *source.Decoded);
    if (FAILED(result)) { error = "Thumbnail resize failed"; return false; }
    return true;
}

ThumbnailPrepared::MeshPart ReadMeshMaterial(const aiScene& scene, const aiMesh& mesh, const std::filesystem::path& modelPath)
{
    ThumbnailPrepared::MeshPart part;
    if (mesh.mMaterialIndex >= scene.mNumMaterials) return part;
    const auto& source = *scene.mMaterials[mesh.mMaterialIndex];
    aiColor4D color(1, 1, 1, 1);
    if (source.Get(AI_MATKEY_BASE_COLOR, color) != AI_SUCCESS) source.Get(AI_MATKEY_COLOR_DIFFUSE, color);
    part.Material.BaseColor = {color.r, color.g, color.b, color.a};
    source.Get(AI_MATKEY_METALLIC_FACTOR, part.Material.Metallic);
    source.Get(AI_MATKEY_ROUGHNESS_FACTOR, part.Material.Roughness);
    float opacity = 1;
    source.Get(AI_MATKEY_OPACITY, opacity);
    part.Material.BaseColor[3] *= opacity;
    if (part.Material.BaseColor[3] < 1) part.Material.Surface = MaterialSurface::Transparent;
    int twoSided = 0;
    source.Get(AI_MATKEY_TWOSIDED, twoSided);
    if (twoSided) part.Material.Cull = MaterialCull::None;
    const aiTextureType types[] = {aiTextureType_BASE_COLOR, aiTextureType_NORMALS, aiTextureType_UNKNOWN, aiTextureType_AMBIENT_OCCLUSION, aiTextureType_EMISSIVE};
    for (size_t slot = 0; slot < part.Textures.size(); ++slot)
    {
        aiString reference;
        auto status = source.GetTexture(types[slot], 0, &reference);
        if (slot == 0 && status != AI_SUCCESS) status = source.GetTexture(aiTextureType_DIFFUSE, 0, &reference);
        if (status != AI_SUCCESS) continue;
        auto& texture = part.Textures[slot];
        if (const auto* embedded = scene.GetEmbeddedTexture(reference.C_Str()))
        {
            texture.Identity = modelPath.generic_string() + "|" + reference.C_Str();
            if (!embedded->mHeight)
            {
                const auto* bytes = reinterpret_cast<const uint8_t*>(embedded->pcData);
                texture.Encoded.assign(bytes, bytes + embedded->mWidth);
            }
            else
            {
                DirectX::ScratchImage decoded;
                if (SUCCEEDED(decoded.Initialize2D(DXGI_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM, embedded->mWidth, embedded->mHeight, 1, 1)))
                {
                    const auto* image = decoded.GetImage(0, 0, 0);
                    for (UINT row = 0; row < embedded->mHeight; ++row)
                    {
                        auto* destination = image->pixels + row * image->rowPitch;
                        for (UINT column = 0; column < embedded->mWidth; ++column)
                        {
                            const auto pixel = embedded->pcData[row * embedded->mWidth + column];
                            destination[column * 4] = pixel.r; destination[column * 4 + 1] = pixel.g;
                            destination[column * 4 + 2] = pixel.b; destination[column * 4 + 3] = pixel.a;
                        }
                    }
                    texture.Decoded = std::make_unique<DirectX::ScratchImage>();
                    const float scale = std::min(1.0f, 256.0f / std::max(embedded->mWidth, embedded->mHeight));
                    if (FAILED(DirectX::Resize(*image, std::max<size_t>(1, static_cast<size_t>(embedded->mWidth * scale)),
                        std::max<size_t>(1, static_cast<size_t>(embedded->mHeight * scale)), DirectX::TEX_FILTER_DEFAULT, *texture.Decoded))) texture.Decoded.reset();
                }
            }
        }
        else
        {
            texture.Path = (modelPath.parent_path() / std::filesystem::u8path(reference.C_Str())).lexically_normal();
            texture.BorrowedDescriptor = TextureManager::FindLoadedTexture(texture.Path);
            if (texture.BorrowedDescriptor >= 0) texture.Borrowed = TextureManager::GetTextureResource(texture.BorrowedDescriptor);
        }
    }
    return part;
}

void ReadMeshNode(const aiScene& scene, const aiNode& node, const aiMatrix4x4& parent, ThumbnailPrepared& input)
{
    auto& vertices = input.Geometry;
    const auto transform = parent * node.mTransformation;
    auto normalTransform = aiMatrix3x3(transform);
    normalTransform.Inverse().Transpose();
    for (unsigned int index = 0; index < node.mNumMeshes; ++index)
    {
        const auto& mesh = *scene.mMeshes[node.mMeshes[index]];
        auto part = ReadMeshMaterial(scene, mesh, input.SourcePath);
        part.FirstVertex = static_cast<UINT>(vertices.size());
        aiColor4D color(1, 1, 1, 1);
        if (mesh.mMaterialIndex < scene.mNumMaterials) scene.mMaterials[mesh.mMaterialIndex]->Get(AI_MATKEY_COLOR_DIFFUSE, color);
        for (unsigned int faceIndex = 0; faceIndex < mesh.mNumFaces; ++faceIndex)
        {
            const auto& face = mesh.mFaces[faceIndex];
            if (face.mNumIndices != 3) continue;
            for (unsigned int corner = 0; corner < 3; ++corner)
            {
                const auto vertexIndex = face.mIndices[corner];
                const auto position = transform * mesh.mVertices[vertexIndex];
                auto normal = mesh.HasNormals() ? normalTransform * mesh.mNormals[vertexIndex] : aiVector3D(0, 1, 0);
                normal.Normalize();
                const auto uv = mesh.HasTextureCoords(0) ? mesh.mTextureCoords[0][vertexIndex] : aiVector3D();
                vertices.push_back({{position.x, position.y, position.z}, {normal.x, normal.y, normal.z},
                    {uv.x, uv.y}, {1, 1, 1, 10}});
            }
        }
        part.VertexCount = static_cast<UINT>(vertices.size()) - part.FirstVertex;
        if (part.VertexCount) input.MeshParts.push_back(std::move(part));
    }
    for (unsigned int child = 0; child < node.mNumChildren; ++child)
        ReadMeshNode(scene, *node.mChildren[child], transform, input);
}

std::shared_ptr<ThumbnailGpuImage> Upload(ThumbnailSourceImage& source, bool alias)
{
    auto image = std::make_shared<ThumbnailGpuImage>();
    if (!source.Borrowed || alias)
    {
        image->Descriptor = EditorDescriptors::Allocate();
        if (!image->Descriptor) return {};
    }
    if (source.Borrowed)
    {
        const auto description = source.Borrowed->GetDesc();
        if (description.Dimension != D3D12_RESOURCE_DIMENSION_TEXTURE2D || description.DepthOrArraySize != 1 ||
            description.SampleDesc.Count != 1 || description.Flags & D3D12_RESOURCE_FLAG_ALLOW_DEPTH_STENCIL) return {};
        image->Resource = source.Borrowed;
        image->Width = static_cast<UINT>(description.Width);
        image->Height = description.Height;
        image->BorrowedDescriptor = CD3DX12_GPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE(FrameConstants::GetCbvHeap()->GetGPUDescriptorHandleForHeapStart(),
            source.BorrowedDescriptor, FrameConstants::GetCbvIncrementSize());
        if (!alias) return image;
    }
    else
    {
        if (!source.Decoded) return {};
        const auto* decoded = source.Decoded->GetImage(0, 0, 0);
        image->Width = static_cast<UINT>(decoded->width);
        image->Height = static_cast<UINT>(decoded->height);
        const auto heap = CD3DX12_HEAP_PROPERTIES(D3D12_HEAP_TYPE_DEFAULT);
        const auto description = CD3DX12_RESOURCE_DESC::Tex2D(decoded->format, image->Width, image->Height, 1, 1);
        auto* device = GraphicsDevice::GetDevice();
        if (FAILED(device->CreateCommittedResource(&heap, D3D12_HEAP_FLAG_NONE, &description, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_COPY_DEST,
            nullptr, IID_PPV_ARGS(&image->Resource)))) return {};
        const auto uploadHeap = CD3DX12_HEAP_PROPERTIES(D3D12_HEAP_TYPE_UPLOAD);
        const auto uploadSize = GetRequiredIntermediateSize(image->Resource.Get(), 0, 1);
        const auto uploadDescription = CD3DX12_RESOURCE_DESC::Buffer(uploadSize);
        if (FAILED(device->CreateCommittedResource(&uploadHeap, D3D12_HEAP_FLAG_NONE, &uploadDescription,
            D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_GENERIC_READ, nullptr, IID_PPV_ARGS(&image->Upload)))) return {};
        D3D12_SUBRESOURCE_DATA data{decoded->pixels, static_cast<LONG_PTR>(decoded->rowPitch), static_cast<LONG_PTR>(decoded->slicePitch)};
        image->Bytes = device->GetResourceAllocationInfo(0, 1, &description).SizeInBytes +
            device->GetResourceAllocationInfo(0, 1, &uploadDescription).SizeInBytes;
        Retain(image); // Includes failure paths after commands reference the upload or destination.
        if (!UpdateSubresources(GraphicsDevice::GetCommandList(), image->Resource.Get(), image->Upload.Get(), 0, 0, 1, &data)) return {};
        auto barrier = CD3DX12_RESOURCE_BARRIER::Transition(image->Resource.Get(), D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_COPY_DEST,
            D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE);
        GraphicsDevice::GetCommandList()->ResourceBarrier(1, &barrier);
    }
    D3D12_SHADER_RESOURCE_VIEW_DESC srv{};
    srv.Format = image->Resource->GetDesc().Format;
    srv.ViewDimension = D3D12_SRV_DIMENSION_TEXTURE2D;
    srv.Shader4ComponentMapping = D3D12_DEFAULT_SHADER_4_COMPONENT_MAPPING;
    srv.Texture2D.MipLevels = image->Resource->GetDesc().MipLevels;
    if (source.Borrowed)
    {
        srv.Texture2D.MostDetailedMip = TextureManager::GetTextureResidentMip(source.BorrowedDescriptor);
        srv.Texture2D.MipLevels -= srv.Texture2D.MostDetailedMip;
        // Shader-visible heaps cannot be read as CopyDescriptors sources.
        GraphicsDevice::GetDevice()->CreateShaderResourceView(image->Resource.Get(), &srv, image->Descriptor->Cpu);
        TextureManager::TouchTexture(source.BorrowedDescriptor);
    }
    else GraphicsDevice::GetDevice()->CreateShaderResourceView(image->Resource.Get(), &srv, image->Descriptor->Cpu);
    image->SubmissionFence = GraphicsDevice::GetPendingSubmissionFence();
    return image;
}
}

uint64_t ThumbnailRenderer::SourceRevision(const std::filesystem::path& path)
{
    if (path.empty()) return 0;
    std::error_code error;
    const auto time = std::filesystem::last_write_time(path, error);
    if (error) return 0;
    const auto bytes = std::filesystem::file_size(path, error);
    return error ? 0 : Combine(static_cast<uint64_t>(time.time_since_epoch().count()), bytes);
}

std::filesystem::path ThumbnailRenderer::CachePath(AssetHandle handle)
{
    return std::filesystem::path("EditorCache/Thumbnails") / ThumbnailCacheFileName(handle);
}

ThumbnailPrepared ThumbnailRenderer::Prepare(ThumbnailPrepared input)
{
    if (!input.Error.empty()) return input;
    const HRESULT com = CoInitializeEx(nullptr, COINIT_MULTITHREADED);
    struct ComScope { bool Owned; ~ComScope() { if (Owned) CoUninitialize(); } } scope{SUCCEEDED(com)};
    if (input.Type == AssetType::Mesh)
    {
        std::vector<std::filesystem::path> importedFiles;
        ThumbnailMeshIO io(importedFiles);
        auto callbacks = io.Callbacks();
        const auto utf8Path = input.SourcePath.generic_u8string();
        const auto* scene = aiImportFileEx(std::string(utf8Path.begin(), utf8Path.end()).c_str(),
            aiProcess_Triangulate | aiProcess_GenSmoothNormals | aiProcess_ConvertToLeftHanded | aiProcess_ValidateDataStructure, &callbacks);
        const std::unique_ptr<const aiScene, decltype(&aiReleaseImport)> owner(scene, aiReleaseImport);
        if (!scene || !scene->mRootNode) input.Error = aiGetErrorString();
        else ReadMeshNode(*scene, *scene->mRootNode, aiMatrix4x4(), input);
        if (input.Geometry.empty()) input.Error = "Mesh contains no triangles";
        for (const auto& file : importedFiles)
        {
            if (file != input.SourcePath) input.SourceDependencies.push_back({file,
                SourceRevision(file) ^ SourceRevision(file.wstring() + L".meta")});
        }
    }
    for (auto& part : input.MeshParts)
    {
        for (auto& texture : part.Textures)
        {
            if (!texture.Path.empty()) input.SourceDependencies.push_back({texture.Path,
                SourceRevision(texture.Path) ^ SourceRevision(texture.Path.wstring() + L".meta")});
        }
    }
    auto key = Combine(input.Key, ThumbnailGeneratorVersion);
    key = Combine(key, input.Size);
    for (auto& texture : input.Textures)
    {
        key = Combine(key, SourceRevision(texture.Path));
        key = Combine(key, SourceRevision(texture.Path.wstring() + L".meta"));
    }
    for (const auto& dependency : input.SourceDependencies) key = Combine(key, dependency.second);
    input.Key = key;
    const auto cachePath = CachePath(input.Handle);
    uint64_t cachedKey = 0;
    std::ifstream manifest(cachePath.string() + ".key");
    if (input.UseDiskCache && !input.BypassDiskCache && !(input.Type == AssetType::Texture && input.Textures[0].Borrowed) && manifest >> cachedKey && cachedKey == key)
    {
        auto cached = std::make_unique<DirectX::ScratchImage>();
        DirectX::TexMetadata metadata;
        if (SUCCEEDED(DirectX::LoadFromDDSFile(cachePath.c_str(), DirectX::DDS_FLAGS_NONE, &metadata, *cached)) &&
            metadata.dimension == DirectX::TEX_DIMENSION_TEXTURE2D && metadata.arraySize == 1 && !metadata.IsCubemap() &&
            metadata.width <= input.Size && metadata.height <= input.Size)
        {
            input.Cached = true;
            input.Textures[0].Borrowed.Reset();
            input.Textures[0].Decoded = std::move(cached);
            return input;
        }
    }
    for (auto& texture : input.Textures)
    {
        if (input.Type != AssetType::Mesh && !Decode(texture, input.Type == AssetType::Texture ? input.Size : 256, input.Error)) return input;
    }
    for (auto& part : input.MeshParts)
        for (auto& texture : part.Textures) if (!Decode(texture, 256, input.Error)) return input;
    return input;
}

std::shared_ptr<ThumbnailGpuImage> ThumbnailRenderer::Generate(ThumbnailPrepared& input)
{
    if (!input.Error.empty()) return {};
    if (input.Type == AssetType::Texture || input.Cached) return Upload(input.Textures[0], false);
    auto result = std::make_shared<ThumbnailGpuImage>();
    result->Descriptor = EditorDescriptors::Allocate();
    if (!result->Descriptor) return {};
    result->Preview = std::make_shared<ThumbnailPreviewContext>();
    if (!result->Preview->Initialize(input.Size, result->Descriptor->Index)) return {};
    result->Resource = result->Preview->GetTarget();
    const auto initialPreviewBytes = result->Preview->MemoryBytes();
    result->Bytes = initialPreviewBytes;
    Retain(result);
    std::array<int, 5> descriptors{-1, -1, -1, -1, -1};
    std::unordered_map<std::string, std::shared_ptr<ThumbnailGpuImage>> textureImages;
    const auto uploadDependency = [&](ThumbnailSourceImage& source)
    {
        const auto key = source.IdentityKey();
        if (const auto found = textureImages.find(key); !key.empty() && found != textureImages.end()) return found->second;
        auto image = Upload(source, true);
        if (image)
        {
            if (!key.empty()) textureImages.emplace(key, image);
            result->Bytes += image->Bytes;
            result->Dependencies.push_back(image);
        }
        return image;
    };
    if (input.Type == AssetType::Material)
    {
        for (size_t slot = 0; slot < input.Textures.size(); ++slot)
        {
            auto& source = input.Textures[slot];
            if (source.Path.empty()) continue;
            auto texture = uploadDependency(source);
            if (!texture || !texture->Descriptor) return {};
            descriptors[slot] = static_cast<int>(texture->Descriptor->Index);
        }
    }
    std::vector<ThumbnailPreviewPart> parts;
    for (auto& part : input.MeshParts)
    {
        std::array<int, 5> textureDescriptors{-1, -1, -1, -1, -1};
        for (size_t slot = 0; slot < part.Textures.size(); ++slot)
        {
            auto& source = part.Textures[slot];
            if (source.Path.empty() && !source.Decoded && source.Encoded.empty()) continue;
            auto texture = uploadDependency(source);
            if (!texture || !texture->Descriptor) return {};
            textureDescriptors[slot] = static_cast<int>(texture->Descriptor->Index);
        }
        parts.push_back({MaterialManager::BuildPreviewBinding(part.Material, textureDescriptors), part.FirstVertex, part.VertexCount});
    }
    auto material = MaterialManager::BuildPreviewBinding(input.Material, descriptors);
    if (!result->Preview->Render(material, input.Geometry, parts)) return {};
    result->Resource = result->Preview->GetTarget();
    result->Width = result->Height = input.Size;
    result->Bytes = result->Bytes - initialPreviewBytes + result->Preview->MemoryBytes();
    result->SubmissionFence = GraphicsDevice::GetPendingSubmissionFence();
    return result;
}

bool ThumbnailRenderer::BeginReadback(const std::shared_ptr<ThumbnailGpuImage>& image)
{
    const auto description = image->Resource->GetDesc();
    UINT64 bytes = 0;
    GraphicsDevice::GetDevice()->GetCopyableFootprints(&description, 0, 1, 0, &image->Footprint, nullptr, nullptr, &bytes);
    const auto heap = CD3DX12_HEAP_PROPERTIES(D3D12_HEAP_TYPE_READBACK);
    const auto buffer = CD3DX12_RESOURCE_DESC::Buffer(bytes);
    if (FAILED(GraphicsDevice::GetDevice()->CreateCommittedResource(&heap, D3D12_HEAP_FLAG_NONE, &buffer,
        D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_COPY_DEST, nullptr, IID_PPV_ARGS(&image->Readback)))) return false;
    image->Bytes += GraphicsDevice::GetDevice()->GetResourceAllocationInfo(0, 1, &buffer).SizeInBytes;
    auto* commands = GraphicsDevice::GetCommandList();
    D3D12_RESOURCE_BARRIER barrier = CD3DX12_RESOURCE_BARRIER::Transition(image->Resource.Get(), D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_COPY_SOURCE);
    commands->ResourceBarrier(1, &barrier);
    const CD3DX12_TEXTURE_COPY_LOCATION source(image->Resource.Get(), 0);
    const CD3DX12_TEXTURE_COPY_LOCATION destination(image->Readback.Get(), image->Footprint);
    commands->CopyTextureRegion(&destination, 0, 0, 0, &source, nullptr);
    std::swap(barrier.Transition.StateBefore, barrier.Transition.StateAfter);
    commands->ResourceBarrier(1, &barrier);
    image->SubmissionFence = GraphicsDevice::GetPendingSubmissionFence();
    return true;
}

std::future<void> ThumbnailRenderer::SaveCache(const ThumbnailPrepared& input, const std::shared_ptr<ThumbnailGpuImage>& image)
{
    const auto path = CachePath(input.Handle);
    const auto key = input.Key;
    return std::async(std::launch::async, [path, key, image]
    {
        DirectX::ScratchImage pixels;
        if (FAILED(pixels.Initialize2D(image->Resource->GetDesc().Format, image->Width, image->Height, 1, 1))) return;
        const auto* target = pixels.GetImage(0, 0, 0);
        uint8_t* source = nullptr;
        D3D12_RANGE read{0, static_cast<SIZE_T>(image->Readback->GetDesc().Width)};
        if (FAILED(image->Readback->Map(0, &read, reinterpret_cast<void**>(&source)))) return;
        for (UINT row = 0; row < image->Height; ++row)
            memcpy(target->pixels + row * target->rowPitch, source + image->Footprint.Offset + row * image->Footprint.Footprint.RowPitch, target->rowPitch);
        const D3D12_RANGE noWrite{0, 0};
        image->Readback->Unmap(0, &noWrite);
        std::error_code error;
        std::filesystem::create_directories(path.parent_path(), error);
        if (error) return;
        const std::filesystem::path temporary(path.wstring() + L".tmp");
        if (FAILED(DirectX::SaveToDDSFile(pixels.GetImages(), pixels.GetImageCount(), pixels.GetMetadata(), DirectX::DDS_FLAGS_NONE, temporary.c_str()))) return;
        if (!MoveFileExW(temporary.c_str(), path.c_str(), MOVEFILE_REPLACE_EXISTING | MOVEFILE_WRITE_THROUGH)) return;
        std::string message;
        WriteAssetFile(path.string() + ".key", std::to_string(key), message);
    });
}

void ThumbnailRenderer::Collect()
{
    const auto completed = GraphicsDevice::GetCompletedFence();
    std::erase_if(inFlight, [completed](const auto& item) { return item.Fence <= completed; });
}

uint64_t ThumbnailRenderer::InFlightBytes()
{
    uint64_t bytes = 0;
    for (const auto& item : inFlight) bytes += item.Image->Bytes;
    return bytes;
}

void ThumbnailRenderer::Shutdown() { inFlight.clear(); }

===== FILE: rendering\thumbnailrenderer.h =====
#pragma once
#include "materialasset.h"
#include "staticmodel.h"
#include "editordescriptors.h"
#include "thumbnailpreviewcontext.h"
#include <DirectXTex.h>
#include <future>

struct ThumbnailSourceImage
{
    std::filesystem::path Path;
    ComPtr<ID3D12Resource> Borrowed;

#include "pch.h"
#include "transmittanceshadows.h"
#include "graphicsdevice.h"

ComPtr<ID3D12Resource> g_Color, g_Depth, g_Constants;
ComPtr<ID3D12DescriptorHeap> g_Rtv, g_Dsv;
ComPtr<ID3D12PipelineState> g_Pso;
UINT8* g_Mapped = nullptr;
bool g_HasCasters = false, g_Active = false;
UINT g_Slice = 0, g_PreviousDescriptor = 0, g_ConstantOffset = 0;
struct ShadowTransmissionConstants
{
    XMMATRIX ViewProjection;
    XMFLOAT4 MapParams, FilterParams, PeelParams, LightPositionType, LightDirection;
};
static_assert(sizeof(ShadowTransmissionConstants) <= 256);

void TransmittanceShadows::PrepareFrame()
{
    g_HasCasters = false;
    for (EntityID entity : World::GetView<MaterialComponent>())
    {
        if (ComponentManager::HasComponent<LightComponent>(entity)) continue;
        if (ComponentManager::HasComponent<MeshComponent>(entity) &&
            ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<MeshComponent>(entity).IsEnvironment) continue;
        if (ComponentManager::HasComponent<SpriteComponent>(entity) &&
            !ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<SpriteComponent>(entity).Is3D) continue;
        if (!ComponentManager::HasComponent<TransformComponent>(entity) ||
            !(ComponentManager::HasComponent<MeshComponent>(entity) ||
              ComponentManager::HasComponent<SpriteComponent>(entity) ||
              ComponentManager::HasComponent<StaticModelComponent>(entity) ||
              ComponentManager::HasComponent<AnimationModelComponent>(entity))) continue;
        const auto& source = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<MaterialComponent>(entity);
        const UINT count = static_cast<UINT>(source.MaterialSlots.size());
        for (UINT slot = 0; slot <= count; ++slot)
        {
            const auto& material = slot == count ? MaterialManager::Resolve(source) : MaterialManager::Resolve(source, slot);
            if (MaterialSystem::CastsShadowInPass(material, true)) { g_HasCasters = true; break; }
        }
        if (g_HasCasters) break;
    }
    if (g_HasCasters && !CreateResources())
    {
        g_HasCasters = false;
        Debug::Log("ERROR: Transmittance shadow resources unavailable\n");
    }
}

bool TransmittanceShadows::HasCasters() { return g_HasCasters; }
bool TransmittanceShadows::IsActive() { return g_Active; }
ID3D12PipelineState* TransmittanceShadows::GetPipelineState() { return g_Pso.Get(); }
ID3D12Resource* TransmittanceShadows::GetColorResource() { return g_Color.Get(); }
ID3D12Resource* TransmittanceShadows::GetDepthResource() { return g_Depth.Get(); }
D3D12_GPU_VIRTUAL_ADDRESS TransmittanceShadows::GetCurrentConstantBufferAddress()
{
    return g_Constants ? g_Constants->GetGPUVirtualAddress() + g_ConstantOffset : 0;
}

bool TransmittanceShadows::CreateResources()
{
    if (g_Pso) return true;
    auto* device = m_Device.Get();
    constexpr UINT slices = g_kMAX_SHADOW_LIGHTS * g_kTRANSMITTANCE_SHADOW_LAYERS;
    auto heap = CD3DX12_HEAP_PROPERTIES(D3D12_HEAP_TYPE_DEFAULT);
    auto colorDesc = CD3DX12_RESOURCE_DESC::Tex2D(DXGI_FORMAT_R16G16B16A16_FLOAT,
        g_kTRANSMITTANCE_SHADOW_SIZE, g_kTRANSMITTANCE_SHADOW_SIZE, slices, 1, 1, 0,
        D3D12_RESOURCE_FLAG_ALLOW_RENDER_TARGET);
    D3D12_CLEAR_VALUE colorClear{DXGI_FORMAT_R16G16B16A16_FLOAT, {1, 1, 1, 1}};
    if (FAILED(device->CreateCommittedResource(&heap, D3D12_HEAP_FLAG_NONE, &colorDesc,
        D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE, &colorClear, IID_PPV_ARGS(&g_Color)))) return false;
    auto depthDesc = colorDesc;
    depthDesc.Format = DXGI_FORMAT_R32_TYPELESS;
    depthDesc.Flags = D3D12_RESOURCE_FLAG_ALLOW_DEPTH_STENCIL;
    D3D12_CLEAR_VALUE depthClear{};
    depthClear.Format = DXGI_FORMAT_D32_FLOAT;
    depthClear.DepthStencil.Depth = 1;
    if (FAILED(device->CreateCommittedResource(&heap, D3D12_HEAP_FLAG_NONE, &depthDesc,
        D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE, &depthClear, IID_PPV_ARGS(&g_Depth)))) return false;
    g_Color->SetName(L"Peeled RGB shadow transmission");
    g_Depth->SetName(L"Peeled transparent shadow depth");
    D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_HEAP_DESC views{};
    views.NumDescriptors = slices;
    views.Type = D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_HEAP_TYPE_RTV;
    if (FAILED(device->CreateDescriptorHeap(&views, IID_PPV_ARGS(&g_Rtv)))) return false;
    views.Type = D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_HEAP_TYPE_DSV;
    if (FAILED(device->CreateDescriptorHeap(&views, IID_PPV_ARGS(&g_Dsv)))) return false;
    const UINT rtvSize = device->GetDescriptorHandleIncrementSize(D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_HEAP_TYPE_RTV);
    const UINT dsvSize = device->GetDescriptorHandleIncrementSize(D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_HEAP_TYPE_DSV);
    auto srvHandle = [&](UINT index) { return CD3DX12_CPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE(
        m_CbvHeap->GetCPUDescriptorHandleForHeapStart(), index, m_CbvIncrementSize); };
    D3D12_SHADER_RESOURCE_VIEW_DESC srv{};
    srv.Shader4ComponentMapping = D3D12_DEFAULT_SHADER_4_COMPONENT_MAPPING;
    srv.ViewDimension = D3D12_SRV_DIMENSION_TEXTURE2DARRAY;
    srv.Texture2DArray.MipLevels = 1;
    srv.Texture2DArray.ArraySize = slices;
    srv.Format = DXGI_FORMAT_R16G16B16A16_FLOAT;
    device->CreateShaderResourceView(g_Color.Get(), &srv, srvHandle(g_kTRANSMITTANCE_SHADOW_SRV_START));
    srv.Format = DXGI_FORMAT_R32_FLOAT;
    device->CreateShaderResourceView(g_Depth.Get(), &srv, srvHandle(g_kTRANSMITTANCE_SHADOW_SRV_START + 1));
    for (UINT slice = 0; slice < slices; ++slice)
    {
        D3D12_RENDER_TARGET_VIEW_DESC rtv{};
        rtv.Format = DXGI_FORMAT_R16G16B16A16_FLOAT;
        rtv.ViewDimension = D3D12_RTV_DIMENSION_TEXTURE2DARRAY;
        rtv.Texture2DArray.FirstArraySlice = slice;
        rtv.Texture2DArray.ArraySize = 1;
        device->CreateRenderTargetView(g_Color.Get(), &rtv, CD3DX12_CPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE(g_Rtv->GetCPUDescriptorHandleForHeapStart(), slice, rtvSize));
        D3D12_DEPTH_STENCIL_VIEW_DESC dsv{};
        dsv.Format = DXGI_FORMAT_D32_FLOAT;
        dsv.ViewDimension = D3D12_DSV_DIMENSION_TEXTURE2DARRAY;
        dsv.Texture2DArray.FirstArraySlice = slice;
        dsv.Texture2DArray.ArraySize = 1;
        device->CreateDepthStencilView(g_Depth.Get(), &dsv, CD3DX12_CPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE(g_Dsv->GetCPUDescriptorHandleForHeapStart(), slice, dsvSize));
        srv.Texture2DArray.ArraySize = 1;
        srv.Texture2DArray.FirstArraySlice = slice;
        device->CreateShaderResourceView(g_Depth.Get(), &srv, srvHandle(g_kTRANSMITTANCE_SHADOW_SRV_START + 2 + slice));
    }
    heap = CD3DX12_HEAP_PROPERTIES(D3D12_HEAP_TYPE_UPLOAD);
    auto cbDesc = CD3DX12_RESOURCE_DESC::Buffer(g_kFRAME_COUNT * g_kMAX_SHADOW_PASSES * g_kTRANSMITTANCE_SHADOW_LAYERS * 256);
    if (FAILED(device->CreateCommittedResource(&heap, D3D12_HEAP_FLAG_NONE, &cbDesc,
        D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_GENERIC_READ, nullptr, IID_PPV_ARGS(&g_Constants)))) return false;
    CD3DX12_RANGE readRange(0, 0);
    if (FAILED(g_Constants->Map(0, &readRange, reinterpret_cast<void**>(&g_Mapped)))) return false;
    ComPtr<ID3DBlob> vs, ps;
    ShaderDescription shader{};
    shader.csoPath = "shader/hlsl/build/ShadowMapVS.cso";
    shader.ppBlob = vs.GetAddressOf();
    if (!ShaderPipelines::LoadShaderBlob(shader)) return false;
    shader.csoPath = "shader/hlsl/build/ShadowTransmissionPS.cso";
    shader.ppBlob = ps.GetAddressOf();
    if (!ShaderPipelines::LoadShaderBlob(shader)) return false;
    const D3D12_INPUT_ELEMENT_DESC layout[] = {
        {"POSITION", 0, DXGI_FORMAT_R32G32B32_FLOAT, 0, 0, D3D12_INPUT_CLASSIFICATION_PER_VERTEX_DATA, 0},
        {"NORMAL", 0, DXGI_FORMAT_R32G32B32_FLOAT, 0, 12, D3D12_INPUT_CLASSIFICATION_PER_VERTEX_DATA, 0},
        {"TEXCOORD", 0, DXGI_FORMAT_R32G32_FLOAT, 0, 24, D3D12_INPUT_CLASSIFICATION_PER_VERTEX_DATA, 0},
        {"COLOR", 0, DXGI_FORMAT_R32G32B32A32_FLOAT, 0, 32, D3D12_INPUT_CLASSIFICATION_PER_VERTEX_DATA, 0}};
    D3D12_GRAPHICS_PIPELINE_STATE_DESC pso{};
    pso.pRootSignature = ShaderPipelines::GetModelRootSignature();
    pso.VS = CD3DX12_SHADER_BYTECODE(vs.Get());
    pso.PS = CD3DX12_SHADER_BYTECODE(ps.Get());
    pso.InputLayout = {layout, _countof(layout)};
    pso.RasterizerState = CD3DX12_RASTERIZER_DESC(D3D12_DEFAULT);
    pso.RasterizerState.CullMode = D3D12_CULL_MODE_NONE;
    pso.BlendState = CD3DX12_BLEND_DESC(D3D12_DEFAULT);
    pso.DepthStencilState = CD3DX12_DEPTH_STENCIL_DESC(D3D12_DEFAULT);
    pso.SampleMask = UINT_MAX;
    pso.PrimitiveTopologyType = D3D12_PRIMITIVE_TOPOLOGY_TYPE_TRIANGLE;
    pso.NumRenderTargets = 1;
    pso.RTVFormats[0] = DXGI_FORMAT_R16G16B16A16_FLOAT;
    pso.DSVFormat = DXGI_FORMAT_D32_FLOAT;
    pso.SampleDesc.Count = 1;
    return SUCCEEDED(device->CreateGraphicsPipelineState(&pso, IID_PPV_ARGS(&g_Pso)));
}

bool TransmittanceShadows::BeginPass(UINT shadowIndex, UINT peel)
{
    if (!g_HasCasters || peel >= g_kTRANSMITTANCE_SHADOW_LAYERS) return false;
    UINT lightLayer;
    D3D12_VIEWPORT viewport;
    D3D12_RECT scissor;
    bool clearLayer;
    if (!LightingResources::GetShadowPassInfo(shadowIndex, lightLayer, viewport, scissor, clearLayer)) return false;
    LightingResources::SetCurrentShadowPassIndex(shadowIndex);
    g_Slice = lightLayer * g_kTRANSMITTANCE_SHADOW_LAYERS + peel;
    g_PreviousDescriptor = peel == 0 ? g_kSHADOW_SRV_INDEX : g_kTRANSMITTANCE_SHADOW_SRV_START + 2 + g_Slice - 1;
    g_ConstantOffset = ((m_FrameIndex * g_kMAX_SHADOW_PASSES + shadowIndex) * g_kTRANSMITTANCE_SHADOW_LAYERS + peel) * 256;
    ShadowTransmissionConstants constants{};
    constants.ViewProjection = XMMatrixTranspose(LightingResources::GetCurrentShadowViewProjection());
    constants.PeelParams = {static_cast<float>(peel), 1.0f / g_kTRANSMITTANCE_SHADOW_SIZE, 0.000001f, static_cast<float>(lightLayer)};
    LightingResources::GetCurrentShadowLight(constants.LightPositionType, constants.LightDirection);
    memcpy(g_Mapped + g_ConstantOffset, &constants, sizeof(constants));
    const float scale = static_cast<float>(g_kTRANSMITTANCE_SHADOW_SIZE) / g_kSHADOW_MAP_SIZE;
    viewport.TopLeftX *= scale; viewport.TopLeftY *= scale;
    viewport.Width *= scale; viewport.Height *= scale;
    scissor.left = static_cast<LONG>(scissor.left * scale); scissor.top = static_cast<LONG>(scissor.top * scale);
    scissor.right = static_cast<LONG>(scissor.right * scale); scissor.bottom = static_cast<LONG>(scissor.bottom * scale);
    D3D12_RESOURCE_BARRIER barriers[] = {
        CD3DX12_RESOURCE_BARRIER::Transition(g_Color.Get(), D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_RENDER_TARGET, g_Slice),
        CD3DX12_RESOURCE_BARRIER::Transition(g_Depth.Get(), D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_DEPTH_WRITE, g_Slice)};
    m_CommandList->ResourceBarrier(_countof(barriers), barriers);
    const auto rtv = CD3DX12_CPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE(g_Rtv->GetCPUDescriptorHandleForHeapStart(), g_Slice,
        m_Device->GetDescriptorHandleIncrementSize(D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_HEAP_TYPE_RTV));
    const auto dsv = CD3DX12_CPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE(g_Dsv->GetCPUDescriptorHandleForHeapStart(), g_Slice,
        m_Device->GetDescriptorHandleIncrementSize(D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_HEAP_TYPE_DSV));
    const float white[4] = {1, 1, 1, 1};
    const UINT rectCount = clearLayer ? 0 : 1;
    m_CommandList->ClearRenderTargetView(rtv, white, rectCount, clearLayer ? nullptr : &scissor);
    m_CommandList->ClearDepthStencilView(dsv, D3D12_CLEAR_FLAG_DEPTH, 1, 0, rectCount, clearLayer ? nullptr : &scissor);
    m_CommandList->OMSetRenderTargets(1, &rtv, FALSE, &dsv);
    m_CommandList->RSSetViewports(1, &viewport);
    m_CommandList->RSSetScissorRects(1, &scissor);
    m_CommandList->SetGraphicsRootSignature(ShaderPipelines::GetModelRootSignature());
    m_CommandList->IASetPrimitiveTopology(D3D_PRIMITIVE_TOPOLOGY_TRIANGLELIST);
    g_Active = true;
    BindCurrentPass(m_CommandList.Get());
    return true;
}

void TransmittanceShadows::BindCurrentPass(ID3D12GraphicsCommandList* commands)
{
    if (!g_Active) return;
    commands->SetGraphicsRootConstantBufferView(5, GetCurrentConstantBufferAddress());
    commands->SetGraphicsRootDescriptorTable(33, CD3DX12_GPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE(
        m_CbvHeap->GetGPUDescriptorHandleForHeapStart(), g_PreviousDescriptor, m_CbvIncrementSize));
}

void TransmittanceShadows::EndPass()
{
    D3D12_RESOURCE_BARRIER barriers[] = {
        CD3DX12_RESOURCE_BARRIER::Transition(g_Color.Get(), D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_RENDER_TARGET, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE, g_Slice),
        CD3DX12_RESOURCE_BARRIER::Transition(g_Depth.Get(), D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_DEPTH_WRITE, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE, g_Slice)};
    m_CommandList->ResourceBarrier(_countof(barriers), barriers);
    g_Active = false;
}

void TransmittanceShadows::BindLighting(ID3D12GraphicsCommandList* commands, UINT colorRoot, UINT depthRoot)
{
    const UINT start = g_Color ? g_kTRANSMITTANCE_SHADOW_SRV_START : g_kSHADOW_SRV_INDEX;
    commands->SetGraphicsRootDescriptorTable(colorRoot, CD3DX12_GPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE(m_CbvHeap->GetGPUDescriptorHandleForHeapStart(), start, m_CbvIncrementSize));
    commands->SetGraphicsRootDescriptorTable(depthRoot, CD3DX12_GPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE(m_CbvHeap->GetGPUDescriptorHandleForHeapStart(), g_Depth ? start + 1 : start, m_CbvIncrementSize));
}

void TransmittanceShadows::Shutdown()
{
    if (g_Mapped && g_Constants) g_Constants->Unmap(0, nullptr);
    g_Mapped = nullptr;
    g_Constants.Reset(); g_Color.Reset(); g_Depth.Reset(); g_Rtv.Reset(); g_Dsv.Reset(); g_Pso.Reset();
    g_Active = false; g_HasCasters = false;
}

#include "pch.h"

namespace GPUVisibility
