namespace
{
struct Constants
{
    XMFLOAT4X4 View{}, Projection{}, PreviousViewProjection{};
    uint32_t Slots = 0, Meshes = 0, Groups = 0, Levels = 0;
    uint32_t Occlusion = 0, LOD = 0, Reset = 0, Force = UINT32_MAX;
    float DepthBias = 0, LODBias = 0, Width = 1, Height = 1;
    uint32_t Mips = 1, Debug = 0, NativeHierarchy = 0, Padding = 0;
};
static_assert(sizeof(Constants) == 256);
struct FrameData
{
    GpuSceneBuffer Result, Counters;
    ComPtr<ID3D12Resource> Readback, RecordReadback;
    bool Pending = false;
    uint32_t RecordCount = 0;
};
struct State
{
    Settings Options;
    Constants Parameters;
    vector<Visibility::GPULODGroup> Groups;
    vector<Visibility::GPULODLevel> Levels;
    vector<uint32_t> NewGroups, NewLevels;
    GpuSceneBuffer GroupBuffer, LevelBuffer, History;
    array<FrameData, GpuSceneBuffer::FrameCount> Frames;
    ComPtr<ID3D12RootSignature> Root;
    ComPtr<ID3D12PipelineState> ResetPSO, OcclusionPSO, LODPSO;
    XMFLOAT4X4 PreviousVP{}, PreviousView{}, PreviousProjection{};
    uint32_t PreviousCamera = UINT32_MAX, FrameIndex = 0;
    bool HaveCamera = false, Cut = true, Reset = true, UsableHistory = false;
    bool PreviousOcclusion = false, PreviousLOD = true, CameraFrozen = false;
    int PreviousForce = -1;
    float PreviousBias = 0;
    const char *Reason = "First frame";
    Visibility::Statistics Latest;
    bool HasSample=false;
    vector<Visibility::VisibleInstanceData> DebugRecords;
};
State &Data()
{
    static State state;
    return state;
}
FrameData &Frame()
{
    return Data().Frames.at(Data().FrameIndex);
}
RenderGraph::ResourceHandle Import(RenderGraph &graph, const char *name, GpuSceneBuffer &buffer)
{
    RenderGraph::ImportedResource resource{};
    resource.Name = name;
    resource.Resource = buffer.Resource();
    resource.InitialState = buffer.State;
    resource.FinalState = D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_NON_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE;
    resource.HasFinalState = true;
    buffer.State = resource.FinalState;
    return graph.ImportResource(resource);
}
void Initialize()
{
    auto &state = Data();
    if (state.Root)
    {
        return;
    }
    CD3DX12_DESCRIPTOR_RANGE hierarchy(D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_RANGE_TYPE_SRV, 1, 5);
    CD3DX12_DESCRIPTOR_RANGE constants(D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_RANGE_TYPE_CBV, 1, 0);
    CD3DX12_ROOT_PARAMETER parameters[10];
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < 5; ++i)
    {
        parameters[i].InitAsShaderResourceView(i);
    }
    parameters[5].InitAsDescriptorTable(1, &hierarchy);
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < 3; ++i)
    {
        parameters[6 + i].InitAsUnorderedAccessView(i);
    }
    parameters[9].InitAsDescriptorTable(1, &constants);
    CD3DX12_ROOT_SIGNATURE_DESC description(_countof(parameters), parameters);
    ComPtr<ID3DBlob> blob, errors;
    auto *device = GraphicsDevice::GetDevice();
    if (FAILED(D3D12SerializeRootSignature(&description, D3D_ROOT_SIGNATURE_VERSION_1, &blob, &errors)) ||
        FAILED(
            device->CreateRootSignature(0, blob->GetBufferPointer(), blob->GetBufferSize(), IID_PPV_ARGS(&state.Root))))
    {
        throw runtime_error("GPU visibility root signature failed");
    }
    auto pipeline = [&](const char *path, ComPtr<ID3D12PipelineState> &output) {
        ComPtr<ID3DBlob> shader;
        ShaderDescription input{};
        input.csoPath = path;
        input.ppBlob = shader.GetAddressOf();
        if (!ShaderPipelines::LoadShaderBlob(input))
        {
            throw runtime_error("GPU visibility shader missing");
        }
        D3D12_COMPUTE_PIPELINE_STATE_DESC desc{};
        desc.pRootSignature = state.Root.Get();
        desc.CS = {shader->GetBufferPointer(), shader->GetBufferSize()};
        if (FAILED(device->CreateComputePipelineState(&desc, IID_PPV_ARGS(&output))))
        {
            throw runtime_error("GPU visibility compute pipeline failed");
        }
    };
    pipeline("shader/hlsl/build/GPUVisibilityResetCS.cso", state.ResetPSO);
    pipeline("shader/hlsl/build/GPUOcclusionCS.cso", state.OcclusionPSO);
    pipeline("shader/hlsl/build/GPULODSelectionCS.cso", state.LODPSO);
}
void AllocateReadback(ComPtr<ID3D12Resource> &resource, uint64_t bytes)
{
    if (resource)
    {
        return;
    }
    const auto heap = CD3DX12_HEAP_PROPERTIES(D3D12_HEAP_TYPE_READBACK);
    const auto desc = CD3DX12_RESOURCE_DESC::Buffer(bytes);
    if (FAILED(GraphicsDevice::GetDevice()->CreateCommittedResource(
            &heap, D3D12_HEAP_FLAG_NONE, &desc, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_COPY_DEST, nullptr, IID_PPV_ARGS(&resource))))
    {
        throw runtime_error("GPU visibility debug readback allocation failed");
    }
}
void ConsumeReadback(FrameData &frame)
{
    if (!frame.Pending)
    {
        return;
    }
    // Prepare runs after this frame slot's fence; no wait or per-frame allocation.
    void *mapped = nullptr;
    D3D12_RANGE range{0, sizeof(Visibility::Statistics)};
    if (SUCCEEDED(frame.Readback->Map(0, &range, &mapped)))
    {
        memcpy(&Data().Latest, mapped, sizeof(Visibility::Statistics));
        Data().HasSample=true;
        const D3D12_RANGE noWrite{0, 0};
        frame.Readback->Unmap(0, &noWrite);
    }
    Data().DebugRecords.clear();
    if (frame.RecordCount)
    {
        range.End = size_t(frame.RecordCount) * sizeof(Visibility::VisibleInstanceData);
        if (SUCCEEDED(frame.RecordReadback->Map(0, &range, &mapped)))
        {
            auto *records = static_cast<Visibility::VisibleInstanceData *>(mapped);
            Data().DebugRecords.assign(records, records + frame.RecordCount);
            const D3D12_RANGE noWrite{0, 0};
            frame.RecordReadback->Unmap(0, &noWrite);
        }
    }
    frame.Pending = false;
}
void Bind(ID3D12GraphicsCommandList *list, ID3D12Resource *geometry)
{
    auto &data = Data();
    ID3D12DescriptorHeap *heap = FrameConstants::GetCbvHeap();
    list->SetDescriptorHeaps(1, &heap);
    list->SetComputeRootSignature(data.Root.Get());
    list->SetComputeRootShaderResourceView(0, GpuScene::InstanceBuffer()->GetGPUVirtualAddress());
    list->SetComputeRootShaderResourceView(1, GpuScene::VisibilityBuffer()->GetGPUVirtualAddress());
    list->SetComputeRootShaderResourceView(2, geometry->GetGPUVirtualAddress());
    list->SetComputeRootShaderResourceView(3, data.GroupBuffer.Resource()->GetGPUVirtualAddress());
    list->SetComputeRootShaderResourceView(4, data.LevelBuffer.Resource()->GetGPUVirtualAddress());
    // The engine creates a null R32 SRV when Hi-Z isn't available. Never bind an uninitialized descriptor.
    list->SetComputeRootDescriptorTable(5, OcclusionCulling::GetPreviousSrv());
    list->SetComputeRootUnorderedAccessView(6, Frame().Result.Resource()->GetGPUVirtualAddress());
    list->SetComputeRootUnorderedAccessView(7, data.History.Resource()->GetGPUVirtualAddress());
    list->SetComputeRootUnorderedAccessView(8, Frame().Counters.Resource()->GetGPUVirtualAddress());
    const auto cbv = FrameConstants::AllocateTransientConstantBuffer(&data.Parameters, sizeof(data.Parameters));
    if (!cbv.ptr)
    {
        throw runtime_error("GPU visibility transient constants exhausted");
    }
    list->SetComputeRootDescriptorTable(9, cbv);
}
} // namespace
Settings &GetSettings()
{
    return Data().Options;
}
DirectX::XMFLOAT4X4 CullingViewProjection()
{
    XMFLOAT4X4 result;
    const auto& p=Data().Parameters;
    XMStoreFloat4x4(&result,XMLoadFloat4x4(&p.View)*XMLoadFloat4x4(&p.Projection));
    return result;
}
vector<uint32_t> LODMeshes(uint32_t id)
{
    const auto& state=Data();
    vector<uint32_t> result;
    if (id<state.Groups.size())
    {
        const auto& group=state.Groups[id];
        for (uint32_t i=0;i<group.Count;++i) result.push_back(state.Levels[group.Offset+i].MeshIndex);
    }
    return result;
}
uint32_t RegisterLODGroup(const array<uint32_t, Visibility::MaxLODs> &meshes,
                          const Visibility::LODMetadata &metadata)
{
    if (!Visibility::ValidLOD(metadata))
    {
        return Visibility::InvalidID;
    }
    auto &state = Data();
    array<Visibility::GPULODLevel, Visibility::MaxLODs> levels{};
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < metadata.Count; ++i)
    {
        levels[i] = {meshes[i], metadata.Thresholds[i], metadata.Hysteresis, 0};
    }
    for (uint32_t id = 0; id < state.Groups.size(); ++id)
    {
        const auto &group = state.Groups[id];
        if (group.Count == metadata.Count &&
            memcmp(state.Levels.data() + group.Offset, levels.data(), metadata.Count * sizeof(levels[0])) == 0)
        {
            return id;
        }
    }
    const uint32_t id = static_cast<uint32_t>(state.Groups.size());
    state.Groups.push_back({static_cast<uint32_t>(state.Levels.size()), metadata.Count, {0, 0}});
    state.NewGroups.push_back(id);
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < metadata.Count; ++i)
    {
        state.NewLevels.push_back(static_cast<uint32_t>(state.Levels.size()));
        state.Levels.push_back(levels[i]);
    }
    return id;
}
void Invalidate(const char *reason)
{
    Data().Reset = true;
    Data().UsableHistory = false;
    Data().Reason = reason;
    OcclusionCulling::InvalidateHistory();
}
void PrepareCamera()
{
    auto &state = Data();
    if (state.Options.FreezeCamera && state.CameraFrozen)
    {
        // Frozen view is not compatible with Hi-Z captured from the live camera.
        state.UsableHistory=false;
        return;
    }
    if (state.CameraFrozen) Invalidate("Culling camera released");
    state.CameraFrozen=state.Options.FreezeCamera;
    if (OcclusionCulling::GetWidth() != GraphicsDevice::GetSceneWidth() ||
        OcclusionCulling::GetHeight() != GraphicsDevice::GetSceneHeight())
    {
        Invalidate("Render resolution changed");
        OcclusionCulling::Resize(GraphicsDevice::GetSceneWidth(), GraphicsDevice::GetSceneHeight());
    }
    if (state.Options.Occlusion != state.PreviousOcclusion || state.Options.LOD != state.PreviousLOD ||
        state.Options.ForceLOD != state.PreviousForce || state.Options.LODBias != state.PreviousBias)
    {
        OcclusionCulling::InvalidateHistory();
        state.Reason = "Visibility/LOD settings changed";
    }
    state.PreviousOcclusion = state.Options.Occlusion;
    state.PreviousLOD = state.Options.LOD;
    state.PreviousForce = state.Options.ForceLOD;
    state.PreviousBias = state.Options.LODBias;
    XMMATRIX view, projection;
    const auto camera = Camera::GetCameraEntity();
    if (camera == UINT32_MAX || !ComponentManager::HasComponent<CameraComponent>(camera))
    {
        Invalidate("No camera");
        state.Cut = true;
        return;
    }
    Camera::GetCameraMatrices(camera, view, projection);
    XMStoreFloat4x4(&state.Parameters.View, view);
    XMStoreFloat4x4(&state.Parameters.Projection, projection);
    const bool viewChanged = memcmp(&state.PreviousView, &state.Parameters.View, sizeof(XMFLOAT4X4)) != 0;
    const bool projectionChanged =
        memcmp(&state.PreviousProjection, &state.Parameters.Projection, sizeof(XMFLOAT4X4)) != 0;
    const XMMATRIX currentWorld = XMMatrixInverse(nullptr, view);
    const XMMATRIX previousWorld = XMMatrixInverse(nullptr, XMLoadFloat4x4(&state.PreviousView));
    const float translation =
        state.HaveCamera ? XMVectorGetX(XMVector3Length(currentWorld.r[3] - previousWorld.r[3])) : 0;
    const float direction = state.HaveCamera ? XMVectorGetX(XMVector3Dot(currentWorld.r[2], previousWorld.r[2])) : 1;
    state.Cut = !state.HaveCamera || state.PreviousCamera != camera || projectionChanged || translation > 10 ||
                direction < 0.70710678f;
    if (state.Cut)
    {
        Invalidate("Camera/view/projection changed");
    }
    else if (viewChanged)
    {
        OcclusionCulling::InvalidateHistory();
        state.Reason = "Camera moved (LOD history retained)";
    }
    state.Parameters.PreviousViewProjection = state.PreviousVP;
    state.UsableHistory = !state.Options.FreezeCamera && !state.Reset && OcclusionCulling::HasPrevious() && !state.Cut && !viewChanged;
    state.PreviousView = state.Parameters.View;
    state.PreviousProjection = state.Parameters.Projection;
    XMStoreFloat4x4(&state.PreviousVP, view * projection);
    state.PreviousCamera = camera;
    state.HaveCamera = true;
}
RenderGraph::ResourceHandle Prepare(RenderGraph &graph, RenderGraph::ResourceHandle instances,
                                    RenderGraph::ResourceHandle frustum, RenderGraph::ResourceHandle geometry,
                                    ID3D12Resource *geometryResource, uint32_t slots, uint32_t capacity,
                                    uint32_t meshCount)
{
    Initialize();
    auto &state = Data();
    state.FrameIndex = GraphicsDevice::GetFrameIndex();
    auto &frame = Frame();
    ConsumeReadback(frame);
    auto prepare = [&](GpuSceneBuffer &buffer, uint32_t count, uint32_t stride, const wchar_t *name, bool uav) {
        buffer.BeginFrame(state.FrameIndex);
        return buffer.Ensure(GraphicsDevice::GetDevice(), count, stride, state.FrameIndex, name, uav);
    };
    prepare(frame.Result, capacity, 16, L"GPU Visibility Results", true);
    prepare(frame.Counters, 16, 4, L"GPU Visibility Statistics", true);
    const bool newHistory = prepare(state.History, capacity, 16, L"GPU LOD History", true);
    prepare(state.GroupBuffer, static_cast<uint32_t>(state.Groups.size()), 16, L"GPU LOD Groups", false);
    prepare(state.LevelBuffer, static_cast<uint32_t>(state.Levels.size()), 16, L"GPU LOD Levels", false);
    const auto groupBytes = state.GroupBuffer.Stage(GraphicsDevice::GetDevice(), state.FrameIndex, state.Groups.data(),
                                                    static_cast<uint32_t>(state.Groups.size()), state.NewGroups);
    const auto levelBytes = state.LevelBuffer.Stage(GraphicsDevice::GetDevice(), state.FrameIndex, state.Levels.data(),
                                                    static_cast<uint32_t>(state.Levels.size()), state.NewLevels);
    state.NewGroups.clear();
    state.NewLevels.clear();
    const auto result = Import(graph, "Visibility + Selected LOD", frame.Result);
    const auto counters = Import(graph, "Visibility Statistics", frame.Counters);
    const auto history = Import(graph, "LOD History", state.History);
    const auto groups = Import(graph, "LOD Groups", state.GroupBuffer);
    const auto levels = Import(graph, "LOD Levels", state.LevelBuffer);
    if (groupBytes || levelBytes)
    {
        graph.AddPass(
            "LOD Metadata Upload",
            [=](RenderGraph::PassBuilder &builder) {
                if (groupBytes)
                {
                    builder.Write(groups, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_COPY_DEST);
                }
                if (levelBytes)
                {
                    builder.Write(levels, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_COPY_DEST);
                }
            },
            [](ID3D12GraphicsCommandList *list) {
                auto &data = Data();
                data.GroupBuffer.Copy(list, data.FrameIndex);
                data.LevelBuffer.Copy(list, data.FrameIndex);
            });
    }
    state.Parameters.Slots = slots;
    state.Parameters.Meshes = meshCount;
    state.Parameters.Groups = static_cast<uint32_t>(state.Groups.size());
    state.Parameters.Levels = static_cast<uint32_t>(state.Levels.size());
    state.Parameters.Occlusion = state.Options.Occlusion && state.UsableHistory;
    state.Parameters.LOD = state.Options.LOD;
    state.Parameters.NativeHierarchy = MeshShaderRenderer::NativeReady() &&
        VirtualGeometryTraversal::GetSettings().Enabled;
    state.Parameters.Reset = state.Reset || newHistory;
    state.Parameters.Force = static_cast<uint32_t>(state.Options.ForceLOD);
    state.Parameters.DepthBias = state.Options.DepthBias;
    state.Parameters.LODBias = state.Options.LODBias;
    state.Parameters.Width = float((max)(OcclusionCulling::GetWidth(), 1u));
    state.Parameters.Height = float((max)(OcclusionCulling::GetHeight(), 1u));
    state.Parameters.Mips = (max)(OcclusionCulling::GetMipCount(), 1u);
    graph.AddPass(
        "Visibility Counter Reset",
        [=](RenderGraph::PassBuilder &builder) { builder.Write(counters, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS); },
        [](ID3D12GraphicsCommandList *list) {
            list->SetComputeRootSignature(Data().Root.Get());
            list->SetPipelineState(Data().ResetPSO.Get());
            list->SetComputeRootUnorderedAccessView(8, Frame().Counters.Resource()->GetGPUVirtualAddress());
            list->Dispatch(1, 1, 1);
        });
    RenderGraph::ResourceHandle hierarchy;
    if (state.Parameters.Occlusion)
    {
        RenderGraph::ImportedResource resource{};
        resource.Name = "Previous Hi-Z";
        resource.Resource = OcclusionCulling::GetPreviousResource();
        resource.InitialState = resource.FinalState = OcclusionCulling::ReadState();
        resource.HasFinalState = true;
        hierarchy = graph.ImportResource(resource);
    }
    graph.AddPass(
        "GPU Occlusion Culling",
        [=](RenderGraph::PassBuilder &builder) {
            builder.Read(instances, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_NON_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE)
                .Read(frustum, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_NON_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE)
                .Read(geometry, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_NON_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE)
                .Write(result, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS)
                .ReadWrite(history, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS)
                .ReadWrite(counters, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS);
            if (hierarchy.IsValid())
            {
                builder.Read(hierarchy, OcclusionCulling::ReadState());
            }
        },
        [geometryResource](ID3D12GraphicsCommandList *list) {
            RenderProfiler::ScopedEvent profile("Occlusion Culling", list);
            Bind(list, geometryResource);
            list->SetPipelineState(Data().OcclusionPSO.Get());
            if (Data().Parameters.Slots)
            {
                list->Dispatch((Data().Parameters.Slots + 63) / 64, 1, 1);
            }
        });
    graph.AddPass(
        "GPU LOD Selection",
        [=](RenderGraph::PassBuilder &builder) {
            builder.Read(instances, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_NON_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE)
                .Read(geometry, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_NON_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE)
                .Read(groups, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_NON_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE)
                .Read(levels, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_NON_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE)
                .ReadWrite(result, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS)
                .ReadWrite(history, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS)
                .ReadWrite(counters, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS);
        },
        [geometryResource](ID3D12GraphicsCommandList *list) {
            RenderProfiler::ScopedEvent profile("LOD Selection", list);
            Bind(list, geometryResource);
            list->SetPipelineState(Data().LODPSO.Get());
            if (Data().Parameters.Slots)
            {
                list->Dispatch((Data().Parameters.Slots + 63) / 64, 1, 1);
            }
        });
    if (state.Options.DebugReadback || state.Options.Bounds || state.Options.ScreenRectangles)
    {
        AllocateReadback(frame.Readback, sizeof(Visibility::Statistics));
        const uint32_t records = state.Options.Bounds || state.Options.ScreenRectangles ? (min)(slots, 4096u) : 0;
        if (records)
        {
            AllocateReadback(frame.RecordReadback, 4096 * 16);
        }
        graph.AddPass(
            "Visibility Debug Readback",
            [=](RenderGraph::PassBuilder &builder) {
                builder.Read(counters, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_COPY_SOURCE);
                if (records)
                {
                    builder.Read(result, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_COPY_SOURCE);
                }
            },
            [records](ID3D12GraphicsCommandList *list) {
                auto &buffers = Frame();
                list->CopyBufferRegion(buffers.Readback.Get(), 0, buffers.Counters.Resource(), 0,
                                       sizeof(Visibility::Statistics));
                if (records)
                {
                    list->CopyBufferRegion(buffers.RecordReadback.Get(), 0, buffers.Result.Resource(), 0,
                                           uint64_t(records) * 16);
                }
                buffers.Pending = true;
                buffers.RecordCount = records;
            });
    }
    state.Reset = false;
    return result;
}

    return Frame().Result.Resource();

    return Frame().Counters.Resource();

void DrawDebug()
{
    auto &state = Data();
    auto &options = state.Options;
    ImGui::Checkbox("Enable Frustum Culling", &options.Frustum);
    ImGui::Checkbox("Enable Hi-Z Occlusion", &options.Occlusion);
    ImGui::Checkbox("Enable GPU LOD", &options.LOD);
    ImGui::DragFloat("Occlusion Depth Bias", &options.DepthBias, 0.0001f, 0, 0.1f, "%.5f");
    ImGui::SliderFloat("LOD Bias", &options.LODBias, -4, 4);
    ImGui::SliderInt("Force LOD (-1 = Auto)", &options.ForceLOD, -1, 7);
    ImGui::Combo("Debug shading", &options.DebugMode, "Off\0Visibility\0LOD\0");
    ImGui::Checkbox("Bounds overlay (debug readback)", &options.Bounds);
    ImGui::Checkbox("Screen rectangles (debug readback)", &options.ScreenRectangles);
    ImGui::Checkbox("Culling statistics (delayed debug readback)", &options.DebugReadback);
    ImGui::Text("Hi-Z: %ux%u / %u mips / history %s", OcclusionCulling::GetWidth(), OcclusionCulling::GetHeight(),
                OcclusionCulling::GetMipCount(), state.UsableHistory ? "valid" : "disabled");
    if (!state.UsableHistory)
    {
        ImGui::Text("History reset: %s", state.Reason);
    }
    if (OcclusionCulling::HasPrevious())
    {
        const int maximum = int(OcclusionCulling::GetMipCount()) - 1;
        options.HiZMip = clamp(options.HiZMip, 0, maximum);
        ImGui::SliderInt("Hi-Z Mip", &options.HiZMip, 0, maximum);
        OcclusionCulling::SetDebugPreview(uint32_t(options.HiZMip), true);
        ImGui::Image((ImTextureID)OcclusionCulling::GetDebugMipSrv(uint32_t(options.HiZMip)).ptr, ImVec2(320, 180));
    }
    if (options.DebugReadback)
    {
        const auto &stats = state.Latest;
        ImGui::Text("Total %u / Frustum culled %u / Frustum visible %u", stats.Total, stats.FrustumCulled,
                    stats.FrustumVisible);
        ImGui::Text("Occlusion tested %u / Culled %u / Final visible %u", stats.Tested, stats.Occluded,
                    stats.FinalVisible);
        ImGui::Text("Triangles %u / Index vertex invocations %u", stats.Triangles, stats.IndexVertices);
        for (uint32_t i = 0; i < Visibility::MaxLODs; ++i)
        {
            ImGui::Text("LOD%u: %u", i, stats.LODCounts[i]);
        }
    }
    for (const auto &pass : RenderProfiler::GetLatest().Passes)
    {
        if (pass.Name == "Hi-Z Build" || pass.Name == "GPU Scene Culling" || pass.Name == "Occlusion Culling" ||
            pass.Name == "LOD Selection" || pass.Name == "Generate Indirect Commands" ||
            pass.Name == "Opaque ExecuteIndirect")
        {
            ImGui::Text("%s: %.4f ms GPU", pass.Name.c_str(), pass.GpuMs);
        }
    }
    ImGui::TextDisabled("Bounds preview shows up to 4096 instance slots; cyan visible, red frustum, orange occluded.");
    if (options.Bounds || options.ScreenRectangles)
    {
        ImDrawList *draw = ImGui::GetWindowDrawList();
        const ImVec2 origin = ImGui::GetCursorScreenPos();
        const ImVec2 extent(320, 180);
        draw->AddRect(origin, ImVec2(origin.x + extent.x, origin.y + extent.y), IM_COL32(100, 100, 100, 255));
        XMMATRIX vp = XMLoadFloat4x4(&state.Parameters.View) * XMLoadFloat4x4(&state.Parameters.Projection);
        for (const auto &record : state.DebugRecords)
        {
            if (!record.State)
            {
                continue;
            }
            const auto *instance = GpuScene::GetInstance(record.InstanceID);
            if (!instance)
            {
                continue;
            }
            ImVec2 points[8];
            bool valid = true;
            float minX = 1, minY = 1, maxX = 0, maxY = 0;
            for (uint32_t i = 0; i < 8; ++i)
            {
                const auto &c = instance->BoundsCenter;
                const auto &e = instance->BoundsExtents;
                XMFLOAT4 clip;
                XMStoreFloat4(&clip,
                              XMVector4Transform(XMVectorSet(c.x + ((i & 1) ? e.x : -e.x), c.y + ((i & 2) ? e.y : -e.y),
                                                             c.z + ((i & 4) ? e.z : -e.z), 1),
                                                 vp));
                if (clip.w <= 0 || clip.z <= 0)
                {
                    valid = false;
                    break;
                }
                const float x = clip.x / clip.w * 0.5f + 0.5f, y = 0.5f - clip.y / clip.w * 0.5f;
                minX = (min)(minX, x);
                minY = (min)(minY, y);
                maxX = (max)(maxX, x);
                maxY = (max)(maxY, y);
                points[i] = ImVec2(origin.x + x * extent.x, origin.y + y * extent.y);
            }
            if (!valid || minX < 0 || minY < 0 || maxX > 1 || maxY > 1)
            {
                continue;
            }
            const ImU32 color = record.State == 1   ? IM_COL32(40, 230, 230, 170)
                                : record.State == 2 ? IM_COL32(255, 40, 40, 170)
                                                    : IM_COL32(255, 160, 40, 170);
            if (options.ScreenRectangles)
            {
                draw->AddRect(ImVec2(origin.x + minX * extent.x, origin.y + minY * extent.y),
                              ImVec2(origin.x + maxX * extent.x, origin.y + maxY * extent.y), color);
            }
            if (options.Bounds)
            {
                for (uint32_t i = 0; i < 8; ++i)
                {
                    for (uint32_t axis = 0; axis < 3; ++axis)
                    {
                        if ((i & (1u << axis)) == 0)
                        {
                            draw->AddLine(points[i], points[i | (1u << axis)], color);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        ImGui::Dummy(extent);
    }
}
void Shutdown()
{
    Data() = {};
}

{
    WriteGraphicsLog("GPU Visibility validation: %s %s\n", success ? "PASS" : "FAIL", description);
    if (!success)
    {
        ++failures;
    }

void WriteGrid(const string &path, uint32_t subdivisions, uint32_t sections = 1)
{
    ofstream file(path);
    if (sections > 1)
    {
        const auto materialPath = filesystem::path(path).replace_extension(".mtl");
        ofstream materials(materialPath);
        file << "mtllib " << materialPath.filename().string() << '\n';
        for (uint32_t section = 0; section < sections; ++section)
        {
            materials << "newmtl section" << section << "\nKd " << (0.2f + 0.05f * section) << " 1 1\n";
        }
    }
    const uint32_t side = subdivisions + 1;
    file << "vn 0 0 -1\n";
    for (uint32_t y = 0; y < side; ++y)
    {
        for (uint32_t x = 0; x < side; ++x)
        {
            const float fx = float(x) / float(subdivisions) * 2 - 1, fy = float(y) / float(subdivisions) * 2 - 1;
            file << "v " << fx << ' ' << fy << ' ' << 0.05f * sinf(fx * 3.14159265f) * sinf(fy * 3.14159265f) << '\n';
        }
    }
    for (uint32_t section = 0; section < sections; ++section)
    {
        file << "g section" << section << "\nusemtl section" << section << '\n';
        for (uint32_t y = 0; y < subdivisions; ++y)
        {
            for (uint32_t x = 0; x < subdivisions; ++x)
            {
                const uint32_t a = y * side + x + 1, b = a + side;
                file << "f " << a << "//1 " << b << "//1 " << b + 1 << "//1\n";
                file << "f " << a << "//1 " << b + 1 << "//1 " << a + 1 << "//1\n";
            }
        }
    }
}
EntityID Create(uint32_t index, bool isWall = false)
{
    Entity entity = World::CreateEntity();
    if (!entity.IsValid())
    {
        Check(false, "fixture entity capacity");
        return UINT32_MAX;
    }
    entity.Add<TransformComponent>().Add<StaticModelComponent>().Add<MaterialComponent>().Add<LODComponent>();
    entity.Get<StaticModelComponent>().ModelId = isWall ? wallMeshID : meshID;
    auto &transform = entity.Get<TransformComponent>();
    transform.Position =
        isWall ? XMFLOAT3(0, 0, 0)
               : XMFLOAT3(float(index % 100) * 0.08f - 3.96f, float((index / 100) % 100) * 0.08f - 3.96f, 5);
    transform.Scale = isWall ? XMFLOAT3(20, 20, 1) : XMFLOAT3(0.035f, 0.035f, 0.035f);
    auto &material = entity.Get<MaterialComponent>();
    material.ShaderClassMode = MaterialMode::Manual;
    material.ShaderClass = ShaderClass::PBR;
    material.UseTexture = false;
    material.IsTransparent = false;
    material.Alpha = 1;
    auto &lod = entity.Get<LODComponent>();
    lod.UseLOD = !isWall;
    lod.UseAssetSettings = false;
    lod.ScreenLOD.MeshPaths = meshPaths;
    return entity.GetID();
}
void Grow(uint32_t count)
{
    while (fixtures.size() < count)
    {
        fixtures.push_back(Create(static_cast<uint32_t>(fixtures.size())));
    }
}
void Clear()
{
    for (auto entity : fixtures)
    {
        if (Registry::IsAlive(entity))
        {
            World::DestroyEntity(Entity(entity));
        }
    }
    fixtures.clear();
    for (auto entity : buildings)
    {
        if (Registry::IsAlive(entity))
        {
            World::DestroyEntity(Entity(entity));
        }
    }
    buildings.clear();
    if (Registry::IsAlive(wall))
    {
        World::DestroyEntity(Entity(wall));
    }
    wall = UINT32_MAX;
}
void Capture(bool compare)
{
    vector<RenderCapture::TextureData> image(2);
    bool read = RenderCapture::ReadTexture(RenderTargets::GetGBufferResource(GBufferType::BASE_COLOR), image[0]);
    read &= RenderCapture::ReadTexture(RenderTargets::GetGBufferResource(GBufferType::DEPTH), image[1]);
    Check(read, "capture opaque color/depth");
    if (!read)
    {
        return;
    }
    if (!compare)
    {
        reference = move(image);
        return;
    }
    uint64_t differences = 0, covered = 0;
    bool dimensions = reference.size() == image.size();
    for (size_t i = 0; dimensions && i < image.size(); ++i)
    {
        const auto &a = reference[i];
        const auto &b = image[i];
        dimensions &= a.Width == b.Width && a.Height == b.Height && a.Format == b.Format;
        if (!dimensions)
        {
            break;
        }
        for (uint32_t y = 0; y < a.Height; ++y)
        {
            for (uint32_t x = 0; x < a.Width; ++x)
            {
                const auto *first = a.Bytes.data() + y * a.RowPitch + x * 4;
                const auto *second = b.Bytes.data() + y * b.RowPitch + x * 4;
                if (i == 1)
                {
                    float da, db;
                    memcpy(&da, first, 4);
                    memcpy(&db, second, 4);
                    differences += abs(da - db) > 0.00001f;
                    covered += da > 0 && da < 0.999f;
                }
                else
                {
                    differences += memcmp(first, second, 4) != 0;
                }
            }
        }
    }
    WriteGraphicsLog("GPU Visibility image comparison: differences=%llu covered=%llu\n", differences, covered);
    Check(dimensions && differences == 0 && covered > 0, "occlusion OFF/ON image equivalence");
}
Visibility::Statistics ReadStats()
{
    vector<uint8_t> bytes;
    Visibility::Statistics stats;
    const bool read = RenderCapture::ReadBuffer(GPUVisibility::StatisticsBuffer(),
                                                D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_NON_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE, sizeof(stats), bytes);
    Check(read, "read validation-only visibility counters");
    if (read)
    {
        memcpy(&stats, bytes.data(), sizeof(stats));
    }
    Check(stats.FinalVisible + stats.Occluded == stats.FrustumVisible &&
              stats.FrustumVisible + stats.FrustumCulled == stats.Total,
          "visibility counter conservation");
    return stats;
}
void ValidateSelectedCommands(uint32_t expectedLOD)
{
    vector<uint8_t> counter, visible, commands, geometry;
    bool valid =
        RenderCapture::ReadBuffer(GPUDrivenRenderer::CountBuffer(), D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_INDIRECT_ARGUMENT, 4, counter);
    uint32_t count = 0;
    if (valid)
    {
        memcpy(&count, counter.data(), 4);
    }
    valid &= count > 0 && count <= GPUDrivenRenderer::CommandCapacity();
    if (valid)
    {
        valid &=
            RenderCapture::ReadBuffer(GPUDrivenRenderer::VisibleBuffer(),
                                      D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_NON_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE, uint64_t(count) * 16, visible);
        valid &= RenderCapture::ReadBuffer(GPUDrivenRenderer::CommandBuffer(), D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_INDIRECT_ARGUMENT,
                                           uint64_t(count) * sizeof(GPUIndirectDrawCommand), commands);
        valid &= RenderCapture::ReadBuffer(
            GPUDrivenRenderer::GeometryBuffer(), D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_NON_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE,
            uint64_t(GpuScene::Statistics().Meshes) * sizeof(GPUDrivenGeometryData), geometry);
    }
    for (uint32_t i = 0; valid && i < count; ++i)
    {
        Visibility::VisibleInstanceData record{};
        GPUIndirectDrawCommand command{};
        GPUDrivenGeometryData mesh{};
        memcpy(&record, visible.data() + size_t(i) * 16, 16);
        memcpy(&command, commands.data() + size_t(i) * sizeof(command), sizeof(command));
        if (record.SelectedMeshID >= GpuScene::Statistics().Meshes || record.SelectedLOD != expectedLOD)
        {
            valid = false;
            break;
        }
        memcpy(&mesh, geometry.data() + size_t(record.SelectedMeshID) * sizeof(mesh), sizeof(mesh));
        valid &= mesh.Ready != 0 && command.InstanceID == record.InstanceID &&
                 command.Draw.IndexCountPerInstance == mesh.IndexCount &&
                 command.Draw.StartIndexLocation == mesh.StartIndex &&
                 command.Draw.BaseVertexLocation == mesh.BaseVertex && command.Draw.InstanceCount == 1 &&
                 command.Draw.StartInstanceLocation == 0;
    }
    Check(valid, "Indirect commands use exact selected LOD mesh geometry");
}
void SetHysteresisCamera(float screenSize)
{
    const auto *mesh = ModelManager::GetStaticModel(meshID);
    const auto extents = mesh->GetAabbExtents();
    const float radius = sqrtf(extents.x * extents.x + extents.y * extents.y + extents.z * extents.z);
    const auto camera = Camera::GetCameraEntity();
    auto &data = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<CameraComponent>(camera);
    auto &transform = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<TransformComponent>(camera);
    const float focal = data.ProjectionMatrix._22;
    transform.Position = {0, 0, -(radius + radius * focal / screenSize)};
    transform.IsDirty = true;
    data.Target = {0, 0, 0};
}
} // namespace
bool GPUVisibilityValidation::Enabled()
{
    char value[8]{};
    return GetEnvironmentVariableA("DX12_GPU_VISIBILITY_STRESS_TEST", value, sizeof(value)) && atoi(value) != 0;
}
void GPUVisibilityValidation::BeforeFrame(uint64_t frame)
{
    // This suite exercises mesh-wide discrete LOD. Native continuous hierarchy
    // selection is validated separately and deliberately bypasses this policy.
    VirtualGeometryTraversal::GetSettings().Enabled = false;
    frameCount = frame + 1;
    if (!frame)
    {
        vector<EntityID> remove;
        for (uint32_t i = 0; i < Registry::GetEntities().size(); ++i)
        {
            if (Registry::IsAlive(i) && !ComponentManager::HasComponent<CameraComponent>(i))
            {
                remove.push_back(i);
            }
        }
        for (auto entity : remove)
        {
            World::DestroyEntity(Entity(entity));
        }
        filesystem::create_directories("build/visibility");
        for (uint32_t level = 0; level < 5; ++level)
        {
            const auto path = "build/visibility/grid-lod" + to_string(level) + ".obj";
            WriteGrid(path, 16u >> level);
            if (level)
            {
                meshPaths[level] = path;
            }
        }
        meshID = ModelManager::LoadStaticModel("build/visibility/grid-lod0.obj", false);
        WriteGrid("build/visibility/wall.obj", 1);
        wallMeshID = ModelManager::LoadStaticModel("build/visibility/wall.obj", false);
        Check(meshID >= 0 && wallMeshID >= 0, "import five-level fixture and wall");
        Grow(1000);
        World::SetVSyncEnabled(false);
        measurements.open("build/visibility/comparison.csv");
        measurements << "frame,mode,total,frustum,occluded,visible,triangles,index_vertices,frame_gpu_ms,vs_"
                        "invocations,ps_invocations,cull_gpu_ms,lod_gpu_ms,opaque_gpu_ms,hiz_gpu_ms\n";
    }
    RenderConfiguration::SetRenderMode(RenderMode::DEFERRED);
    RendererSettings::SetComputeGBufferEnabled(false);
    RendererSettings::SetMeshShadersEnabled(false);
    RendererSettings::SetTwoPhaseOcclusionEnabled(false);
    RendererSettings::SetUpscaleMode(UpscaleMode::Bilateral);
    Raytracing::GetSettings().Enabled = false;
    DayNightCycle::GetSettings().Running = false;
    GPUDrivenRenderer::SetEnabled(true);
    auto &settings = GPUVisibility::GetSettings();
    settings.Frustum = true;
    settings.Occlusion = frame == 0 || frame >= 10;
    settings.LOD = frame >= 52;
    settings.DebugReadback = true;
    settings.DebugMode = 0;
    settings.ForceLOD = -1;
    const auto cameraID = Camera::GetCameraEntity();
    auto &camera = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<CameraComponent>(cameraID);
    auto &transform = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<TransformComponent>(cameraID);
    transform.Position = {0, 0, -12};
    transform.IsDirty = true;
    camera.Target = {0, 0, 5};
    camera.AllowUserControl = false;
    camera.LockOnTarget = UINT32_MAX;
    if (frame == 20)
    {
        Grow(10000);
        wall = Create(0, true);
    }
    if (frame >= 20 && frame < 30)
    {
        settings.Occlusion = false;
    }
    if (frame >= 40 && frame < 48)
    {
        transform.Position.x = frame % 2 ? 25.0f : -25.0f;
        camera.Target = {0, 0, 0};
    }
    if (frame == 48)
    {
        transform.Position = {100, 50, -100};
        camera.Target = {0, 0, 0};
    }
    if (frame == 52 && Registry::IsAlive(wall))
    {
        World::DestroyEntity(Entity(wall));
        wall = UINT32_MAX;
    }
    if (frame >= 52 && frame < 72)
    {
        settings.ForceLOD = int((frame - 52) / 4);
    }
    if (frame == 72)
    {
        Clear();
        Grow(1);
        auto &object = Entity(fixtures[0]).Get<TransformComponent>();
        object.Position = {0, 0, 0};
        object.Scale = {1, 1, 1};
        object.IsDirty = true;
        GpuSceneChanges::Notify(fixtures[0]);
    }
    if (frame >= 72 && frame < 100)
    {
        settings.Occlusion = false;
        if (frame < 84)
        {
            settings.ForceLOD = 0;
        }
        const float size = frame < 87 ? 0.28f : frame < 91 ? 0.26f : frame < 95 ? 0.32f : 0.34f;
        SetHysteresisCamera(size);
    }
    if (frame == 76)
    {
        Entity(fixtures[0]).Get<LODComponent>().ScreenLOD.Count = 8;
        GpuSceneChanges::Notify(fixtures[0]);
    }
    if (frame >= 76 && frame < 80)
    {
        settings.ForceLOD = 7; // LOD5..7 are missing; use LOD4.
    }
    if (frame == 100 || frame == 125)
    {
        Clear();
        const uint32_t sections = frame == 100 ? 5 : 10;
        const auto path = "build/visibility/city-" + to_string(sections) + ".obj";
        WriteGrid(path, 2, sections);
        meshID = ModelManager::LoadStaticModel(path.c_str(), false);
        auto *city = ModelManager::GetStaticModel(meshID);
        Check(city && city->LoadAssimpModel(path.c_str(), GraphicsDevice::GetDevice(), false) &&
                  city->GetMeshCount() == sections,
              "import independent city mesh sections");
        // Multi-section fixtures respect the existing 16384-entity ECS limit.
        meshPaths.fill("");
        Grow(10000);
        for (uint32_t building = 0; building < 12; ++building)
        {
            const auto id = Create(building, true);
            buildings.push_back(id);
            auto &object = Entity(id).Get<TransformComponent>();
            object.Position = {float(building % 4) * 1.8f - 2.7f, float(building / 4) * 2.4f - 2.4f, 0};
            object.Scale = {0.5f, 0.8f, 1};
            object.IsDirty = true;
            GpuSceneChanges::Notify(id);
        }
        for (auto entity : fixtures)
        {
            Entity(entity).Get<LODComponent>().ScreenLOD.Thresholds = {0.3f, 0.15f, 0.05f, 0.01f, 0, 0, 0, 0};
            GpuSceneChanges::Notify(entity);
        }
    }
    if (frame >= 100 && frame < 108)
    {
        settings.Occlusion = false;
        settings.LOD = false;
    }
    else if (frame >= 108 && frame < 116)
    {
        settings.Occlusion = true;
        settings.LOD = false;
    }
    else if (frame >= 116)
    {
        settings.Occlusion = true;
        settings.LOD = true;
    }
    if (frame == 126)
    {
        Check(GraphicsDevice::WaitForGpuIdle(), "wait for resize resource retirement");
        RenderTargets::ResizeScene(801, 451);
    }
    if (frame == 135 || frame == 136)
    {
        OcclusionCulling::SetDebugPreview(frame == 135 ? 3u : 0u, true);
    }
}
void GPUVisibilityValidation::AfterFrame(uint64_t frame)
{
    if (frame == 0 || !GPUDrivenRenderer::IsActive())
    {
        Check(GPUDrivenRenderer::IsActive(), "production GPU Driven path active");
    }
    if (frame == 0)
    {
        Check(!GPUVisibility::HistoryValid() && ReadStats().Tested == 0, "first frame does not sample previous Hi-Z");
    }
    if (frame == 126)
    {
        Check(!GPUVisibility::HistoryValid(), "resize invalidates previous Hi-Z");
    }
    if (frame == 6 || frame == 26)
    {
        Capture(false);
    }
    if (frame == 18 || frame == 38)
    {
        Capture(true);
    }
    if (frame == 38)
    {
        const auto stats = ReadStats();
        Check(stats.Total == 10001 && stats.Occluded >= 9500 && stats.FinalVisible < 100,
              "wall occludes most of 10000 objects");
    }
    if (frame >= 40 && frame <= 49)
    {
        const auto stats = ReadStats();
        Check(!GPUVisibility::HistoryValid() && stats.Tested == 0, "camera motion/cut never tests stale Hi-Z");
        if (frame == 48)
        {
            Check(GPUVisibility::CameraCut(), "teleport sets camera cut");
        }
    }
    if (frame >= 55 && frame < 72 && (frame - 55) % 4 == 0)
    {
        const auto stats = ReadStats();
        const auto level = uint32_t((frame - 52) / 4);
        Check(stats.FinalVisible > 0 && stats.LODCounts[level] == stats.FinalVisible,
              "five selected LOD meshes reach Indirect drawing");
        ValidateSelectedCommands(level);
    }
    if (frame == 79)
    {
        ValidateSelectedCommands(4);
    }
    if (frame == 86 || frame == 90 || frame == 94 || frame == 98)
    {
        const auto stats = ReadStats();
        const uint32_t expected = frame == 90 || frame == 94 ? 1 : 0;
        Check(stats.FinalVisible == 1 && stats.LODCounts[expected] == 1,
              "LOD hysteresis retains and crosses correct boundary");
    }
    if (frame == 106 || frame == 114 || frame == 122 || frame == 137)
    {
        const auto stats = ReadStats();
        Check(stats.Total >= (frame < 125 ? 50000u : 100000u), "large scene instance capacity");
        const auto &profiler = RenderProfiler::GetLatest();
        double cull = 0, lod = 0, opaque = 0, hiz = 0;
        for (const auto &pass : profiler.Passes)
        {
            if (pass.Name == "GPU Scene Culling" || pass.Name == "Occlusion Culling")
            {
                cull += pass.GpuMs;
            }
            if (pass.Name == "LOD Selection")
            {
                lod += pass.GpuMs;
            }
            if (pass.Name == "Opaque ExecuteIndirect")
            {
                opaque += pass.GpuMs;
            }
            if (pass.Name == "Hi-Z Build")
            {
                hiz += pass.GpuMs;
            }
        }
        const char *mode = frame == 106 ? "Frustum" : frame == 114 ? "Frustum+Occlusion" : "Frustum+Occlusion+LOD";
        measurements << frame << ',' << mode << ',' << stats.Total << ',' << stats.FrustumVisible << ','
                     << stats.Occluded << ',' << stats.FinalVisible << ',' << stats.Triangles << ','
                     << stats.IndexVertices << ',' << profiler.GpuRenderMs << ',' << profiler.Pipeline.VSInvocations
                     << ',' << profiler.Pipeline.PSInvocations << ',' << cull << ',' << lod << ',' << opaque << ','
                     << hiz << '\n';
        WriteGraphicsLog("GPU Visibility stress: %s total=%u final=%u occluded=%u triangles=%u frame=%.4f culling=%.4f "
                         "opaque=%.4f ms\n",
                         mode, stats.Total, stats.FinalVisible, stats.Occluded, stats.Triangles, profiler.GpuRenderMs,
                         cull, opaque);
    }
    if (frame == 138)
    {
        vector<RenderCapture::TextureData> mips(OcclusionCulling::GetMipCount());
        bool valid = true;
        for (uint32_t level = 0; level < mips.size(); ++level)
        {
            valid &= RenderCapture::ReadTextureMip(OcclusionCulling::GetPreviousResource(), mips[level], level,
                                                   OcclusionCulling::ReadState());
        }
        for (uint32_t level = 1; valid && level < mips.size(); ++level)
        {
            const auto &source = mips[level - 1];
            const auto &destination = mips[level];
            for (uint32_t y = 0; y < destination.Height && valid; ++y)
            {
                for (uint32_t x = 0; x < destination.Width; ++x)
                {
                    const auto xr = Visibility::ReductionRange(x, source.Width, destination.Width);
                    const auto yr = Visibility::ReductionRange(y, source.Height, destination.Height);
                    float maximum = 0, actual = 0;
                    for (uint32_t sy = yr.first; sy < yr.second; ++sy)
                    {
                        for (uint32_t sx = xr.first; sx < xr.second; ++sx)
                        {
                            float depth;
                            memcpy(&depth, source.Bytes.data() + sy * source.RowPitch + sx * 4, 4);
                            maximum = (max)(maximum, depth);
                        }
                    }
                    memcpy(&actual, destination.Bytes.data() + y * destination.RowPitch + x * 4, 4);
                    if (actual != maximum)
                    {
                        valid = false;
                        break;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        Check(valid && mips[0].Width == 801 && mips[0].Height == 451,
              "GPU odd-resolution pyramid matches CPU max reduction at every mip");
    }
}
bool GPUVisibilityValidation::Finish()
{
    GraphicsDevice::WaitForGpuIdle();
    Check(frameCount >= 140, "complete visibility stress sequence");
    failures += RenderCapture::ReportGraphicsErrors();
    measurements.close();
    WriteGraphicsLog("GPU Visibility validation failures = %u\n", failures);
    return failures == 0;
}

#pragma once
#include <cstdint>

===== FILE: rendering\visibility\visibilitytypes.h =====
#pragma once
#include <algorithm>
#include <array>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstdint>
#include <iomanip>
#include <istream>
#include <ostream>
#include <string>
#include <utility>

namespace Visibility
{
inline constexpr uint32_t InvalidID = UINT32_MAX;
inline constexpr uint32_t MaxLODs = 8;
struct VisibleInstanceData
{
    uint32_t InstanceID, SelectedMeshID, SelectedLOD, State;
};
struct GPULODLevel
{
    uint32_t MeshIndex = InvalidID;
    float ScreenSizeThreshold = 0;
    float Hysteresis = 0.1f;
    uint32_t Padding = 0;
};
struct GPULODGroup
{
    uint32_t Offset = 0, Count = 0, Padding[2]{};
};
struct LODMetadata
{
    uint32_t Count = 5;
    std::array<float, MaxLODs> Thresholds{0.30f, 0.15f, 0.05f, 0.01f, 0, 0, 0, 0};
    float Hysteresis = 0.1f;
    std::array<std::string, MaxLODs> MeshPaths{}; // Empty uses the imported mesh's generated LOD.
};
struct Statistics
{
    uint32_t Total = 0, FrustumCulled = 0, FrustumVisible = 0, Tested = 0;
    uint32_t Occluded = 0, FinalVisible = 0, Triangles = 0, IndexVertices = 0;
    std::array<uint32_t, MaxLODs> LODCounts{};
};
static_assert(sizeof(VisibleInstanceData) == 16 && sizeof(GPULODLevel) == 16 && sizeof(GPULODGroup) == 16);
static_assert(sizeof(Statistics) == 64);

// Half-open source coverage. Floor-sized D3D mips need the odd edge folded in.
inline std::pair<uint32_t, uint32_t> ReductionRange(uint32_t pixel, uint32_t source, uint32_t destination)
{
    return {pixel * source / destination, ((pixel + 1) * source + destination - 1) / destination};
}
inline uint32_t SelectLOD(float size, const LODMetadata &metadata, uint32_t previous)
{
    const uint32_t count = std::clamp(metadata.Count, 1u, MaxLODs);
    if (!std::isfinite(size) || size < 0)
    {
        return 0;
    }
    uint32_t selected = count - 1;
    for (uint32_t level = 0; level < count; ++level)
    {
        if (size >= metadata.Thresholds[level])
        {
            selected = level;
            break;
        }
    }
    if (previous < count)
    {
        selected = previous;
        while (selected + 1 < count && size < metadata.Thresholds[selected] * (1 - metadata.Hysteresis))
        {
            ++selected;
        }
        while (selected > 0 && size >= metadata.Thresholds[selected - 1] * (1 + metadata.Hysteresis))
        {
            --selected;
        }
    }
    return selected;
}
inline uint32_t FallbackLOD(uint32_t selected, const std::array<uint32_t, MaxLODs> &meshes)
{
    for (int level = static_cast<int>((std::min)(selected, MaxLODs - 1)); level >= 0; --level)
    {
        if (meshes[level] != InvalidID)
        {
            return static_cast<uint32_t>(level);
        }
    }
    return InvalidID;
}
inline bool ValidLOD(const LODMetadata &value)
{
    if (!value.Count || value.Count > MaxLODs || !std::isfinite(value.Hysteresis) || value.Hysteresis < 0 ||
        value.Hysteresis > 0.5f)
    {
        return false;
    }
    float previous = 1;
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < value.Count; ++i)
    {
        const float threshold = value.Thresholds[i];
        if (!std::isfinite(threshold) || threshold < 0 || threshold > previous)
        {
            return false;
        }
        previous = threshold;
    }
    return true;
}
inline bool SaveLOD(std::ostream &stream, const LODMetadata &value)
{
    if (!ValidLOD(value))
    {
        return false;
    }
    stream << "LOD 2 " << value.Count << ' ' << value.Hysteresis;
    for (float threshold : value.Thresholds)
    {
        stream << ' ' << threshold;
    }
    for (const auto &path : value.MeshPaths)
    {
        stream << ' ' << std::quoted(path);
    }
    stream << '\n';
    return bool(stream);
}
inline bool LoadLOD(std::istream &stream, LODMetadata &destination)
{
    std::string magic;
    uint32_t version = 0;
    LODMetadata value;
    if (!(stream >> magic >> version >> value.Count >> value.Hysteresis) || magic != "LOD" ||
        (version != 1 && version != 2))
    {
        return false;
    }
    for (float &threshold : value.Thresholds)
    {
        if (!(stream >> threshold))
        {
            return false;
        }
    }
    if (version == 2)
    {
        for (auto &path : value.MeshPaths)
        {
            if (!(stream >> std::quoted(path)))
            {
                return false;
            }
        }
    }
    if (!ValidLOD(value))
    {
        return false;
    }
    destination = value;
    return true;
}
} // namespace Visibility

===== FILE: rendering\visibilitybuffer.cpp =====
#include "pch.h"
#include "visibilitybuffer.h"
#include "rendererstate.h"


	ComPtr<ID3D12Device> g_VisibilityDevice;
	ComPtr<ID3D12DescriptorHeap> g_VisibilityDescriptorHeap;
	ComPtr<ID3D12RootSignature> g_VisibilityRootSignature;
	ComPtr<ID3D12PipelineState> g_VisibilityPso;
	UINT g_VisibilityDescriptorIncrement = 0;


bool VisibilityBuffer::Initialize(
	ID3D12Device* device,
	ID3D12DescriptorHeap* descriptorHeap,
	UINT descriptorIncrement)
{
	Shutdown();
	if (!device || !descriptorHeap || descriptorIncrement == 0) return false;
	g_VisibilityDevice = device;
	g_VisibilityDescriptorHeap = descriptorHeap;
	g_VisibilityDescriptorIncrement = descriptorIncrement;

	CD3DX12_DESCRIPTOR_RANGE ranges[2];
	ranges[0].Init(D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_RANGE_TYPE_SRV, 1, 0);
	ranges[1].Init(D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_RANGE_TYPE_UAV, RendererState::g_kGEOMETRY_GBUFFER_COUNT, 0);
	CD3DX12_ROOT_PARAMETER parameters[3];
	parameters[0].InitAsDescriptorTable(1, &ranges[0]);
	parameters[1].InitAsDescriptorTable(1, &ranges[1]);
	parameters[2].InitAsConstants(4, 0);
	CD3DX12_ROOT_SIGNATURE_DESC rootDesc(
		_countof(parameters), parameters, 0, nullptr, D3D12_ROOT_SIGNATURE_FLAG_NONE);
	ComPtr<ID3DBlob> serialized;
	ComPtr<ID3DBlob> errors;
	HRESULT hr = D3D12SerializeRootSignature(
		&rootDesc,
		D3D_ROOT_SIGNATURE_VERSION_1,
		&serialized,
		&errors);
	if (FAILED(hr))
	{
		if (errors) Debug::Log("Visibility Buffer root signature: %s\n", static_cast<const char*>(errors->GetBufferPointer()));
		return false;
	}
	hr = device->CreateRootSignature(
		0,
		serialized->GetBufferPointer(),
		serialized->GetBufferSize(),
		IID_PPV_ARGS(&g_VisibilityRootSignature));
	if (FAILED(hr)) return false;

	ComPtr<ID3DBlob> shader;
	if (FAILED(D3DReadFileToBlob(L"shader/hlsl/build/GBufferFromVisibilityCS.cso", &shader)))
	{
		Debug::Log("GBufferFromVisibilityCS.cso is missing.\n");
		return false;
	}
	D3D12_COMPUTE_PIPELINE_STATE_DESC psoDesc{};
	psoDesc.pRootSignature = g_VisibilityRootSignature.Get();
	psoDesc.CS = CD3DX12_SHADER_BYTECODE(shader.Get());
	return SUCCEEDED(device->CreateComputePipelineState(&psoDesc, IID_PPV_ARGS(&g_VisibilityPso)));
}

void VisibilityBuffer::Shutdown()
{
	g_VisibilityPso.Reset();
	g_VisibilityRootSignature.Reset();
	g_VisibilityDescriptorHeap.Reset();
	g_VisibilityDevice.Reset();
	g_VisibilityDescriptorIncrement = 0;
}

bool VisibilityBuffer::IsAvailable()
{
	return g_VisibilityPso && g_VisibilityRootSignature && g_VisibilityDescriptorHeap;
}

void VisibilityBuffer::GenerateGBuffer(
	ID3D12GraphicsCommandList* commandList,
	D3D12_GPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE visibilitySrv,
	UINT width,
	UINT height)
{
	if (!commandList || !IsAvailable() || width == 0 || height == 0) return;
	ID3D12DescriptorHeap* heaps[] = { g_VisibilityDescriptorHeap.Get() };
	commandList->SetDescriptorHeaps(_countof(heaps), heaps);
	commandList->SetComputeRootSignature(g_VisibilityRootSignature.Get());
	commandList->SetPipelineState(g_VisibilityPso.Get());
	commandList->SetComputeRootDescriptorTable(0, visibilitySrv);
	commandList->SetComputeRootDescriptorTable(
		1,
		CD3DX12_GPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE(
			g_VisibilityDescriptorHeap->GetGPUDescriptorHandleForHeapStart(),
			RendererState::g_kGBUFFER_UAV_START_INDEX,
			g_VisibilityDescriptorIncrement));
	const UINT constants[4] = { width, height, 0, 0 };
	commandList->SetComputeRoot32BitConstants(2, 4, constants, 0);
	commandList->Dispatch((width + 7u) / 8u, (height + 3u) / 4u, 1);
}

===== FILE: scene\Camera.cpp =====
#include "pch.h"
#include "camera.h"
#include "world.h"
#include "componentmanager.h"
#include "projectmanager.h"


	bool IsCameraEntity(EntityID entity)
	{
		return entity != g_kINVALID_ENTITY &&
			Registry::IsAlive(entity) &&
			ComponentManager::HasComponent<CameraComponent>(entity);
	}

	Entity CreateCameraEntity(
		const string& name,
		const XMFLOAT3& position,
		const XMFLOAT3& target,
		float fov,
		bool gameCamera)
	{
		auto entity = World::CreateEntity()
			.Add<NameComponent>()
			.Add<TransformComponent>()
			.Add<InputComponent>()
			.Add<MoveComponent>()
			.Add<PostProcessComponent>()
			.Add<CameraComponent>();

		entity.SetName(name);
		entity.Get<TransformComponent>().Position = position;

		auto& camera = entity.Get<CameraComponent>();
		camera.Target = target;
		camera.Fov = clamp(fov, XMConvertToRadians(1.0f), XMConvertToRadians(179.0f));
		camera.NearClip = 0.1f;
		camera.FarClip = 1000.0f;
		camera.LockOnTarget = g_kINVALID_ENTITY;
		camera.LockOnOffset = { 0.0f, 4.0f, 0.0f };
		camera.EnablePostProcess = true;
		camera.IsGameCamera = gameCamera;
		camera.IsMainGameCamera = false;
		camera.AllowUserControl = true;

		entity.Get<PostProcessComponent>().Type = PostProcessType::BLOOM;


		entity.Get<InputComponent>().IsActive = false;
		auto& move = entity.Get<MoveComponent>();
		move.Speed = 0.1f;
		move.RotationSpeed = 0.02f;
		move.UseCameraRelativeMovement = true;
		return entity;
	}


void Camera::Create(XMFLOAT3 target, float fov)
{
	Entity editorCamera = CreateCameraEntity(
		"EditorCamera", { 5.0f, 4.0f, -10.0f }, target, fov, false);
	m_EditorCameraEntity = editorCamera.GetID();
}

EntityID Camera::CreateGameCamera(
	const string& name,
	XMFLOAT3 position,
	XMFLOAT3 target,
	float fov,
	bool makeMain)
{
	string cameraName;
	if (name.empty())
	{
		cameraName = "GameCamera";
	}
	else
	{
		cameraName = name;
	}
	Entity gameCamera = CreateCameraEntity(
		cameraName,
		position,
		target,
		fov,
		true);
	if (makeMain || GetGameCameraEntity() == g_kINVALID_ENTITY)
	{
		SetMainGameCamera(gameCamera.GetID());
	}
	return gameCamera.GetID();
}

EntityID Camera::GetCameraEntity()
{
	if (ProjectManager::IsPlaying())
	{
		const EntityID gameCamera = GetGameCameraEntity();
		if (gameCamera != g_kINVALID_ENTITY)
		{
			return gameCamera;
		}
	}
	return GetEditorCameraEntity();
}

EntityID Camera::GetEditorCameraEntity()
{
	if (IsCameraEntity(m_EditorCameraEntity) &&
		!ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<CameraComponent>(
			m_EditorCameraEntity).IsGameCamera)
	{
		return m_EditorCameraEntity;
	}
	auto cameraEntities = World::GetView<CameraComponent>();
	for (EntityID entity : cameraEntities)
	{
		if (!ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<CameraComponent>(entity).IsGameCamera)
		{
			m_EditorCameraEntity = entity;
			return entity;
		}
	}
	m_EditorCameraEntity = g_kINVALID_ENTITY;
	return g_kINVALID_ENTITY;
}

EntityID Camera::GetGameCameraEntity()
{
	if (IsCameraEntity(m_GameCameraEntity))
	{
		const auto& cached =
			ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<CameraComponent>(m_GameCameraEntity);
		if (cached.IsGameCamera && cached.IsMainGameCamera)
		{
			return m_GameCameraEntity;
		}
	}

	EntityID fallback = g_kINVALID_ENTITY;
	int fallbackPriority = numeric_limits<int>::min();
	for (EntityID entity : World::GetView<CameraComponent>())
	{
		const auto& camera =
			ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<CameraComponent>(entity);
		if (!camera.IsGameCamera)
		{
			continue;
		}
		if (camera.IsMainGameCamera)
		{
			m_GameCameraEntity = entity;
			return entity;
		}
		if (fallback == g_kINVALID_ENTITY || camera.Priority > fallbackPriority)
		{
			fallback = entity;
			fallbackPriority = camera.Priority;
		}
	}
	m_GameCameraEntity = fallback;
	return fallback;
}

void Camera::SetMainGameCamera(EntityID entity)
{
	if (!IsCameraEntity(entity))
	{
		return;
	}
	for (EntityID cameraEntity : World::GetView<CameraComponent>())
	{
		auto& camera =
			ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<CameraComponent>(cameraEntity);
		if (camera.IsGameCamera)
		{
			camera.IsMainGameCamera = cameraEntity == entity;
			if (ComponentManager::HasComponent<InputComponent>(cameraEntity))
			{
				ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<InputComponent>(
					cameraEntity).IsActive = cameraEntity == entity;
			}
		}
	}
	auto& selected = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<CameraComponent>(entity);
	selected.IsGameCamera = true;
	selected.IsMainGameCamera = true;
	if (ComponentManager::HasComponent<InputComponent>(entity))
	{
		ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<InputComponent>(entity).IsActive = true;
	}
	m_GameCameraEntity = entity;
}

void Camera::GetCameraMatrices(EntityID camera, XMMATRIX& view, XMMATRIX& proj)
{
	view = XMMatrixIdentity();
	proj = XMMatrixIdentity();
	if (camera != g_kINVALID_ENTITY && Registry::HasComponent(camera, ComponentType::CAMERA))
	{
		auto& cam = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<CameraComponent>(camera);
		view = XMLoadFloat4x4(&cam.ViewMatrix);
		proj = XMLoadFloat4x4(&cam.ProjectionMatrix);
	}
}

void Camera::SetCameraPostProcess(PostProcessType type)
{
	const EntityID cameraEntity = GetCameraEntity();
	if (cameraEntity != g_kINVALID_ENTITY && Registry::HasComponent(cameraEntity, ComponentType::POST_PROCESS))
	{
		auto& postProcess = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<PostProcessComponent>(cameraEntity);
		postProcess.Type = type;
		Debug::Log("Camera post-process set to %d\n", static_cast<int>(type));
	}
}

===== FILE: scene\daynightcycle.cpp =====
#include "pch.h"
#include "daynightcycle.h"
#include "solarcycle.h"
#include "sun.h"
#include "world.h"
#include "projectmanager.h"

namespace
{
DayNightCycle::Settings g_Settings;
}

DayNightCycle::Settings& DayNightCycle::GetSettings()
{
    return g_Settings;
}

void DayNightCycle::SetTime(float hours)
{
    g_Settings.Hours = SolarCycle::WrapHours(hours);
    g_Settings.TimeDriven = true;
    Update(0.0f);
}

void DayNightCycle::Update(float deltaTime)
{
    if (g_Settings.Running && g_Settings.TimeDriven && !ProjectManager::IsPaused() &&
        (ProjectManager::IsSimulationRunning() || g_Settings.PreviewInEditor))
    {
        const double hoursPerSecond = 24.0 / (max)(1.0f, g_Settings.DayDurationSeconds);
        g_Settings.Hours = SolarCycle::WrapHours(g_Settings.Hours + deltaTime * hoursPerSecond);
    }
    bool firstSun = true;
    for (EntityID entity : World::GetView<SunComponent, TransformComponent, LightComponent>())
    {
        auto& transform = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<TransformComponent>(entity);
        const auto& sun = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<SunComponent>(entity);
        auto& light = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<LightComponent>(entity);
        if (g_Settings.TimeDriven && firstSun)
        {
            const auto direction = SolarCycle::Calculate(g_Settings.Hours, g_Settings.Latitude, g_Settings.DayOfYear);
            const float radius = clamp(g_Settings.OrbitRadius, 10.0f, 1000.0f);
            const XMFLOAT3 position = { sun.Target.x + direction.East * radius,
                sun.Target.y + direction.Up * radius, sun.Target.z + direction.North * radius };
            if (position.x != transform.Position.x || position.y != transform.Position.y || position.z != transform.Position.z)
            {
                transform.Position = position;
                transform.IsDirty = true;
            }
        }
        Sun::Sync(entity);
        if (g_Settings.AutomaticLighting && sun.SyncDirectionalLight)
        {
            const float daylight = SolarCycle::Daylight(light.Direction.y);
            const float neutral = SolarCycle::SmoothRange(0.0f, 0.65f, light.Direction.y);
            light.Color = { 1.0f, 0.38f + neutral * 0.57f, 0.12f + neutral * 0.73f, 1.0f };
            light.Intensity = (max)(0.0f, g_Settings.DayIntensity) * daylight *
                pow((max)(0.05f, light.Direction.y), 0.35f);
        }
        firstSun = false;
    }
}

XMFLOAT4 DayNightCycle::GetSunDirection()
{
    for (EntityID entity : World::GetView<SunComponent, LightComponent>())
    {
        const auto& light = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<LightComponent>(entity);
        return { light.Direction.x, light.Direction.y, light.Direction.z, 1.0f };
    }
    return { 0.0f, 1.0f, 0.0f, 1.0f };
}

float DayNightCycle::GetDaylight()
{
    return SolarCycle::Daylight(GetSunDirection().y);
}

===== FILE: scene\grid.cpp =====
#include "pch.h"
#include "grid.h"
#include "psomanager.h"

#include <d3dcompiler.h>
#include <vector>


	struct GridVertex
	{
		XMFLOAT3 Pos;
		XMFLOAT3 Normal;
		XMFLOAT2 Tex;
		XMFLOAT4 Color;
	};


ComPtr<ID3D12Resource> Grid::VertexBuffer;
D3D12_VERTEX_BUFFER_VIEW Grid::VertexBufferView {};
UINT Grid::m_VertexCount = 0;
ComPtr<ID3D12PipelineState> Grid::m_LinePso;
ComPtr<ID3D12PipelineState> Grid::m_DeferredLinePso;
bool Grid::m_IsInitialized = false;

void Grid::Init(ID3D12Device* device, ID3D12RootSignature* rootSignature, int gridSize, float spacing)
{
	if (m_IsInitialized || !device || !rootSignature || gridSize <= 0 || spacing <= 0.0f)
	{
		return;
	}

	vector<GridVertex> vertices;
	vertices.reserve(static_cast<size_t>(gridSize + 1) * 4);

	const float halfExtent = gridSize * spacing * 0.5f;
	const XMFLOAT3 normal = { 0.0f, 1.0f, 0.0f };
	const XMFLOAT2 uv = { 0.0f, 0.0f };
	const XMFLOAT4 color = { 0.45f, 0.45f, 0.45f, 1.0f };

	for (int i = 0; i <= gridSize; ++i)
	{
		const float offset = -halfExtent + i * spacing;

		vertices.push_back({ { -halfExtent, 0.0f, offset }, normal, uv, color });
		vertices.push_back({ {  halfExtent, 0.0f, offset }, normal, uv, color });

		vertices.push_back({ { offset, 0.0f, -halfExtent }, normal, uv, color });
		vertices.push_back({ { offset, 0.0f,  halfExtent }, normal, uv, color });
	}

	m_VertexCount = static_cast<UINT>(vertices.size());
	const UINT bufferSize = static_cast<UINT>(vertices.size() * sizeof(GridVertex));

	auto heapProps = CD3DX12_HEAP_PROPERTIES(D3D12_HEAP_TYPE_UPLOAD);
	auto resourceDesc = CD3DX12_RESOURCE_DESC::Buffer(bufferSize);
	HRESULT hr = device->CreateCommittedResource(
		&heapProps,
		D3D12_HEAP_FLAG_NONE,
		&resourceDesc,
		D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_GENERIC_READ,
		nullptr,
		IID_PPV_ARGS(&VertexBuffer));
	if (FAILED(hr))
	{
		Debug::Log("ERROR: Failed to create grid vertex buffer.\n");
		return;
	}

	void* mapped = nullptr;
	hr = VertexBuffer->Map(0, nullptr, &mapped);
	if (FAILED(hr) || !mapped)
	{
		Debug::Log("ERROR: Failed to map grid vertex buffer.\n");
		VertexBuffer.Reset();
		m_VertexCount = 0;
		return;
	}

	memcpy(mapped, vertices.data(), bufferSize);
	VertexBuffer->Unmap(0, nullptr);

	VertexBufferView.BufferLocation = VertexBuffer->GetGPUVirtualAddress();
	VertexBufferView.SizeInBytes = bufferSize;
	VertexBufferView.StrideInBytes = sizeof(GridVertex);

	ComPtr<ID3DBlob> vsBlob;
	ComPtr<ID3DBlob> psBlob;
	ComPtr<ID3DBlob> deferredPsBlob;
	hr = D3DReadFileToBlob(L"shader/hlsl/build/debugLineVS.cso", &vsBlob);
	if (FAILED(hr))
	{
		Debug::Log("ERROR: Failed to load debugLineVS.cso for grid.\n");
		Uninit();
		return;
	}

	hr = D3DReadFileToBlob(L"shader/hlsl/build/debugLinePS.cso", &psBlob);
	if (FAILED(hr))
	{
		Debug::Log("ERROR: Failed to load debugLinePS.cso for grid.\n");
		Uninit();
		return;
	}

	hr = D3DReadFileToBlob(L"shader/hlsl/build/debugLinePS_MRT.cso", &deferredPsBlob);
	if (FAILED(hr))
	{
		Debug::Log("ERROR: Failed to load debugLinePS_MRT.cso for deferred grid.\n");
		Uninit();
		return;
	}

	D3D12_GRAPHICS_PIPELINE_STATE_DESC psoDesc {};
	psoDesc.pRootSignature = rootSignature;
	psoDesc.VS = CD3DX12_SHADER_BYTECODE(vsBlob.Get());
	psoDesc.PS = CD3DX12_SHADER_BYTECODE(psBlob.Get());
	psoDesc.BlendState = CD3DX12_BLEND_DESC(D3D12_DEFAULT);
	psoDesc.SampleMask = UINT_MAX;
	psoDesc.RasterizerState = CD3DX12_RASTERIZER_DESC(D3D12_DEFAULT);
	psoDesc.RasterizerState.CullMode = D3D12_CULL_MODE_NONE;
	psoDesc.DepthStencilState = CD3DX12_DEPTH_STENCIL_DESC(D3D12_DEFAULT);
	psoDesc.PrimitiveTopologyType = D3D12_PRIMITIVE_TOPOLOGY_TYPE_LINE;
	psoDesc.NumRenderTargets = 1;
	psoDesc.RTVFormats[0] = DXGI_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM;
	psoDesc.DSVFormat = DXGI_FORMAT_D32_FLOAT;
	psoDesc.SampleDesc.Count = 1;

	static D3D12_INPUT_ELEMENT_DESC inputLayout[] =
	{
		{ "POSITION", 0, DXGI_FORMAT_R32G32B32_FLOAT,    0,  0, D3D12_INPUT_CLASSIFICATION_PER_VERTEX_DATA, 0 },
		{ "NORMAL",   0, DXGI_FORMAT_R32G32B32_FLOAT,    0, 12, D3D12_INPUT_CLASSIFICATION_PER_VERTEX_DATA, 0 },
		{ "TEXCOORD", 0, DXGI_FORMAT_R32G32_FLOAT,       0, 24, D3D12_INPUT_CLASSIFICATION_PER_VERTEX_DATA, 0 },
		{ "COLOR",    0, DXGI_FORMAT_R32G32B32A32_FLOAT, 0, 32, D3D12_INPUT_CLASSIFICATION_PER_VERTEX_DATA, 0 },
	};
	psoDesc.InputLayout = { inputLayout, _countof(inputLayout) };

	if (!PsoManager::CreateGraphicsPipelineState(psoDesc, "grid line", m_LinePso))
	{
		Debug::Log("ERROR: Failed to create grid line PSO.\n");
		Uninit();
		return;
	}

	D3D12_GRAPHICS_PIPELINE_STATE_DESC deferredPsoDesc = psoDesc;
	deferredPsoDesc.PS = CD3DX12_SHADER_BYTECODE(deferredPsBlob.Get());
	deferredPsoDesc.NumRenderTargets = 2;
	deferredPsoDesc.RTVFormats[0] = DXGI_FORMAT_R16G16B16A16_FLOAT;
	deferredPsoDesc.RTVFormats[1] = DXGI_FORMAT_R16G16B16A16_FLOAT;

	if (!PsoManager::CreateGraphicsPipelineState(deferredPsoDesc, "deferred grid line", m_DeferredLinePso))
	{
		Debug::Log("ERROR: Failed to create deferred grid line PSO.\n");
		Uninit();
		return;
	}

	m_IsInitialized = true;
}

void Grid::Uninit()
{
	m_DeferredLinePso.Reset();
	m_LinePso.Reset();
	VertexBuffer.Reset();
	VertexBufferView = {};
	m_VertexCount = 0;
	m_IsInitialized = false;
}

#include "pch.h"
#include "light.h"

	static XMMATRIX BuildWorldMatrix(const TransformComponent& transform)
	{
		return XMMatrixScaling(transform.Scale.x, transform.Scale.y, transform.Scale.z) *
			XMMatrixRotationX(transform.Rotation.x) *
			XMMatrixRotationY(transform.Rotation.y) *
			XMMatrixRotationZ(transform.Rotation.z) *
			XMMatrixTranslation(transform.Position.x, transform.Position.y, transform.Position.z);
	}

	XMFLOAT3 NormalizeDirection(const XMFLOAT3& direction)
	{
		const XMVECTOR dir = XMLoadFloat3(&direction);
		if (XMVectorGetX(XMVector3LengthSq(dir)) <= 0.000001f)
		{
			return { 0.0f, 1.0f, -1.0f };
		}

		XMFLOAT3 normalized{};
		XMStoreFloat3(&normalized, XMVector3Normalize(dir));
		return normalized;
	}


Light::CreateDesc Light::MakeDefaultDesc(LightType type)
{
	CreateDesc desc{};
	desc.Type = type;
	desc.Name = string(GetTypeName(type)) + " Light";
	if ((type == LightType::Volume))
	{
		desc.Intensity = 1.5f;
	}
	else
	{
		desc.Intensity = 1.0f;
	}
	if ((type == LightType::Volume))
	{
		desc.Range = 6.0f;
	}
	else
	{
		desc.Range = 8.0f;
	}
	if ((type == LightType::Directional || type == LightType::Volume))
	{
		desc.VolumeDensity = 0.35f;
	}
	else
	{
		desc.VolumeDensity = 0.0f;
	}
	desc.AffectsOpaque = type != LightType::Volume;
	desc.AffectsForward = type != LightType::Volume;
	desc.AffectsVolumetrics =
		type == LightType::Directional || type == LightType::Volume;
	desc.CastShadow = (type == LightType::Directional);
	return desc;
}

EntityID Light::Create(const CreateDesc& desc)
{
	Entity entity = World::CreateEntity()
		.Add<NameComponent>()
		.Add<TransformComponent>()
		.Add<LightComponent>();


	string lightName;
	if (desc.Name.empty())
	{
		lightName = string(GetTypeName(desc.Type)) + " Light";
	}
	else
	{
		lightName = desc.Name;
	}


	const string name = lightName;
	entity.SetName(name);

	auto& transform = entity.Get<TransformComponent>();
	transform.Position = desc.Position;
	transform.Rotation = desc.Rotation;
	transform.Scale = desc.Scale;
	XMStoreFloat4x4(&transform.WorldMatrix, BuildWorldMatrix(transform));
	transform.IsDirty = true;

	auto& light = entity.Get<LightComponent>();
	light.Type = desc.Type;
	light.Position = desc.Position;
	light.Direction = NormalizeDirection(desc.Direction);
	light.Color = desc.Color;
	light.Intensity = max(0.0f, desc.Intensity);
	light.Range = max(0.01f, desc.Range);
	light.InnerAngle = max(0.1f, min(89.0f, desc.InnerAngle));
	light.OuterAngle = max(light.InnerAngle + 0.1f, min(89.5f, desc.OuterAngle));
	light.VolumeDensity = max(0.0f, min(3.0f, desc.VolumeDensity));
	light.VolumeShape = desc.VolumeShape;
	light.IsActive = desc.IsActive;
	light.DrawDebug = desc.DrawDebug;
	light.AffectsOpaque = desc.AffectsOpaque;
	light.AffectsForward = desc.AffectsForward;
	light.AffectsVolumetrics = desc.AffectsVolumetrics;
	light.CastShadow = desc.CastShadow;
	light.Priority = desc.Priority;
	light.RenderMode = desc.RenderMode;

	return entity.GetID();
}

EntityID Light::Create(LightType type)
{
	return Create(MakeDefaultDesc(type));
}

const char* Light::GetTypeName(LightType type)
{
	switch (type)
	{
	case LightType::Directional: return "Directional";
	case LightType::Point: return "Point";
	case LightType::Spot: return "Spot";
	case LightType::Volume: return "Volume";
	default: return "Light";
	}
}

void Light::AttachLightTimeLine(EntityID entity)
{
	if (entity == g_kINVALID_ENTITY ||
		!Registry::IsAlive(entity) ||
		!ComponentManager::HasComponent<TransformComponent>(entity))
	{
		return;
	}

	const auto& transform = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<TransformComponent>(entity);
	auto& director = TimeLineSystem::CreateDirector();
	auto& asset = director.CreateAsset();

	asset.SetDuration(10.0f);

	auto& lightTrack = asset.AddTransformTrack(entity);
	auto& lightClip = lightTrack.AddClip(0.0f, asset.GetDuration());

	lightClip.AddPositionKey(0.0f, transform.Position);
	lightClip.AddPositionKey(5.0f, { transform.Position.x + 3.0f, transform.Position.y + 2.0f, transform.Position.z + 3.0f });
	lightClip.AddPositionKey(10.0f, transform.Position);

	auto& colorTrack = asset.AddComponentTrack<LightComponent>(entity);
	auto& colorClip = colorTrack.AddVector4Clip(0.0f, asset.GetDuration(), &LightComponent::Color);
	colorClip.AddKey(0.0f, { 1.0f, 0.2f, 0.2f, 1.0f });
	colorClip.AddKey(5.0f, { 0.2f, 1.0f, 0.3f, 1.0f });
	colorClip.AddKey(10.0f, { 0.2f, 0.4f, 1.0f, 1.0f });

	director.SetLoop(true);
	director.Play();
}

#include "pch.h"
#include "simulationconfiguration.h"
#include "atmosphere.h"
#include "daynightcycle.h"
