    uint32_t FrameIndex = 0, Capacity = 1, ExactBins = 1, Materials = 0;
    uint64_t Serial = 0;
    bool Available = false, Failed = false;
};
State& Data() { static State state; return state; }
Frame& Current() { return Data().Frames.at(Data().FrameIndex); }
void Check(HRESULT result)
{
    if (FAILED(result)) throw std::runtime_error("Virtual Geometry material bin allocation/pipeline failed");
}
void Initialize()
{
    auto& state = Data();
    if (state.Scatter) return;
    CD3DX12_ROOT_PARAMETER parameters[7];
    parameters[0].InitAsShaderResourceView(0);
    parameters[1].InitAsShaderResourceView(1);
    for (uint32_t index = 0; index < 4; ++index) parameters[2+index].InitAsUnorderedAccessView(index);
    parameters[6].InitAsConstants(4,0);
    CD3DX12_ROOT_SIGNATURE_DESC description(7,parameters);
    ComPtr<ID3DBlob> blob, error;
    Check(D3D12SerializeRootSignature(&description,D3D_ROOT_SIGNATURE_VERSION_1,&blob,&error));
    auto* device = GraphicsDevice::GetDevice();
    Check(device->CreateRootSignature(0,blob->GetBufferPointer(),blob->GetBufferSize(),IID_PPV_ARGS(&state.Root)));
    auto pipeline = [&](const char* path, ComPtr<ID3D12PipelineState>& output)
    {
        ComPtr<ID3DBlob> shader;
        ShaderDescription input{};
        input.csoPath = path;
        input.ppBlob = shader.GetAddressOf();
        if (!ShaderPipelines::LoadShaderBlob(input)) throw std::runtime_error(path);
        D3D12_COMPUTE_PIPELINE_STATE_DESC desc{};
        desc.pRootSignature = state.Root.Get();
        desc.CS = {shader->GetBufferPointer(),shader->GetBufferSize()};
        Check(device->CreateComputePipelineState(&desc,IID_PPV_ARGS(&output)));
    };
    pipeline("shader/hlsl/build/VirtualGeometryBinsResetCS.cso",state.Reset);
    pipeline("shader/hlsl/build/VirtualGeometryBinsCountCS.cso",state.Count);
    pipeline("shader/hlsl/build/VirtualGeometryBinsPrefixCS.cso",state.Prefix);
    pipeline("shader/hlsl/build/VirtualGeometryBinsScatterCS.cso",state.Scatter);
}
RenderGraph::ResourceHandle Import(RenderGraph& graph, const char* name, GpuSceneBuffer& buffer, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATES final)
{
    auto existing = graph.FindImportedResource(buffer.Resource());
    if (existing.IsValid()) return existing;
    RenderGraph::ImportedResource resource{};
    resource.Name = name;
    resource.Resource = buffer.Resource();
    resource.InitialState = buffer.State;
    resource.FinalState = final;
    resource.HasFinalState = true;
    buffer.State = final;
    return graph.ImportResource(resource);
}
void Bind(ID3D12GraphicsCommandList* commands, VirtualGeometryTraversal::RasterPhase phase)
{
    auto& state = Data();
    auto& frame = Current();
    commands->SetComputeRootSignature(state.Root.Get());
    commands->SetComputeRootShaderResourceView(0,VirtualGeometryTraversal::VisibleBuffer(phase).Resource()->GetGPUVirtualAddress());
    commands->SetComputeRootShaderResourceView(1,VirtualGeometryTraversal::CounterBuffer(phase).Resource()->GetGPUVirtualAddress()
        +VirtualGeometryTraversal::CounterOffset(phase));
    GpuSceneBuffer* outputs[] = {&frame.Bins,&frame.Visible,&frame.Arguments,&frame.Counters};
    for (uint32_t index = 0; index < 4; ++index)
        commands->SetComputeRootUnorderedAccessView(2+index,outputs[index]->Resource()->GetGPUVirtualAddress());
    const uint32_t constants[] = {state.Capacity,state.ExactBins,state.Materials,0};
    commands->SetComputeRoot32BitConstants(6,4,constants,0);
}
void Poll()
{
    auto& state = Data();
    uint64_t completed = GraphicsDevice::GetCompletedFence();
    for (auto& frame : state.Frames)
    {
        if (!frame.Fence || frame.Fence > completed) continue;
        D3D12_RANGE range{0,96};
        void* mapped = nullptr;
        Check(frame.Readback->Map(0,&range,&mapped));
        const auto* values = static_cast<const uint32_t*>(mapped);
        for (uint32_t phase = 0; phase < 3; ++phase)
        {
            if ((frame.SampleMask&(1u<<phase)) == 0 || frame.Serial <= state.SampleSerial[phase]) continue;
            auto& sample = state.Stats.Phases[phase];
            sample.ActiveBins = values[phase*8];
            sample.Clusters = values[phase*8+1];
            sample.OverflowClusters = values[phase*8+2];
            sample.InvalidMaterials = values[phase*8+3];
            sample.RejectedClusters = values[phase*8+4]+values[phase*8+6];
            sample.HasSample = true;
            if (sample.OverflowClusters && Data().Options.MaxMaterialBins < 65535u)
            {
                Data().Options.MaxMaterialBins = std::min(65535u, Data().Options.MaxMaterialBins*2);
            }
            state.SampleSerial[phase] = frame.Serial;
        }
        D3D12_RANGE noWrite{0,0};
        frame.Readback->Unmap(0,&noWrite);
        frame.Fence = 0;
    }
}
}
Settings& GetSettings() { return Data().Options; }
const Statistics& GetStatistics() { return Data().Stats; }
const std::string& UnavailableReason() { return Data().Reason; }
bool Active() { return Data().Available; }
GpuSceneBuffer& VisibleBuffer() { return Current().Visible; }
GpuSceneBuffer& ArgumentBuffer() { return Current().Arguments; }
GpuSceneBuffer& CounterBuffer() { return Current().Counters; }
uint32_t MaximumCommands() { return Data().ExactBins+1; }

void BeginFrame(bool rasterAvailable)
{
    auto& state = Data();
    state.Available = false;
    state.FrameIndex = GraphicsDevice::GetFrameIndex();
    ++state.Serial;
    Poll();
    if (!state.Options.Enabled)
    {
        state.Failed = false;
        state.Reason = "Disabled";
        return;
    }
    if (!rasterAvailable)
    {
        state.Reason = "Binned raster shaders unavailable; using original dispatch";
        return;
    }
    if (state.Failed || !VirtualGeometryTraversal::Active() || !VirtualGeometryTraversal::GetSettings().Enabled) return;
    try
    {
        Initialize();
        auto& frame = Current();
        state.Options.MaxMaterialBins = std::clamp(state.Options.MaxMaterialBins,1u,65535u);
        state.Materials = GpuScene::Statistics().Materials;
        state.ExactBins = std::min(std::max(1u,state.Materials),state.Options.MaxMaterialBins);
        // All phase cuts are subsets of this pre-reserved full resident cut.
        state.Capacity = std::min(4000000u,VirtualGeometryTraversal::VisibleBuffer().Capacity());
        auto ensure = [&](GpuSceneBuffer& buffer, uint32_t count, uint32_t stride)
        {
            buffer.BeginFrame(state.FrameIndex);
            buffer.Ensure(GraphicsDevice::GetDevice(),count,stride,state.FrameIndex,L"Native material bins",true);
        };
        ensure(frame.Bins,state.ExactBins+1,16);
        ensure(frame.Visible,state.Capacity,16);
        ensure(frame.Arguments,state.ExactBins+1,sizeof(IndirectCommand));
        ensure(frame.Counters,8,4);
        if (!frame.Readback)
        {
            auto heap = CD3DX12_HEAP_PROPERTIES(D3D12_HEAP_TYPE_READBACK);
            auto description = CD3DX12_RESOURCE_DESC::Buffer(96);
            Check(GraphicsDevice::GetDevice()->CreateCommittedResource(&heap,D3D12_HEAP_FLAG_NONE,&description,
                D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_COPY_DEST,nullptr,IID_PPV_ARGS(&frame.Readback)));
        }
        frame.SampleMask = 0;
        state.Stats.BufferBytes = 0;
        for (const auto& item : state.Frames)
            state.Stats.BufferBytes += item.Bins.MemoryBytes()+item.Visible.MemoryBytes()+item.Arguments.MemoryBytes()
                +item.Counters.MemoryBytes()+(item.Readback ? 96 : 0);
        state.Reason.clear();
        state.Available = true;
        if (!VirtualGeometryTraversal::TwoPassActive()) state.Stats.Phases[1] = {};
        RenderProfiler::GeometryBinningStatistics sample{};
        for (uint32_t phase = 0; phase < 3; ++phase)
        {
            const auto& latest = state.Stats.Phases[phase];
            sample.ActiveBins[phase] = latest.ActiveBins;
            sample.Clusters[phase] = latest.Clusters;
            sample.OverflowClusters[phase] = latest.OverflowClusters;
            sample.InvalidMaterials[phase] = latest.InvalidMaterials;
            sample.HasSample[phase] = latest.HasSample;
        }
        sample.BufferBytes = state.Stats.BufferBytes;
        RenderProfiler::RecordGeometryBinning(sample);
    }
    catch (const std::exception& error)
    {
        state.Failed = true;
        state.Reason = error.what();
        WriteGraphicsLog("Native material binning unavailable; using original dispatch: %s\n",error.what());
    }
}

void Prepare(RenderGraph& graph, VirtualGeometryTraversal::RasterPhase phase)
{
    if (!Active()) return;
    auto& frame = Current();
    auto input = Import(graph,"Native bin input",VirtualGeometryTraversal::VisibleBuffer(phase),D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_NON_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE);
    auto count = Import(graph,"Native bin input count",VirtualGeometryTraversal::CounterBuffer(phase),D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_NON_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE);
    auto bins = Import(graph,"Native material ranges",frame.Bins,D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS);
    auto sorted = Import(graph,"Native material sorted clusters",frame.Visible,D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_NON_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE);
    auto args = Import(graph,"Native material commands",frame.Arguments,D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_INDIRECT_ARGUMENT);
    auto stats = Import(graph,"Native material bin counters",frame.Counters,D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_INDIRECT_ARGUMENT);
    graph.AddPass("Native material bin reset",
        [=](RenderGraph::PassBuilder& b) { b.Write(bins,D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS).Write(stats,D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS); },
        [=](ID3D12GraphicsCommandList* list)
        {
            Bind(list,phase);
            list->SetPipelineState(Data().Reset.Get());
            list->Dispatch((std::max(8u,Data().ExactBins+1)+63)/64,1,1);
        });
    graph.AddPass("Native material bin count",
        [=](RenderGraph::PassBuilder& b)
        {
            b.Read(input,D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_NON_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE).Read(count,D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_NON_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE)
                .ReadWrite(bins,D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS).ReadWrite(stats,D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS);
        },
        [=](ID3D12GraphicsCommandList* list)
        {
            RenderProfiler::ScopedEvent profile("Native material bin count",list);
            Bind(list,phase);
            list->SetPipelineState(Data().Count.Get());
            list->Dispatch((Data().Capacity+63)/64,1,1);
        });
    graph.AddPass("Native material bin prefix and commands",
        [=](RenderGraph::PassBuilder& b)
        {
            b.ReadWrite(bins,D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS).ReadWrite(stats,D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS)
                .Write(args,D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS);
        },
        [=](ID3D12GraphicsCommandList* list)
        {
            RenderProfiler::ScopedEvent profile("Native material bin prefix",list);
            Bind(list,phase);
            list->SetPipelineState(Data().Prefix.Get());
            list->Dispatch(1,1,1);
        });
    graph.AddPass("Native material bin scatter",
        [=](RenderGraph::PassBuilder& b)
        {
            b.Read(input,D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_NON_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE).Read(count,D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_NON_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE)
                .ReadWrite(bins,D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS).Write(sorted,D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS);
        },
        [=](ID3D12GraphicsCommandList* list)
        {
            RenderProfiler::ScopedEvent profile("Native material bin scatter",list);
            Bind(list,phase);
            list->SetPipelineState(Data().Scatter.Get());
            list->Dispatch((Data().Capacity+63)/64,1,1);
        });
    auto* target = &frame;
    uint32_t phaseIndex = uint32_t(phase);
    uint64_t serial = Data().Serial;
    graph.AddPass("Native material bin feedback",
        [=](RenderGraph::PassBuilder& b) { b.Read(stats,D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_COPY_SOURCE); },
        [=](ID3D12GraphicsCommandList* list)
        {
            list->CopyBufferRegion(target->Readback.Get(),uint64_t(phaseIndex)*32,target->Counters.Resource(),0,32);
            target->Fence = GraphicsDevice::GetPendingSubmissionFence();
            target->Serial = serial;
            target->SampleMask |= 1u<<phaseIndex;
        });
}
void Shutdown() { Data() = {}; }
}

===== FILE: virtualgeometry\virtualgeometrybuilder.cpp =====
#include "virtualgeometrybuilder.h"
#include "virtualgeometryinternal.h"
#include "virtualgeometryvalidator.h"
#include <chrono>
#include <algorithm>

VirtualGeometryBuildResult VirtualGeometryBuilder::Build(
    std::span<const VirtualGeometryVertex> vertices, std::span<const uint32_t> indices,
    const VirtualGeometryBuildConfig& config, uint32_t materialId)
{
    VirtualGeometryBuildResult result;
    if (!ValidateVirtualGeometryConfig(config, result.Error))
    {
        return result;
    }
    auto start = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
    try
    {
        auto& asset = result.Asset;
        asset.Config = config;
        asset.SourceMaterialId = materialId;
        asset.Stats.SourceVertices = vertices.size();
        asset.Stats.SourceTriangles = indices.size() / 3;
        asset.Stats.SourceMemoryBytes = vertices.size_bytes() + indices.size_bytes();
        auto clean = VirtualGeometryInternal::CleanSource(vertices, indices, asset.Stats);
        auto leaves = VirtualGeometryInternal::AppendClusters(asset, vertices, clean, 0, 0);
        asset.Stats.LeafClusters = VirtualGeometryInternal::CheckedIndex(leaves.size());
        // Release source-sized temporary indices before hierarchy group temporaries.
        std::vector<uint32_t>().swap(clean);
        VirtualGeometryInternal::BuildHierarchy(asset, std::move(leaves));
        VirtualGeometryInternal::UpdateStatistics(asset);
        if (!VirtualGeometryValidator::Validate(asset, result.Error))
        {
            result.Asset = {};
            return result;
        }
        asset.Stats.BuildMilliseconds = std::chrono::duration<double, std::milli>(
            std::chrono::steady_clock::now() - start).count();
    }
    catch (const std::exception& exception)
    {
        result.Asset = {};
        result.Error = exception.what();
    }
    return result;
}

void VirtualGeometryInternal::UpdateStatistics(VirtualGeometryAsset& asset)
{
    auto& stats = asset.Stats;
    stats.TotalClusters = CheckedIndex(asset.Clusters.size());
    stats.TotalGroups = CheckedIndex(asset.Groups.size());
    asset.Levels.clear();
    uint64_t triangles = 0;
    uint64_t vertices = 0;
    for (const auto& cluster : asset.Clusters)
    {
        if (asset.Levels.size() <= cluster.Level)
        {
            asset.Levels.resize(size_t(cluster.Level) + 1);
        }
        auto& level = asset.Levels[cluster.Level];
        ++level.Clusters;
        level.Triangles += cluster.TriangleCount;
        level.Vertices += cluster.VertexCount;
        triangles += cluster.TriangleCount;
        vertices += cluster.VertexCount;
        stats.MaximumTrianglesPerCluster = std::max(stats.MaximumTrianglesPerCluster, cluster.TriangleCount);
        stats.MaximumVerticesPerCluster = std::max(stats.MaximumVerticesPerCluster, cluster.VertexCount);
    }
    stats.HierarchyLevels = CheckedIndex(asset.Levels.size());
    stats.AverageTrianglesPerCluster = double(triangles) / stats.TotalClusters;
    stats.AverageVerticesPerCluster = double(vertices) / stats.TotalClusters;
    stats.RawMemoryBytes = uint64_t(asset.Vertices.size()) * sizeof(VirtualGeometryVertex) +
        asset.TriangleIndices.size() + uint64_t(asset.Clusters.size()) * sizeof(VirtualGeometryCluster) +
        uint64_t(asset.Groups.size()) * sizeof(VirtualGeometryClusterGroup) +
        uint64_t(asset.HierarchyIndices.size() + asset.RootClusters.size()) * sizeof(uint32_t) +
        uint64_t(asset.Levels.size()) * sizeof(VirtualGeometryLevelStats);
}

===== FILE: virtualgeometry\virtualgeometrycompression.cpp =====
#include "virtualgeometrycompression.h"
#include "virtualgeometryserializationinternal.h"
#include <algorithm>
#include <bit>
#include <cmath>
#include <limits>
#include <stdexcept>

namespace VirtualGeometryCompression
{
namespace
{
using VirtualGeometrySerialization::Writer;
using Vec3 = std::array<float, 3>;
std::string AttributeName(uint32_t semantic)
{
    switch (semantic)
    {
    case Position: return "Position";
    case Normal: return "Normal";
    case Tangent: return "Tangent";
    case Color: return "Color";
    default: return "UV" + std::to_string(semantic - Texcoord0);
    }
}
uint32_t Read(std::span<const uint8_t> bytes, size_t offset, uint32_t width = 4)
{
    if (offset > bytes.size() || width > bytes.size() - offset)
    {
        throw std::runtime_error("Compressed geometry offset out of range");
    }
    uint32_t value = 0;
    for (uint32_t byte = 0; byte < width; ++byte)
    {
        value |= uint32_t(bytes[offset + byte]) << (8 * byte);
    }
    return value;
}
float ReadFloat(std::span<const uint8_t> bytes, size_t offset)
{
    return std::bit_cast<float>(Read(bytes, offset));
}
void Put(std::vector<uint8_t>& bytes, size_t offset, uint32_t value, uint32_t width = 4)
{
    if (offset > bytes.size() || width > bytes.size() - offset)
    {
        throw std::runtime_error("Compressed geometry write out of range");
    }
    for (uint32_t byte = 0; byte < width; ++byte)
    {
        bytes[offset + byte] = uint8_t(value >> (8 * byte));
    }
}
float Sign(float value)
{
    if (value < 0)
    {
        return -1;
    }
    return 1;
}
Vec3 Normalize(Vec3 value)
{
    double length = std::sqrt(double(value[0])*value[0] + double(value[1])*value[1] + double(value[2])*value[2]);
    if (!std::isfinite(length) || length <= 1e-30)
    {
        return {0, 1, 0};
    }
    for (auto& component : value)
    {
        component = float(component / length);
    }
    return value;
}
float Angle(Vec3 first, Vec3 second)
{
    first = Normalize(first);
    second = Normalize(second);
    // Chord length avoids acos losing precision close to parallel vectors.
    double squared = 0;
    for (uint32_t axis = 0; axis < 3; ++axis)
    {
        double delta = double(first[axis]) - second[axis];
        squared += delta * delta;
    }
    return float(2 * std::asin(std::min(1.0, std::sqrt(squared) * 0.5)));
}
uint32_t PackOct(Vec3 normal)
{
    normal = Normalize(normal);
    float inverse = 1 / (std::abs(normal[0]) + std::abs(normal[1]) + std::abs(normal[2]));
    float x = normal[0] * inverse;
    float y = normal[1] * inverse;
    if (normal[2] < 0)
    {
        float oldX = x;
        x = (1 - std::abs(y)) * Sign(oldX);
        y = (1 - std::abs(oldX)) * Sign(y);
    }
    uint16_t packedX = uint16_t(int16_t(std::lround(std::clamp(x, -1.0f, 1.0f) * 32767)));
    uint16_t packedY = uint16_t(int16_t(std::lround(std::clamp(y, -1.0f, 1.0f) * 32767)));
    return uint32_t(packedX) | (uint32_t(packedY) << 16);
}
int32_t Signed(uint32_t value, uint32_t bits)
{
    uint32_t signBit = 1u << (bits - 1);
    return int32_t(value & (signBit - 1)) - int32_t(value & signBit);
}
Vec3 UnpackOct(uint32_t packed)
{
    float x = std::max(-1.0f, float(Signed(packed & 65535, 16)) / 32767);
    float y = std::max(-1.0f, float(Signed(packed >> 16, 16)) / 32767);
    float z = 1 - std::abs(x) - std::abs(y);
    if (z < 0)
    {
        float oldX = x;
        x = (1 - std::abs(y)) * Sign(oldX);
        y = (1 - std::abs(oldX)) * Sign(y);
    }
    return Normalize({x, y, z});
}
uint32_t PackTangent(const std::array<float, 4>& tangent)
{
    Vec3 direction = Normalize({tangent[0], tangent[1], tangent[2]});
    uint32_t packed = 1u << 30;
    if (tangent[3] < 0)
    {
        packed = 3u << 30;
    }
    for (uint32_t axis = 0; axis < 3; ++axis)
    {
        packed |= (uint32_t(int32_t(std::lround(direction[axis] * 511))) & 1023) << (axis * 10);
    }
    return packed;
}
Vec3 UnpackTangent(uint32_t packed)
{
    return Normalize({float(Signed(packed & 1023, 10)) / 511,
        float(Signed((packed >> 10) & 1023, 10)) / 511,
        float(Signed((packed >> 20) & 1023, 10)) / 511});
}
Vec3 Orthogonalize(Vec3 tangent, Vec3 normal)
{
    normal = Normalize(normal);
    float dot = tangent[0]*normal[0] + tangent[1]*normal[1] + tangent[2]*normal[2];
    for (uint32_t axis = 0; axis < 3; ++axis)
    {
        tangent[axis] -= dot * normal[axis];
    }
    if (std::abs(tangent[0]) + std::abs(tangent[1]) + std::abs(tangent[2]) < 1e-6f)
    {
        Vec3 helper{0, 0, 1};
        if (std::abs(normal[2]) > 0.9f)
        {
            helper = {0, 1, 0};
        }
        tangent = {helper[1]*normal[2]-helper[2]*normal[1],
            helper[2]*normal[0]-helper[0]*normal[2], helper[0]*normal[1]-helper[1]*normal[0]};
    }
    return Normalize(tangent);
}
// IEEE binary16, round to nearest even. Shared wire representation with HLSL f16tof32.
uint16_t ToHalf(float value)
{
    uint32_t bits = std::bit_cast<uint32_t>(value);
    uint32_t sign = (bits >> 16) & 0x8000;
    int32_t exponent = int32_t((bits >> 23) & 255) - 127 + 15;
    uint32_t mantissa = bits & 0x7fffff;
    if (exponent >= 31)
    {
        return uint16_t(sign | 0x7c00);
    }
    if (exponent <= 0)
    {
        if (exponent < -10)
        {
            return uint16_t(sign);
        }
        mantissa |= 0x800000;
        uint32_t shift = uint32_t(14 - exponent);
        uint32_t rounded = (mantissa + ((1u << (shift - 1)) - 1) + ((mantissa >> shift) & 1)) >> shift;
        return uint16_t(sign | rounded);
    }
    uint32_t rounded = mantissa + 0xfff + ((mantissa >> 13) & 1);
    return uint16_t(sign | ((uint32_t(exponent) << 10) + (rounded >> 13)));
}
float FromHalf(uint16_t value)
{
    uint32_t sign = uint32_t(value & 0x8000) << 16;
    uint32_t exponent = (value >> 10) & 31;
    uint32_t mantissa = value & 1023;
    if (!exponent)
    {
        float result = std::ldexp(float(mantissa), -24);
        if (sign)
        {
            result = -result;
        }
        return result;
    }
    if (exponent == 31)
    {
        return std::bit_cast<float>(sign | 0x7f800000 | (mantissa << 13));
    }
    return std::bit_cast<float>(sign | ((exponent + 112) << 23) | (mantissa << 13));
}
uint32_t Components(uint32_t semantic)
{
    if (semantic >= Texcoord0)
    {
        return 2;
    }
    if (semantic == Tangent || semantic == Color)
    {
        return 4;
    }
    return 3;
}
uint32_t Stride(const Stream& stream)
{
    if (stream.Encoding == Codec::Float32)
    {
        return Components(stream.Attribute) * 4;
    }
    if (stream.Encoding == Codec::UNorm16x3)
    {
        return 6;
    }
    return 4;
}
std::array<float, 4> Attribute(const Input& input, uint32_t index, uint32_t semantic)
{
    if (index >= input.Vertices.size())
    {
        throw std::runtime_error("Compression vertex stream index out of range");
    }
    const auto& vertex = input.Vertices[index];
    if (semantic == Position)
    {
        return {vertex.Position[0], vertex.Position[1], vertex.Position[2], 0};
    }
    if (semantic == Normal)
    {
        return {vertex.Normal[0], vertex.Normal[1], vertex.Normal[2], 0};
    }
    if (semantic == Tangent)
    {
        if (index >= input.Tangents.size())
        {
            throw std::runtime_error("Compression tangent stream index out of range");
        }
        return input.Tangents[index];
    }
    if (semantic == Color)
    {
        return {vertex.Diffuse[0], vertex.Diffuse[1], vertex.Diffuse[2], vertex.Diffuse[3]};
    }
    if (input.Texcoords.empty())
    {
        return {vertex.TexCoord[0], vertex.TexCoord[1], 0, 0};
    }
    auto stream = input.Texcoords.at(semantic - Texcoord0);
    if (index >= stream.size())
    {
        throw std::runtime_error("Compression UV stream index out of range");
    }
    const auto& uv = stream[index];
    return {uv[0], uv[1], 0, 0};
}
uint16_t Quantize(float value, float origin, float step)
{
    if (step == 0)
    {
        return 0;
    }
    return uint16_t(std::round(std::clamp((double(value) - origin) / step, 0.0, 65535.0)));
}
float DecodePosition(float origin, float step, uint32_t quantized)
{
    // GPU uses precise multiply/add, preventing an FMA-specific CPU/GPU boundary difference.
    volatile float delta = float(quantized) * step;
    return origin + delta;
}
void EncodeAttribute(std::vector<uint8_t>& bytes, uint32_t address, const Stream& stream,
    const std::array<float, 4>& value, const Plan& plan)
{
    switch (stream.Encoding)
    {
    case Codec::Float32:
        for (uint32_t component = 0; component < Components(stream.Attribute); ++component)
        {
            Put(bytes, address + component*4, std::bit_cast<uint32_t>(value[component]));
        }
        break;
    case Codec::UNorm16x3:
        for (uint32_t axis = 0; axis < 3; ++axis)
        {
            Put(bytes, address + axis*2, Quantize(value[axis], plan.Origin[axis], plan.Step[axis]), 2);
        }
        break;
    case Codec::OctSnorm16x2:
        Put(bytes, address, PackOct({value[0], value[1], value[2]}));
        break;
    case Codec::Snorm1010102:
        Put(bytes, address, PackTangent(value));
        break;
    case Codec::Float16x2:
        Put(bytes, address, uint32_t(ToHalf(value[0])) | (uint32_t(ToHalf(value[1])) << 16));
        break;
    case Codec::UNorm8x4:
        for (uint32_t component = 0; component < 4; ++component)
        {
            Put(bytes, address + component, uint32_t(std::lround(std::clamp(value[component], 0.0f, 1.0f)*255)), 1);
        }
        break;
    }
}
}

IndexCodec SelectIndexCodec(uint32_t vertexCount, bool allow8)
{
    if (vertexCount == 0 || vertexCount > 65536)
    {
        throw std::runtime_error("Index codec vertex count out of range");
    }
    if (allow8 && vertexCount <= 256)
    {
        return IndexCodec::UInt8;
    }
    return IndexCodec::UInt16;
}

uint64_t SettingsKey(const VGCompressionSettings& settings)
{
    Writer writer;
    writer.U32(CompressionVersion); // Bump when rounding or stream packing changes.
    writer.F32(settings.MaxPositionError);
    writer.F32(settings.MaxNormalAngularError);
    writer.F32(settings.MaxTangentAngularError);
    writer.F32(settings.MaxTexcoordError);
    writer.U32(uint32_t(settings.Enabled));
    writer.U32(uint32_t(settings.AllowPositionQuantization));
    writer.U32(uint32_t(settings.AllowNormalCompression));
    writer.U32(uint32_t(settings.AllowTangentCompression));
    writer.U32(uint32_t(settings.AllowHalfTexcoord));
    writer.U32(uint32_t(settings.AllowIndex8));
    uint64_t hash = 14695981039346656037ull;
    for (uint8_t byte : writer.Bytes)
    {
        hash ^= byte;
        hash *= 1099511628211ull;
    }
    return hash;
}

bool Select(const Input& input, const VGCompressionSettings& settings, Plan& output, std::string& error)
{
    try
    {
        if (input.Vertices.empty() || input.Vertices.size() > UINT32_MAX || input.Texcoords.size() > 24 ||
            (!input.Tangents.empty() && input.Tangents.size() != input.Vertices.size()))
        {
            throw std::runtime_error("Invalid compression input streams");
        }
        for (auto stream : input.Texcoords)
        {
            if (stream.size() != input.Vertices.size())
            {
                throw std::runtime_error("UV stream vertex count mismatch");
            }
        }
        for (float threshold : {settings.MaxPositionError, settings.MaxNormalAngularError,
            settings.MaxTangentAngularError, settings.MaxTexcoordError})
        {
            if (!std::isfinite(threshold) || threshold < 0)
            {
                throw std::runtime_error("Invalid compression error threshold");
            }
        }
        Plan plan;
        plan.Settings = settings;
        plan.Streams.push_back({Position, Codec::Float32});
        if (input.HasNormal)
        {
            plan.Streams.push_back({Normal, Codec::Float32});
        }
        if (!input.Tangents.empty())
        {
            plan.Streams.push_back({Tangent, Codec::Float32});
        }
        if (input.HasColor)
        {
            plan.Streams.push_back({Color, Codec::UNorm8x4});
        }
        uint32_t uvCount = 0;
        if (input.HasTexcoord)
        {
            uvCount = std::max(1u, uint32_t(input.Texcoords.size()));
        }
        for (uint32_t channel = 0; channel < uvCount; ++channel)
        {
            plan.Streams.push_back({Texcoord0 + channel, Codec::Float32});
        }
        Vec3 maximum{};
        for (uint32_t axis = 0; axis < 3; ++axis)
        {
            plan.Origin[axis] = input.Vertices.front().Position[axis];
            maximum[axis] = plan.Origin[axis];
        }
        for (uint32_t index = 0; index < input.Vertices.size(); ++index)
        {
            for (const auto& stream : plan.Streams)
            {
                auto value = Attribute(input, index, stream.Attribute);
                for (uint32_t component = 0; component < Components(stream.Attribute); ++component)
                {
                    if (!std::isfinite(value[component]))
                    {
                        throw std::runtime_error("Nonfinite " + AttributeName(stream.Attribute) + " at vertex " + std::to_string(index));
                    }
                }
            }
            for (uint32_t axis = 0; axis < 3; ++axis)
            {
                plan.Origin[axis] = std::min(plan.Origin[axis], input.Vertices[index].Position[axis]);
                maximum[axis] = std::max(maximum[axis], input.Vertices[index].Position[axis]);
            }
        }
        bool validGrid = true;
        for (uint32_t axis = 0; axis < 3; ++axis)
        {
            plan.Step[axis] = float((double(maximum[axis]) - plan.Origin[axis]) / 65535.0);
            double endpoint = double(plan.Origin[axis]) + double(plan.Step[axis])*65535;
            validGrid &= std::isfinite(plan.Step[axis]) && std::abs(endpoint) <= std::numeric_limits<float>::max() &&
                double(plan.Step[axis])*65535 <= std::numeric_limits<float>::max();
        }
        for (auto& stream : plan.Streams)
        {
            bool candidate = false;
            if (stream.Attribute == Position)
            {
                candidate = settings.AllowPositionQuantization;
                stream.Encoding = Codec::UNorm16x3;
            }
            else if (stream.Attribute == Normal)
            {
                candidate = settings.AllowNormalCompression;
                stream.Encoding = Codec::OctSnorm16x2;
            }
            else if (stream.Attribute == Tangent)
            {
                candidate = settings.AllowTangentCompression;
                stream.Encoding = Codec::Snorm1010102;
            }
            else if (stream.Attribute >= Texcoord0)
            {
                candidate = settings.AllowHalfTexcoord;
                stream.Encoding = Codec::Float16x2;
            }
            else
            {
                // Preserve HDR/out-of-range colors through a full precision fallback.
                candidate = true;
            }
            if (!candidate)
            {
                stream.Encoding = Codec::Float32;
                continue;
            }
            bool accurate = true;
            for (uint32_t index = 0; index < input.Vertices.size(); ++index)
            {
                auto value = Attribute(input, index, stream.Attribute);
                if (stream.Attribute == Position)
                {
                    double squared = 0;
                    for (uint32_t axis = 0; axis < 3; ++axis)
                    {
                        float decoded = DecodePosition(plan.Origin[axis], plan.Step[axis],
                            Quantize(value[axis], plan.Origin[axis], plan.Step[axis]));
                        double delta = double(value[axis]) - decoded;
                        squared += delta*delta;
                    }
                    float distance = float(std::sqrt(squared));
                    plan.PositionError = std::max(plan.PositionError, distance);
                    accurate &= validGrid && std::isfinite(distance) && distance <= settings.MaxPositionError;
                }
                else if (stream.Attribute == Normal)
                {
                    accurate &= Angle({value[0], value[1], value[2]}, UnpackOct(PackOct({value[0], value[1], value[2]}))) <= settings.MaxNormalAngularError;
                }
                else if (stream.Attribute == Tangent)
                {
                    auto sourceNormal = Attribute(input, index, Normal);
                    Vec3 normal{sourceNormal[0], sourceNormal[1], sourceNormal[2]};
                    if (!input.HasNormal)
                    {
                        normal = {0, 1, 0};
                    }
                    Vec3 decodedNormal = normal;
                    for (const auto& normalStream : plan.Streams)
                    {
                        if (normalStream.Attribute == Normal && normalStream.Encoding == Codec::OctSnorm16x2)
                        {
                            decodedNormal = UnpackOct(PackOct(normal));
                        }
                    }
                    accurate &= Angle(Orthogonalize({value[0], value[1], value[2]}, normal),
                        Orthogonalize(UnpackTangent(PackTangent(value)), decodedNormal)) <= settings.MaxTangentAngularError;
                }
                else if (stream.Attribute >= Texcoord0)
                {
                    double squared = 0;
                    for (uint32_t component = 0; component < 2; ++component)
                    {
                        float decoded = FromHalf(ToHalf(value[component]));
                        double delta = double(value[component]) - decoded;
                        squared += delta*delta;
                        accurate &= std::abs(value[component]) <= 65504 && std::isfinite(decoded);
                    }
                    accurate &= std::sqrt(squared) <= settings.MaxTexcoordError;
                }
                else
                {
                    for (float component : value)
                    {
                        accurate &= component >= 0 && component <= 1;
                    }
                }
            }
            if (!accurate)
            {
                stream.Encoding = Codec::Float32;
                plan.FallbackReasons.push_back(AttributeName(stream.Attribute) + ": codec error/range exceeded; Float32 fallback");
            }
        }
        Stream* normalStream = nullptr;
        Stream* tangentStream = nullptr;
        for (auto& stream : plan.Streams)
        {
            if (stream.Attribute == Normal)
            {
                normalStream = &stream;
            }
            if (stream.Attribute == Tangent)
            {
                tangentStream = &stream;
            }
        }
        // A full precision tangent can still lose angular accuracy when projected onto a packed normal.
        if (normalStream && tangentStream && normalStream->Encoding == Codec::OctSnorm16x2 && tangentStream->Encoding == Codec::Float32)
        {
            bool accurate = true;
            for (uint32_t index = 0; index < input.Vertices.size(); ++index)
            {
                auto sourceNormal = Attribute(input, index, Normal);
                auto sourceTangent = Attribute(input, index, Tangent);
                Vec3 normal{sourceNormal[0], sourceNormal[1], sourceNormal[2]};
                Vec3 tangent{sourceTangent[0], sourceTangent[1], sourceTangent[2]};
                accurate &= Angle(Orthogonalize(tangent, normal), Orthogonalize(tangent, UnpackOct(PackOct(normal)))) <= settings.MaxTangentAngularError;
            }
            if (!accurate)
            {
                normalStream->Encoding = Codec::Float32;
                plan.FallbackReasons.push_back("Normal: Float32 fallback to preserve tangent angular accuracy");
            }
        }
        if (plan.Streams.front().Encoding == Codec::Float32)
        {
            plan.PositionError = 0;
            plan.Step = {};
        }
        output = std::move(plan);
        error.clear();
        return true;
    }
    catch (const std::exception& exception)
    {
        error = exception.what();
        return false;
    }
}

bool EncodeCluster(const Input& input, const Plan& plan, uint32_t firstVertex, uint32_t vertexCount,
    std::span<const uint32_t> indices, std::vector<uint8_t>& output, std::string& error)
{
    try
    {
        if (firstVertex > input.Vertices.size() || vertexCount > input.Vertices.size() - firstVertex ||
            indices.empty() || indices.size() % 3 || plan.Streams.empty() || plan.Streams.size() > 28)
        {
            throw std::runtime_error("Invalid compressed cluster input range");
        }
        uint32_t width = uint32_t(SelectIndexCodec(vertexCount, plan.Settings.AllowIndex8));
        Writer header;
        header.U32(PayloadMagic);
        header.U32(0); // Total payload bytes, patched after packing.
        header.U32(vertexCount);
        header.U32(uint32_t(indices.size() / 3));
        uint32_t mask = 0;
        for (const auto& stream : plan.Streams)
        {
            mask |= 1u << stream.Attribute;
        }
        header.U32(mask);
        header.U32(width);
        header.U32(0); // Index offset.
        header.U32(uint32_t(plan.Streams.size()));
        header.Float3(plan.Origin);
        header.Float3(plan.Step);
        uint32_t offset = HeaderBytes + uint32_t(plan.Streams.size())*16;
        for (const auto& stream : plan.Streams)
        {
            header.U32(stream.Attribute);
            header.U32(uint32_t(stream.Encoding));
            header.U32(offset);
            header.U32(Stride(stream));
            offset = (offset + Stride(stream)*vertexCount + 3) & ~3u;
        }
        uint32_t indexOffset = offset;
        uint64_t total = (uint64_t(offset) + uint64_t(indices.size())*width + 3) & ~uint64_t(3);
        if (total > VirtualGeometryConfig::GeometryPageBytes)
        {
            throw std::runtime_error("Compressed cluster exceeds existing Streaming Page size");
        }
        auto bytes = std::move(header.Bytes);
        bytes.resize(size_t(total), 0);
        Put(bytes, 4, uint32_t(total));
        Put(bytes, 24, indexOffset);
        for (uint32_t streamIndex = 0; streamIndex < plan.Streams.size(); ++streamIndex)
        {
            const auto& stream = plan.Streams[streamIndex];
            uint32_t start = Read(bytes, HeaderBytes + streamIndex*16 + 8);
            for (uint32_t vertex = 0; vertex < vertexCount; ++vertex)
            {
                EncodeAttribute(bytes, start + vertex*Stride(stream), stream, Attribute(input, firstVertex + vertex, stream.Attribute), plan);
            }
        }
        for (size_t index = 0; index < indices.size(); ++index)
        {
            if (indices[index] >= vertexCount)
            {
                throw std::runtime_error("Compressed cluster index exceeds VertexCount");
            }
            Put(bytes, indexOffset + index*width, indices[index], width);
        }
        if (!Validate(bytes, vertexCount, uint32_t(indices.size()/3), error))
        {
            return false;
        }
        // Asset-build-only reference validation. Runtime uploads the bytes unchanged.
        for (uint32_t index = 0; index < vertexCount; ++index)
        {
            auto decoded = DecodeVertexCPU(bytes, index);
            const auto& source = input.Vertices[firstVertex + index];
            double squared = 0;
            for (uint32_t axis = 0; axis < 3; ++axis)
            {
                double delta = double(decoded.Position[axis]) - source.Position[axis];
                squared += delta*delta;
            }
            if (!std::isfinite(squared) || std::sqrt(squared) > plan.Settings.MaxPositionError)
            {
                throw std::runtime_error("Position reference decode exceeds error threshold");
            }
        }
        output = std::move(bytes);
        error.clear();
        return true;
    }
    catch (const std::exception& exception)
    {
        error = exception.what();
        return false;
    }
}

bool Validate(std::span<const uint8_t> bytes, uint32_t vertices, uint32_t triangles, std::string& error)
{
    try
    {
        if (bytes.size() < HeaderBytes || bytes.size() > VirtualGeometryConfig::GeometryPageBytes || bytes.size() % 4 ||
            Read(bytes, 0) != PayloadMagic || Read(bytes, 4) != bytes.size() || Read(bytes, 8) != vertices ||
            !vertices || vertices > 65536 || !triangles || Read(bytes, 12) != triangles)
        {
            throw std::runtime_error("Invalid compressed cluster header/count/size");
        }
        uint32_t width = Read(bytes, 20);
        uint32_t count = Read(bytes, 28);
        uint32_t indexOffset = Read(bytes, 24);
        if ((width != 1 && width != 2) || (width == 1 && vertices > 256) || !count || count > 28 ||
            HeaderBytes + uint64_t(count)*16 > bytes.size())
        {
            throw std::runtime_error("Invalid compressed stream/index directory");
        }
        for (uint32_t axis = 0; axis < 3; ++axis)
        {
            float origin = ReadFloat(bytes, 32 + axis*4);
            float step = ReadFloat(bytes, 44 + axis*4);
            double end = double(origin) + double(step)*65535;
            if (!std::isfinite(origin) || !std::isfinite(step) || step < 0 ||
                end > std::numeric_limits<float>::max() || end < -std::numeric_limits<float>::max() ||
                double(step)*65535 > std::numeric_limits<float>::max())
            {
                throw std::runtime_error("Invalid global quantization grid");
            }
        }
        uint64_t end = HeaderBytes + count*16;
        uint32_t mask = 0;
        uint32_t previous = 0;
        for (uint32_t index = 0; index < count; ++index)
        {
            uint32_t descriptor = HeaderBytes + index*16;
            uint32_t semantic = Read(bytes, descriptor);
            Codec codec = Codec(Read(bytes, descriptor + 4));
            uint32_t offset = Read(bytes, descriptor + 8);
            uint32_t stride = Read(bytes, descriptor + 12);
            bool supported = codec == Codec::Float32 || (semantic == Position && codec == Codec::UNorm16x3) ||
                (semantic == Normal && codec == Codec::OctSnorm16x2) || (semantic == Tangent && codec == Codec::Snorm1010102) ||
                (semantic == Color && codec == Codec::UNorm8x4) || (semantic >= Texcoord0 && codec == Codec::Float16x2);
            if (semantic >= 32 || (semantic > Color && semantic < Texcoord0) ||
                (!index && semantic != Position) || (index && semantic <= previous) || !supported ||
                stride != Stride({semantic, codec}) || offset != end || offset % 4)
            {
                throw std::runtime_error("Invalid compressed attribute descriptor");
            }
            previous = semantic;
            mask |= 1u << semantic;
            end = (uint64_t(offset) + uint64_t(vertices)*stride + 3) & ~uint64_t(3);
            if (end > bytes.size())
            {
                throw std::runtime_error("Compressed attribute outside Page payload");
            }
            if (codec == Codec::Float32)
            {
                for (uint32_t vertex = 0; vertex < vertices; ++vertex)
                {
                    for (uint32_t component = 0; component < Components(semantic); ++component)
                    {
                        if (!std::isfinite(ReadFloat(bytes, offset + vertex*stride + component*4)))
                        {
                            throw std::runtime_error("Nonfinite compressed Float32 attribute");
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            if (codec == Codec::Float16x2)
            {
                for (uint32_t vertex = 0; vertex < vertices; ++vertex)
                {
                    uint32_t packed = Read(bytes, offset + vertex*stride);
                    if ((packed & 0x7c00) == 0x7c00 || (packed & 0x7c000000) == 0x7c000000)
                    {
                        throw std::runtime_error("Nonfinite compressed half UV");
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        uint64_t expectedEnd = (end + uint64_t(triangles)*3*width + 3) & ~uint64_t(3);
        if (mask != Read(bytes, 16) || indexOffset != end || expectedEnd != bytes.size())
        {
            throw std::runtime_error("Invalid compressed index range/attribute mask");
        }
        for (uint64_t index = 0; index < uint64_t(triangles)*3; ++index)
        {
            if (Read(bytes, indexOffset + size_t(index)*width, width) >= vertices)
            {
                throw std::runtime_error("Compressed triangle index out of range");
            }
        }
        error.clear();
        return true;
    }
    catch (const std::exception& exception)
    {
        error = exception.what();
        return false;
    }
}

DecodedVertex DecodeVertexCPU(std::span<const uint8_t> bytes, uint32_t vertexIndex)
{
    if (vertexIndex >= Read(bytes, 8))
    {
        throw std::runtime_error("Compressed vertex index out of range");
    }
    DecodedVertex result;
    uint32_t count = Read(bytes, 28);
    if (count > 28)
    {
        throw std::runtime_error("Compressed stream count out of range");
    }
    for (uint32_t index = 0; index < count; ++index)
    {
        uint32_t descriptor = HeaderBytes + index*16;
        uint32_t semantic = Read(bytes, descriptor);
        Codec codec = Codec(Read(bytes, descriptor + 4));
        size_t address = Read(bytes, descriptor + 8) + size_t(vertexIndex)*Read(bytes, descriptor + 12);
        std::array<float, 4> value{};
        if (codec == Codec::Float32)
        {
            for (uint32_t component = 0; component < Components(semantic); ++component)
            {
                value[component] = ReadFloat(bytes, address + component*4);
            }
        }
        else if (codec == Codec::UNorm16x3)
        {
            for (uint32_t axis = 0; axis < 3; ++axis)
            {
                value[axis] = DecodePosition(ReadFloat(bytes, 32 + axis*4), ReadFloat(bytes, 44 + axis*4), Read(bytes, address + axis*2, 2));
            }
        }
        else if (codec == Codec::OctSnorm16x2)
        {
            auto normal = UnpackOct(Read(bytes, address));
            std::copy(normal.begin(), normal.end(), value.begin());
        }
        else if (codec == Codec::Snorm1010102)
        {
            uint32_t packed = Read(bytes, address);
            auto tangent = UnpackTangent(packed);
            std::copy(tangent.begin(), tangent.end(), value.begin());
            value[3] = 1;
            if ((packed >> 30) == 3)
            {
                value[3] = -1;
            }
        }
        else if (codec == Codec::Float16x2)
        {
            uint32_t packed = Read(bytes, address);
            value[0] = FromHalf(uint16_t(packed));
            value[1] = FromHalf(uint16_t(packed >> 16));
        }
        else if (codec == Codec::UNorm8x4)
        {
            for (uint32_t component = 0; component < 4; ++component)
            {
                value[component] = float(Read(bytes, address + component, 1)) / 255;
            }
        }
        else
        {
            throw std::runtime_error("Unsupported geometry codec");
        }
        if (semantic == Position)
        {
            result.Position = {value[0], value[1], value[2]};
        }
        else if (semantic == Normal)
        {
            result.Normal = Normalize({value[0], value[1], value[2]});
        }
        else if (semantic == Tangent)
        {
            result.Tangent = value;
        }
        else if (semantic == Color)
        {
            result.Color = value;
        }
        else if (semantic >= Texcoord0 && semantic < 32)
        {
            result.Texcoords.resize(std::max(result.Texcoords.size(), size_t(semantic - Texcoord0 + 1)));
            result.Texcoords[semantic - Texcoord0] = {value[0], value[1]};
        }
    }
    auto tangent = Orthogonalize({result.Tangent[0], result.Tangent[1], result.Tangent[2]}, result.Normal);
    std::copy(tangent.begin(), tangent.end(), result.Tangent.begin());
    return result;
}

std::array<uint32_t, 3> LoadTriangleCPU(std::span<const uint8_t> bytes, uint32_t triangleIndex)
{
    if (triangleIndex >= Read(bytes, 12))
    {
        throw std::runtime_error("Compressed triangle index out of range");
    }
    uint32_t width = Read(bytes, 20);
    if (width != 1 && width != 2)
    {
        throw std::runtime_error("Unsupported index codec");
    }
    size_t address = Read(bytes, 24) + size_t(triangleIndex)*3*width;
    std::array<uint32_t, 3> result{Read(bytes, address, width), Read(bytes, address + width, width), Read(bytes, address + width*2, width)};
    for (uint32_t index : result)
    {
        if (index >= Read(bytes, 8))
        {
            throw std::runtime_error("Decoded triangle index exceeds VertexCount");
        }
    }
    return result;
}
}

#pragma once

// All angles are radians and all position errors are in object-space units.
struct VGCompressionSettings
{
    bool Enabled = true; // False selects the Phase 9 raw Page layout for controlled A/B captures.
    float MaxPositionError = 0.001f;
    float MaxNormalAngularError = 0.001f;
    float MaxTangentAngularError = 0.005f;
    float MaxTexcoordError = 0.0005f;
    bool AllowPositionQuantization = true;
    bool AllowNormalCompression = true;
    bool AllowTangentCompression = true;
    bool AllowHalfTexcoord = true;
    bool AllowIndex8 = true;
};

namespace VirtualGeometryCompression
{
inline constexpr uint32_t CompressionVersion = 1;
inline constexpr uint32_t ClusterFlag = 0x10000;
inline constexpr uint32_t PayloadMagic = 0x31434756; // VGC1
inline constexpr uint32_t HeaderBytes = 56;
enum class Codec : uint32_t { Float32, UNorm16x3, OctSnorm16x2, Snorm1010102, Float16x2, UNorm8x4 };
enum Semantic : uint32_t { Position = 0, Normal = 1, Tangent = 2, Color = 3, Texcoord0 = 8 };
enum class IndexCodec : uint32_t { UInt8 = 1, UInt16 = 2 };

struct Input
{
    std::span<const VirtualGeometryVertex> Vertices;
    std::span<const std::array<float, 4>> Tangents;
    // Empty means use the legacy vertex's UV0; otherwise one span per UV channel.
    std::vector<std::span<const std::array<float, 2>>> Texcoords;
    bool HasNormal = true;
    bool HasTexcoord = true;
    bool HasColor = true;
};
struct Stream
{
    uint32_t Attribute = Position;
    Codec Encoding = Codec::Float32;
};
struct Plan
{
    std::array<float, 3> Origin{};
    std::array<float, 3> Step{};
    std::vector<Stream> Streams;
    std::vector<std::string> FallbackReasons;
    VGCompressionSettings Settings;
    float PositionError = 0;
};
struct DecodedVertex
{
    std::array<float, 3> Position{};
    std::array<float, 3> Normal{0, 1, 0};
    std::array<float, 4> Tangent{1, 0, 0, 1};
    std::array<float, 4> Color{1, 1, 1, 1};
    std::vector<std::array<float, 2>> Texcoords;
};
struct Metrics
{
    uint64_t EncodedBytes = 0;
    uint64_t RawBytes = 0;
    uint64_t FallbackCount = 0;
    uint64_t PositionQuantized = 0;
    uint64_t HalfUV = 0;
    uint64_t Index8Clusters = 0;
    uint64_t Index16Clusters = 0;
};

VGStatistics GetVGStatistics()
{
    VGStatistics result;
    result.RegisteredAssets = VirtualGeometryResources::AssetCount();
    result.RegisteredClusters = VirtualGeometryResources::RegisteredClusterCount();
    const auto& streaming = VirtualGeometryStreaming::GetStatistics();
    result.ResidentPages = streaming.Resident;
    result.RequestedPages = streaming.Requested;
    result.Evictions = streaming.Evictions;
    result.ResidentAllocationBytes = streaming.PoolBytes;
    result.BudgetBytes = streaming.BudgetBytes;
    result.MetadataBytes = streaming.MetadataBytes;
    result.SubmittedBytes = streaming.SubmittedBytes;
    result.CompletedBytes = streaming.CompletedBytes;
    result.IoErrors = streaming.IoErrors;
    result.RequestOverflow = streaming.RequestOverflow;
    const auto compression = VirtualGeometryResources::CompressionMetrics();
    result.RawGeometryBytes = compression.RawBytes;
    result.EncodedGeometryBytes = compression.EncodedBytes;
    const auto& visibility = VirtualGeometryTraversal::GetTemporalStatistics();
    result.HasVisibilitySample = visibility.HasSample && VirtualGeometryTraversal::Active() &&
        MeshShaderRenderer::IsActive() && VirtualGeometryTraversal::GetSettings().Enabled &&
        GetGeometryRenderingMode() != GeometryRenderingMode::Legacy;
    result.VisibilitySampleSerial = visibility.SampleSerial;
    result.FirstVisibleClusters = visibility.FirstVisible;
    result.SecondVisibleClusters = visibility.SecondVisible;
    result.CapacityFallbacks = visibility.CapacityFallbacks;
    result.VisibleTriangles = VirtualGeometryTraversal::DebugCounters()[6];
    const auto& sourceCounts = VirtualGeometryResources::SourceTriangleCounts();
    for (const auto count : sourceCounts)
    {
        result.SourceTriangles += count;
    }
    result.SceneInstances = GpuScene::Statistics().ActiveInstances;
    const auto& overflow = GPUDrivenRenderer::GetOverflowStatistics();
    result.VisibleInstanceOverflow = overflow.VisibleInstanceOverflow;
    result.InvalidIndirectCommands = overflow.InvalidIndirectCommands;
    result.VisibleInstances = VirtualGeometryTraversal::DebugCounters()[4];
    result.HasInstanceSample = result.HasVisibilitySample;
    for (uint32_t slot = 0; slot < GpuScene::Statistics().InstanceSlots; ++slot)
    {
        const auto* instance = GpuScene::GetInstance(slot);
        if (instance && (instance->Flags&16u) && instance->VirtualGeometryAssetIndex < sourceCounts.size())
        {
            ++result.Instances;
            result.InstancedSourceTriangles += sourceCounts[instance->VirtualGeometryAssetIndex];
        }
    }
    for (const auto& phase : VirtualGeometryBinning::GetStatistics().Phases)
    {
        if (phase.HasSample)
        {
            result.MaterialBinOverflow += phase.OverflowClusters;
            result.InvalidMaterialRecords += phase.InvalidMaterials;
            result.BinningRejectedClusters += phase.RejectedClusters;
        }
    }
    return result;
}

    static VirtualGeometryDebug::Preferences options;
    return options;

vector<const StaticMeshData *> Meshes(uint32_t entity)
{
    vector<const StaticMeshData *> result;
    if (ComponentManager::HasComponent<StaticModelComponent>(entity))
    {
        auto *model = ModelManager::GetStaticModel(
            ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<StaticModelComponent>(entity).ModelId);
        if (model)
            for (UINT i = 0; i < model->GetMeshCount(); ++i)
                result.push_back(&model->GetMeshData(i));
    }
    else if (ComponentManager::HasComponent<MeshComponent>(entity))
    {
        const auto &mesh = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<MeshComponent>(entity);
        if (mesh.NaniteMesh)
            result.push_back(mesh.NaniteMesh.get());
    }
    return result;
}
const char *FallbackReason(uint32_t entity)
{
    if (ComponentManager::HasComponent<AnimationModelComponent>(entity))
        return "Skinned mesh: traditional rendering";
    if (VertexDeformation::IsRequested(entity))
        return "Vertex deformation: traditional rendering";
    if (!GPUDrivenRenderer::SupportsEntity(entity))
        return "Material, shader or background: traditional rendering";
    if (!MeshShaderRenderer::Supported())
        return "Mesh Shader hardware unavailable";
    if (!MeshShaderRenderer::IsActive())
        return "Mesh Shader path disabled or render mode incompatible";
    if (!GPUDrivenRenderer::HandlesEntity(entity))
        return "GPU geometry not ready";
    return "Automatic Nanite / leaf clusters (finest hierarchy level)";
}

void DrawAssetInspector(const std::filesystem::path& path)
{
    if (!ImGui::CollapsingHeader("Virtual Geometry", ImGuiTreeNodeFlags_DefaultOpen))
    {
        return;
    }
    static std::filesystem::path selected;
    static VGImportSettings settings;
    static std::string error;
    if (selected != path)
    {
        selected = path;
        settings = {};
        VirtualGeometryImport::Load(path, settings, error);
    }
    ImGui::PushID(path.generic_string().c_str());
    ImGui::Checkbox("Enabled", &settings.Enabled);
    ImGui::Checkbox("Build in background", &settings.BackgroundBuild);
    int quality = static_cast<int>(settings.Quality);
    if (ImGui::Combo("Build quality", &quality, "Low\0Medium\0High\0Production\0Custom\0"))
    {
        settings.Quality = static_cast<VGQuality>(quality);
    }
    ImGui::InputFloat("Position error (0 = Auto)", &settings.PositionError, 0, 0, "%.6f");
    ImGui::InputFloat("LOD error (0 = Auto)", &settings.LODError);
    int priority = static_cast<int>(settings.StreamingPriority);
    if (ImGui::Combo("Streaming priority", &priority, "Low\0Normal\0High\0"))
    {
        settings.StreamingPriority = static_cast<uint32_t>(priority);
    }
    if (settings.Quality == VGQuality::Custom)
    {
        ImGui::SliderFloat("Simplification ratio", &settings.Custom.SimplificationRatio, 0.1f, 0.9f);
        ImGui::SliderFloat("Normal weight", &settings.Custom.NormalWeight, 0, 4);
        ImGui::SliderFloat("UV weight", &settings.Custom.TexCoordWeight, 0, 4);
    }
    if (ImGui::Button("Save and rebuild"))
    {
        ModelManager::SaveVirtualGeometrySettings(path, settings, error);
    }
    ImGui::SameLine();
    if (ImGui::Button("Reload settings"))
    {
        VirtualGeometryImport::Load(path, settings, error);
    }
    auto* model = ModelManager::FindLoadedStaticModel(path);
    if (!model)
    {
        ImGui::TextUnformatted("Status: not imported in this session");
        if (ImGui::Button("Import mesh"))
        {
            const auto encoded = path.u8string();
            const std::string source(reinterpret_cast<const char*>(encoded.data()),encoded.size());
            ModelManager::LoadStaticModel(source.c_str());
        }
    }
    else
    {
        uint64_t vertices = 0, triangles = 0, clusters = 0, groups = 0;
        uint64_t rawBytes = 0, encodedBytes = 0, pages = 0, pinned = 0;
        uint32_t levels = 0;
        bool building = false;
        for (uint32_t index = 0; index < model->GetMeshCount(); ++index)
        {
            const auto& mesh = model->GetMeshData(index);
            building |= mesh.VirtualGeometryBuilds[0].valid();
            const auto& asset = mesh.VirtualGeometryLODs[0];
            if (asset && asset->Error.empty())
            {
                vertices += asset->Hierarchy.Stats.SourceVertices;
                triangles += asset->Hierarchy.Stats.SourceTriangles;
                clusters += asset->Hierarchy.Stats.TotalClusters;
                groups += asset->Hierarchy.Stats.TotalGroups;
                levels = std::max(levels, asset->Hierarchy.Stats.HierarchyLevels);
                const auto manifest = asset->Pages ? asset->Pages : VirtualGeometryResources::ManifestFor(asset.get());
                if (manifest)
                {
                    rawBytes += manifest->Compression.RawBytes;
                    encodedBytes += manifest->Compression.EncodedBytes;
                    pages += manifest->Pages.size();
                    pinned += std::count(manifest->PinnedPages.begin(),manifest->PinnedPages.end(),uint8_t(1));
                }
            }
            else
            {
                vertices += mesh.VertexCount;
                triangles += mesh.IndexCount/3;
            }
            if (!mesh.VirtualGeometryBuildError.empty())
            {
                ImGui::TextWrapped("Fallback: %s", mesh.VirtualGeometryBuildError.c_str());
            }
        }
        const char* status = "Legacy fallback";
        if (building)
        {
            status = "Building (legacy mesh available)";
        }
        else if (clusters)
        {
            status = "Hierarchy built; streaming readiness is reported in the dashboard";
        }
        ImGui::TextWrapped("Status: %s", status);
        ImGui::Text("Source vertices %llu / triangles %llu", vertices, triangles);
        ImGui::Text("Clusters %llu / groups %llu / LOD levels %u", clusters, groups, levels);
        ImGui::Text("Raw / encoded %.2f / %.2f MiB / streaming pages %llu",
            double(rawBytes)/(1024*1024),double(encodedBytes)/(1024*1024),pages);
        ImGui::Text("Pinned minimum %.2f MiB / resident upper estimate %.2f MiB",
            double(pinned*VirtualGeometryPages::PageBytes)/(1024*1024),
            double(std::min(pages*VirtualGeometryPages::PageBytes,VirtualGeometryStreaming::GetBudget().MaxResidentMemory))/(1024*1024));
        if (rawBytes)
        {
            ImGui::Text("Encoded / raw %.1f%%",100.0*double(encodedBytes)/rawBytes);
        }
    }
    if (!error.empty())
    {
        ImGui::TextWrapped("%s", error.c_str());
    }
    ImGui::PopID();
}

void DrawControls()
{
    const auto dashboard = GetVGStatistics();
    ImGui::Text("VG instances %u / source triangles %llu / instanced source triangles %llu",
        dashboard.Instances, dashboard.SourceTriangles, dashboard.InstancedSourceTriangles);
    if (dashboard.HasInstanceSample) ImGui::Text("Visible instances %u",dashboard.VisibleInstances);
    else ImGui::TextUnformatted("Visible instances: sample pending / GPU path inactive");
    ImGui::Text("Clusters %llu / material overflow %llu / invalid materials %llu",
        dashboard.RegisteredClusters, dashboard.MaterialBinOverflow, dashboard.InvalidMaterialRecords);
    ImGui::Text("Overflow: instances %llu / indirect rejected %llu / binned clusters rejected %llu",
        dashboard.VisibleInstanceOverflow,dashboard.InvalidIndirectCommands,dashboard.BinningRejectedClusters);
    if (RenderProfiler::HasLatest() && ImGui::TreeNode("VG GPU timings"))
    {
        const auto& profile = RenderProfiler::GetLatest();
        if (!profile.GpuTimingValid) ImGui::TextUnformatted("GPU timestamps unavailable");
        for (const auto& pass : profile.Passes)
        {
            if (pass.Name.find("Nanite") != std::string::npos || pass.Name.find("Native") != std::string::npos ||
                pass.Name.find("Compact Visible") != std::string::npos || pass.Name.find("material bin") != std::string::npos)
            {
                if (profile.GpuTimingValid) ImGui::Text("%s: %.3f ms",pass.Name.c_str(),pass.GpuMs);
            }
        }
        ImGui::TextUnformatted("Geometry decode is included in native raster; traversal combines hierarchy and cluster work.");
        ImGui::TreePop();
    }
    if (VirtualGeometryProduction::Recording())
    {
        if (ImGui::Button("Stop VG benchmark"))
        {
            VirtualGeometryProduction::EndBenchmark();
        }
    }
    else if (ImGui::Button("Record VG benchmark"))
    {
        std::string error;
        VirtualGeometryProduction::BeginBenchmark("build/virtualgeometry-phase11", error);
    }
    if (!VirtualGeometryProduction::LastError().empty())
    {
        ImGui::TextWrapped("%s", VirtualGeometryProduction::LastError().c_str());
    }
    auto &options = Settings();
    auto &visibility = GPUVisibility::GetSettings();
    auto &mesh = MeshShaderRenderer::GetSettings();
    auto& native = VirtualGeometryTraversal::GetSettings();
    int view = static_cast<int>(native.View);
    if (ImGui::Combo("VG debug view", &view,
        "None\0LOD\0Cluster\0Hierarchy\0Material bin\0Compression\0Page residency\0Streaming priority\0Occlusion\0Overdraw\0Geometry error\0Object ID\0"))
    {
        native.View = static_cast<VirtualGeometryTraversal::DebugView>(view);
        native.LevelColors = false;
    }
    ImGui::Checkbox("Grow VG buffers from completed overflow feedback", &native.AutoGrowBuffers);
    ImGui::Checkbox("Predictive page prefetch",&native.PredictiveStreaming);
    ImGui::SliderFloat("Prefetch lookahead seconds",&native.PrefetchSeconds,0,1);
    ImGui::Text("Prefetch requests %llu (cumulative)",VirtualGeometryStreaming::GetStatistics().PrefetchRequests);
    if (native.View == VirtualGeometryTraversal::DebugView::Occlusion)
    {
        ImGui::TextUnformatted("Cyan: static selected geometry. Orange: moving geometry bypasses history occlusion.");
        ImGui::Text("Deferred %u / recovered %u", VirtualGeometryTraversal::GetTemporalStatistics().Candidates,
            VirtualGeometryTraversal::GetTemporalStatistics().SecondVisible);
        if (OcclusionCulling::IsAvailable() && OcclusionCulling::GetMipCount())
        {
            const int maximum = static_cast<int>(OcclusionCulling::GetMipCount())-1;
            visibility.HiZMip = std::clamp(visibility.HiZMip,0,maximum);
            ImGui::SliderInt("VG Hi-Z mip",&visibility.HiZMip,0,maximum);
            OcclusionCulling::SetDebugPreview(static_cast<uint32_t>(visibility.HiZMip),true);
            ImGui::Image((ImTextureID)OcclusionCulling::GetDebugMipSrv(static_cast<uint32_t>(visibility.HiZMip)).ptr,ImVec2(320,180));
        }
    }
    if (native.View == VirtualGeometryTraversal::DebugView::PageResidency ||
        native.View == VirtualGeometryTraversal::DebugView::StreamingPriority)
    {
        if (ImGui::BeginTable("VG Page states",4,ImGuiTableFlags_ScrollY | ImGuiTableFlags_Borders,ImVec2(0,180)))
        {
            for (const auto* label : {"Page","State","Priority","Pinned"}) ImGui::TableSetupColumn(label);
            ImGui::TableHeadersRow();
            ImGuiListClipper clipper;
            clipper.Begin(static_cast<int>(std::min(VirtualGeometryStreaming::PageCount(),uint32_t(INT_MAX))));
            while (clipper.Step())
            {
                for (int page = clipper.DisplayStart; page < clipper.DisplayEnd; ++page)
                {
                    VirtualGeometryStreaming::PageInfo info;
                    if (!VirtualGeometryStreaming::InspectPage(static_cast<uint32_t>(page),info)) continue;
                    constexpr const char* states[] = {"Evicted","Requested","Loading","Resident"};
                    ImGui::TableNextRow();
                    ImGui::TableNextColumn();
                    ImGui::Text("%d",page);
                    ImGui::TableNextColumn();
                    ImGui::TextUnformatted(info.State < 4 ? states[info.State] : "Invalid");
                    ImGui::TableNextColumn();
                    ImGui::Text("%u",info.Priority);
                    ImGui::TableNextColumn();
                    ImGui::TextUnformatted(info.Pinned ? "yes" : "no");
                }
            }
            ImGui::EndTable();
        }
    }
    if (native.View == VirtualGeometryTraversal::DebugView::Overdraw)
    {
        ImGui::TextUnformatted("Additive coverage of selected clusters; disable occlusion to inspect hidden surfaces.");
    }
    int geometryMode = static_cast<int>(GetGeometryRenderingMode());

    {

        if (GetGeometryRenderingMode() != GeometryRenderingMode::Legacy)
        {
            GPUDrivenRenderer::SetEnabled(true);
            mesh.Enabled = true;
            native.Enabled = true;
        }
        GPUVisibility::Invalidate("Geometry rendering mode changed");
        VirtualGeometryTraversal::InvalidateHistory();

    ImGui::Text("Native hardware: %s / frame path: %s",MeshShaderRenderer::Supported() ? "supported" : "unsupported",

    ImGui::Checkbox("Native hierarchy rendering",&native.Enabled);
    ImGui::SliderFloat("Target Error Pixels",&native.TargetErrorPixels,0.1f,8.0f,"%.2f");
    ImGui::Checkbox("LOD hysteresis",&native.HysteresisEnabled);
    ImGui::SliderFloat("LOD hysteresis width",&native.HysteresisFraction,0.0f,0.5f,"%.2f");
    ImGui::Checkbox("Native two-pass occlusion",&native.TwoPassOcclusion);
    const auto& temporal = VirtualGeometryTraversal::GetTemporalStatistics();

    {
        ImGui::Text("First %u / retest candidates %u / recovered %u / LOD transitions %u",

    }

    if (ImGui::SliderInt("Recently used protection frames", &protectionFrames, 1, 120))
    {
        streaming.RecentlyUsedProtectionFrames = static_cast<uint32_t>(protectionFrames);
    }

    const auto compression = VirtualGeometryResources::CompressionMetrics();
    ImGui::TextUnformatted("Virtual Geometry Compression");
    ImGui::Text("Encoded / reference raw %.2f / %.2f MiB",
        double(compression.EncodedBytes)/(1024*1024), double(compression.RawBytes)/(1024*1024));
    if (compression.RawBytes)

            100.0*double(compression.EncodedBytes)/double(compression.RawBytes), compression.FallbackCount);

        compression.PositionQuantized, compression.HalfUV, compression.Index8Clusters, compression.Index16Clusters);

    int budgetMiB = int(streaming.BudgetMiB);
    if (ImGui::SliderInt("Geometry VRAM Budget (MiB)",&budgetMiB,1,1024)) streaming.BudgetMiB = uint32_t(budgetMiB);
    ImGui::Text("Pages Resident %llu / Requested %llu / Loading %llu / Evicted %llu",
        pages.Resident,pages.Requested,pages.Loading,pages.Evicted);

        pages.Pinned,pages.Evictions,pages.RequestOverflow,pages.IoErrors);

        double(pages.PoolBytes)/(1024*1024),double(pages.ReservedBytes)/(1024*1024),double(pages.BudgetBytes)/(1024*1024),double(pages.StagingBytes)/(1024*1024));

            sample.ActiveBins,sample.Clusters,sample.OverflowClusters,sample.InvalidMaterials);
    }

    if (!VirtualGeometryBinning::UnavailableReason().empty())
        ImGui::TextDisabled("%s",VirtualGeometryBinning::UnavailableReason().c_str());
    const auto stats = VirtualGeometryRuntime::GetStatistics();
    ImGui::Text("Cache hits %llu / shared %llu / builds %llu / failures %llu", stats.CacheHits,
                stats.SharedHits, stats.Builds, stats.Failures);
    ImGui::Text("Import/cache elapsed time: %.2f ms (cumulative)", stats.BuildMilliseconds);
    ImGui::Text("Geometry arena %.2f MiB / frame upload %.2f KiB",
                double(GPUDrivenRenderer::GeometryArenaBytes()) / (1024 * 1024),
                double(GPUDrivenRenderer::GeometryUploadBytes()) / 1024);
    if (ImGui::Checkbox("Automatic Nanite rendering", &mesh.Enabled))

    {

            ImGui::SameLine();
        ImGui::ColorButton(("LOD" + to_string(lod)).c_str(),
                           ImGui::ColorConvertU32ToFloat4(LODColors[lod]), ImGuiColorEditFlags_NoTooltip,
                           ImVec2(12, 12));

        ImGui::Text("%u", lod);

    ImGui::Checkbox("LOD statistics (delayed GPU sample)", &visibility.DebugReadback);
    if (visibility.DebugReadback && GPUVisibility::HasStatisticsSample())
    {
        const auto &sample = GPUVisibility::LatestStatistics();
        ImGui::Text("Last completed sample: %u visible / %u triangles", sample.FinalVisible,
                    sample.Triangles);
        for (uint32_t lod = 0; lod < 8; ++lod)
        {
            if (lod)
                ImGui::SameLine();
            ImGui::Text("LOD%u:%u", lod, sample.LODCounts[lod]);
        }
    }
    else

    ImGui::Checkbox("Selected entity only", &options.SelectedOnly);

    {

void DrawViewport(ImDrawList *draw, const ImVec2 &origin, const ImVec2 &size, uint32_t selected)
{
    auto &options = Settings();
    const auto &settings = MeshShaderRenderer::GetSettings();
    if (!options.HierarchyBounds && !options.Wireframe && !settings.MeshletBounds &&
        !settings.ClusterBounds && !settings.ConeAxes)
        return;
    const auto camera = Camera::GetCameraEntity();
    if (!Registry::IsAlive(camera))
        return;
    XMMATRIX view, projection;
    Camera::GetCameraMatrices(camera, view, projection);
    const XMMATRIX vp = view * projection;
    auto project = [&](XMVECTOR local, XMMATRIX world, ImVec2 &point)
    {
        XMFLOAT4 clip;
        XMStoreFloat4(&clip, XMVector4Transform(XMVector4Transform(local, world), vp));
        if (clip.w <= 1e-5f || clip.z < 0 || clip.z > clip.w)
            return false;
        point = {origin.x + (clip.x / clip.w * 0.5f + 0.5f) * size.x,
                 origin.y + (0.5f - clip.y / clip.w * 0.5f) * size.y};
        return true;
    };
    auto sphere = [&](const Meshlets::Bounds &bounds, XMMATRIX world, ImU32 color)
    {
        for (uint32_t axis = 0; axis < 3; ++axis)
        {
            ImVec2 previous{};
            bool have = false;
            for (uint32_t step = 0; step <= 24; ++step)
            {
                const float angle = XM_2PI * float(step) / 24;
                float xyz[] = {bounds.Center.X, bounds.Center.Y, bounds.Center.Z};
                xyz[axis] += cosf(angle) * bounds.Radius;
                xyz[(axis + 1) % 3] += sinf(angle) * bounds.Radius;
                ImVec2 point{};
                const bool valid = project(XMVectorSet(xyz[0], xyz[1], xyz[2], 1), world, point);
                if (have && valid)
                    draw->AddLine(previous, point, color);
                previous = point;
                have = valid;
            }
        }
    };
    draw->PushClipRect(origin, ImVec2(origin.x + size.x, origin.y + size.y), true);
    uint32_t displayed = 0;
    if (settings.MeshletBounds || settings.ClusterBounds || settings.ConeAxes)
    {
        const auto &data = MeshletManager::AssetData();
        const ImU32 colors[] = {IM_COL32(150, 150, 150, 180), IM_COL32(40, 230, 230, 200),
                                IM_COL32(200, 80, 240, 200),  IM_COL32(250, 60, 60, 200),
                                IM_COL32(240, 220, 40, 200),  IM_COL32(250, 150, 40, 200)};
        for (const auto &record : MeshShaderRenderer::DebugRecords())
        {
            if (displayed >= uint32_t(options.Limit))
                break;
            const auto *instance = GpuScene::GetInstance(record[0]);
            if (!instance || !(instance->Flags & 1u) || record[1] >= data.Bounds.size() ||
                (options.SelectedOnly && instance->Entity != selected))
                continue;
            ++displayed;
            const auto world = XMLoadFloat4x4(&instance->World);
            const auto &bounds = data.Bounds[record[1]];
            if (settings.MeshletBounds)
                sphere(bounds, world, colors[min(record[2], 5u)]);
            if (settings.ClusterBounds && record[3] < data.Clusters.size() &&
                record[1] == data.Clusters[record[3]].MeshletOffset)
                sphere(data.Clusters[record[3]].Bounds, world, IM_COL32(190, 190, 255, 200));
            if (settings.ConeAxes && bounds.ConeCutoff < 1)
            {
                ImVec2 start, end;
                auto center = XMVectorSet(bounds.Center.X, bounds.Center.Y, bounds.Center.Z, 1);
                auto tip = center + XMVectorSet(bounds.ConeAxis.X, bounds.ConeAxis.Y, bounds.ConeAxis.Z, 0) *
                                        bounds.Radius;
                if (project(center, world, start) && project(tip, world, end))
                    draw->AddLine(start, end, IM_COL32_WHITE, 2);
            }
        }
    }
    if ((options.HierarchyBounds || options.Wireframe) && Registry::IsAlive(selected) &&
        ComponentManager::HasComponent<TransformComponent>(selected))
    {
        const auto world = XMLoadFloat4x4(
            &ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<TransformComponent>(selected).WorldMatrix);
        uint32_t previews = 0;
        for (const auto *source : Meshes(selected))
        {
            const auto &asset = source->VirtualGeometryLODs[options.SourceLOD];
            if (!asset || !asset->Error.empty())
                continue;
            const auto &hierarchy = asset->Hierarchy;
            for (const auto &cluster : hierarchy.Clusters)
            {
                if (previews >= uint32_t(options.Limit))
                    break;
                const bool bounds =
                    options.HierarchyBounds && cluster.Level == uint32_t(options.HierarchyLevel);
                const bool wire = options.Wireframe && cluster.Level == 0;
                if (!bounds && !wire)
                    continue;
                ++previews;
                const auto color = LODColors[min(cluster.Level, 7u)];
                if (bounds)
                    sphere({{cluster.Bounds.Center[0], cluster.Bounds.Center[1], cluster.Bounds.Center[2]},
                            cluster.Bounds.Radius,
                            {},
                            1},
                           world, color);
                if (wire)
                    for (uint32_t triangle = 0; triangle < cluster.TriangleCount; ++triangle)
                    {
                        ImVec2 points[3];
                        bool valid = true;
                        for (uint32_t i = 0; i < 3; ++i)
                        {
                            const auto &vertex =
                                hierarchy.Vertices[cluster.VertexOffset +
                                                   hierarchy.TriangleIndices[cluster.TriangleOffset +
                                                                             triangle * 3 + i]];
                            valid &= project(
                                XMVectorSet(vertex.Position[0], vertex.Position[1], vertex.Position[2], 1),
                                world, points[i]);
                        }
                        if (valid)
                            for (uint32_t i = 0; i < 3; ++i)
                                draw->AddLine(points[i], points[(i + 1) % 3], color);
                    }
            }
        }
        displayed += previews;
    }
    draw->AddText(ImVec2(origin.x + 8, origin.y + 8), IM_COL32_WHITE,
                  ("Nanite overlay: " + to_string(displayed) + " clusters (limit " +
                   to_string(options.Limit) + ")")
                      .c_str());
    draw->PopClipRect();
}
} // namespace VirtualGeometryDebug
