void Check(bool condition, const char* message)
{
    if (!condition) ++failures;
    WriteGraphicsLog("Geometry streaming validation: %s %s\n",condition ? "PASS" : "FAIL",message);
}
std::vector<uint8_t> Coverage()
{
    RenderCapture::TextureData texture;
    if (!RenderCapture::ReadTexture(RenderTargets::GetGBufferResource(GBufferType::DEPTH),texture) ||
        texture.Format != DXGI_FORMAT_R32_FLOAT || !texture.Width || !texture.Height)
    {
        return {};
    }
    std::vector<uint8_t> result(size_t(texture.Width)*texture.Height);
    for (uint32_t y = 0; y < texture.Height; ++y)
    {
        const auto* depth = reinterpret_cast<const float*>(texture.Bytes.data()+size_t(y)*texture.RowPitch);
        for (uint32_t x = 0; x < texture.Width; ++x)
        {
            result[size_t(y)*texture.Width+x] = uint8_t(std::isfinite(depth[x]) && depth[x] > 0 && depth[x] < 1);
        }
    }
    return result;
}
void Setup()
{
    char path[4096]{};
    GetEnvironmentVariableA("DX12_VG_STRESS_DIRECTORY",path,sizeof(path));
    directory = path;
    char requestedText[32]{};
    GetEnvironmentVariableA("DX12_VG_STRESS_TRIANGLES",requestedText,sizeof(requestedText));
    uint64_t requested = std::stoull(requestedText);
    assetCount = uint32_t((requested+VirtualGeometryPageStress::SourceTrianglesPerAsset-1)/VirtualGeometryPageStress::SourceTrianglesPerAsset);
    budgetMiB = (assetCount+15)/16+4;
    VirtualGeometryStreaming::GetSettings().BudgetMiB = budgetMiB;
    std::vector<uint32_t> remove;
    for (uint32_t entity = 0; entity < Registry::GetEntities().size(); ++entity)
    {
        if (Registry::IsAlive(entity) && !ComponentManager::HasComponent<CameraComponent>(entity)) remove.push_back(entity);
    }
    for (uint32_t entity : remove) World::DestroyEntity(Entity(entity));
    for (uint32_t asset = 0; asset < assetCount; ++asset)
    {
        auto manifest = std::make_shared<VirtualGeometryPageCache::PageManifest>();
        std::string error;
        if (!VirtualGeometryPageCache::Open(directory/("asset-"+std::to_string(asset)+".vgp2"),*manifest,error))
        {
            throw std::runtime_error(error);
        }
        for (const auto& cluster : manifest->Metadata.Clusters)
        {
            if (cluster.Level == 0) sourceTriangles += cluster.TriangleCount;
        }
        if (asset == 0)
        {
            admissionProbe = std::make_shared<VirtualGeometryPageCache::PageManifest>(*manifest);
            std::fill(admissionProbe->PinnedPages.begin(),admissionProbe->PinnedPages.end(),uint8_t(1));
        }
        int modelId = ModelManager::LoadStaticModel(manifest->Path.string().c_str(),false);
        auto* model = ModelManager::GetStaticModel(modelId);
        if (!model || model->GetMeshCount() != 1) throw std::runtime_error("Streaming fallback mesh import failed");
        // Standard VG importer supplies pinned root fallback and the original Entity identity.
        Entity entity = World::CreateEntity();
        entity.Add<TransformComponent>().Add<StaticModelComponent>().Add<MaterialComponent>().Add<ShaderComponent>().Add<NameComponent>();
        entity.Get<NameComponent>().Name = "Streaming disk asset "+std::to_string(asset);
        entity.Get<StaticModelComponent>().ModelId = modelId;
        entity.Get<TransformComponent>().Position = {float(asset%16)*10,float(asset/16)*10,0};
        auto& material = entity.Get<MaterialComponent>();
        material.ShaderClassMode = MaterialMode::Manual;
        material.ShaderClass = ShaderClass::PBR;
        material.UseTexture = false;
    }
    Check(sourceTriangles >= requested,"scene contains requested source triangles without an instance multiplier");
    WriteGraphicsLog("Geometry streaming scene: source triangles=%llu assets=%u budget MiB=%u\n",sourceTriangles,assetCount,budgetMiB);
    World::SetVSyncEnabled(false);
}
}
bool Enabled()
{
    char value[8]{};
    return GetEnvironmentVariableA("DX12_VIRTUAL_GEOMETRY_STREAMING_TEST",value,sizeof(value)) && atoi(value) != 0;
}
void BeforeFrame(uint64_t frame)
{
    if (frame == 0) Setup();
    if (frame == 48)
    {
        uint32_t assetsBefore = VirtualGeometryResources::AssetCount();
        uint64_t clustersBefore = VirtualGeometryResources::RegisteredClusterCount();
        uint32_t pagesBefore = VirtualGeometryStreaming::PageCount();
        bool rejected = true;
        for (uint32_t attempt = 0; attempt < 32; ++attempt)
        {
            rejected &= VirtualGeometryResources::RegisterManifest(admissionProbe) == UINT32_MAX;
        }
        Check(rejected && assetsBefore == VirtualGeometryResources::AssetCount() &&
            clustersBefore == VirtualGeometryResources::RegisteredClusterCount() && pagesBefore == VirtualGeometryStreaming::PageCount(),
            "repeated pinned-budget rejection leaves asset, metadata and Page counts unchanged");
        admissionProbe.reset();
    }
    RenderConfiguration::SetRenderMode(RenderMode::DEFERRED);
    RendererSettings::SetMeshShadersEnabled(false);
    RendererSettings::SetComputeGBufferEnabled(false);
    RendererSettings::SetTwoPhaseOcclusionEnabled(false);
    RendererSettings::SetUpscaleMode(UpscaleMode::Bilateral);
    DayNightCycle::GetSettings().Running = false;
    bool traditional = frame%12 == 1;
    GPUDrivenRenderer::SetEnabled(!traditional);
    MeshShaderRenderer::GetSettings().Enabled = !traditional;
    auto& options = VirtualGeometryTraversal::GetSettings();
    options.Enabled = !traditional;
    options.DebugReadback = false;
    options.LevelColors = false;
    options.FrustumCulling = true;
    options.ConeCulling = false;
    options.OcclusionCulling = false;
    options.ForceHierarchyLevel = 0;
    options.MaxGroupStates = 4000000;
    options.MaxSelectedClusters = 4000000;
    GPUVisibility::GetSettings().LOD = false;
    GPUVisibility::GetSettings().Occlusion = false;
    if (frame == 60) VirtualGeometryStreaming::GetSettings().BudgetMiB = budgetMiB-1;
    if (frame == 120) VirtualGeometryStreaming::GetSettings().BudgetMiB = budgetMiB;
    uint32_t target = uint32_t((frame/12)%assetCount);
    if (frame%12 > 1) target = uint32_t((frame*17)%assetCount);
    float distance = frame/12%3 == 0 ? 5.0f : frame/12%3 == 1 ? 30.0f : 100.0f;
    auto cameraEntity = Camera::GetCameraEntity();
    if (Registry::IsAlive(cameraEntity))
    {
        auto& transform = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<TransformComponent>(cameraEntity);
        auto& camera = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<CameraComponent>(cameraEntity);
        float x = float(target%16)*10;
        float y = float(target/16)*10;
        transform.Position = {x,y,-distance};
        transform.IsDirty = true;
        camera.Target = {x,y,0};
    }
}
void AfterFrame(uint64_t frame)
{
    const auto& stats = VirtualGeometryStreaming::GetStatistics();
    uint64_t submitted = GraphicsDevice::GetPendingSubmissionFence()-1;
    uint64_t completed = GraphicsDevice::GetCompletedFence();
    if (submitted > completed) maximumPendingGraphics = std::max(maximumPendingGraphics,submitted-completed);
    if (RenderProfiler::HasLatest())
    {
        const auto& timing = RenderProfiler::GetLatest();
        if (timing.Serial != timingSerial)
        {
            timingSerial = timing.Serial;
            ++timingSamples;
            cpuMilliseconds += timing.CpuRenderMs;
            gpuMilliseconds += timing.GpuRenderMs;
            maximumCpuMilliseconds = std::max(maximumCpuMilliseconds,timing.CpuRenderMs);
            if (readyFrame != UINT64_MAX && frame > readyFrame+12)
            {
                ++steadySamples;
                steadyCpuMilliseconds += timing.CpuRenderMs;
                steadyGpuMilliseconds += timing.GpuRenderMs;
            }
        }
    }
    if (readyFrame == UINT64_MAX && stats.Pinned == assetCount && stats.Resident >= stats.Pinned)
    {
        bool ready = VirtualGeometryResources::AssetCount() == assetCount;
        for (uint32_t asset = 0; asset < VirtualGeometryResources::AssetCount(); ++asset) ready &= VirtualGeometryResources::Ready(asset);
        if (ready) readyFrame = frame;
    }
    if (frame%24 == 0)
    {
        WriteGraphicsLog("Geometry streaming frame=%llu resident=%llu requested=%llu loading=%llu evicted=%llu evictions=%llu bytes=%llu/%llu requests=%llu copy=%llu\n",
            frame,stats.Resident,stats.Requested,stats.Loading,stats.Evicted,stats.Evictions,stats.ReservedBytes,stats.BudgetBytes,stats.GpuRequests,stats.CompletedBytes);
#ifdef _DEBUG
        Check(RenderCapture::ReportGraphicsErrors() == 0,"D3D12 errors during streaming camera movement");
#endif
    }
    if (readyFrame == UINT64_MAX || frame < readyFrame+4) return;
    if (frame%12 == 0)
    {
        auto routing = MeshShaderRenderer::CaptureNativeRouting();
        Check(routing.Error.empty(),"unique native cut and exclusive native/legacy/fallback routing");
        if (!routing.Error.empty()) WriteGraphicsLog("Geometry routing capture: %s\n",routing.Error.c_str());
        maximumSelected = std::max(maximumSelected,routing.SelectedClusters);
        maximumLeaves = std::max(maximumLeaves,routing.LeafClusters);
        ++routingSamples;
        referenceCoverage = Coverage();
        Check(std::count(referenceCoverage.begin(),referenceCoverage.end(),uint8_t(1)) != 0,"native or parent fallback renders visible geometry");
    }
    if (frame%12 == 1 && !referenceCoverage.empty())
    {
        auto traditional = Coverage();
        Check(traditional == referenceCoverage,"Page loading/eviction preserves traditional raster coverage");
        ++comparisons;
        referenceCoverage.clear();
    }
}
bool Finish()
{
    Check(GraphicsDevice::WaitForGpuIdle(),"final graphics work completed");
    char gpuValidation[8]{};
    if (GetEnvironmentVariableA("DX12_GPU_BASED_VALIDATION",gpuValidation,sizeof(gpuValidation)) && atoi(gpuValidation))
    {
        Check(GraphicsDevice::GpuBasedValidationEnabled(),"requested GPU Based Validation actually enabled");
    }
    const auto& stats = VirtualGeometryStreaming::GetStatistics();
    Check(readyFrame != UINT64_MAX,"all source assets reached native root residency");
    Check(comparisons >= 4,"repeated raster comparisons after camera teleports");
    Check(routingSamples >= 4 && maximumSelected > 0,"repeated native cluster and routing inspection");
    Check(maximumPendingGraphics > 0,"ordinary stress frames submit graphics before prior work completes");
    Check(stats.IoErrors == 1,"single injected I/O failure recovered without additional read errors");
    Check(stats.GpuRequests > 0 && stats.CpuRequests > 0,"GPU requests reached the CPU loader");
    Check(stats.Evictions > 0,"working set exceeds pool budget and evicts old Pages");
    Check(stats.CompletedBytes > uint64_t(assetCount)*65536,"fine Pages completed Copy after pinned roots");
    Check(stats.PoolBytes <= stats.BudgetBytes && stats.ReservedBytes <= stats.BudgetBytes,"physical pool and reservations fit restored budget");
#ifdef _DEBUG
    Check(RenderCapture::ReportGraphicsErrors() == 0,"final D3D12 errors zero");
#endif
    WriteGraphicsLog("Geometry streaming final: source=%llu comparisons=%u GPU requests=%llu SSD bytes=%llu Copy bytes=%llu VRAM=%llu staging=%llu evictions=%llu I/O errors=%llu CPU ms=%.3f I/O ms=%.3f\n",
        sourceTriangles,comparisons,stats.GpuRequests,stats.DiskBytes,stats.CompletedBytes,stats.PoolBytes,stats.StagingBytes,stats.Evictions,stats.IoErrors,stats.CpuMilliseconds,stats.IoMilliseconds);
    PROCESS_MEMORY_COUNTERS_EX memory{};
    memory.cb = sizeof(memory);
    bool memoryValid = K32GetProcessMemoryInfo(GetCurrentProcess(),reinterpret_cast<PROCESS_MEMORY_COUNTERS*>(&memory),sizeof(memory)) != FALSE;
    WriteGraphicsLog("Geometry streaming performance: samples=%llu average CPU render ms=%.3f average GPU render ms=%.3f maximum CPU render ms=%.3f RAM working set=%llu private bytes=%llu memory valid=%u\n",
        timingSamples,cpuMilliseconds/std::max(uint64_t(1),timingSamples),gpuMilliseconds/std::max(uint64_t(1),timingSamples),maximumCpuMilliseconds,
        uint64_t(memory.WorkingSetSize),uint64_t(memory.PrivateUsage),unsigned(memoryValid));
    WriteGraphicsLog("Geometry streaming steady performance: samples=%llu CPU render ms=%.3f GPU render ms=%.3f (after root warmup)\n",
        steadySamples,steadyCpuMilliseconds/std::max(uint64_t(1),steadySamples),steadyGpuMilliseconds/std::max(uint64_t(1),steadySamples));
    WriteGraphicsLog("Geometry streaming routing: samples=%u maximum selected clusters=%u maximum leaves=%u maximum pending graphics fence values=%llu synchronous counters every frame=0\n",
        routingSamples,maximumSelected,maximumLeaves,maximumPendingGraphics);
    WriteGraphicsLog("Geometry streaming validation failures = %u\n",failures);
    return failures == 0;
}
}

===== FILE: virtualgeometry\virtualgeometrytemporal.h =====
#pragma once
#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>

namespace VirtualGeometryTemporal
{
inline bool Refine(double errorPixels, float targetPixels, float fraction, bool previousRefine, bool historyValid)
{
    float target = std::isfinite(targetPixels) && targetPixels > 0 ? targetPixels : 1.0f;
    float width = std::isfinite(fraction) ? std::clamp(fraction, 0.0f, 0.5f) : 0.1f;
    float threshold = target;
    if (historyValid)
    {
        threshold *= previousRefine ? 1.0f - width : 1.0f + width;
    }
    return errorPixels > threshold;
}
}

struct Constants
{
    XMFLOAT4X4 VP{}, PreviousVP{};
    XMFLOAT4 Camera{};
    uint32_t Capacity = 0, ObjectCapacity = 0, Assets = 0, Materials = 0;
    uint32_t Frustum = 1, Cone = 1, Occlusion = 0, Enabled = 0;
    float Bias = 0.001f, Width = 1, Height = 1;
    uint32_t Mips = 1;
    float ProjectionPixels = 1, TargetPixels = 1;

    uint32_t HysteresisEnabled = 0, TemporalPhase = 0, TemporalPadding = 0;
};
static_assert(sizeof(Constants) == 256);
struct HistoryHeader
{
    uint64_t Generation = 0;
    uint32_t Asset = UINT32_MAX, GroupBase = 0, GroupCount = 0, Epoch = 0, Padding[2]{};
};
static_assert(sizeof(HistoryHeader) == 32);
struct Frame
{
    GpuSceneBuffer States, Visible, Counters, Arguments, Success, Queue;
    GpuSceneBuffer HistoryHeaders, First, Deferred, Second, Combined, TemporalCounters, TemporalArguments;
    ComPtr<ID3D12Resource> TemporalReadback;
    uint64_t SampleFence = 0, SampleSerial = 0;
    bool SampleTwoPass = false;
};
struct State
{
    Settings Options;
    Constants Parameters;
    FrameInputs Inputs;
    std::array<Frame, GpuSceneBuffer::FrameCount> Frames;
    uint32_t FrameIndex = 0;
    bool Active = false;
    bool HistoryDirty = true, PreviousHysteresis = false, PreviousEnabled = false;

    std::array<uint32_t,64> Debug{};

State& Data() { static State state; return state; }
Frame& Current() { return Data().Frames.at(Data().FrameIndex); }
void Check(HRESULT result)
{
    if (FAILED(result)) throw std::runtime_error("Native VirtualGeometry compute initialization failed");
}
void Initialize()
{
    auto& state = Data();
    if (state.ArgumentsPSO) return;
    CD3DX12_ROOT_PARAMETER parameters[29];
    for (uint32_t index = 0; index < 9; ++index) parameters[index].InitAsShaderResourceView(index);
    for (uint32_t index = 0; index < 6; ++index) parameters[9+index].InitAsUnorderedAccessView(index);
    CD3DX12_DESCRIPTOR_RANGE hiz, cbv;
    hiz.Init(D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_RANGE_TYPE_SRV,1,9);
    cbv.Init(D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_RANGE_TYPE_CBV,1,0);
    parameters[15].InitAsDescriptorTable(1,&hiz);
    parameters[16].InitAsDescriptorTable(1,&cbv);
    parameters[17].InitAsShaderResourceView(10);
    for (uint32_t index = 0; index < 3; ++index) parameters[18+index].InitAsUnorderedAccessView(6+index);
    parameters[21].InitAsUnorderedAccessView(9);
    parameters[22].InitAsShaderResourceView(11);
    for (uint32_t index = 0; index < 6; ++index) parameters[23+index].InitAsUnorderedAccessView(10+index);
    CD3DX12_ROOT_SIGNATURE_DESC description(29,parameters);
    ComPtr<ID3DBlob> blob, error;
    Check(D3D12SerializeRootSignature(&description,D3D_ROOT_SIGNATURE_VERSION_1,&blob,&error));
    Check(GraphicsDevice::GetDevice()->CreateRootSignature(0,blob->GetBufferPointer(),blob->GetBufferSize(),IID_PPV_ARGS(&state.Root)));
    auto pipeline = [&](const char* path, ComPtr<ID3D12PipelineState>& target)
    {
        ComPtr<ID3DBlob> shader;
        ShaderDescription input{};
        input.csoPath = path;
        input.ppBlob = shader.GetAddressOf();
        if (!ShaderPipelines::LoadShaderBlob(input)) throw std::runtime_error(path);
        D3D12_COMPUTE_PIPELINE_STATE_DESC desc{};
        desc.pRootSignature = state.Root.Get();
        desc.CS = {shader->GetBufferPointer(),shader->GetBufferSize()};
        Check(GraphicsDevice::GetDevice()->CreateComputePipelineState(&desc,IID_PPV_ARGS(&target)));
    };
    pipeline("shader/hlsl/build/VirtualGeometryResetCS.cso",state.ResetPSO);
    pipeline("shader/hlsl/build/VirtualGeometryTraversalCS.cso",state.TraversePSO);
    pipeline("shader/hlsl/build/VirtualGeometryArgumentsCS.cso",state.ArgumentsPSO);
    pipeline("shader/hlsl/build/VirtualGeometryPartitionCS.cso",state.PartitionPSO);
    pipeline("shader/hlsl/build/VirtualGeometryRetestCS.cso",state.RetestPSO);
    pipeline("shader/hlsl/build/VirtualGeometryTemporalArgumentsCS.cso",state.TemporalArgumentsPSO);
}
RenderGraph::ResourceHandle Import(RenderGraph& graph, const char* name, GpuSceneBuffer& buffer, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATES final)
{
    auto existing = graph.FindImportedResource(buffer.Resource());
    if (existing.IsValid()) return existing;
    RenderGraph::ImportedResource resource{};
    resource.Name = name;
    resource.Resource = buffer.Resource();
    resource.InitialState = buffer.State;
    resource.HasFinalState = true;
    resource.FinalState = final;
    buffer.State = final;
    return graph.ImportResource(resource);
}
void Bind(ID3D12GraphicsCommandList* list, uint32_t temporalPhase = 0)
{
    auto& state = Data();
    auto& frame = Current();
    ID3D12DescriptorHeap* heap = FrameConstants::GetCbvHeap();
    list->SetDescriptorHeaps(1,&heap);
    list->SetComputeRootSignature(state.Root.Get());
    ID3D12Resource* sources[] = {GpuScene::InstanceBuffer(),state.Inputs.ObjectResource,
        VirtualGeometryResources::AssetBuffer().Resource(),VirtualGeometryResources::ClusterBuffer().Resource(),
        VirtualGeometryResources::GroupBuffer().Resource(),VirtualGeometryResources::HierarchyIndexBuffer().Resource(),
        VirtualGeometryResources::RootBuffer().Resource(),state.Inputs.CountResource,GpuScene::MaterialBuffer()};
    for (uint32_t index = 0; index < 9; ++index) list->SetComputeRootShaderResourceView(index,sources[index]->GetGPUVirtualAddress());
    GpuSceneBuffer* outputs[] = {&frame.States,&frame.Visible,&frame.Counters,&frame.Arguments,&frame.Success,&frame.Queue};
    for (uint32_t index = 0; index < 6; ++index) list->SetComputeRootUnorderedAccessView(9+index,outputs[index]->Resource()->GetGPUVirtualAddress());
    list->SetComputeRootDescriptorTable(15,temporalPhase == 2 ? OcclusionCulling::GetCurrentSrv() : OcclusionCulling::GetPreviousSrv());
    auto constants = state.Parameters;
    constants.TemporalPhase = temporalPhase;
    if (temporalPhase == 0 && constants.TwoPass) constants.Occlusion = 0;
    if (temporalPhase == 2) constants.Occlusion = OcclusionCulling::HasCurrent();
    list->SetComputeRootDescriptorTable(16,FrameConstants::AllocateTransientConstantBuffer(&constants,sizeof(constants)));
    list->SetComputeRootShaderResourceView(17,VirtualGeometryStreaming::ResidencyBuffer().Resource()->GetGPUVirtualAddress());
    GpuSceneBuffer* feedback[] = {&VirtualGeometryStreaming::RequestBitsBuffer(),&VirtualGeometryStreaming::RequestBuffer(),&VirtualGeometryStreaming::UsageBuffer()};
    for (uint32_t index = 0; index < 3; ++index)
    {
        list->SetComputeRootUnorderedAccessView(18+index,feedback[index]->Resource()->GetGPUVirtualAddress());
    }
    list->SetComputeRootUnorderedAccessView(21,state.History.Resource()->GetGPUVirtualAddress());
    list->SetComputeRootShaderResourceView(22,frame.HistoryHeaders.Resource()->GetGPUVirtualAddress());
    GpuSceneBuffer* temporal[] = {&frame.First,&frame.Deferred,&frame.Second,&frame.Combined,&frame.TemporalCounters,&frame.TemporalArguments};
    for (uint32_t index = 0; index < 6; ++index)
    {
        list->SetComputeRootUnorderedAccessView(23+index,temporal[index]->Resource()->GetGPUVirtualAddress());
    }
}

void PollTemporalStatistics()
{
    auto& state = Data();
    uint64_t completed = GraphicsDevice::GetCompletedFence();
    for (auto& frame : state.Frames)
    {
        if (!frame.SampleFence || frame.SampleFence > completed) continue;
        void* mapped = nullptr;
        D3D12_RANGE range{0,1024};
        Check(frame.TemporalReadback->Map(0,&range,&mapped));
        if (frame.SampleSerial > state.LatestSample)
        {
            const auto* values = static_cast<const uint32_t*>(mapped);
            state.TemporalStats.Candidates = values[0];
            state.TemporalStats.FirstVisible = frame.SampleTwoPass ? values[1] : values[193];
            state.TemporalStats.LodTransitions = values[4];
            state.TemporalStats.SecondVisible = values[65];
            state.TemporalStats.CapacityFallbacks = values[195];
            state.TemporalStats.HasSample = true;
            state.TemporalStats.SampleSerial = frame.SampleSerial;
            std::copy_n(values+192, 64, state.Debug.begin());
            if (state.Options.AutoGrowBuffers && state.TemporalStats.CapacityFallbacks != 0)
            {
                // Applied before BeginFrame/Ensure, using only fence-completed feedback.
                state.Options.MaxSelectedClusters = static_cast<uint32_t>(std::min<uint64_t>(4000000, uint64_t(state.Options.MaxSelectedClusters)*2));
                state.Options.MaxGroupStates = static_cast<uint32_t>(std::min<uint64_t>(4000000, uint64_t(state.Options.MaxGroupStates)*2));
            }
            state.LatestSample = frame.SampleSerial;
        }
        D3D12_RANGE noWrite{0,0};
        frame.TemporalReadback->Unmap(0,&noWrite);
        frame.SampleFence = 0;
    }
}

uint64_t PrepareHistory(RenderGraph& graph)
{
    auto& state = Data();
    auto& frame = Current();
    const auto& assets = VirtualGeometryResources::AssetTable();
    std::vector<HistoryHeader> headers(std::max(1u,GpuScene::Statistics().InstanceSlots));
    uint32_t used = 0;
    bool changed = state.HistoryDirty || GPUVisibility::CameraCut() || state.PreviousEnabled != state.Options.Enabled ||
        state.PreviousHysteresis != state.Options.HysteresisEnabled || state.PreviousScratch != state.Options.MaxGroupStates;
    for (uint32_t id = 0; id < headers.size(); ++id)
    {
        const auto* instance = GpuScene::GetInstance(id);
        if (!instance || instance->VirtualGeometryAssetIndex >= assets.size()) continue;
        auto& header = headers[id];
        header.Generation = GpuScene::InstanceHistoryGeneration(id);
        header.Asset = instance->VirtualGeometryAssetIndex;
        uint32_t groups = assets[header.Asset].GroupCount;
        if (groups <= state.Options.MaxGroupStates-used)
        {
            header.GroupBase = used;
            header.GroupCount = groups;
            used += groups;
        }
    }
    if (headers.size() != state.HistoryLayout.size()) changed = true;
    for (size_t id = 0; id < headers.size() && id < state.HistoryLayout.size(); ++id)
    {
        // Compare identity/layout only, excluding the epoch assigned below.
        if (std::memcmp(&headers[id],&state.HistoryLayout[id],offsetof(HistoryHeader,Epoch)) != 0) changed = true;
    }
    state.History.BeginFrame(state.FrameIndex);
    changed |= state.History.Ensure(GraphicsDevice::GetDevice(),std::max(1u,used),4,state.FrameIndex,L"Native LOD history",true);
    if (changed)
    {
        state.HistoryEpoch = state.HistoryEpoch == 0x7fffffffu ? 1 : state.HistoryEpoch+1;
    }
    for (auto& header : headers) header.Epoch = state.HistoryEpoch;
    state.HistoryLayout = headers;
    state.HistoryDirty = false;
    state.PreviousEnabled = state.Options.Enabled;
    state.PreviousHysteresis = state.Options.HysteresisEnabled;
    state.PreviousScratch = state.Options.MaxGroupStates;
    state.Parameters.HistorySlots = uint32_t(headers.size());
    state.Parameters.HistoryCapacity = used;
    state.Parameters.ResetHistory = changed;
    frame.HistoryHeaders.BeginFrame(state.FrameIndex);
    frame.HistoryHeaders.Ensure(GraphicsDevice::GetDevice(),uint32_t(headers.size())*2,16,state.FrameIndex,L"Native LOD identities");
    std::vector<uint32_t> changes(headers.size()*2);
    std::iota(changes.begin(),changes.end(),0u);
    uint64_t bytes = frame.HistoryHeaders.Stage(GraphicsDevice::GetDevice(),state.FrameIndex,headers.data(),uint32_t(changes.size()),changes);
    auto headerHandle = Import(graph,"Native LOD identities",frame.HistoryHeaders,D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_NON_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE);
    if (bytes)
    {
        graph.AddPass("Native LOD identity upload",
            [=](RenderGraph::PassBuilder& b) { b.Write(headerHandle,D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_COPY_DEST); },
            [](ID3D12GraphicsCommandList* list) { Current().HistoryHeaders.Copy(list,Data().FrameIndex); });
    }
    return bytes;
}
}

void Prepare(RenderGraph& graph, const FrameInputs& inputs)
{
    auto& state = Data();
    PollTemporalStatistics();
    ++state.Serial;
    state.Active = false;
    state.FrameIndex = GraphicsDevice::GetFrameIndex();
    state.Inputs = inputs;
    auto& frame = Current();
    uint64_t maximumClusters = 1;
    for (const auto& asset : VirtualGeometryResources::AssetTable())
    {
        maximumClusters = std::max(maximumClusters,uint64_t(std::max(asset.ClusterCount,asset.GroupCount)));
    }
    uint64_t maximumWork = maximumClusters*inputs.ObjectCapacity;
    auto ensure = [&](GpuSceneBuffer& buffer,uint32_t count,uint32_t stride)
    {
        buffer.BeginFrame(state.FrameIndex);
        buffer.Ensure(GraphicsDevice::GetDevice(),count,stride,state.FrameIndex,L"Native VirtualGeometry frame",true);
    };
    // Always reset routing, including disabled/failed native frames.
    ensure(frame.Success,inputs.ObjectCapacity,4);
    ensure(frame.Counters,64,4);
    ensure(frame.Arguments,1,12);
    state.Options.MaxSelectedClusters = std::clamp(state.Options.MaxSelectedClusters,1u,4000000u);
    state.Options.MaxGroupStates = std::clamp(state.Options.MaxGroupStates,1u,4000000u);
    uint32_t scratch = state.Options.Enabled ? uint32_t(std::min(uint64_t(state.Options.MaxGroupStates),maximumWork)) : 1;
    uint32_t selectedCapacity = state.Options.Enabled ? uint32_t(std::min(uint64_t(state.Options.MaxSelectedClusters),maximumWork)) : 1;
    ensure(frame.States,scratch,4);
    ensure(frame.Queue,scratch,4);
    ensure(frame.Visible,selectedCapacity,16);
    bool twoPass = state.Options.Enabled && state.Options.TwoPassOcclusion && state.Options.OcclusionCulling &&
        RendererSettings::GetTwoPhaseOcclusionEnabled() && OcclusionCulling::IsAvailable();
    uint32_t phaseCapacity = twoPass ? selectedCapacity : 1;
    for (auto* buffer : {&frame.First,&frame.Deferred,&frame.Second,&frame.Combined}) ensure(*buffer,phaseCapacity,16);
    ensure(frame.TemporalCounters,192,4);
    ensure(frame.TemporalArguments,3,12);
    VirtualGeometryResources::Prepare(graph);
    PrepareHistory(graph);
    Initialize();
    auto& p = state.Parameters;
    XMMATRIX view, projection;
    Camera::GetCameraMatrices(Camera::GetCameraEntity(),view,projection);
    XMStoreFloat4x4(&p.VP,view*projection);
    XMStoreFloat4x4(&p.PreviousVP,XMLoadFloat4x4(&GraphicsDevice::GetPreviousViewMatrix())*XMLoadFloat4x4(&GraphicsDevice::GetPreviousProjectionMatrix()));
    XMStoreFloat4(&p.Camera,XMMatrixInverse(nullptr,view).r[3]);
    p.Camera.w = 0;
    p.StreamingPadding[0] = p.StreamingPadding[1] = 0;
    if (state.Options.PredictiveStreaming && !GPUVisibility::CameraCut() && state.Options.ForceHierarchyLevel < 0)
    {
        const auto currentWorld = XMMatrixInverse(nullptr,view);
        const auto previousWorld = XMMatrixInverse(nullptr,XMLoadFloat4x4(&GraphicsDevice::GetPreviousViewMatrix()));
        const float seconds = static_cast<float>(std::clamp(World::GetFrameTimeMs()*0.001,0.001,0.1));
        const auto velocity = (currentWorld.r[3]-previousWorld.r[3])/seconds;
        const auto predictedOffset = velocity*std::clamp(state.Options.PrefetchSeconds,0.0f,2.0f) + currentWorld.r[2]*2.0f;
        const float length = XMVectorGetX(XMVector3Length(predictedOffset));
        if (std::isfinite(length) && length > 0.001f && std::isfinite(state.Options.MaxPrefetchDistance))
        {
            XMFLOAT3 direction;
            XMStoreFloat3(&direction,XMVector3Normalize(predictedOffset));
            auto pack = [](float value)
            {
                return static_cast<uint32_t>(std::clamp((value*0.5f+0.5f)*1023.0f,0.0f,1023.0f)+0.5f);
            };
            p.StreamingPadding[0] = pack(direction.x) | (pack(direction.y)<<10) | (pack(direction.z)<<20);
            p.StreamingPadding[1] = 1;
            p.Camera.w = std::min(length,std::max(0.0f,state.Options.MaxPrefetchDistance));
        }
    }
    XMFLOAT4X4 projectionValues;
    XMStoreFloat4x4(&projectionValues,projection);
    p.ProjectionPixels = 0.5f*float(GraphicsDevice::GetSceneHeight())*std::abs(projectionValues._22);
    p.TargetPixels = std::max(0.01f,state.Options.TargetErrorPixels);
    p.ForceLevel = std::clamp(state.Options.ForceHierarchyLevel,-1,31);
    p.Capacity = selectedCapacity;
    p.StateCapacity = scratch;
    p.ObjectCapacity = inputs.ObjectCapacity;
    p.Assets = VirtualGeometryResources::AssetCount();
    p.PageCount = VirtualGeometryStreaming::PageCount();
    p.RequestCapacity = VirtualGeometryStreaming::RequestCapacity;
    p.Materials = GpuScene::Statistics().Materials;
    p.Enabled = state.Options.Enabled;
    p.TwoPass = twoPass;
    p.HysteresisEnabled = p.Enabled && state.Options.HysteresisEnabled;
    p.HysteresisFraction = std::isfinite(state.Options.HysteresisFraction) ? std::clamp(state.Options.HysteresisFraction,0.0f,0.5f) : 0.1f;
    p.Frustum = state.Options.FrustumCulling;
    p.Cone = state.Options.ConeCulling;
    p.Occlusion = state.Options.OcclusionCulling && GPUVisibility::HistoryValid() && !GPUVisibility::GetSettings().FreezeCamera;
    p.Width = float(std::max(1u,OcclusionCulling::GetWidth()));
    p.Height = float(std::max(1u,OcclusionCulling::GetHeight()));
    p.Mips = std::max(1u,OcclusionCulling::GetMipCount());
    auto stats = Import(graph,"Nanite Counters",frame.Counters,D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_NON_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE);
    auto success = Import(graph,"Nanite Instance Routing",frame.Success,D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_NON_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE);
    auto visible = Import(graph,"Visible Virtual Clusters",frame.Visible,D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_NON_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE);
    auto arguments = Import(graph,"Nanite Dispatch Arguments",frame.Arguments,D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_INDIRECT_ARGUMENT);
    auto states = Import(graph,"Nanite Group States",frame.States,D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS);
    auto queue = Import(graph,"Nanite Traversal Queue",frame.Queue,D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS);
    auto history = Import(graph,"Native LOD history",state.History,D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS);
    auto historyHeaders = Import(graph,"Native LOD identities",frame.HistoryHeaders,D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_NON_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE);
    auto temporalCounters = Import(graph,"Native temporal counters",frame.TemporalCounters,D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_NON_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE);
    auto residency = Import(graph,"Geometry Residency",VirtualGeometryStreaming::ResidencyBuffer(),D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_NON_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE);
    std::vector<RenderGraph::ResourceHandle> feedback;
    for (auto* buffer : {&VirtualGeometryStreaming::RequestBitsBuffer(),&VirtualGeometryStreaming::RequestBuffer(),&VirtualGeometryStreaming::UsageBuffer()})
    {
        feedback.push_back(Import(graph,"Geometry Feedback",*buffer,D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS));
    }
    std::vector<RenderGraph::ResourceHandle> assetHandles;
    GpuSceneBuffer* assets[] = {&VirtualGeometryResources::AssetBuffer(),&VirtualGeometryResources::ClusterBuffer(),
        &VirtualGeometryResources::GroupBuffer(),&VirtualGeometryResources::HierarchyIndexBuffer(),&VirtualGeometryResources::RootBuffer()};
    for (auto* buffer : assets) assetHandles.push_back(Import(graph,"Nanite Asset SRV",*buffer,D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_NON_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE));
    auto external = [&](ID3D12Resource* resource,const char* name,D3D12_RESOURCE_STATES read)
    {
        auto existing = graph.FindImportedResource(resource);
        if (existing.IsValid()) return existing;
        RenderGraph::ImportedResource input{};
        input.Name = name; input.Resource = resource;
        input.InitialState = input.FinalState = read; input.HasFinalState = true;
        return graph.ImportResource(input);
    };
    auto material = external(GpuScene::MaterialBuffer(),"Nanite Materials",D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_NON_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE);
    RenderGraph::ResourceHandle hiz;
    if (OcclusionCulling::GetPreviousResource()) hiz = external(OcclusionCulling::GetPreviousResource(),"Nanite Hi-Z",OcclusionCulling::ReadState());
    graph.AddPass("Nanite Reset",
        [=](RenderGraph::PassBuilder& b)
        {
            b.Write(stats,D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS).Write(success,D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS);
            b.Write(temporalCounters,D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS).ReadWrite(history,D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS);
            for (auto handle : feedback) b.Write(handle,D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS);
        },
        [](ID3D12GraphicsCommandList* list)
        {
            Bind(list); list->SetPipelineState(Data().ResetPSO.Get());
            uint32_t resetCount = std::max({192u,Data().Inputs.ObjectCapacity,(Data().Parameters.PageCount+31)/32,
                Data().Parameters.ResetHistory ? Data().Parameters.HistoryCapacity : 0u});
            list->Dispatch(std::max(1u,(resetCount+63)/64),1,1);
        });
    graph.AddPass("Nanite Hierarchy Traversal",
        [=](RenderGraph::PassBuilder& b)
        {
            b.Read(inputs.Instances,D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_NON_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE)
                .Read(inputs.Objects,D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_NON_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE)
                .Read(inputs.Count,D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_NON_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE)
                .Read(material,D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_NON_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE);
            for (auto handle : assetHandles) b.Read(handle,D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_NON_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE);
            b.Read(residency,D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_NON_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE);
            b.Read(historyHeaders,D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_NON_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE)
                .ReadWrite(history,D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS).ReadWrite(temporalCounters,D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS);
            for (auto handle : feedback) b.ReadWrite(handle,D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS);
            if (hiz.IsValid()) b.Read(hiz,OcclusionCulling::ReadState());
            b.ReadWrite(stats,D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS).Write(success,D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS)
                .Write(visible,D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS).Write(states,D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS)
                .Write(queue,D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS);
        },
        [](ID3D12GraphicsCommandList* list)
        {
            RenderProfiler::ScopedEvent profile("Nanite Hierarchy Traversal",list);
            Bind(list); list->SetPipelineState(Data().TraversePSO.Get());
            uint32_t count = Data().Inputs.ObjectCapacity;
            uint32_t x = std::min(std::max(1u,count),65535u);
            list->Dispatch(x,std::max(1u,(count+x-1)/x),1);
        });
    graph.AddPass("Nanite Indirect Dispatch",
        [=](RenderGraph::PassBuilder& b) { b.ReadWrite(stats,D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS).Write(arguments,D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS); },
        [](ID3D12GraphicsCommandList* list) { Bind(list); list->SetPipelineState(Data().ArgumentsPSO.Get()); list->Dispatch(1,1,1); });
    state.Active = true;
    state.TemporalStats.HistoryBytes = state.History.MemoryBytes();
    state.TemporalStats.CandidateBytes = 0;
    for (const auto& item : state.Frames)
    {
        state.TemporalStats.HistoryBytes += item.HistoryHeaders.MemoryBytes();
        state.TemporalStats.CandidateBytes += item.First.MemoryBytes()+item.Deferred.MemoryBytes()+item.Second.MemoryBytes()+item.Combined.MemoryBytes()
            +item.TemporalCounters.MemoryBytes()+item.TemporalArguments.MemoryBytes()+(item.TemporalReadback ? 1024 : 0);
    }
    RenderProfiler::GeometryTemporalStatistics sample{};
    sample.FirstVisible = state.TemporalStats.FirstVisible;
    sample.Candidates = state.TemporalStats.Candidates;
    sample.SecondVisible = state.TemporalStats.SecondVisible;
    sample.LodTransitions = state.TemporalStats.LodTransitions;
    sample.CapacityFallbacks = state.TemporalStats.CapacityFallbacks;
    sample.HistoryBytes = state.TemporalStats.HistoryBytes;
    sample.CandidateBytes = state.TemporalStats.CandidateBytes;
    sample.HasSample = state.TemporalStats.HasSample;
    RenderProfiler::RecordGeometryTemporal(sample);
    if (TwoPassActive())
    {
        std::vector<RenderGraph::ResourceHandle> temporal;
        for (auto* buffer : {&frame.First,&frame.Deferred,&frame.Second,&frame.Combined})
            temporal.push_back(Import(graph,"Native phase clusters",*buffer,D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_NON_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE));
        auto temporalArgs = Import(graph,"Native phase arguments",frame.TemporalArguments,D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_INDIRECT_ARGUMENT);
        graph.AddPass("Native temporal partition",
            [=](RenderGraph::PassBuilder& b)
            {
                b.Read(inputs.Instances,D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_NON_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE)
                    .Read(visible,D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS).Read(stats,D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS)
                    .ReadWrite(temporalCounters,D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS);
                for (auto handle : assetHandles) b.Read(handle,D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_NON_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE);
                if (hiz.IsValid()) b.Read(hiz,OcclusionCulling::ReadState());
                for (auto handle : temporal) b.Write(handle,D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS);
            },
            [](ID3D12GraphicsCommandList* list)
            {
                RenderProfiler::ScopedEvent profile("Native temporal partition",list);
                Bind(list,1);
                list->SetPipelineState(Data().PartitionPSO.Get());
                list->Dispatch((Data().Parameters.Capacity+63)/64,1,1);
            });
        graph.AddPass("Native phase dispatch arguments",
            [=](RenderGraph::PassBuilder& b) { b.Read(temporalCounters,D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS).Write(temporalArgs,D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS); },
            [](ID3D12GraphicsCommandList* list)
            {
                Bind(list,1);
                list->SetPipelineState(Data().TemporalArgumentsPSO.Get());
                list->Dispatch(1,1,1);
            });
    }
}

void RecordFeedback(RenderGraph& graph)
{
    if (!Active()) return;
    auto& frame = Current();
    if (!frame.TemporalReadback)
    {
        auto heap = CD3DX12_HEAP_PROPERTIES(D3D12_HEAP_TYPE_READBACK);
        auto description = CD3DX12_RESOURCE_DESC::Buffer(1024);
        Check(GraphicsDevice::GetDevice()->CreateCommittedResource(&heap,D3D12_HEAP_FLAG_NONE,&description,
            D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_COPY_DEST,nullptr,IID_PPV_ARGS(&frame.TemporalReadback)));
    }
    auto counters = Import(graph,"Native temporal sample",frame.TemporalCounters,D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_NON_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE);
    auto routing = Import(graph,"Native routing sample",frame.Counters,D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_NON_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE);
    auto* target = &frame;
    uint64_t serial = Data().Serial;
    graph.AddPass("Native temporal feedback",
        [=](RenderGraph::PassBuilder& b) { b.Read(counters,D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_COPY_SOURCE).Read(routing,D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_COPY_SOURCE); },
        [=](ID3D12GraphicsCommandList* commands)
        {
            commands->CopyBufferRegion(target->TemporalReadback.Get(),0,target->TemporalCounters.Resource(),0,768);
            commands->CopyBufferRegion(target->TemporalReadback.Get(),768,target->Counters.Resource(),0,256);
            target->SampleFence = GraphicsDevice::GetPendingSubmissionFence();
            target->SampleSerial = serial;
            target->SampleTwoPass = TwoPassActive();
        });
    VirtualGeometryStreaming::RecordFeedbackCopy(graph);
}

void Retest(ID3D12GraphicsCommandList* commands)
{
    if (!Active()) return;
    RenderGraph graph;
    if (TwoPassActive())
    {
        auto& frame = Current();
        auto deferred = Import(graph,"Native deferred clusters",frame.Deferred,D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_NON_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE);
        auto second = Import(graph,"Native second-pass clusters",frame.Second,D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_NON_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE);
        auto combined = Import(graph,"Native combined clusters",frame.Combined,D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_NON_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE);
        auto counters = Import(graph,"Native phase counters",frame.TemporalCounters,D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_NON_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE);
        auto arguments = Import(graph,"Native phase arguments",frame.TemporalArguments,D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_INDIRECT_ARGUMENT);
        auto clusters = Import(graph,"Native cluster bounds",VirtualGeometryResources::ClusterBuffer(),D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_NON_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE);
        RenderGraph::ImportedResource input{};
        input.Name = "Native instance transforms";
        input.Resource = GpuScene::InstanceBuffer();
        input.InitialState = input.FinalState = D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_NON_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE;
        input.HasFinalState = true;
        auto instances = graph.ImportResource(input);
        RenderGraph::ResourceHandle hiz;
        if (OcclusionCulling::HasCurrent())
        {
            input.Name = "Native current Hi-Z";
            input.Resource = OcclusionCulling::GetCurrentResource();
            input.InitialState = input.FinalState = OcclusionCulling::ReadState();
            hiz = graph.ImportResource(input);
        }
        graph.AddPass("Native current-depth retest",
            [=](RenderGraph::PassBuilder& b)
            {
                b.Read(instances,D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_NON_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE).Read(clusters,D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_NON_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE)
                    .Read(deferred,D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS).ReadWrite(counters,D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS)
                    .Write(second,D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS).ReadWrite(combined,D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS);
                if (hiz.IsValid()) b.Read(hiz,OcclusionCulling::ReadState());
            },
            [](ID3D12GraphicsCommandList* list)
            {
                RenderProfiler::ScopedEvent profile("Native current-depth retest",list);
                Bind(list,2);
                list->SetPipelineState(Data().RetestPSO.Get());
                list->Dispatch((Data().Parameters.Capacity+63)/64,1,1);
            });
        graph.AddPass("Native final dispatch arguments",
            [=](RenderGraph::PassBuilder& b) { b.Read(counters,D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS).Write(arguments,D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS); },
            [](ID3D12GraphicsCommandList* list)
            {
                Bind(list,2);
                list->SetPipelineState(Data().TemporalArgumentsPSO.Get());
                list->Dispatch(1,1,1);
            });
    }
    RecordFeedback(graph);
    if (!graph.Compile() || !graph.Execute(commands)) throw std::runtime_error(graph.GetLastError());
}
void EndFrame()
{
    if (Data().Active && Data().Options.DebugReadback)
    {
        std::vector<uint8_t> bytes;
        if (RenderCapture::ReadBuffer(Current().Counters.Resource(),Current().Counters.State,256,bytes))
        {
            memcpy(Data().Debug.data(),bytes.data(),256);
        }
    }
}
void Shutdown() { VirtualGeometryResources::Shutdown(); Data() = {}; }
}

#pragma once
#include "virtualgeometryconfig.h"
#include <array>
#include <cstddef>
#include <type_traits>

// Portable CPU layout mirrors StaticModelVertex; no D3D resource ownership.
struct VirtualGeometryVertex
{
    float Position[3]{};
    float Normal[3]{};
    float TexCoord[2]{};
    float Diffuse[4]{};
};
static_assert(std::is_standard_layout_v<VirtualGeometryVertex>);
static_assert(sizeof(VirtualGeometryVertex) == 12 * sizeof(float));
static_assert(offsetof(VirtualGeometryVertex, Normal) == 3 * sizeof(float));

struct VirtualGeometrySphere
{
    std::array<float, 3> Center{};
    float Radius = 0;
};
struct VirtualGeometryAabb
{
    std::array<float, 3> Min{};
    std::array<float, 3> Max{};
};
struct VirtualGeometryNormalCone
{
    std::array<float, 3> Axis{};
    std::array<float, 3> Apex{};
    float Cutoff = 1;
};
struct VirtualGeometryCluster
{
    uint32_t VertexOffset = 0;
    uint32_t VertexCount = 0;
    uint32_t TriangleOffset = 0; // Byte offset: three uint8_t indices per triangle.
    uint32_t TriangleCount = 0;
    uint32_t Level = 0;
    uint32_t GroupIndex = VirtualGeometryConfig::InvalidIndex; // Consuming group; invalid for roots.
    uint32_t GeneratingGroupIndex = VirtualGeometryConfig::InvalidIndex;
    uint32_t MaterialId = 0; // Stable source section ID, distinct from shader MaterialPartId.
    VirtualGeometrySphere Bounds;
    VirtualGeometryAabb Aabb;
    VirtualGeometryNormalCone Cone;
    float LodError = 0;
};
struct VirtualGeometryClusterGroup
{
    uint32_t Level = 0; // Child level.
    uint32_t FirstChild = 0;
    uint32_t ChildCount = 0;
    uint32_t FirstParent = 0;
    uint32_t ParentCount = 0;
    VirtualGeometrySphere Bounds; // Covers descendant geometry, not just simplified parents.
    float MinError = 0;
    float MaxError = 0;
};
struct VirtualGeometryLevelStats
{
    uint32_t Clusters = 0;
    uint64_t Triangles = 0;
    uint64_t Vertices = 0;
};
struct VirtualGeometryBuildStats
{
    uint64_t SourceVertices = 0;
    uint64_t SourceTriangles = 0;
    uint64_t RemovedDegenerateTriangles = 0;
    uint64_t RemovedDuplicateTriangles = 0;
    uint64_t FinalLeafTriangles = 0;
    uint32_t LeafClusters = 0;
    uint32_t TotalClusters = 0;
    uint32_t TotalGroups = 0;
    uint32_t HierarchyLevels = 0;
    uint32_t MaximumTrianglesPerCluster = 0;
    uint32_t MaximumVerticesPerCluster = 0;
    double AverageTrianglesPerCluster = 0;
    double AverageVerticesPerCluster = 0;
    uint64_t SourceMemoryBytes = 0;
    uint64_t RawMemoryBytes = 0;
    double BuildMilliseconds = 0; // Telemetry; excluded from deterministic serialization/hash.
};

    WriteGraphicsLog("VirtualGeometry validation: %s %s\n",condition ? "PASS" : "FAIL",label);
    if (!condition) ++failures;
}

void WriteFixture()
{
    std::filesystem::create_directories("build/virtualgeometry-phase6");
    std::ofstream file("build/virtualgeometry-phase6/curved.obj");
    constexpr uint32_t size = 96;
    file << "vn 0 0 -1\n";
    for (uint32_t y = 0; y <= size; ++y)
    {
        for (uint32_t x = 0; x <= size; ++x)
        {
            float px = float(x)*8/size-4, py = float(y)*8/size-4;
            float z = 0.4f*sinf(px*2.3f)*cosf(py*1.7f);
            file << "v " << px << ' ' << py << ' ' << z << '\n';
        }
    }
    for (uint32_t y = 0; y < size; ++y)
    {
        for (uint32_t x = 0; x < size; ++x)
        {
            uint32_t a = y*(size+1)+x+1, b = a+1, c = a+size+1, d = c+1;
            file << "f " << a << "//1 " << c << "//1 " << b << "//1\nf " << b << "//1 " << c << "//1 " << d << "//1\n";
        }
    }
}
bool Capture(const wchar_t* path)
{
    return RenderCapture::SaveTexturePng(RenderTargets::GetGBufferResource(GBufferType::EMISSION_AO),path);
}
std::vector<bool> Coverage()
{
    RenderCapture::TextureData texture;
    if (!RenderCapture::ReadTexture(RenderTargets::GetGBufferResource(GBufferType::EMISSION_AO),texture) ||
        texture.Format != DXGI_FORMAT_R16G16B16A16_FLOAT)
    {
        return {};
    }
    std::vector<bool> mask;
    mask.reserve(size_t(texture.Width)*texture.Height);
    for (uint32_t row = 0; row < texture.Height; ++row)
    {
        auto pixels = reinterpret_cast<const uint16_t*>(texture.Bytes.data()+size_t(row)*texture.RowPitch);
        for (uint32_t column = 0; column < texture.Width; ++column)
        {
            float color = RenderCapture::HalfToFloat(pixels[column*4])+RenderCapture::HalfToFloat(pixels[column*4+1])+
                RenderCapture::HalfToFloat(pixels[column*4+2]);
            mask.push_back(color > 0.1f);
        }
    }
    return mask;
}
bool HasVisibleCenterDepth()
{
    RenderCapture::TextureData depth;
    if (!RenderCapture::ReadTexture(RenderTargets::GetGBufferResource(GBufferType::DEPTH), depth) ||
        depth.Format != DXGI_FORMAT_R32_FLOAT || !depth.Width || !depth.Height)
        return false;
    float centerDepth = 1;
    memcpy(&centerDepth, depth.Bytes.data()+size_t(depth.Height/2)*depth.RowPitch+
        size_t(depth.Width/2)*sizeof(float), sizeof(float));
    return std::isfinite(centerDepth) && centerDepth >= 0 && centerDepth < 1;
}
void CompareTraditionalRaster()
{
    uint64_t changed = 0, compared = 0;
    for (size_t target = 0; target < comparisonTargets.size(); ++target)
    {
        RenderCapture::TextureData traditional;
        const auto& native = nativeReference[target];
        if (!RenderCapture::ReadTexture(RenderTargets::GetGBufferResource(comparisonTargets[target]), traditional) ||
            traditional.Width != native.Width || traditional.Height != native.Height ||
            traditional.Format != native.Format || native.Bytes.empty())
        {
            Check(false, "native/traditional GBuffer readback dimensions");
            return;
        }
        const auto description = RenderTargets::GetGBufferResource(comparisonTargets[target])->GetDesc();
        UINT64 rowBytes = 0;
        GraphicsDevice::GetDevice()->GetCopyableFootprints(&description, 0, 1, 0, nullptr, nullptr, &rowBytes, nullptr);
        for (uint32_t row = 0; row < native.Height; ++row)
        {
            for (size_t byte = 0; byte < rowBytes; ++byte)
            {
                changed += abs(int(native.Bytes[size_t(row)*native.RowPitch+byte]) -
                    int(traditional.Bytes[size_t(row)*traditional.RowPitch+byte])) > 1;
                ++compared;
            }
        }
    }
    WriteGraphicsLog("VirtualGeometry native/traditional GBuffer changed bytes = %llu / %llu\n", changed, compared);
    Check(compared != 0 && changed <= compared/10000, "native leaf material/normal GBuffer matches traditional raster");
}
}
bool Enabled()
{
    char value[8]{};
    return GetEnvironmentVariableA("DX12_VIRTUAL_GEOMETRY_STRESS_TEST",value,sizeof(value)) && atoi(value) != 0;
}
void BeforeFrame(uint64_t frame)
{
    if (frame == 0)
    {
        std::vector<uint32_t> remove;
        for (uint32_t entity = 0; entity < Registry::GetEntities().size(); ++entity)
        {
            if (Registry::IsAlive(entity) && !ComponentManager::HasComponent<CameraComponent>(entity)) remove.push_back(entity);
        }
        for (uint32_t entity : remove) World::DestroyEntity(Entity(entity));
        WriteFixture();
        int model = ModelManager::LoadStaticModel("build/virtualgeometry-phase6/curved.obj",false);
        Check(model >= 0,"import curved hierarchy fixture");
        Entity entity = World::CreateEntity();
        entity.Add<TransformComponent>().Add<StaticModelComponent>().Add<MaterialComponent>().Add<ShaderComponent>().Add<NameComponent>();
        fixture = entity.GetID();
        entity.Get<NameComponent>().Name = "Native hierarchy acceptance fixture";
        entity.Get<StaticModelComponent>().ModelId = model;
        auto& material = entity.Get<MaterialComponent>();
        material.ShaderClassMode = MaterialMode::Manual;
        material.ShaderClass = ShaderClass::PBR;
        material.UseTexture = false;
        World::SetVSyncEnabled(false);
        auto* imported = ModelManager::GetStaticModel(model);
        Check(imported && imported->GetMeshCount() != 0,"native fixture imported mesh");
        if (imported && imported->GetMeshCount())
        {
            const auto& runtime = imported->GetMeshData(0).VirtualGeometryLODs[0];
            Check(runtime && runtime->Error.empty() && runtime->Hierarchy.Levels.size() > 1,"fixture has drawable parent hierarchy");
        }
    }
    if (warmupStart == UINT64_MAX && frame > 0 && VirtualGeometryStreaming::PageCount() > 0 &&
        VirtualGeometryStreaming::GetStatistics().Resident == VirtualGeometryStreaming::PageCount())
    {
        warmupStart = frame;
        WriteGraphicsLog("VirtualGeometry streaming warmup completed at frame %llu\n",frame);
    }
    frame = warmupStart == UINT64_MAX ? 0 : frame-warmupStart;
    RenderConfiguration::SetRenderMode(RenderMode::DEFERRED);
    RendererSettings::SetMeshShadersEnabled(false);
    RendererSettings::SetComputeGBufferEnabled(false);
    RendererSettings::SetTwoPhaseOcclusionEnabled(false);
    RendererSettings::SetUpscaleMode(UpscaleMode::Bilateral);
    DayNightCycle::GetSettings().Running = false;
    GPUDrivenRenderer::SetEnabled(true);
    MeshShaderRenderer::GetSettings().Enabled = true;
    auto& options = VirtualGeometryTraversal::GetSettings();
    options.Enabled = frame < 20;
    options.DebugReadback = true;
    options.LevelColors = true;
    options.FrustumCulling = false;
    options.ConeCulling = false;
    options.OcclusionCulling = false;
    options.TargetErrorPixels = 1;
    options.ForceHierarchyLevel = frame < 4 ? 0 : frame < 8 ? 2 : -1;
    if (frame >= 24)
    {
        options.Enabled = frame < 28 || frame >= 32;
        options.LevelColors = false;
        options.ForceHierarchyLevel = 0;
        MeshShaderRenderer::GetSettings().Enabled = frame < 28 || frame >= 32;
        GPUDrivenRenderer::SetEnabled(frame < 28 || frame >= 32);
    }
    if (frame == 32)
    {
        // Manual Unlit is rendered by the traditional path, outside native eligibility.
        Entity(fixture).Get<MaterialComponent>().ShaderClass = ShaderClass::Unlit;
        GpuSceneChanges::Notify(fixture, GpuSceneDirtyFlags::Material);
    }
    GPUVisibility::GetSettings().LOD = true;
    if (frame >= 24) GPUVisibility::GetSettings().LOD = false;
    GPUVisibility::GetSettings().Occlusion = false;
    auto cameraEntity = Camera::GetCameraEntity();
    if (Registry::IsAlive(cameraEntity))
    {
        auto& transform = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<TransformComponent>(cameraEntity);
        auto& camera = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<CameraComponent>(cameraEntity);
        transform.Position = {0,0,frame >= 12 && frame < 16 ? -100.0f : -5.0f};
        transform.IsDirty = true;
        camera.Target = {0,0,0};
    }
}
void AfterFrame(uint64_t frame)
{
    if (warmupStart == UINT64_MAX) return;
    frame -= warmupStart;
    if (frame == 3 || frame == 7 || frame == 11 || frame == 15)
    {
        Check(VirtualGeometryTraversal::Active(),"native traversal active in frame pipeline");
        const auto& sample = VirtualGeometryTraversal::DebugCounters();
        Check(sample[4] != 0 && sample[1] != 0 && sample[3] == 0,"complete native selection without capacity fallback");
        if (frame == 3)
        {
            Check(sample[8] == sample[1],"Force Level 0 selects leaves");
            Check(Capture(L"build/virtualgeometry-phase6/forced-leaf.png"),"capture selected leaf colors");
            leafCoverage = Coverage();
            Check(!leafCoverage.empty(),"read leaf raster coverage");
        }
        if (frame == 7)
        {
            uint32_t parents = 0;
            for (uint32_t level = 1; level < 32; ++level) parents += sample[8+level];
            Check(parents != 0,"Force Level renders nonleaf clusters");
            Check(Capture(L"build/virtualgeometry-phase6/forced-parent.png"),"capture actual parent colors");
            Check(Coverage() == leafCoverage,"parent transition preserves full raster coverage without cracks");
        }
        if (frame == 11)
        {
            nearClusters = sample[1];
            uint32_t selectedLevels = 0;
            for (uint32_t level = 0; level < 32; ++level) selectedLevels += sample[8+level] != 0;
            Check(selectedLevels > 1,"one mesh selects multiple hierarchy levels simultaneously");
            Check(Capture(L"build/virtualgeometry-phase6/near.png"),"capture automatic near hierarchy");
            Check(Coverage() == leafCoverage,"mixed-level selection preserves complete raster coverage");
        }
        if (frame == 15)
        {
            farClusters = sample[1];
            Check(farClusters < nearClusters,"camera distance coarsens cluster selection");
            Check(Capture(L"build/virtualgeometry-phase6/far.png"),"capture automatic far hierarchy");
        }
    }
    if (frame == 19)
    {
        Check(VirtualGeometryTraversal::DebugCounters()[1] == nearClusters,"camera return refines back to near detail");
    }
    if (frame == 23)
    {
        Check(MeshShaderRenderer::IsActive() && VirtualGeometryTraversal::DebugCounters()[4] == 0,"native disabled restores legacy discrete LOD path");
        CheckGraphicsErrors();
    }
    if (frame == 27)
    {
        Check(HasVisibleCenterDepth(), "native material reference contains visible geometry");
        Check(VirtualGeometryTraversal::DebugCounters()[1] != 0 &&
            VirtualGeometryTraversal::DebugCounters()[8] == VirtualGeometryTraversal::DebugCounters()[1],
            "material reference uses native leaves");
        for (size_t target = 0; target < comparisonTargets.size(); ++target)
            Check(RenderCapture::ReadTexture(RenderTargets::GetGBufferResource(comparisonTargets[target]), nativeReference[target]),
                "capture native material reference");
    }
    if (frame == 31)
    {
        Check(HasVisibleCenterDepth(), "traditional material comparison contains visible geometry");
        CompareTraditionalRaster();
    }
    if (frame == 35)
    {
        completedChecks = true;
        Check(!GPUDrivenRenderer::SupportsEntity(fixture) && !GPUDrivenRenderer::HandlesEntity(fixture),
            "unsupported Unlit material uses traditional renderer");
        Check(HasVisibleCenterDepth(), "unsupported material retains visible center depth");
        CheckGraphicsErrors();
    }
}
bool Finish()
{
    Check(completedChecks,"all 36 acceptance stages executed after streaming warmup");
    CheckGraphicsErrors();
    WriteGraphicsLog("VirtualGeometry validation failures = %u\n",failures);
    return failures == 0;
}
}

#pragma once

===== FILE: virtualgeometry\virtualgeometryvalidator.cpp =====
#include "virtualgeometryvalidator.h"
#include "virtualgeometryinternal.h"
#include <algorithm>
#include <bit>
#include <cmath>
#include <unordered_map>

namespace
{
    using namespace VirtualGeometryInternal;
    bool Finite(const std::array<float, 3>& values)
    {
        return std::all_of(values.begin(), values.end(), [](float value) { return std::isfinite(value); });
    }

    bool ValidSphere(const VirtualGeometrySphere& sphere)
    {
        return Finite(sphere.Center) && std::isfinite(sphere.Radius) && sphere.Radius >= 0;
    }

    bool Contains(const VirtualGeometrySphere& outer, const VirtualGeometrySphere& inner, float epsilon)
    {
        double distanceSquared = 0;
        for (size_t axis = 0; axis < 3; ++axis)
        {
            double difference = double(outer.Center[axis]) - inner.Center[axis];
            distanceSquared += difference * difference;
        }
        double tolerance = std::max(double(epsilon), double(outer.Radius) * 1e-5);
        return std::sqrt(distanceSquared) + inner.Radius <= outer.Radius + tolerance;
    }

    struct PositionKey
    {
        std::array<uint32_t, 3> Bits{};
        explicit PositionKey(const VirtualGeometryVertex& vertex)
        {
            for (size_t axis = 0; axis < 3; ++axis)
            {
                Bits[axis] = vertex.Position[axis] == 0 ? 0 : std::bit_cast<uint32_t>(vertex.Position[axis]);
            }
        }
        bool operator==(const PositionKey&) const = default;
    };
    struct PositionHash
    {
        size_t operator()(const PositionKey& position) const
        {
            size_t hash = 0;
            for (uint32_t bits : position.Bits)
            {
                hash = hash * 16777619u ^ bits;
            }
            return hash;
        }
    };
    using EdgeCounts = std::unordered_map<uint64_t, uint32_t>;

    void AddEdges(const VirtualGeometryAsset& asset, uint32_t clusterIndex,
        const std::vector<uint32_t>& positionIds, EdgeCounts& counts)
    {
        const auto& cluster = asset.Clusters[clusterIndex];
        for (uint32_t triangle = 0; triangle < cluster.TriangleCount; ++triangle)
        {
            for (uint32_t corner = 0; corner < 3; ++corner)
            {
                uint32_t first = positionIds[cluster.VertexOffset +
                    asset.TriangleIndices[cluster.TriangleOffset + triangle * 3 + corner]];
                uint32_t second = positionIds[cluster.VertexOffset +
                    asset.TriangleIndices[cluster.TriangleOffset + triangle * 3 + (corner + 1) % 3]];
                ++counts[uint64_t(std::min(first, second)) << 32 | std::max(first, second)];
            }
        }
    }

    bool ValidateGroupBoundaries(const VirtualGeometryAsset& asset, std::string& error)
    {
        std::unordered_map<PositionKey, uint32_t, PositionHash> positions;
        std::vector<uint32_t> positionIds;
        positionIds.reserve(asset.Vertices.size());
        for (const auto& vertex : asset.Vertices)
        {
            auto [entry, inserted] = positions.emplace(PositionKey(vertex), CheckedIndex(positions.size()));
            positionIds.push_back(entry->second);
        }
        // Build positional edge incidence once per level. No pairwise cluster comparisons.
        struct Incidence
        {
            uint32_t Count = 0;
            uint32_t Group = VirtualGeometryConfig::InvalidIndex;
            bool Shared = false;
        };
        std::vector<std::unordered_map<uint64_t, Incidence>> levelEdges(asset.Levels.size());
        for (uint32_t index = 0; index < asset.Clusters.size(); ++index)
        {
            const auto& cluster = asset.Clusters[index];
            EdgeCounts edges;
            AddEdges(asset, index, positionIds, edges);
            for (const auto& [key, count] : edges)
            {
                auto& incidence = levelEdges[cluster.Level][key];
                if (incidence.Count == 0)
                {
                    incidence.Group = cluster.GroupIndex;
                }
                incidence.Shared |= incidence.Group != cluster.GroupIndex;
                incidence.Count += count;
            }
        }
        for (const auto& group : asset.Groups)
        {
            EdgeCounts before;
            EdgeCounts after;
            for (uint32_t child = 0; child < group.ChildCount; ++child)
            {
                AddEdges(asset, asset.HierarchyIndices[group.FirstChild + child], positionIds, before);
            }
            for (uint32_t parent = 0; parent < group.ParentCount; ++parent)
            {
                AddEdges(asset, asset.HierarchyIndices[group.FirstParent + parent], positionIds, after);
            }
            for (const auto& [key, count] : before)
            {
                const auto& incidence = levelEdges[group.Level].at(key);
                bool protectedEdge = count != 2 || incidence.Shared || incidence.Count != 2;
                if (protectedEdge && (!after.contains(key) || after.at(key) != count))
                {
                    error = "Group boundary geometry changed across LOD";
                    return false;
                }
            }
            for (const auto& [key, count] : after)
            {
                if (count != 2 && (!before.contains(key) || before.at(key) != count))
                {
                    error = "Parent geometry introduces a boundary/non-manifold edge";
                    return false;
                }
            }
        }
        return true;
    }

    bool ValidateData(const VirtualGeometryAsset& asset, std::string& error)
    {
        auto fail = [&error](const char* message)
        {
            error = message;
            return false;
        };
        if (asset.Version != VirtualGeometryConfig::AssetVersion || !ValidateVirtualGeometryConfig(asset.Config, error))
        {
            return fail("Unsupported asset version or invalid build config");
        }
        if (asset.Clusters.empty() || asset.RootClusters.empty() || asset.Levels.empty() ||
            asset.Levels.size() > asset.Config.MaxHierarchyLevels || !std::isfinite(asset.SourceMaterialPartId))
        {
            return fail("Empty or invalid virtual geometry asset");
        }
        if (asset.Vertices.size() >= VirtualGeometryConfig::InvalidIndex ||
            asset.TriangleIndices.size() >= VirtualGeometryConfig::InvalidIndex ||
            asset.Clusters.size() >= VirtualGeometryConfig::InvalidIndex ||
            asset.Groups.size() >= VirtualGeometryConfig::InvalidIndex ||
            asset.HierarchyIndices.size() >= VirtualGeometryConfig::InvalidIndex)
        {
            return fail("Asset exceeds 32-bit addressing");
        }
        for (const auto& vertex : asset.Vertices)
        {
            if (!IsFiniteVertex(vertex))
            {
                return fail("Non-finite asset vertex");
            }
        }
        std::vector<VirtualGeometryLevelStats> measured(asset.Levels.size());
        uint64_t vertexEnd = 0;
        uint64_t triangleEnd = 0;
        uint32_t maximumTriangles = 0;
        uint32_t maximumVertices = 0;
        for (const auto& cluster : asset.Clusters)
        {
            if (cluster.VertexCount == 0 || cluster.VertexCount > asset.Config.MaxClusterVertices ||
                cluster.TriangleCount == 0 || cluster.TriangleCount > asset.Config.MaxClusterTriangles ||
                cluster.Level >= asset.Levels.size() || cluster.MaterialId != asset.SourceMaterialId ||
                !RangeFits(cluster.VertexOffset, cluster.VertexCount, asset.Vertices.size()) ||
                !RangeFits(cluster.TriangleOffset, uint64_t(cluster.TriangleCount) * 3, asset.TriangleIndices.size()) ||
                cluster.VertexOffset != vertexEnd || cluster.TriangleOffset != triangleEnd)
            {
                return fail("Invalid cluster ranges, limits, level, or material");
            }
            vertexEnd += cluster.VertexCount;
            triangleEnd += uint64_t(cluster.TriangleCount) * 3;
            if (!ValidSphere(cluster.Bounds) || !Finite(cluster.Aabb.Min) || !Finite(cluster.Aabb.Max) ||
                !Finite(cluster.Cone.Axis) || !Finite(cluster.Cone.Apex) ||
                !std::isfinite(cluster.Cone.Cutoff) || cluster.Cone.Cutoff < 0 || cluster.Cone.Cutoff > 1 ||
                !std::isfinite(cluster.LodError) || cluster.LodError < 0 ||
                (cluster.Level == 0 && cluster.LodError != 0))
            {
                return fail("Invalid cluster bounds/cone/error");
            }
            for (size_t axis = 0; axis < 3; ++axis)
            {
                if (cluster.Aabb.Min[axis] > cluster.Aabb.Max[axis])
                {
                    return fail("Inverted AABB");
                }
            }
            for (uint32_t vertexIndex = 0; vertexIndex < cluster.VertexCount; ++vertexIndex)
            {
                const auto& vertex = asset.Vertices[cluster.VertexOffset + vertexIndex];
                VirtualGeometrySphere point;
                std::copy_n(vertex.Position, 3, point.Center.begin());
                if (!Contains(cluster.Bounds, point, asset.Config.BoundaryEpsilon))
                {
                    return fail("Cluster sphere does not cover geometry");
                }
                for (size_t axis = 0; axis < 3; ++axis)
                {
                    if (vertex.Position[axis] < cluster.Aabb.Min[axis] || vertex.Position[axis] > cluster.Aabb.Max[axis])
                    {
                        return fail("Cluster AABB does not cover geometry");
                    }
                }
            }
            for (uint32_t index = 0; index < cluster.TriangleCount * 3; ++index)
            {
                if (asset.TriangleIndices[cluster.TriangleOffset + index] >= cluster.VertexCount)
                {
                    return fail("Cluster-local triangle index out of bounds");
                }
            }
            auto& level = measured[cluster.Level];
            ++level.Clusters;
            level.Triangles += cluster.TriangleCount;
            level.Vertices += cluster.VertexCount;
            maximumTriangles = std::max(maximumTriangles, cluster.TriangleCount);
            maximumVertices = std::max(maximumVertices, cluster.VertexCount);
        }
        if (vertexEnd != asset.Vertices.size() || triangleEnd != asset.TriangleIndices.size())
        {
            return fail("Unreferenced geometry payload");
        }
        std::vector<uint32_t> consumers(asset.Clusters.size(), VirtualGeometryConfig::InvalidIndex);
        std::vector<uint32_t> producers(asset.Clusters.size(), VirtualGeometryConfig::InvalidIndex);
        uint64_t hierarchyEnd = 0;
        for (uint32_t index = 0; index < asset.Groups.size(); ++index)
        {
            const auto& group = asset.Groups[index];
            if (group.ChildCount == 0 || group.ParentCount == 0 || group.ParentCount >= group.ChildCount ||
                !RangeFits(group.FirstChild, group.ChildCount, asset.HierarchyIndices.size()) ||
                !RangeFits(group.FirstParent, group.ParentCount, asset.HierarchyIndices.size()) ||
                group.FirstChild != hierarchyEnd || uint64_t(group.FirstParent) != hierarchyEnd + group.ChildCount ||
                !ValidSphere(group.Bounds) || !std::isfinite(group.MinError) || !std::isfinite(group.MaxError) ||
                group.MinError < 0 || group.MaxError < group.MinError)
            {
                return fail("Invalid cluster group ranges/bounds/error");
            }
            hierarchyEnd += uint64_t(group.ChildCount) + group.ParentCount;
            float maximumChildError = 0;
            uint64_t childTriangles = 0;
            uint64_t parentTriangles = 0;
            for (uint32_t child = 0; child < group.ChildCount; ++child)
            {
                uint32_t childIndex = asset.HierarchyIndices[group.FirstChild + child];
                if (childIndex >= asset.Clusters.size() || consumers[childIndex] != VirtualGeometryConfig::InvalidIndex)
                {
                    return fail("Invalid or duplicate group child");
                }
                consumers[childIndex] = index;
                const auto& cluster = asset.Clusters[childIndex];
                if (cluster.Level != group.Level || cluster.GroupIndex != index)
                {
                    return fail("Child level/group mismatch");
                }
                const auto& descendantBounds = cluster.GeneratingGroupIndex == VirtualGeometryConfig::InvalidIndex
                    ? cluster.Bounds : asset.Groups.at(cluster.GeneratingGroupIndex).Bounds;
                if (!Contains(group.Bounds, descendantBounds, asset.Config.BoundaryEpsilon))
                {
                    return fail("Group sphere does not cover descendants");
                }
                maximumChildError = std::max(maximumChildError, cluster.LodError);
                childTriangles += cluster.TriangleCount;
            }
            if (group.MinError != maximumChildError)
            {
                return fail("Group minimum error does not match its children");
            }
            for (uint32_t parent = 0; parent < group.ParentCount; ++parent)
            {
                uint32_t parentIndex = asset.HierarchyIndices[group.FirstParent + parent];
                if (parentIndex >= asset.Clusters.size() || producers[parentIndex] != VirtualGeometryConfig::InvalidIndex)
                {
                    return fail("Invalid or duplicate group parent");
                }
                producers[parentIndex] = index;
                const auto& cluster = asset.Clusters[parentIndex];
                // Strict level increase proves acyclicity without recursive stack traversal.
                if (uint64_t(cluster.Level) != uint64_t(group.Level) + 1 || cluster.GeneratingGroupIndex != index ||
                    cluster.LodError < maximumChildError || cluster.LodError != group.MaxError)
                {
                    return fail("Hierarchy cycle/level/parent error mismatch");
                }
                parentTriangles += cluster.TriangleCount;
            }
            if (parentTriangles >= childTriangles)
            {
                return fail("Non-reducing hierarchy group");
            }
        }
        if (hierarchyEnd != asset.HierarchyIndices.size())
        {
            return fail("Unreferenced hierarchy payload");
        }
        std::vector<bool> roots(asset.Clusters.size());
        for (uint32_t root : asset.RootClusters)
        {
            if (root >= asset.Clusters.size() || roots[root] || consumers[root] != VirtualGeometryConfig::InvalidIndex)
            {
                return fail("Invalid, duplicate, or consumed root");
            }
            roots[root] = true;
        }
        for (size_t index = 0; index < asset.Clusters.size(); ++index)
        {
            const auto& cluster = asset.Clusters[index];
            bool isRoot = consumers[index] == VirtualGeometryConfig::InvalidIndex;
            bool isLeaf = cluster.Level == 0;
            if (roots[index] != isRoot || cluster.GroupIndex != consumers[index] ||
                cluster.GeneratingGroupIndex != producers[index] ||
                isLeaf != (producers[index] == VirtualGeometryConfig::InvalidIndex))
            {
                return fail("Orphan cluster or inconsistent producer/consumer/root metadata");
            }
        }
        const auto& stats = asset.Stats;
        if (stats.SourceVertices == 0 || stats.SourceVertices >= VirtualGeometryConfig::InvalidIndex ||
            stats.SourceTriangles == 0 || stats.SourceTriangles >= VirtualGeometryConfig::InvalidIndex / 3 ||
            stats.RemovedDegenerateTriangles > stats.SourceTriangles ||
            stats.RemovedDuplicateTriangles > stats.SourceTriangles - stats.RemovedDegenerateTriangles ||
            stats.FinalLeafTriangles != stats.SourceTriangles - stats.RemovedDegenerateTriangles - stats.RemovedDuplicateTriangles ||
            stats.FinalLeafTriangles != measured[0].Triangles || stats.LeafClusters != measured[0].Clusters ||
            stats.TotalClusters != asset.Clusters.size() || stats.TotalGroups != asset.Groups.size() ||
            stats.HierarchyLevels != asset.Levels.size() || stats.MaximumTrianglesPerCluster != maximumTriangles ||
            stats.MaximumVerticesPerCluster != maximumVertices || !std::isfinite(stats.BuildMilliseconds) || stats.BuildMilliseconds < 0)
        {
            return fail("Invalid source/leaf/asset statistics");
        }
        uint64_t allTriangles = 0;
        uint64_t allVertices = 0;
        for (size_t level = 0; level < measured.size(); ++level)
        {
            const auto& expected = asset.Levels[level];
            const auto& actual = measured[level];
            if (actual.Clusters == 0 || expected.Clusters != actual.Clusters ||
                expected.Triangles != actual.Triangles || expected.Vertices != actual.Vertices)
            {
                return fail("Invalid per-level statistics");
            }
            allTriangles += actual.Triangles;
            allVertices += actual.Vertices;
        }
        uint64_t rawBytes = uint64_t(asset.Vertices.size()) * sizeof(VirtualGeometryVertex) + asset.TriangleIndices.size() +
            uint64_t(asset.Clusters.size()) * sizeof(VirtualGeometryCluster) + uint64_t(asset.Groups.size()) * sizeof(VirtualGeometryClusterGroup) +
            uint64_t(asset.HierarchyIndices.size() + asset.RootClusters.size()) * sizeof(uint32_t) +
            uint64_t(asset.Levels.size()) * sizeof(VirtualGeometryLevelStats);
        if (stats.AverageTrianglesPerCluster != double(allTriangles) / asset.Clusters.size() ||
            stats.AverageVerticesPerCluster != double(allVertices) / asset.Clusters.size() ||
            stats.RawMemoryBytes != rawBytes || stats.SourceMemoryBytes != stats.SourceVertices * sizeof(VirtualGeometryVertex) +
                stats.SourceTriangles * 3 * sizeof(uint32_t))
        {
            return fail("Invalid memory/average statistics");
        }
        return ValidateGroupBoundaries(asset, error);
    }
}

bool VirtualGeometryValidator::Validate(const VirtualGeometryAsset& asset, std::string& error)
{
    error.clear();
    try
    {
        return ValidateData(asset, error);
    }
    catch (const std::exception& exception)
    {
        error = exception.what();
        return false;
    }
}

===== FILE: virtualgeometry\virtualgeometryvalidator.h =====
#pragma once
#include "virtualgeometryasset.h"

class VirtualGeometryValidator
{
public:
    // Explicit error in Debug AND Release. Never logs-and-continues on invalid data.
    static bool Validate(const VirtualGeometryAsset& asset, std::string& error);
};
